pmid-10531722.summary_en: A 17-year-old man presented with upper gastrointestinal bleeding, and endoscopic fine needle aspiration of a duodenal mass suggested a germ cell tumor. Histology of the testis later confirmed a germ cell tumor, establishing that the duodenal lesion was a metastasis from a testicular primary. The case highlights that upper GI bleeding can be the first presentation of metastatic testicular tumor and that endoscopic aspiration cytology can provide diagnosis.

pmid-10533299.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍31例を対象に、PCNAとKi-67の免疫反応性を免疫組織化学染色で評価した。PCNAスコアが高いと予後が不良で、両マーカーは病期よりも再発や腫瘍死をよく予測した。増殖マーカーにより低リスク群と高リスク群を層別化できる可能性があり、早期例でも術後の積極的な化学療法を考慮すべきと提案されている。
pmid-10533299.summary_en: Thirty-one patients with surgically resected malignant ovarian germ cell tumors were evaluated for PCNA and Ki-67 immunoreactivity by immunohistochemistry. High PCNA scores were associated with poorer survival, and PCNA and Ki-67 scoring predicted relapse and tumor-related death better than tumor stage. The authors suggest these proliferation markers may stratify patients into low- and high-risk groups, supporting consideration of aggressive postoperative chemotherapy even in early-stage disease.

pmid-10533325.summary_ja: 1990〜1996年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍34例を後方視的に検討し、外科的管理と生存成績を組織型・病期別に評価した。全生存期間(全生存率)は78.8%だった。限局例には片側卵巣摘出後にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行い、進行した卵黄嚢腫瘍では温存手術が推奨された。混合型は全生存率が33.3%と最も低かった。
pmid-10533325.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 34 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (1990–1996) assessed surgical management and survival by histology and stage. Overall survival was 78.8%. Patients with limited disease were managed with unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy followed by cisplatin-based chemotherapy when indicated, while conservative surgery was advised for advanced endodermal sinus tumor. Pure dysgerminoma and immature teratoma had favorable outcomes, whereas mixed germ cell tumors had the lowest survival.

pmid-10534168.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍と正常精巣におけるGH/PL遺伝子群の転写パターンをRT-PCRで解析した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は全例でGH-N、PL-A/B、PL-Lを発現し、セミノーマは特有のパターンを示した。正常精巣の特徴であるGH-Vは腫瘍検体では検出されず、悪性化に伴って遺伝子発現が変化することが示された。
pmid-10534168.summary_en: Growth hormone/placental lactogen gene cluster transcription was analyzed by RT-PCR in testicular GCTs and normal testis. All nonseminomatous GCTs expressed GH-N, PL-A/B and PL-L, while seminomas showed a distinct pattern. GH-V, a hallmark of normal testis, was absent in all 16 cancer specimens. Choriocarcinoma cell lines BeWo and JAR showed a placental-type pattern. The authors conclude that testis-specific GH/PL expression changes with malignancy and may relate to GCT pathogenesis.

pmid-10535348.summary_ja: 1970〜1994年にイスラエルで診断された19歳以下の悪性卵巣腫瘍82例を、全国がん登録データで解析した。胚細胞腫瘍が72%を占め、その約3分の1はディスジャーミノーマだった。期間の経過とともにディスジャーミノーマの減少により胚細胞腫瘍の罹患率が低下した一方、境界悪性腫瘍は増加した。
pmid-10535348.summary_en: This nationwide Israeli registry study analyzed 82 patients aged 19 years or younger with malignant ovarian tumors diagnosed from 1970 to 1994. Germ cell tumors accounted for 72%, about one third of them dysgerminomas. Epithelial tumors were 26.6%, mostly borderline. Age-adjusted incidence of germ cell tumors declined over time, driven by a decrease in dysgerminomas, while borderline tumors increased, possibly due to greater pathologist awareness.

pmid-10535619.summary_ja: 出生時より左眼窩から突出する10×8cm大の腫瘤を呈した男児例。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では石灰化を伴う嚢胞充実性の眼窩腫瘤で、頭蓋内進展はなかった。病理組織学的所見で三胚葉すべての成分を含む奇形腫と診断され、眼球は摘出された。眼窩腫瘤を伴う新生児では奇形腫を念頭に早期に評価し、可能な場合は眼球温存を検討すべきと述べられている。
pmid-10535619.summary_en: A newborn boy presented with a 10 × 8 cm mass extruding from the left orbit. MRI showed a mixed cystic-solid orbital mass with calcification and no intracranial extension. Histopathology revealed all three germ layers consistent with teratoma, with disorganized ocular structures but no organized eye. The eye was removed with eyelid reconstruction, and follow-up was uneventful. The report emphasizes early evaluation of neonatal orbital masses for teratoma so that globe preservation can be considered where possible.

pmid-10535768.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌JAr細胞の増殖に対するメラトニンの作用を検討した。メラトニンは増殖を有意に抑制し、高親和性作動薬の2-ヨードメラトニンはより強い効果を示した。MT2受容体選択的リガンドは相加的な抗増殖作用を示し、細胞はMT2受容体を発現していた。メラトニンはG1/S期移行を遅延させ、その作用の一部はMT2受容体を介すると考えられた。
pmid-10535768.summary_en: This study examined the effects of melatonin on proliferation of human choriocarcinoma JAr cells. Melatonin significantly inhibited JAr cell growth, and the high-affinity agonist 2-iodomelatonin was more potent. The MT2-selective ligand 4-P-PDOT had antiproliferative effects that were additive with melatonin. JAr cells bound 2-[125I]iodomelatonin and expressed MT2 receptor mRNA. Melatonin delayed the G1/S cell cycle transition, suggesting a mechanism partly mediated by MT2 receptors.

pmid-10540706.summary_ja: 後腹膜に発生した性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。組織学的に胎児性癌で、AFPとβ-hCGが上昇し、精巣には腫瘍を認めませんでした。BEP・EP療法後、マーカーは正常化し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清で下大静脈の腫瘍栓を切除しました。切除標本に生存腫瘍細胞は認められず、経過は良好です。
pmid-10540706.summary_en: This case report describes a man with a retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor, with embryonal carcinoma on histology, elevated AFP and β-hCG, and para-aortic nodes. Testicular examination and ultrasonography showed no tumor. After BEP and EP chemotherapy, markers normalized and RPLND resected a tumor thrombus in the inferior vena cava, with no viable tumor cells found.

pmid-10543416.summary_ja: 8歳から成長ホルモン治療を受けていた31歳男性の症例です。不妊と男性ホルモン欠乏で受診した際に片側精巣腫瘍が偶然発見され、セミノーマと診断されました。著者らは成長ホルモンが胚細胞腫瘍の発生に関与する可能性を示唆し、定期的な精巣の超音波検査を推奨しています。
pmid-10543416.summary_en: This report describes a 31-year-old man who received growth hormone from age 8 and presented with infertility and androgen deficiency. Ultrasonography incidentally revealed a unilateral testicular tumor, diagnosed as seminoma. The authors suggest growth hormone may contribute to germ cell tumor development, and recommend regular testicular ultrasonography in patients with a history of maldescended testes receiving GH.

pmid-10547554.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞性腫瘍22例で、テロメラーゼRNA成分(hTR)の発現をin situハイブリダイゼーションにより検討した。hTR発現は胎児性癌で最も高く、分化の程度と相関していた。成熟奇形腫では低値、精母細胞性セミノーマでは中等度であった。発現は腫瘍の攻撃性に関係なく、分化に伴って低下していた。
pmid-10547554.summary_en: This study used in situ hybridization to examine the RNA component of telomerase (hTR) in 22 adult testicular germ cell neoplasms across all major histologic types. hTR expression was highest in embryonal carcinoma and tracked with differentiation, being low in mature teratoma and intermediate in spermatocytic seminoma. Expression was down-regulated with differentiation regardless of tumor aggressiveness.

pmid-10547581.summary_ja: ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍と関連する精巣組織において、アルカリホスファターゼアイソザイムの発現を酵素・免疫組織化学およびRT-PCRで検討した。TNAPおよびPLAP/GCAPに対する抗体は、上皮内癌(CIS)、セミノーマ、胎児性癌で陽性を示した。CISとセミノーマは主にGCAPを発現し、胎児性癌では発現が一定でなかった。正常精巣組織にも転写産物が存在するため、RT-PCRは生検による早期検出には適さない。
pmid-10547581.summary_en: This study examined alkaline phosphatase isozymes in human testicular germ cell tumors and related testicular tissue using enzyme and immunohistochemistry plus RT-PCR. Antibodies to TNAP and PLAP/GCAP stained carcinoma in situ, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma. CIS and seminoma predominantly expressed GCAP, while embryonal carcinoma varied. Normal testicular tissue transcripts limit RT-PCR use for early biopsy detection.

pmid-10548709.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫(卵巣類皮嚢腫)の腹腔鏡下摘出について、ポート創拡大法と後腟円蓋切開法をランダム化比較した研究です。両法とも嚢腫を破裂させずに無傷で摘出でき、ポート創拡大法は手術時間と出血量が少ないと結論づけています。
pmid-10548709.summary_en: This prospective randomized trial compared two methods of extracting mature teratomas (ovarian dermoid cysts) during laparoscopic cystectomy in 31 women: enlarged port-site extraction versus culdotomy. Both approaches allowed intact removal in an endobag without spillage. Operating time and blood loss were significantly lower with the enlarged port approach, while tumor size, age, and postoperative recovery did not differ. The authors therefore favor the enlarged port technique for laparoscopic removal of mature teratomas.

pmid-10550141.summary_ja: 進行期の男性胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象に、初回大量化学療法と標準量化学療法を多変量解析とマッチドペア解析で比較した研究です。予後不良例では大量化学療法群で2年無増悪生存率と全生存率が有意に高く、初回治療での強化が有益と結論づけています。
pmid-10550141.summary_en: This multicenter comparison examined first-line high-dose chemotherapy (VIP with autologous stem-cell transplantation) against standard-dose PEB or VIP in male patients with advanced germ cell tumors. Using multivariate and matched-pair analyses of 147 high-dose and 309 standard-dose patients, high-dose therapy was associated with significantly better two-year progression-free and overall survival in poor-prognosis disease. Salvage high-dose therapy did not appear to offset this advantage, suggesting that up-front intensification benefits patients with poor-prognosis GCT.

pmid-10550142.summary_ja: セミノーマの化学療法後残存腫瘤について、陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)が壊死と生存腫瘍を鑑別できるかを前向きに検討しました。初回化学療法後の症例ではPETが陰性で、救援化学療法後では偽陽性例がありました。大きなセミノーマでは評価に有用性は乏しいと結論づけています。
pmid-10550142.summary_en: This prospective study evaluated whether positron emission tomography (PET) can distinguish necrosis from viable seminoma in postchemotherapy residual masses. Twenty-nine patients were studied, with 19 scanned after primary chemotherapy and 10 after salvage chemotherapy. All primary-treatment patients had negative PET results and stable or shrinking masses. In the salvage group, one PET-positive mediastinal mass was necrotic on pathology, and five patients relapsed. The authors concluded that PET offers no apparent benefit for evaluating residual masses in bulky seminoma.

pmid-10550526.summary_ja: 精巣の胎児性癌組織について、DNA断片化とDNA凝縮を二重蛍光染色で同時に評価し、アポトーシスを検討した予備的研究です。形態学的基準のみでは40〜75%のアポトーシス細胞を見逃すことが示されました。腫瘍内で腫瘍細胞とリンパ球のアポトーシス指数が最も高く、Fas/FasL系との関連が考察されています。
pmid-10550526.summary_en: This preliminary study examined apoptosis in human testicular embryonal cell carcinoma using double-fluorescence labeling of DNA fragmentation and DNA condensation. Apoptotic indices were measured in tumor sections and surrounding regions. Morphological criteria alone missed 40 to 75 percent of apoptotic cells, suggesting that some cells undergo condensation without fragmentation. Apoptotic indices of both tumor cells and lymphocytes were highest within the tumor, a finding discussed in relation to the Fas/FasL system.

pmid-10551730.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫に生じた扁平上皮癌と膀胱転移の症例を報告しています。MRIでは脂肪・液体のニボーを伴う卵巣嚢腫に付着した充実性腫瘤を認め、T2強調像で低信号を示しました。奇形腫の悪性転化を画像で捉える所見を示しています。
pmid-10551730.summary_en: This case report describes squamous cell carcinoma arising within a mature teratoma of the ovary, with metastasis to the urinary bladder. Magnetic resonance imaging showed a solid, lobulated mass attached to an ovarian cyst that contained a fat-fluid level. The solid component extended into pelvic fat and was hypointense on T2-weighted images with good enhancement. Imaging also demonstrated a metastatic lesion in the bladder. The report highlights MR features that can help recognize malignant transformation of a mature teratoma.

pmid-10552153.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法の今後の方向性を総説しています。予後良好例では標準療法PEBが維持される一方、予後不良例では初回大量化学療法と幹細胞移植の有用性が示されています。治癒例の増加に伴い、シスプラチンによる晩期毒性が課題とされています。
pmid-10552153.summary_en: This review addresses future directions in chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors. For good-prognosis disease, PEB remains standard, with carboplatin and bleomycin-sparing attempts under study. For poor-prognosis disease, up-front high-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell transplantation shows promising long-term survival. Salvage high-dose therapy is also being evaluated. The review highlights cisplatin-related late toxicity as a major issue for the growing population of cured patients.

pmid-10552343.summary_ja: 良性縦隔奇形腫を3年間経過観察していた48歳女性が、急性心タンポナーデを発症しました。胸骨正中切開と右開胸により体外循環下で腫瘍を摘出しています。無症状でも早期の外科的切除が重要であると結論づけています。
pmid-10552343.summary_en: This case report describes a 48-year-old woman with a benign mature mediastinal teratoma, followed for three years after an exploratory sternotomy showed the tumor could not be resected. She later developed acute cardiac tamponade. The tumor was removed through sternotomy and right thoracotomy with cardiopulmonary bypass standby. Pericardial fluid had high amylase and CA19-9, and the tumor expressed inflammatory cytokines. The authors emphasize early surgical excision of benign mediastinal teratomas, even when asymptomatic.

pmid-10559615.summary_ja: ドイツ・オーストリア・スイスの多施設前向き試験(セミノーマ726例)。標準治療後、hCG陽性と陰性で予後に差はなく、36か月時点の生存率は98%、再発率は6%であった。独立した予後因子は病期とLDH上昇・マーカー減衰の遅延のみで、病期IIBは放射線療法後の再発率が24%と高く、化学療法が推奨された。hCG陽性セミノーマは特別な病型ではないと結論された。
pmid-10559615.summary_en: This prospective multicenter study of 803 German, Austrian, and Swiss seminoma patients (726 evaluable) examined whether hCG elevation affects outcome. hCG-positive and hCG-negative patients had similar outcomes after standard therapy, with a 6% relapse rate and 98% survival at 36 months. Stage and elevated LDH with slow marker decay were the only independent prognostic factors. Stage IIB patients treated with radiotherapy had a 24% relapse rate, leading the authors to recommend chemotherapy for this group. They conclude that hCG-positive seminomas are not a distinct entity.

pmid-10560495.summary_ja: 精巣のセミノーマ、成熟・未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌の患者43例を対象に、腫瘍内の免疫担当細胞を定量した。Tリンパ球(CD3、UCHL1)とマクロファージ(MAC387、CD68)を評価したところ、使用する抗体によって細胞数の差や腫瘍型の順位が変化した。腫瘍型と抗体の間に統計学的な交互作用があると結論され、免疫浸潤の比較では抗体の選択が重要であることが示された。
pmid-10560495.summary_en: This methodological study quantified immunocompetent cells in 43 men with testicular tumors, including seminomas, mature and immature teratomas, and embryonal carcinomas. T-lymphocytes were assessed with CD3 and UCHL1, and macrophages with MAC387 and CD68. Cell counts varied significantly depending on the antibody used. For macrophages, the ranking of tumor types by cell density changed with the antibody. The authors conclude that there is a statistical interaction between tumor type and antibody, so antibody choice must be considered when comparing immune infiltrates.

pmid-10560848.summary_ja: 1974年から1996年に肝転移に対して肝切除を受けた非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍57例の後方視的検討の更新版。化学療法後の病理診断で分類された。奇形腫は肉腫化や圧迫症状を起こすため切除が必要とされ、マーカーが正常でも活動性疾患があれば完全切除が生存の唯一の機会とされた。術前化学療法後にマーカーが上昇している場合を除き、安全かつ有効と結論された。
pmid-10560848.summary_en: This update reviews 57 patients who underwent hepatic resection for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma at Indiana University between 1974 and 1996. The retrospective study grouped patients by postchemotherapy pathology. Among 2,219 patients undergoing postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, only 57 underwent liver resection. The authors argue that teratomas can degenerate into sarcomas and cause compressive symptoms, so they should be resected, and that complete resection offers the only survival chance for patients with active disease but normal markers. Hepatic resection is considered safe and effective except when markers remain elevated after preoperative chemotherapy.

pmid-10561173.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマ478例を対象に、傍大動脈照射とドッグレッグ照射を比較した無作為化試験。3年無再発生存率はいずれも約96%と同等であった。傍大動脈照射は急性毒性や性腺毒性(精子数)が少ない一方、骨盤内再発が多かった。リンパ流が保たれた患者では傍大動脈照射が標準治療として推奨された。
pmid-10561173.summary_en: This MRC randomized trial compared para-aortic (PA) strip irradiation with dogleg (PA plus ipsilateral iliac) radiotherapy in 478 men with stage I testicular seminoma. Median follow-up was 4.5 years. Relapse rates were low and similar in both arms, with 3-year relapse-free survival of about 96%. PA irradiation caused less acute toxicity and better sperm counts in the first 18 months, but was associated with more pelvic relapses. The authors recommend PA radiotherapy as standard treatment for patients with undisturbed lymphatic drainage.

pmid-10561181.summary_ja: 2つの連続した小児プロトコール(TGM 85/90)を統合し、頭蓋外限局性の悪性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を検討した。初診時のAFP値、病期、原発部位により3つの予後群に分類された。予後不良群の3年無治療失敗生存率は43%、予後良好群では治療失敗がなく、中間群は81%であった。これらの因子はリスクに応じた治療層別化に有用とされた。
pmid-10561181.summary_en: This pooled analysis of two consecutive German pediatric protocols (TGM 85 and TGM 90) examined children over one year old treated with chemotherapy for extracranial, localized malignant nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The TGM 90 protocol substituted carboplatin for cisplatin. Three prognostic groups were defined by initial AFP level, stage, and primary site. Patients with poor prognosis, who had sacrococcygeal or mediastinal primaries with high AFP or stage III disease, had 43% three-year failure-free survival. Good-prognosis patients had no treatment failures, and intermediate-prognosis patients had 81%. The authors conclude these factors should guide risk-adapted therapy.

pmid-10561269.summary_ja: 頭蓋外未熟奇形腫の小児73例を登録した共同研究で、完全切除後の3年EFSが85%を超えるかを検討した。病理再評価で23例に卵黄嚢腫瘍または原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍の病巣が認められた。全体の3年EFSは93%で、卵巣97.8%、精巣100%、性腺外80%であった。悪性成分を伴う23例のうち再発は4例のみであった。著者らは、外科的切除と注意深い経過観察、再発例への白金製剤ベースの治療により、小児未熟奇形腫の80〜100%で安全かつ有効と結論した。
pmid-10561269.summary_en: This Pediatric Oncology Group/Children's Cancer Group intergroup study enrolled 73 children with extracranial immature teratomas and aimed to test whether 3-year event-free survival exceeds 85% after complete resection. Pathology review found yolk sac tumor or PNET foci in 23 patients. Overall 3-year EFS was 93%, with 97.8% for ovarian, 100% for testicular, and 80% for extragonadal primaries. Only four of 23 patients with malignant foci relapsed. The authors conclude that surgical excision, with close observation and platinum-based therapy for recurrence, is safe and effective for 80% to 100% of children with immature teratoma.

pmid-10561340.summary_ja: 1984〜1998年に純粋な卵巣未分化胚細胞腫でBEP化学療法を受けた26例の後方視的検討。妊孕性温存手術を受けた16例のうち、評価可能な14例では化学療法後も71%で正常な月経が維持され、93%が化学療法前のパターンに回復した。5例が妊娠した。追跡期間中央値89か月で96%が無病生存。保存的手術とBEP化学療法は高い治癒率と生殖機能の維持を両立すると結論された。
pmid-10561340.summary_en: This MD Anderson retrospective review examined 26 patients treated with BEP chemotherapy for pure ovarian dysgerminoma between 1984 and 1998. Sixteen underwent fertility-sparing unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. At median follow-up of 89 months, 96% remained disease-free. Among the 14 evaluable conservatively treated patients, 71% maintained normal menstruation during and after chemotherapy, and 93% had returned to their prechemotherapy pattern. Five pregnancies occurred, while two patients had difficulty conceiving. The authors conclude that conservative surgery plus BEP offers high cure rates with preserved reproductive function.

pmid-10563220.summary_ja: 24歳女性で、良性の卵巣成熟性嚢胞性奇形腫に伴う可逆性の傍腫瘍性脳脊髄炎を呈した症例報告。記憶障害や人格変化、幻覚に始まり、延髄・脊髄のMRI病変を伴って呼吸不全と対麻痺が進行した。腫瘍摘出に加え高用量ステロイドと静注免疫グロブリン療法により完全回復した。奇形腫内の神経組織に対する免疫反応が、正常な中枢神経抗原と交差反応した可能性が示唆される。
pmid-10563220.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old woman with paraneoplastic encephalomyelitis (PEM) associated with a benign left ovarian mature cystic teratoma. Her symptoms included memory impairment, personality change, hallucinations, and progressive respiratory failure and paraplegia, with MRI lesions in the medulla and spinal cord. After tumor removal combined with high-dose corticosteroids and intravenous immunoglobulin, she fully recovered. The authors propose that immune responses against neural elements within the teratoma cross-react with normal CNS antigens. This is the first report of reversible PEM linked to a benign tumor.

pmid-10565292.summary_ja: 口腔由来の胎児奇形腫2例を対象とした細胞遺伝学的研究。両例とも唯一の染色体異常は等染色体1q(テトラソミー1q)で、追加された1q領域は母親由来と判明した。1例では胎児の体細胞に存在しない母性アレルが腫瘍に認められ、腫瘍が胎児組織から直接生じたものではないことが示唆された。
pmid-10565292.summary_en: This cytogenetic study examined two cases of fetal teratoma arising in the oral cavity, an extremely rare site. Both tumors showed an isochromosome 1q as their sole chromosomal abnormality, leading to tetrasomy 1q. DNA marker analysis showed that the extra 1q material was maternal in origin. In one case, the tumor carried maternal alleles absent from fetal body cells, suggesting the tumor did not arise directly from fetal tissue. The authors propose that the chromosomally normal fetus may have resulted from a trisomic or tetrasomic zygote rescue mechanism.

pmid-10565293.summary_ja: 母親に重度の羊水過多が生じたため超音波検査で出生前に発見された、成熟型鼻咽頭奇形腫の胎児の症例報告。羊水穿刺により細胞遺伝学的、DNA、病理学的解析を行い、モザイク型テトラソミー1qを確認した。文献レビューでは既報の78例を集計した。出生前診断はさらにまれである。
pmid-10565293.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a mature nasopharyngeal teratoma (NPT) detected prenatally by ultrasound after the mother presented with severe polyhydramnios. Cytogenetic, DNA and pathological analyses were performed, and the findings showed mosaic tetrasomy 1q. The authors also reviewed the literature, compiling 78 previously reported NPT cases. Nasopharyngeal teratomas are rare, and their prenatal detection is rarer still.

pmid-10565754.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者157例と健常ドナー50例の精液を、凍結前後でコンピュータ支援精液分析により比較した。患者では凍結前後とも運動精子数と運動能が低かったが、凍結による変化は両群で同程度だった。病期や組織型は精液の質に有意な影響を与えなかった。妊孕性温存のため精子バンキングを日常的に推奨すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-10565754.summary_en: This study compared sperm quality before and after cryopreservation in 157 men with testicular cancer and 50 normal donors using computer-assisted semen analysis. Patients had lower motile sperm counts and motility before and after freezing, but the cryopreservation-related change was similar to donors. Tumor stage and histology (pure seminoma, pure embryonal, or mixed germ cell) did not significantly affect semen quality. The authors recommend routine sperm banking for men diagnosed with testicular cancer to preserve fertility.

pmid-10565755.summary_ja: 未選択の胚細胞腫瘍患者50例で、FDG-PETを従来の病期評価と比較した。転移の検出率はPETが87%、CTは感度73%・特異度94%、腫瘍マーカーは感度67%・特異度100%であった。PETはCTで見逃された後腹膜転移を検出したが、小さなリンパ節転移は両者とも検出が困難だった。PETは病期分類を改善しうるが、後腹膜の小病変には限界がある。
pmid-10565755.summary_en: This study evaluated whether FDG-PET improves clinical staging compared with conventional methods in 50 unselected patients with germ cell cancer. PET detected metastases in 87% of patients with metastases and excluded them in 94% of those without. CT had 73% sensitivity and 94% specificity, while tumor markers had 67% sensitivity and 100% specificity. PET detected some retroperitoneal metastases missed by CT, but both modalities missed small nodes. The authors conclude PET could improve staging but has limited sensitivity for small retroperitoneal nodes.

pmid-10566618.summary_ja: 腎被膜下に移植したラット絨毛癌を持つラットで、新規プロドラッグcPr-PMEDAPを既存薬と比較した。最大耐容量ではcPr-PMEDAPが完全な腫瘍抑制を最もよく示し、PMEGと異なり治療終了後2週間にわたり効果が持続した。有望な抗腫瘍薬として、他の腫瘍モデルでの追加評価が推奨された。
pmid-10566618.summary_en: This study tested the novel acyclic nucleoside phosphonate prodrug cPr-PMEDAP against its progenitor PMEDAP and the active drug PMEG in rats bearing renal-capsule rat choriocarcinoma tumors. At doses producing moderate to strong toxicity, all three compounds completely inhibited tumor development. At maximum tolerated doses, cPr-PMEDAP was superior in achieving complete inhibition and, unlike PMEG, maintained an antitumor effect for at least 2 weeks after treatment. The authors consider cPr-PMEDAP a promising agent that merits further evaluation in other tumor models.

pmid-10567810.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を伴う男性が、腸重積による消化管出血と小腸閉塞で受診した症例報告。原因は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の転移と判明し、精巣摘除術と腸切除、術後化学療法が行われた。精巣腫瘍と腹痛を訴える患者では、転移による小腸閉塞や腸重積も鑑別に挙げるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-10567810.summary_en: This case report describes a man who presented with gastrointestinal bleeding and small-bowel obstruction caused by jejunal intussusception. Workup revealed a testicular mass, and the intussusception was due to metastatic testicular germ cell cancer. He underwent orchiectomy, bowel resection, and postoperative chemotherapy. The authors review the literature and conclude that metastatic small-bowel obstruction or intussusception should be considered in patients presenting with a testicular mass and abdominal pain.

pmid-10570449.summary_ja: 1985～1996年の全米がんデータベース(NCDB)を用いて精巣がんの診療動向を解析した報告。25歳未満では進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍での診断が多い。早期病変では手術単独治療が増加し、生存率は病期分類が進むほど低下した。
pmid-10570449.summary_en: This US National Cancer Data Base analysis examined patterns of care for testicular carcinoma from 1985 to 1996. Men under 25 more often presented with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Surgery alone was increasingly used for early-stage seminoma and nonseminomatous tumors, while surgery with concomitant chemotherapy rose for advanced seminoma. Survival declined with increasing AJCC stage. The authors suggest these trends can inform strategies for earlier presentation.

pmid-10571021.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と侵入奇胎の患者尿から得られたhCGの糖鎖構造を比較した報告。絨毛癌では悪性細胞でGnT-IVが異常発現し、正常胎盤には見られない腫瘍特異的糖鎖が生じる。この知見は悪性栄養膜疾患の診断法に応用されている。
pmid-10571021.summary_en: This paper reviews the N-linked sugar chains of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG). Choriocarcinoma-derived hCG carries eight neutral oligosaccharide types, whereas invasive mole hCG carries five. Tumor-specific chains reflect abnormal GnT-IV expression in malignant trophoblast cells. These tumor-specific glycoforms underpin a diagnostic method for malignant trophoblastic disease. The paper also summarizes how sugar chains influence the hormonal activity of hCG.

pmid-10571512.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎や侵入奇胎などに続発した肺病変3例を、上皮様栄養膜腫瘍(ETT)として形態学的・免疫組織化学的に検討した報告。絨毛癌に比べ多核巨細胞が少なく、hCG陽性を示す。栄養膜マーカーだけでは他の腫瘍との鑑別は困難であり、形態・免疫染色・臨床経過を組み合わせて診断すべきとしている。
pmid-10571512.summary_en: Three lung lesions from trophoblastic disease, diagnosed as epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT), were studied morphologically and immunohistochemically. The lesions followed hydatidiform mole, invasive mole, or term pregnancy. ETT showed monomorphic, highly atypical mononuclear cells forming nests with central necrosis, with fewer giant cells than choriocarcinoma. Tumor cells were positive for hCG, with variable placental lactogen and alkaline phosphatase staining. The authors stress that diagnosis requires morphology, immunohistochemistry, and clinical history together.

pmid-10571631.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の男性36例で、精巣摘除術の前後に精液を凍結保存した際の精液の質を比較した研究。保存時期や腫瘍型(セミノーマか非セミノーマか)による差は見られなかった。対側精巣の造精機能で術後の凍結保存は十分可能であり、がん患者の妊孕性温存の周知が必要とされる。
pmid-10571631.summary_en: This study examined 36 men with testicular tumours referred for semen cryopreservation, comparing samples banked before versus after orchidectomy. Semen parameters were similar regardless of timing, the delay before banking, or whether the tumour was seminoma or nonseminoma. The authors conclude that contralateral spermatogenesis is sufficient for successful cryopreservation after orchidectomy. They urge oncology teams and patients to be made aware of fertility preservation options in cancer care.

pmid-10573203.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍14例に対し、末梢血幹細胞移植を併用した大量化学療法の成績を報告した。全例で血液毒性を認めたが治療関連死はなく、中央値18か月の追跡で64.3%が無病生存であった。進行例・難治例に対して安全かつ有効な治療であると結論付けている。
pmid-10573203.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of high-dose chemotherapy (carboplatin, etoposide, ifosfamide) with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation in 14 male patients with germ cell tumors, 11 treated as induction after conventional BEP and 3 with recurrent disease. All had grade 4 hematotoxicity, but hematopoietic recovery occurred within 8-11 days, and there were no treatment-related deaths. Nine of 14 patients (64.3%) remained disease-free at a median 18 months follow-up. The authors conclude high-dose chemotherapy is safe and effective for advanced or refractory male germ cell tumors.

pmid-10574599.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患において、細胞のアポトーシス活性とBcl-2・Baxの発現を免疫組織化学的に解析した。アポトーシス指数は胞状奇胎や絨毛癌で高く、Bcl-2発現と逆相関した。自然退縮例で高値を示し、胞状奇胎の予後マーカーとしての有用性が示唆された。
pmid-10574599.summary_en: This study examined apoptosis and Bcl-2 and Bax expression in gestational trophoblastic disease, including normal placentas, spontaneous abortions, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. The apoptotic index was highest in complete moles and choriocarcinomas and correlated inversely with Bcl-2 expression, but not with Bax. It was higher in spontaneously regressing cases than in those needing chemotherapy, suggesting it may serve as a prognostic marker for hydatidiform moles and a diagnostic adjunct.

pmid-10576213.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常ヒト精巣、22例の精巣腫瘍、胎児および出生後の精巣組織におけるアンジオテンシン変換酵素(ACE)のアイソフォームを検討した。RT-PCR、レーザー支援細胞採取法、免疫組織化学を用いて、体細胞型のsACEは精細管内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマ、その他の腫瘍型で発現し、成人の精子細胞は精巣型のtACEを発現することが示された。これらの知見は、腫瘍性胚細胞が胚発生段階の分化状態を反映していることを示唆している。
pmid-10576213.summary_en: This study examined angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) isoforms in normal human testes, 22 testicular tumors, and fetal and postnatal testicular tissues. Using RT-PCR, laser-assisted cell picking, and immunohistochemistry, the authors found that the somatic isoform sACE was expressed in intratubular germ cell neoplasia, seminomas, and other tumor types, while adult spermatids expressed the testicular isoform tACE. These findings suggest neoplastic germ cells reflect an embryonic differentiation stage.

pmid-10579082.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の予後因子に基づくリスク適応型治療について総説した。予後良好例では減量、予後不良例では大量化学療法を検討する臨床試験が進められている。病期I・II非セミノーマでは補助化学療法を含め治療標準が変わり、将来は分子マーカーによる個別化が期待される。
pmid-10579082.summary_en: This review discusses risk-adapted treatment of testicular tumors, which are highly sensitive to cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Cure rates exceed 90% for good prognosis, 70% for intermediate, and 50% for poor prognosis patients. Current trials test high-dose chemotherapy for poor-risk disease and dose reduction for good-risk disease. Treatment standards for stage I and II nonseminomatous tumors have changed based on prognostic factors and adjuvant chemotherapy, and molecular markers may refine future prognosis and therapy selection.

pmid-10582079.summary_ja: 持続性ミュラー管症候群（男性仮性半陰陽の一型）の患者で、腹腔内の精巣に発生したセミノーマが捻転し、急性腹症として開腹術で発見された症例を報告しています。腹腔内精巣は悪性変化のリスクがあるため、停留精巣患者や急性腹症の診療において本合併の認識が重要だと強調しています。
pmid-10582079.summary_en: This case report describes persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, a form of male pseudohermaphroditism caused by absent or inactive Müllerian inhibiting substance. The patient's intra-abdominal testes were complicated by torsion of a seminoma. The acute abdomen was explored by laparotomy, which revealed both the syndrome and the tumor. The authors emphasize that intra-abdominal testes are exposed to malignant degeneration, highlighting the need to recognize this association in patients with cryptorchidism and acute abdominal presentations.

pmid-10582686.summary_ja: IGF-IIを分解する受容体IGF-II/M6PRの発現をアンチセンス法で低下させた絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3を解析しています。その結果、in vitroでもin vivoでも増殖速度が上昇し、本受容体が腫瘍増殖の抑制因子である可能性を示しています。臨床研究ではなく、絨毛癌細胞株を用いた機序研究です。
pmid-10582686.summary_en: This study investigates the insulin-like growth factor-II/mannose-6-phosphate receptor (IGF-II/M6PR), which binds and degrades the mitogen IGF-II. Antisense knockdown of this receptor in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells increased the in vitro growth rate. The same knockdown also accelerated tumor growth in vivo. These findings indicate that reduced IGF-II/M6PR expression confers a growth advantage in choriocarcinoma cells, supporting its role as a negative regulator of tumor growth. The work is mechanistic, using a choriocarcinoma cell line as the central tumor model, rather than clinical.

pmid-10582864.summary_ja: 胎児頸部奇形腫に対し、EXIT手技を用いて救命に成功した管理を報告しています。奇形腫は羊水過多、早産、新生児の気道閉塞を引き起こし、チームによる介入がなければ死亡率は80〜100%とされます。早期診断、計画、多職種チームの形成が新生児の生存に不可欠であると強調しています。
pmid-10582864.summary_en: This report describes successful management of fetal cervical teratoma using the EXIT (ex utero intrapartum treatment) procedure. Cervical teratomas cause polyhydramnios, premature labor, and neonatal airway obstruction, with reported mortality of 80 to 100% without a coordinated team. The authors emphasize early diagnosis, careful planning, and a multispecialty team as essential for neonatal survival. The tumor can also cause pulmonary insufficiency and chondromalacia through mass effect in utero.

pmid-10584566.summary_ja: 本総説は精巣がんの治療と、治癒後の患者に生じる晩期合併症について述べている。1970年代以降のシスプラチン併用化学療法により転移性精巣がんの多くは治癒するようになったが、若年患者は長期生存するため二次がんが重要な問題となる。対側精巣の胚細胞腫瘍、2年以降の晩期再発、放射線療法による二次固形がん、大量エトポシド療法による二次白血病のリスクを整理し、治療による発がん性のモニタリングと予防策の必要性を強調している。
pmid-10584566.summary_en: This review examines the treatment of testicular cancer and the long-term complications survivors face. Since cisplatin-based chemotherapy was introduced in the 1970s, most metastatic testicular cancer patients can be cured, but their young age means they live for decades after treatment. The authors describe the risk of contralateral testicular germ cell tumor, late relapse after two years in about 3% of patients, and second malignancies. Radiotherapy raises the risk of second solid cancers two- to threefold, while high-dose etoposide regimens increase the risk of second leukemia. The authors emphasize monitoring the carcinogenic potential of therapy and developing preventive strategies.

pmid-10584881.summary_ja: 本研究は、肝細胞癌と非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者から精製した血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)の糖鎖構造を解析した。蛍光標識、糖鎖切断酵素処理、HPLC、MALDI-TOF質量分析を組み合わせ、N結合型7種、O結合型4種の計11種の主要な糖鎖を同定した。N結合型は既報と一致する二分岐複合型であった。一方、ムチン型O-GalNAc糖鎖を含むO結合型糖鎖は初めて報告された。AFPの糖鎖差異は、両疾患の検出においてより特異的な検査法の開発につながる可能性がある。
pmid-10584881.summary_en: This study characterized the glycan structures of serum alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) from patients with hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) and non-seminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT). Using fluorescence labeling, exoglycosidase digestion, HPLC, and MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry, the authors identified eleven major glycans, seven N-linked and four O-linked. The N-linked glycans were bi-antennary complex types consistent with previous reports, while the O-linked glycans, including mucin O-GalNAc types, had not been described before. Molecular modelling supported the predicted O-glycosylation sites. The authors suggest these glycoform differences could lead to more specific AFP assays for detecting HCC and NSGCT.

pmid-10584892.summary_ja: 本研究は1989～1995年のオランダ全国がん登録データを用い、12州の年齢調整精巣がん発生率を解析した。全国平均は10万人あたり年間4.4例で、北部のグローニンゲン州が5.8例と最も高かった。北部の高発生はセミノーマと非セミノーマの両方で認められ、都市と農村の差は見られなかった。著者らは、安定した始祖集団における環境要因または遺伝的感受性の共有が関与する可能性を指摘し、感受性遺伝子探索に適した集団であると論じている。
pmid-10584892.summary_en: This epidemiological study analyzed age-adjusted testicular cancer incidence across 12 Dutch provinces from 1989 to 1995 using national registry data. The overall rate was 4.4 per 100,000 men per year, and the northern province of Groningen had the highest rate at 5.8. Elevated rates in Groningen and neighboring Friesland were driven by both seminomas and non-seminomas, and no urban-rural difference was observed. The authors suggest that shared environmental factors or genetic susceptibility within stable founder populations may explain the northern clustering, and that these populations are well suited for searching for susceptibility genes.

pmid-10586360.summary_ja: 泌尿器科で偶発的に発見された後腹膜腫瘍2例を腹腔鏡下に切除した症例報告である。1例目は43歳女性で、CTで副腎腫瘍が疑われた腫瘤は後腹膜神経線維腫と診断された。2例目は68歳男性で、腎結石の経過観察中に発見された腎周囲腫瘤が成熟型後腹膜奇形腫と診断された。著者らは、後腹膜腫瘍および副腎腫瘍のいずれに対しても腹腔鏡下切除が有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-10586360.summary_en: This report describes two rare retroperitoneal tumors incidentally discovered and resected laparoscopically at a urology department. In the first case, a 43-year-old woman with liver dysfunction had a mass initially suspected to be an adrenal tumor on CT; it proved to be a retroperitoneal neurofibroma. In the second, a 68-year-old man followed for renal stones had a perirenal mass diagnosed as a mature retroperitoneal teratoma. The authors conclude that laparoscopic resection is useful for both retroperitoneal tumors and adrenal tumors.

pmid-10586369.summary_ja: 43歳男性が左鎖骨上窩の腫瘤を主訴に受診した症例報告である。超音波検査およびCTでは原発巣不明のリンパ節転移が疑われ、腫瘍マーカーは正常範囲内だった。切除標本は純粋セミノーマと診断された。精巣の超音波検査ではびまん性石灰化を認めたが、生検で悪性所見はなく、性腺外または燃え尽き型のセミノーマと診断された。PVP療法2コース後、34か月間再発は認めていない。
pmid-10586369.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with a left supraclavicular mass that ultrasonography and CT suggested was a lymph node metastasis of unknown primary origin. Tumor markers were normal. Resection showed pure seminoma, and testicular ultrasonography revealed diffuse calcification, but testicular biopsy showed no malignancy. The lesion was diagnosed as extragonadal or burned-out pure seminoma. After two courses of PVP chemotherapy (peplomycin, vinblastine, cisplatin), the patient remained recurrence-free for 34 months.

pmid-10586627.summary_ja: 精巣未分化セミノーマに対する術後放射線療法の1年後に、下肢の筋力低下と感覚障害を生じた33歳男性の症例報告である。MRIでは馬尾の腰仙部前根に線状・限局性のガドリニウム増強効果を認めた。副腎皮質ステロイドとワルファリンにより症状は改善した。著者らは、この放射線関連症候群の主病変は下位運動ニューロンではなく脊髄神経根にあると考え、「腰仙部神経根症」という用語が適切であると提案している。
pmid-10586627.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old man who developed lower-extremity weakness and sensory loss one year after postoperative radiotherapy for left testicular anaplastic seminoma. MRI showed linear and focal gadolinium enhancement of the anterior lumbosacral roots in the cauda equina. Corticosteroids and warfarin improved his symptoms. The authors argue that this radiation-associated syndrome involves primarily the spinal nerve roots rather than lower motor neurons, and propose lumbosacral radiculopathy as a more appropriate term than the older classification.

pmid-10588850.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍は治癒率が高く、リスクに応じた治療により約95%の治癒率が得られる。予後因子に基づく病期分類は複数提案されてきたが、1997年に発表された国際的合意に基づく分類は、セミノーマと非セミノーマの双方に適用でき、十分に検証されたうえでTNM分類およびAJCC病期分類に組み込まれた。治療には基礎病理と腫瘍進展パターンの理解が不可欠であると強調されている。
pmid-10588850.summary_en: This review covers prognostic factors and staging in testicular germ cell cancers, which are highly curable, with overall cure rates near 95% under risk-adapted treatment. It notes that the 1997 internationally agreed consensus classification, applicable to both seminoma and non-seminoma, has been well validated and incorporated into the TNM and AJCC staging systems. The authors emphasize that effective treatment requires understanding of the underlying pathology and tumor spread patterns, and that prognostic-factor-based classifications can accurately predict outcomes.

pmid-10588851.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣摘除後の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の管理を扱う。主な選択肢は原発後腹膜リンパ節郭清と、再発時にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行う経過観察で、両者とも良好な成績を示す。治療選択は毒性、患者の希望、予後因子などを考慮して行うべきとしている。補助化学療法は、高リスク患者を確実に同定できるようになれば有望とされる。
pmid-10588851.summary_en: This review examines management options for clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors after orchidectomy: primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection versus surveillance with cisplatin-based chemotherapy at relapse. Both approaches achieve excellent survival, so selection depends on treatment-related morbidity, physician expertise, patient preferences, compliance, and prognostic factors. Adjuvant chemotherapy for high-risk patients with occult metastases remains limited and would be viable only if high-risk patients could be reliably identified.

pmid-10588852.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの管理について総説する。病期Iでは、傍大動脈および同側骨盤への放射線療法と、再発時に治療を行う経過観察が同等に有効とされ、選択は医師の判断や患者の事情による。副作用軽減のため、放射線計画の修正や放射線の代わりの補助化学療法が研究されている。小さな後腹膜リンパ節腫大の病期IIは放射線療法が有効で、巨大病変の病期IIIではシスプラチン併用化学療法が推奨される。
pmid-10588852.summary_en: This review summarizes management of testicular seminoma. Stage I patients can be treated equally well with adjuvant para-aortic and ipsilateral pelvic radiotherapy or surveillance with treatment at relapse, with the choice depending on physician preference and patient circumstances. Research aims to reduce treatment side effects through modified radiation plans or adjuvant chemotherapy instead of radiation. Stage II patients with small retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy respond well to radiotherapy, while bulky Stage II or Stage III disease warrants cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-10588853.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性精巣がんに対する欧州の臨床試験をまとめた総説である。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン(BEP)が標準治療であり、EORTCや英国MRCなどの共同研究が中心となってきた。予後良好例では毒性軽減、中等度・予後不良例では治療強化や新規薬剤の追加が検討されてきた。現在進行中の欧州の共同研究も紹介している。
pmid-10588853.summary_en: This review discusses European clinical trials in disseminated non-seminomatous testicular germ cell cancer, mainly conducted through EORTC and the UK MRC. Cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (BEP) remains the gold standard for cure. Studies have aimed to reduce toxicity in good-prognosis patients and to intensify treatment or add new agents for intermediate- and poor-prognosis patients. The article also covers ongoing European collaborative research.

pmid-10588854.summary_ja: 北米で男性の胚細胞腫瘍を対象に行われた25年間の臨床試験を総説する。予後良好群と不良群による層別化が進み、良好群ではブレオマイシンの役割やサイクル数、不良群では高用量シスプラチンとイホスファミドの有用性が検討された。性腺原発の第2再発に対しては造血幹細胞救援を伴う大量化学療法が選択される。救援化学療法の検討と、悪性転化などに関する生物学的研究の今後の展望も述べている。
pmid-10588854.summary_en: This review summarizes North American clinical trials for germ cell tumors (GCT) in men over 25 years. Key advances include risk stratification into good- and poor-risk groups, randomized trials clarifying bleomycin use and cycle number in good-risk patients, and high-dose cisplatin with ifosfamide in poor-risk patients. High-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue is discussed as a potential option following induction and as the preferred treatment for responsive second relapse of gonadal tumors. Salvage regimens and future biologic research are also covered.

pmid-10588856.summary_ja: 再発胚細胞腫瘍の治療に関する総説である。再発を模倣する病態との鑑別が重要で、豊富な経験を要する。確認された再発に対しシスプラチン、イホスファミド、エトポシドによる標準化学療法を行うと、約30%が長期無病生存に至る。大量化学療法や新規薬剤、化学療法抵抗性の局所再発や晩期再発に対する救済的手術が、救援成績向上の選択肢として挙げられている。
pmid-10588856.summary_en: This review addresses the management of recurrent germ cell tumors. Clinicians must distinguish true relapse from conditions that mimic it, which requires substantial experience. Standard chemotherapy with cisplatin, ifosfamide, and etoposide yields long-term disease-free survival in about 30% of patients with confirmed recurrence. High-dose chemotherapy, new drugs, and desperation surgery for selected localized chemoresistant or late relapses offer additional options to improve salvage outcomes.

pmid-10588857.summary_ja: 精巣がんの根治治療後に生じる晩期毒性を扱う総説である。主因はシスプラチンで、腎毒性、耳毒性、神経毒性や性腺障害が約20〜30%の患者に生じる。二次性白血病や骨髄異形成症候群が最も重篤な晩期合併症とされる。放射線療法は治療関連固形腫瘍、化学療法は白血病との関連が指摘される。大量化学療法を含む現行治療のリスクとベネフィットは有利と結論づけている。
pmid-10588857.summary_en: This review examines long-term toxicity after curative treatment of testicular cancer, with cisplatin identified as the main cause. Nephrotoxicity, ototoxicity, neurotoxicity, and gonadal damage affect about 20-30% of patients, and strategies such as less toxic regimens and cytoprotective agents are discussed. Secondary leukemia and myelodysplasia are the most serious late complications. Radiation is associated with therapy-related solid tumors, while chemotherapy with topoisomerase-II inhibitors and alkylating agents is associated with leukemia, which remains uncommon.

pmid-10588858.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法や放射線療法後に行う手術の周術期管理を扱う総説である。治療後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清は技術的に難しく、手術合併症率は33〜75%と報告される。化学療法による肺・腎・血管・神経毒性が危険因子となる。術前のリスク評価、ブレオマイシン関連の肺毒性への配慮、適切な輸液管理が、生命を脅かす合併症の予防に重要とされる。
pmid-10588858.summary_en: This review addresses perioperative care for patients with advanced germ cell tumors who undergo surgery after chemotherapy or radiation. Post-therapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissections are technically demanding, with surgical complication rates of 33% to 75%, highest after combined radiation and chemotherapy. Residual pulmonary, renal, vascular, and neurologic toxicities increase risk. The authors emphasize preoperative risk assessment, careful management of bleomycin-related pulmonary toxicity, and judicious fluid management to reduce life-threatening complications.

pmid-10589567.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫で、捻転例と非捻転例をCTで鑑別できるかを後方視的に検討した研究である。捻転例14例と非捻転例23例を病理所見と比較した。捻転例では1 cmを超える偏心性壁肥厚、腫瘍周囲浸潤、子宮に隣接する腫大した充実性卵管腫瘤が有意に多く認められた。CT所見は特異的でない場合もあるが、診断精度の向上に有用と結論づけている。
pmid-10589567.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated whether CT can distinguish torsed from uncomplicated benign cystic teratomas of the ovary. Fourteen torsed and 23 uncomplicated cases were compared with pathology. Torsion was associated with eccentric wall thickening greater than 1 cm, peritumoral infiltration, and an enlarged solid tubal mass adjacent to the uterus. The authors conclude that CT is useful for differentiation, although the findings are not specific in all patients, and detecting these features may improve diagnostic accuracy.

pmid-10589568.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫と組織学的に異なる腫瘍が併存する衝突腫瘍の画像所見を検討した後方視的研究である。病理学的に確認された7例を超音波、CT、MRIで評価した。併存腫瘍は粘液性腫瘍やディスジャーミノーマなどであった。7例中6例で術前に衝突腫瘍が示唆され、奇形腫だけでは説明できない画像所見がある場合は衝突腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-10589568.summary_en: This study describes imaging features of collision tumors of the ovary in which a teratoma coexists with another histologically distinct tumor. Seven pathologically proven cases, including mucinous cystadenoma, borderline mucinous tumor, mucinous cystadenocarcinoma, and dysgerminoma, were retrospectively reviewed using ultrasound, CT, and MRI. Six of seven were suspected preoperatively, based on multiloculated non-fatty fluid-filled cystic portions or solid components beyond typical teratoma findings. The authors recommend considering a collision tumor when imaging cannot be explained by teratoma alone.

pmid-10592105.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性を含む再発胚細胞腫瘍13例に対し、オキサリプラチンとシスプラチンを基本とするサルベージ療法を検討した報告。奏効率は54%で、5年以上の長期完全奏効が2例に得られた。奏効例では腫瘍マーカーが大きく低下し、主な毒性は血液毒性であった。
pmid-10592105.summary_en: This study reports a salvage regimen combining oxaliplatin and cisplatin, with or without additional cytotoxic agents, in 13 patients with recurrent, mostly cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors. The overall response rate was 54%, with two long-term complete responses lasting over five years, and all responses were accompanied by marked falls in tumor markers. Median survival was 8 months. Grade 4 hematological toxicity was common. The authors conclude that oxaliplatin merits further evaluation as a component of combination therapy for this disease.

pmid-10592490.summary_ja: 精巣がんの診断・治療に関する学際的ガイドラインの改訂報告。病期I精巣セミノーマでは放射線療法が標準で、補助カルボプラチンや経過観察も選択肢となる。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、経過観察、補助化学療法の治癒率は同等だが、再発率と侵襲が異なるとされる。
pmid-10592490.summary_en: This interdisciplinary guideline update for testicular cancer covers management of stage I seminoma, where radiotherapy is standard with adjuvant carboplatin or surveillance as alternatives, and clinical stage IIC-III disease, treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. For nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, surveillance, and adjuvant chemotherapy offer similar cure rates but differ in relapse rates and morbidity. The guideline also addresses risk-adapted strategies, TIN, residual tumor resection, CNS metastases, and recurrence therapy.

pmid-10595911.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢分化を規定する転写因子GATA-4を胚細胞腫瘍で検討した報告。小児卵黄嚢腫瘍9例中8例で免疫組織化学的に陽性であり、未熟奇形腫の一部でも陽性となった。成熟奇形腫16例はすべて陰性で、卵黄嚢腫瘍の有用なマーカーとなりうるとされる。
pmid-10595911.summary_en: This study examined GATA-4, a transcription factor regulating yolk sac endoderm differentiation, across human germ cell tumors. GATA-4 mRNA was detected in four germ cell tumor lines with yolk sac differentiation, and protein was found by immunohistochemistry in eight of nine pediatric yolk sac tumors. In immature teratomas it was seen in neural blastematous and cylindrical epithelial components, whereas all 16 mature teratomas were negative. The authors propose GATA-4 as a clinically useful marker for yolk sac tumors.

pmid-10597200.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生を説明する分子モデルを提唱した報告。胚性胚細胞の異数性化を初期事象とし、染色体領域の増減を経て腫瘍が形成されるとする。12p領域の増加が一貫して認められ、その領域の原因遺伝子を同定中である。この遺伝子は精細管の微小環境外でアポトーシスを抑制する可能性があるとされる。
pmid-10597200.summary_en: This paper proposes a molecular model for the development of testicular germ cell tumors. The authors suggest that tumors arise from a pluripotent, erased embryonic germ cell, with aneuploidization as an early event followed by net gains and losses of chromosomal regions. A consistent gain of 12p sequences is observed, and the authors are working to identify the relevant gene on the short arm of chromosome 12. They hypothesize that this gene suppresses apoptosis outside the seminiferous tubule microenvironment.

pmid-10597201.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌(CIS)は精巣胚細胞腫瘍の共通の前駆病変である。隣接精巣の約90%に認められ、停留精巣、曖昧性器、精巣がん患者の反対側精巣などのリスク群でも高頻度に見られる。診断は生検と胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ染色で行う。低線量の局所放射線療法はCISを根絶しライディッヒ細胞を温存するため、精巣摘除術を回避できる可能性がある。ただし化学療法後のCIS再発リスクは依然高い。
pmid-10597201.summary_en: This review summarizes the biology and clinical management of testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS), the precursor of testicular germ cell tumors. CIS is found in about 90% of testes adjacent to tumors and in higher proportions in cryptorchidism, ambiguous genitalia, and the contralateral testis of patients with cancer. Diagnosis relies on biopsy with placental alkaline phosphatase staining. Low-dose testicular radiotherapy eradicates CIS while preserving Leydig cells, sparing orchiectomy, although recurrence risk after chemotherapy remains substantial.

pmid-10597202.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの早期病期に対し、照射野を限定した低線量放射線療法を評価した多施設共同試験の報告。病期I(483例)の再発は3.7%、病期IIA/B(60例)では6.7%と低く、疾患特異的生存率は99%を超えた。急性毒性は消化管症状が中心で、標準治療として推奨されている。
pmid-10597202.summary_en: This prospective multicenter trial evaluated limited-field, low-dose radiotherapy for early testicular seminoma. Clinical stage I patients (483) received 26 Gy to the para-aortic region, while stage IIA (42) and IIB (18) patients received 30 and 36 Gy to the para-aortic and high iliac nodes. With a median follow-up of about 55 months, relapse occurred in 3.7% of stage I and 6.7% of stage IIA/B patients, with disease-specific survival of 99.6% and 100%. Acute toxicity was mainly moderate gastrointestinal, and no major late toxicity was observed. The authors recommend this approach as standard treatment.

pmid-10597203.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍について、血管侵襲、胎児性癌の割合、MIB-1増殖指数などの危険因子と潜在転移の予測を検討した報告。専門家による評価では約90%の精度が得られ、経験豊富な施行者によるコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)病期分類でも同等の精度が期待できた。非専門施設では予測精度が低下するとされる。
pmid-10597203.summary_en: Preliminary results from the German Multicenter Trial examined risk factors for occult metastatic disease and relapse in clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, including vascular invasion, embryonal carcinoma percentage, and MIB-1 proliferation rate. When performed by experts, these factors predicted occult disease with about 90% accuracy, and optimized CT staging by an experienced investigator achieved similar accuracy. Combining both methods may nearly exclude relapse in some patients, but prediction was inferior when performed in non-specialized centers.

pmid-10597204.summary_ja: 中間または不良予後の胚細胞腫瘍に対し、BEP療法へパクリタキセルを加えた一次療法の第I/II相試験。推奨用量はパクリタキセル175mg/m²とBEP 500mg/m²で、評価可能な13例は全例が完全奏効し、中央値18か月の追跡で再発例はなかった。神経毒性は軽微であった。
pmid-10597204.summary_en: This phase I/II study tested adding paclitaxel to standard BEP chemotherapy as first-line treatment for intermediate- or poor-prognosis germ cell cancer, including some carcinoma of unknown primary. Thirty patients were enrolled, and paclitaxel up to 200 mg/m2 was tolerated, with 175 mg/m2 plus BEP 500 mg/m2 recommended for further testing. All 13 evaluable intermediate- or poor-prognosis patients achieved complete response, with no relapses at a median follow-up of 18 months. Neurosensory toxicity was minimal, and a randomized EORTC trial of T-BEP versus BEP was started.

pmid-10597205.summary_ja: メモリアル・スローン・ケタリング癌センターでの予後不良胚細胞腫瘍に対する初回大量化学療法の成績です。腫瘍マーカーの減衰が不十分な患者を選び、2剤または3剤のレジメンを自家骨髄移植と併用しました。歴史的対照と比べ全生存と無イベント生存が改善し、治療関連死亡率は救援設定より低い結果でした。
pmid-10597205.summary_en: A Memorial Sloan-Kettering single-center series of first-line high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell support for poor-risk germ cell tumors. Patients were selected because serum tumor markers failed to decline at the predicted half-life after several cycles of standard treatment. Both two-drug and intensified three-drug regimens were used. Compared with historical controls receiving standard first-line therapy, overall and event-free survival improved significantly, and treatment-related mortality was lower than with salvage high-dose therapy. The authors note that randomized trials are needed to confirm these results.

pmid-10597206.summary_ja: ドイツにおける胚細胞腫瘍の治療成績から、多剤再発・難治例に対する大量化学療法の役割を概説しています。過去10年の経験と臨床試験の結果により、適用の最適化が進みました。救援療法戦略における位置づけが整理されています。
pmid-10597206.summary_en: A brief overview of high-dose chemotherapy with hematopoietic stem-cell support for multiply relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors, drawn from German treatment results. The past decade of experience and clinical trial results have helped optimize the use of high-dose therapy. The abstract clarifies its role within salvage strategies for germ cell tumors. It does not report patient numbers or survival outcomes, so the conclusions are limited to the general role of this treatment.

pmid-10597207.summary_ja: 米国における胚細胞腫瘍への大量化学療法の経験をまとめた総説です。標準量治療に不応の患者では、大量カルボプラチンとエトポシドが標準治療として受け入れられています。予後不良例の初回治療や二次治療への応用も広がっています。
pmid-10597207.summary_en: A review of high-dose chemotherapy in germ cell tumors based on American experience. High-dose carboplatin and etoposide is routinely accepted as standard therapy for patients failing standard-dose regimens. Its use is increasing as aggressive second-line therapy and, to a lesser extent, in primary treatment of poor-risk disease. The authors outline the scientific rationale for multiply relapsed patients, initial salvage, and poor-risk presentations. They also describe how new prognostic information shapes current study designs. Formal study has been limited by the rarity of the disease.

pmid-10597208.summary_ja: 1982〜1996年にフランスのCentre Léon Bérardで胚細胞腫瘍75例に大量化学療法を行った単施設経験です。46例は地固め療法または不完全寛解例、29例は救援療法として投与されました。毒性死は7例、中央値42か月の追跡で45例が無病生存していました。現時点では標準治療ではないと結論づけています。
pmid-10597208.summary_en: A French single-center experience with high-dose chemotherapy in 75 germ cell tumor patients treated between 1982 and 1996. Forty-six patients received it as consolidation or for incomplete response, and 29 as salvage. The most common regimens were VIC, PEC, and Carbo-PEC. Seven patients died of toxicity. At a median follow-up of 42 months, 45 patients were alive and disease-free. The authors conclude that high-dose therapy is not yet a standard treatment for germ cell tumors, and a European randomized trial is ongoing.

pmid-10597209.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を概説しています。アントラサイクリン、ビノレルビン、トポテカン、スラミン、レチノイン酸は臨床的活性を示しませんでした。パクリタキセルの奏効率は21％、ゲムシタビンは集中的に前治療された患者で17％でした。ベンダムスチンとオキサリプラチンの試験が進行中です。
pmid-10597209.summary_en: A review of treatment options for cisplatin-refractory testicular germ cell tumors, which have a poor prognosis. Anthracyclines, vinorelbine, topotecan, suramin, and retinoic acid showed no clinical activity. Paclitaxel gave a 21% response rate, and gemcitabine gave 17% in heavily pretreated patients, many of whom had prior high-dose therapy. Paclitaxel has been added to salvage regimens with cisplatin or ifosfamide. Ongoing German trials are evaluating bendamustine and oxaliplatin. Future strategies may include alternating treatments and new agent combinations.

pmid-10597210.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の残存腫瘤の管理を総説する。腫瘍マーカーの正常化と正常なコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)から生存腫瘍や奇形腫を予測することは不確実で、既存基準では約20%が偽陰性となる。後腹膜再発は2〜4%に限られ、手術には合併症があるため、十分なフォローアップが確保できれば二次手術は避けるべきとしている。手術を行う場合は、残存腫瘤の切除(修正テンプレート郭清の有無を含む)に限定することが望ましいと提案している。
pmid-10597210.summary_en: Discusses management of residual masses after chemotherapy for advanced nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Predicting viable tumor or teratoma from normal markers and CT is unreliable, with about 20% false-negative predictions under established criteria. Because retroperitoneal recurrence occurs in only 2-4% of patients and surgery carries morbidity, the authors favor avoiding secondary surgery when adequate follow-up is assured. When surgery is performed, they suggest limiting it to resection of the residual mass, with or without a modified template dissection.

pmid-10597211.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行う対象の選び方を、716例の国際データで比較しています。10 mm基準では未切除の204例中、成熟奇形腫が25％、がんが5％残っていました。確率ベースの予測モデルは切除数を増やさずに選択を精緻化できました。
pmid-10597211.summary_en: Evaluates policies for selecting patients for retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular cancer, using 716 patients from an international dataset. A simple 10 mm size cutoff left 204 masses unresected, including 25% with mature teratoma and 5% with cancer. Rule-based policies reduced residual tumor left unresected but increased the number of resections. Probability-based models refined selection without increasing resections, supporting their wider clinical application.

pmid-10597212.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の治療後に生じる治療関連悪性腫瘍を総説しています。固形腫瘍は主に放射線療法と関連し、一般集団の約2〜3倍のリスクがあります。白血病はエトポシドなどと関連し、累積用量2 g/m²超では約2％です。自家幹細胞支持を伴う大量化学療法ではリスクが低いとされます。
pmid-10597212.summary_en: Reviews therapy-related malignancies after treatment for germ cell cancer. Solid tumors are mainly linked to radiotherapy, with about a 2- to 3-fold increased risk compared with the general population. Leukemias are mainly linked to topoisomerase-II inhibitors and alkylating agents, with cumulative incidence around 0.5% at etoposide doses up to 2 g/m2 and about 2% above that. High-dose chemotherapy with stem-cell support carries a lower risk of myelodysplasia and leukemia. The authors conclude that current regimens favor benefit, but less toxic alternatives should still be sought.

pmid-10597213.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における細胞傷害性治療が長期妊孕性に与える影響を総説しています。治療前に半数以上の患者で精子形成が障害されています。シスプラチンの累積用量が400 mg/m²未満では長期的障害は起こりにくいとされます。病期Iのセミノーマでは、現代的な放射線療法により妊孕性障害の可能性は極めて低いとされます。
pmid-10597213.summary_en: Reviews how cytotoxic treatment affects long-term fertility in testicular germ cell cancer. More than half of patients show impaired spermatogenesis before treatment, which complicates assessment. Prospective comparisons with surveillance suggest chemotherapy does not irreversibly impair fertility when cumulative cisplatin is below 400 mg/m2, whereas higher doses cause long-term gonadal loss. For stage I seminoma, modern radiotherapy with limited field size and testicular shielding makes radiation-induced infertility very unlikely.

pmid-10597222.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1において、HMBAによる増殖停止と分化を制御するp27の役割を検討しています。p27をノックダウンするとアポトーシスが誘導され、過剰発現では増殖が抑えられました。p21やCDK2阻害では分化は誘導されず、p27が代替不能な因子であることが示されています。
pmid-10597222.summary_en: Investigates how the cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor p27kip1 regulates growth arrest and differentiation in NT2/D1 human embryonal carcinoma cells treated with HMBA. HMBA raised p27 levels and suppressed cyclin E/CDK2 activity. Antisense knockdown of p27 caused apoptosis, while p27 overexpression reduced growth and partly mimicked differentiation. p21 or CDK2 inhibition produced growth arrest without differentiation, indicating that p27 is a unique and essential mediator.

pmid-10597747.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍のBEP化学療法および残存奇形腫切除後、3年で縦隔再発が骨外性骨肉腫と診断された21歳男性の症例報告。奇形腫成分の組織学的転化は稀な現象で、胚細胞腫瘍の生物学を示す。化学療法と腫瘍摘出は奏効せず、患者は脳転移で死亡した。文献レビューと発生機序の考察を含む。
pmid-10597747.summary_en: A 21-year-old man with a mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumor received BEP chemotherapy and resection of residual teratoma. Three years later, a mediastinal recurrence was diagnosed as extraskeletal osteosarcoma, representing histologic transformation of the teratomatous component. Chemotherapy and tumor removal were unsuccessful, and the patient died of cerebral metastases. The authors review the literature and discuss the pathogenesis of this uncommon transformation.

pmid-10599033.summary_ja: 縦隔未熟奇形腫に対し化学療法と全切除で寛解した27歳男性が、2年後に貧血と白赤芽球症を呈した症例報告。骨髄と胸水から横紋筋肉腫細胞が検出され、モザイク型クラインフェルター症候群が判明した。奇形腫の横紋筋肉腫への転化と診断された。集中化学療法にもかかわらず、髄膜浸潤で死亡した。
pmid-10599033.summary_en: A 27-year-old man with a mediastinal immature teratoma achieved remission after chemotherapy and total resection. Two years later he presented with anemia and leukoerythroblastosis, and rhabdomyosarcoma cells were found in marrow and pleural fluid. Karyotyping revealed mosaic Klinefelter syndrome. The authors diagnose transformation of the teratoma into rhabdomyosarcoma in this setting. Despite intensive chemotherapy, the patient died with meningeal infiltration.

pmid-10600295.summary_ja: 正常栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞株の遺伝子発現をcDNAアレイで比較し、9遺伝子の差を同定した。絨毛癌ではHsp-27が低下しており、細胞株および組織切片で確認された。Hsp-27は栄養膜の分化に関与する可能性があり、その低下が絨毛癌の化学療法感受性の高さに寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10600295.summary_en: This study compared gene expression between normal trophoblast and choriocarcinoma cell lines using a cDNA expression array. Nine genes differed significantly, including downregulation of heat shock protein-27 (Hsp-27) in choriocarcinoma. The Hsp-27 reduction was confirmed in cell lines by RT-PCR and Western blot, and in paraffin sections by immunohistochemistry. Strong Hsp-27 expression in villous trophoblast may contribute to differentiation, and its loss may underlie the chemosensitivity of trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-10600316.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の悪性転化による扁平上皮癌が、肛門扁平上皮癌に類似した直腸出血で発見された症例報告。後方骨盤内臓器全摘術と放射線療法後に膣断端再発を来し、シスプラチン単剤にも抵抗性で、初回手術から9か月で死亡した。診断の落とし穴と補助療法の根拠の乏しさを論じる。
pmid-10600316.summary_en: A woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising from malignant transformation of an ovarian dermoid cyst presented with rectal bleeding that mimicked anal carcinoma. Treatment with posterior exenteration, cytoreductive surgery and pelvic radiotherapy was followed by vaginal cuff recurrence and failure of single-agent cisplatin. She died nine months after surgery. The report discusses diagnostic pitfalls and the limited evidence for adjuvant management.

pmid-10602867.summary_ja: 胸膜肺芽腫の患者に、第二の原発性腫瘍として良性奇形腫が認められた症例報告。この稀な組み合わせの放射線学的所見と臨床経過が示され、腫瘍の生物学的意義が考察されている。抄録が短いため、奇形腫の詳細な病理所見や発生部位は不明である。
pmid-10602867.summary_en: The authors describe a patient with pleuropulmonary blastoma in whom a benign teratoma was identified as a second primary tumor. The report presents the radiologic findings and clinical course of this rare association. It also discusses the biological importance of this neoplasm. Because the abstract is brief, pathologic details and the exact site of the teratoma are not specified in the excerpt.

pmid-10604709.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍29例に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を後方視的に検討した。後腹膜リンパ節の41%が陽性で、臨床病期I症例の約30%が病理学的に病期IIへ上方修正された。陽性例10例は補助的白金製剤ベース化学療法を受けた。フォローアップ期間1〜65か月では後腹膜再発は認められなかった。陽性リンパ節が肉眼的に確認された場合は郭清範囲を制限し、2例は出血のため開腹移行した。著者らは、より大規模で長期の研究が必要としつつ、腹腔鏡下RPLNDは経過観察や開腹RPLNDに代わる実行可能で低侵襲な選択肢と結論した。
pmid-10604709.summary_en: This retrospective study of 29 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors evaluated laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND). Retroperitoneal nodes were positive in 41% of patients, and about 30% of clinical stage I cases were pathologically upstaged. Ten node-positive patients received adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. No retroperitoneal recurrence was seen during 1 to 65 months of follow-up. Dissection was limited when nodes were grossly positive, and two cases required conversion to open surgery for hemorrhage. The authors conclude that laparoscopic RPLND is a feasible, minimally invasive alternative to surveillance or open RPLND, though larger, longer studies are needed.

pmid-10613596.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍75例に対するBEP療法(ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン)の後方視的解析。用量強度などの用量送達要素は、完全奏効の有無と有意な関連を示さなかった。治療転帰を最も強く予測したのは病変の範囲であった。完全奏効率は64%、3年無増悪生存期間は59%であった。
pmid-10613596.summary_en: In 75 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy, the authors examined whether drug dose delivery components affected outcome. Overall complete response was 64% and 3-year progression-free survival was 59%. Dose intensity measures did not differ significantly between complete and incomplete responders in either disease-extent or whole-group analyses. Extent of disease, rather than delivered dose, was the most important predictor of outcome. The retrospective design limits generalizability, though the findings support using disease extent to guide risk stratification.

pmid-10614561.summary_ja: 小児の胚細胞腫瘍を総説する。悪性胚細胞腫瘍は小児悪性腫瘍の約3%を占め、米国では年間約225例が発生する。3歳未満では性腺外および精巣の発生が多く、思春期以降は性腺が主な部位となる。女児に多い。始原生殖細胞の異常な移動が発生に関与し、腫瘍マーカーは切除範囲の評価や再発の把握に有用である。白金製剤ベースの化学療法は生存率を大きく改善し、再発性または転移性疾患の救済にも寄与している。
pmid-10614561.summary_en: This review summarizes pediatric germ cell tumors, which account for about 3% of childhood malignancies and occur in roughly 225 new cases per year in the United States. Extragonadal and testicular sites predominate in children under three, while gonadal sites dominate after puberty, and girls are affected more often. The authors highlight aberrant primordial germ cell migration, the utility of tumor markers for assessing resection extent and recurrence, and the marked survival improvement brought by platinum-based chemotherapy, which also aids salvage of relapsed or metastatic disease.

pmid-10614704.summary_ja: 妊娠34～35週の36歳患者に生じた卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。経腟用トランスデューサーを経腹的に用いると、通常の超音波検査では不明瞭な石灰化、毛髪、脂肪組織が明瞭に描出され、診断に有用であった。産後6週で開腹による左卵巣嚢腫摘出術が行われ、病理で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。
pmid-10614704.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old patient at 34 to 35 weeks' gestation with left upper abdominal pain and a complex right upper abdominal adnexal mass. Standard transabdominal ultrasound was unclear, but applying a high-frequency transvaginal transducer transabdominally clearly showed calcifications, hair, and fat, supporting a diagnosis of mature cystic ovarian teratoma. The patient delivered at 39 weeks and underwent elective laparotomy with left ovarian cystectomy six weeks postpartum, and pathology confirmed mature cystic teratoma. The technique proved useful for diagnosis during pregnancy.

pmid-10616195.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍のセミノーマ8例と非セミノーマ10例を対象に、4番と8番染色体を基準とした改変比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で染色体の増減を解析した。既報と一致する結果が得られ、両亜型の比較データも加わった。倍数性の影響を補正する本手法は、発症機序の理解に有用とされる。
pmid-10616195.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization (CGH) with a modified normalization approach, using chromosomes 4 and 8 as ploidy references, to analyze chromosomal gains and losses in testicular germ cell tumors. Eight seminomas and ten nonseminomas were examined. The method allowed regions outside each tumor's intermediate ploidy range to be identified more accurately. Results agreed with earlier karyotypic and CGH findings and added comparative data between seminoma and nonseminoma subtypes. The authors conclude that the approach improves understanding of chromosomal changes and pathogenesis in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-10621907.summary_ja: 機能性卵巣甲状腺腫に濾胞癌を生じた症例を報告する。良性疾患で甲状腺亜全摘術を受けた女性に卵巣腫瘤が出現した。両側卵管卵巣摘出術に加え放射線療法とL-サイロキシン投与を行い、4年間のフォローアップで転移は認められなかった。予後は良好であった。
pmid-10621907.summary_en: This case report describes follicular carcinoma arising in a functioning struma ovarii, a specialized teratoma, presenting as an ovarian mass in a woman who had previously undergone near-total thyroidectomy for a benign lesion. Treatment comprised bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy followed by radiotherapy and L-thyroxine. After four years of follow-up there was no evidence of metastasis, supporting a favorable course with this approach.

pmid-10624852.summary_ja: 対側精巣セミノーマの2例に対し、残存精巣の局所切除と術後20Gyまたは19.8Gyの放射線療法を行う臓器温存治療を報告する。両例とも3年以上無病生存し、男性ホルモン産生は低下したが保たれ、無精子症となった。精巣摘除術に代わる方法として、生存成績を損なわずホルモン機能を温存できると結論している。
pmid-10624852.summary_en: This report describes two patients with contralateral testicular seminoma treated with organ preservation, consisting of local excision of the remaining testicle followed by low-dose postoperative irradiation of 20 Gy in 10 fractions or 19.8 Gy in 11 fractions. Both remained disease-free beyond three years, retained reduced but preserved androgen production and virility, and became azoospermic. The authors argue that organ-sparing treatment is superior to orchiectomy, offering equal survival with better hormonal preservation.

pmid-10626682.summary_ja: マウス栄養膜細胞で免疫したモノクローナル抗体を、正常胎盤、胞状奇胎、絨毛癌の組織で検討した。複数のマウス・ヒト交差反応抗体が得られた。侵入性と非侵入性の胞状奇胎を区別できる抗体や、正常栄養膜にあり腫瘍性栄養膜にはない抗原を認識する抗体も見いだされた。栄養膜特異的な診断ツールとしての可能性を示した。
pmid-10626682.summary_en: This study generated monoclonal antibodies by immunizing with living early invasive mouse trophoblast cells and screened them on placental tissue from first- and third-trimester pregnancies, hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinoma. Several mouse-human cross-reacting antibodies were identified. One trophoblast-specific antibody differentiated invasive from noninvasive molar tissue, while two detected epitopes present in normal but absent in neoplastic trophoblast.

pmid-10626875.summary_ja: 出生前超音波検査で発見された4か月児の肝内胎児内胎児の症例を報告する。画像と病理で診断し、肝半切除術で摘出した。隣接する奇形腫を伴い、3結節のうち2つは胎児内胎児の基準を満たし、残り1つは良性奇形腫の特徴を示した。肝臓には多発性の血管性過誤腫も認められた。
pmid-10626875.summary_en: This case report describes an intrahepatic fetus-in-fetu in a 4-month-old infant, detected on antenatal ultrasound, diagnosed by imaging and pathology, and resected by hemihepatectomy. The lesion included an adjacent teratoma, and two of three nodules met fetus-in-fetu criteria while the third had benign teratoma features. Multiple vascular hamartomas were also found in the liver. The authors review the literature on fetus-in-fetu combined with teratoma.

pmid-10629564.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学とウェスタンブロットを用い、正常胎盤および胞状奇胎・侵入奇胎・絨毛癌におけるシンデカンとグリピカン-1の発現を検討した。病変の重症度が高まるほど発現は低下し、特に侵入奇胎と絨毛癌で顕著であった。シンデカン-2と-4は局在にも異常が見られた。これらの変化は微小環境への応答性を変えると考えられ、絨毛性疾患の進行機構の理解に寄与する可能性がある。
pmid-10629564.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry and western blot study examined syndecan-1, -2, -3, -4 and glypican-1 expression in normal placenta and in gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole, invasive mole and choriocarcinoma. Syndecan-3 was absent from all tissues. During normal gestation the proteoglycans showed stage-specific patterns. In pathological tissue, immunostaining progressively decreased with increasing disease severity, most prominently in invasive mole and choriocarcinoma, and syndecan-2 and -4 showed altered localization. The authors suggest these changes alter cellular responsiveness to the microenvironment and may inform understanding of trophoblastic disease progression.

pmid-10629640.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍81例について、免疫組織化学とウェスタンブロットでmdm-2蛋白発現を検討した。核内の免疫反応は約56%に認められ、非セミノーマで有意に多く、転移例や病期が進んだ症例で高頻度であった。病期の進行とともに発現頻度は増加した。mdm-2の免疫染色は、より侵襲性の高い症例を識別する予後指標となりうると結論されている。
pmid-10629640.summary_en: This study examined mdm-2 protein expression by immunohistochemistry and western blot in 81 testicular germ cell tumors. Nuclear mdm-2 immunoreactivity was present in 55.6 percent of tumors and was significantly more frequent in non-seminomas than in seminomas. Expression was also higher in tumors from metastatic patients and in advanced clinical stages, increasing with stage. Western blot showed the p90 mdm-2 oncoprotein in most tested tumors. The authors conclude that mdm-2 immunostaining may serve as a reliable prognostic marker for identifying patients with more aggressive testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-10631701.summary_ja: 精巣がんの臨床病期分類、予後、治療の最近の進歩を概説した総説である。血管浸潤、リンパ管浸潤、胎児性癌の割合は低病期非セミノーマの転移を予測する。CTは有用な病期分類法であり、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清は病期分類の手段として実施可能とされる。高リスクの臨床病期I非セミノーマに対する初回化学療法は、優位性が証明されておらず推奨されていない。
pmid-10631701.summary_en: This review covers recent advances in clinical staging, prognosis and therapy of testicular cancer. Vascular invasion, lymphatic invasion and a high percentage of embryonal carcinoma predict metastasis in low-stage nonseminoma, and low MIB-1 staining together with low embryonal carcinoma content suggests a low risk of metastasis. CT is a useful staging tool, and laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy appears feasible for staging. The authors note that primary chemotherapy is not currently recommended for high-risk clinical stage I nonseminoma because its superiority is unproven and it can cause long-term sequelae.

pmid-10631738.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1976～1995年に仙尾部奇形腫の治療を受けた23例の小児を検討した。乳児期以降に発見された3例は悪性組織型（卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む）で、全例が再発した。全体で8例が再発し、うち6例は悪性であった。平均12.3年後に受診した生存者17例のうち、5例（29.4%）に尿路または肛門直腸の機能障害が認められた。著者らは、術後のフォローアップでは再発に加え、二次的な尿失禁と便失禁も評価すべきと結論している。
pmid-10631738.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 23 children treated for sacrococcygeal teratoma between 1976 and 1995. Three patients with tumors presenting after infancy had malignant histology, including yolk sac tumor, and all three recurred. Eight children overall had recurrences, six of them malignant. Among 17 survivors reviewed after a mean interval of 12.3 years, several had urinary or anorectal functional impairment, including incontinence, enuresis and neurogenic bladder with reflux. The authors conclude that follow-up after sacrococcygeal teratoma surgery should screen not only for recurrence but also for secondary urinary and fecal incontinence.

pmid-10634163.summary_ja: 絨毛癌と肝転移を有する女性が、Clostridium septicumによるガス産生性の肝膿瘍を発症した症例を報告している。C. septicumは大腸癌や血液悪性疾患との関連が知られる嫌気性グラム陽性桿菌で、肝膿瘍の原因となることはまれである。本症例と既報から、肝膿瘍からC. septicumが検出された場合には、背景に転移性肝腫瘍があることを強く疑うべきだと指摘されている。
pmid-10634163.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with choriocarcinoma and liver metastasis who developed a gas-forming liver abscess caused by Clostridium septicum. C. septicum is an anaerobic gram-positive bacillus strongly associated with colon and hematologic malignancies, and liver abscess due to this organism is rare. The authors note that when C. septicum is identified in a liver abscess, an underlying metastatic liver tumor should be strongly suspected, drawing on this case and previous reports.

pmid-10636053.summary_ja: 胎児の仙尾部奇形腫4例の超音波所見を報告した小規模症例集積研究。妊娠13〜27週で診断され、多くは充実性で一部に嚢胞を伴った。羊水過多や胎児水腫を合併し、早産となった例もあった。出生後に切除された2例は生存し、2例は死亡した。妊娠初期にも診断できる可能性があり、分娩方針の決定に役立つとされる。
pmid-10636053.summary_en: This small case series of four fetuses describes the prenatal ultrasonographic features of sacrococcygeal teratoma, diagnosed between 13 and 27 weeks of gestation. Tumors were mostly solid with cystic areas, and one was entirely cystic. Complications included polyhydramnios, hydrops, and preterm delivery. Two infants survived after postnatal resection, while two died. The authors conclude that an abnormal sacrococcygeal mass can be detected in utero, possibly even in the first trimester, which can influence delivery planning.

pmid-10637741.summary_ja: 30歳男性の右陰嚢内容無痛性腫脹例。胸部X線とCTに異常なく、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)、LDHはいずれも正常であった。右高位精巣摘除術で530gの巨大腫瘍が切除され、病理組織学的に未熟奇形腫と診断された。追加治療は行われず、術後7か月間再発はみられていない。腫瘍マーカーが正常でも巨大な精巣腫瘍が存在しうることを示す症例である。
pmid-10637741.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with painless swelling of the right scrotal contents. Chest radiography and abdominal CT showed no abnormalities, and serum AFP, hCG, and LDH were normal. Right high orchiectomy revealed a 13.5 cm tumor weighing 530 g, pathologically diagnosed as immature teratoma. No further therapy was given, and there was no recurrence at 7 months after surgery. The report illustrates that a giant testicular tumor can present with normal tumor markers.

pmid-10637743.summary_ja: 1980年以降に進行精巣がんで化学療法を受けた73例の単施設報告。43例がサルベージ手術を受けた。化学療法単独での完全奏効は41%、サルベージ治療後の無病生存は86%であった。残存病変が成熟奇形腫または壊死のみの症例は予後良好であったが、残存がんでは生存率は54%にとどまった。サルベージ手術は依然として重要と結論づけられている。
pmid-10637743.summary_en: This single-institution Japanese series reviewed 73 men with advanced testicular cancer treated with chemotherapy since 1980, 43 of whom underwent salvage surgery. First-line regimens included PVB, PEB, and VAB-6. Complete response to chemotherapy alone was 41%, and 86% achieved no evidence of disease after salvage treatment. Residual mature teratoma or necrosis carried an excellent prognosis, whereas residual carcinoma had 54% survival. The authors conclude that salvage surgery remains essential.

pmid-10637744.summary_ja: 精巣および性腺外胚細胞腫瘍115例の化学療法の有効性と毒性を検討した。5年生存率はセミノーマで84%、非セミノーマで68%であった。予後不良例では42〜45%だった。早期の重篤な毒性は15.7%に認められ、晩期にはしびれ、耳鳴、持続的な無精子症などがみられた。BEP療法後にVIP療法を行う方法が標準とされ、予後良好例では毒性の少ない治療、予後不良例では強化治療が推奨されている。
pmid-10637744.summary_en: This report reviews 115 patients with testicular and extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with chemotherapy. Five-year survival was 84% for seminoma and 68% for non-seminoma. Poor-prognosis patients had 42-45% five-year survival. Early serious toxicities occurred in 15.7% of patients, and late effects included numbness, tinnitus, and persistent azoospermia. The authors recommend BEP followed by VIP as standard therapy, with less toxic treatment for good-risk patients and intensified therapy for poor-risk patients.

pmid-10637746.summary_ja: 1997〜1998年に名古屋大学病院で予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍6例に、末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う大量CEC療法を実施した。適応は治療抵抗性の腫瘍マーカー上昇、再発、切除不能な縦隔残存腫瘍であった。治療関連死はなく、6例中5例が奏効した。3例は23〜24か月後も寛解を維持していた。忍容性は良好だが、有効性にはさらなる検討が必要とされる。
pmid-10637746.summary_en: Six patients with germ cell tumor received high-dose CEC (carboplatin, etoposide, cyclophosphamide) with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation at Nagoya University Hospital from 1997 to 1998. Indications included marker-refractory disease, relapse, and unresectable residual mediastinal tumor. No treatment-related deaths occurred. Five of six patients responded, and three remained in remission at 23 to 24 months. The authors conclude the regimen was feasible but that its effectiveness requires further study.

pmid-10637747.summary_ja: 予後不良の進行胚細胞腫瘍14例に対し、末梢血幹細胞移植を伴う超大量化学療法を実施した。導入療法として投与された10例中8例(80%)で腫瘍マーカーが正常化した。切除を受けた7例中5例で手術または病理学的完全奏効が得られた。1年および3年無病生存率はそれぞれ88%、72%であった。安全に実施可能で有用な治療となりうると結論づけられている。
pmid-10637747.summary_en: Fourteen patients with poor-risk advanced germ cell tumors received super high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation. Nadir blood counts and recovery periods were documented. Of 10 patients given it as induction therapy, 80% normalized serum tumor markers. Surgical or pathological complete response was obtained in 5 of 7 resected patients. The 1- and 3-year disease-free survival rates were 88% and 72%. The authors conclude the approach is safe and potentially useful.

pmid-10637748.summary_ja: 予後不良の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を対象とした日本血液細胞移植研究会のパイロット研究。34例のうち16例がBEP療法に大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞自家移植を併用された。腫瘍マーカーが正常化した6例では、切除標本で奇形腫が1例、がんが5例に認められた。追跡中央値11か月で81%が生存し、56%が無病生存であった。
pmid-10637748.summary_en: A pilot study by the Japan Blood Cell Transplantation Study Group evaluated one cycle of high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell autotransplantation in poor-risk testicular germ cell tumor patients. Eighteen patients received BEP alone, and 16 received BEP followed by high-dose chemotherapy. Among the six patients whose markers normalized, pathology showed teratoma in one and carcinoma in five. At a median follow-up of 11 months, 81% were alive and 56% were disease-free. Hematologic recovery times were also documented.

pmid-10639765.summary_ja: 女性患者が膿胸として受診し、予定どおり胸膜剥皮術を行ったところ、左下葉に嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。切除標本の病理組織学的検査で原発性肺内奇形腫と診断された。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の一型である肺奇形腫が、感染性胸膜疾患と類似した経過をとりうることを示す希少例である。術後の経過や追加治療については記載がない。
pmid-10639765.summary_en: A female patient presented with empyema thoracis and underwent planned decortication. Intraoperatively, a cystic mass was found in the left lower lobe and resected. Histopathology diagnosed a primary intrapulmonary teratoma. The authors report this unusual case to highlight that a primary lung teratoma, an extragonadal germ cell tumor, can mimic infectious pleural disease. No details of postoperative course or follow-up are provided.

pmid-10639779.summary_ja: 本報告は27歳男性の後腹膜奇形腫の症例で、長管骨、顎骨、骨盤、肩甲骨といった体軸骨格の構造を含むことが特徴である。これは胎児内胎児に相当し、一卵性双胎の発生異常によると考察されている。成人での発症は極めて稀であり、本症例はその点で貴重な報告である。
pmid-10639779.summary_en: The authors describe a rare case of retroperitoneal teratoma in a 27-year-old man containing recognizable axial skeletal structures, including long bones, jaw, pelvis and scapula, consistent with fetus in fetu. They suggest it may arise from aberrant monozygotic twinning. Because such a presentation in an adult is especially rare, the case adds to the limited literature on this entity.

pmid-10643021.summary_ja: 26歳女性の帝王切開時に摘出された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例である。腺性下垂体と神経性下垂体の両方を含む異所性下垂体組織が認められた。前葉成分の免疫組織化学では、従来は剖検例でしか報告されていなかった妊娠関連の変化が示された。卵巣奇形腫内の異所性下垂体という稀な所見の報告である。
pmid-10643021.summary_en: The authors report a 26-year-old woman who underwent cesarean section and had a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary containing ectopic pituitary tissue, including both adenohypophysis and neurohypophysis. Immunocytochemistry of the anterior pituitary component showed pregnancy-related changes previously described only in autopsy pituitaries. The report documents this rare finding and highlights hormonal changes in pregnancy.

pmid-10643538.summary_ja: 化学療法で完全寛解後に再発した胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした、大量化学療法による救援治療の多施設前向き第II相試験である。35例が治療され、良好リスク群の2年救済率は65%、無増悪生存期間の中央値は44か月であった。静脈閉塞性疾患などの毒性が報告され、Beyerの予後モデルが独立した患者群で確認された。
pmid-10643538.summary_en: This Dutch multicenter phase II trial tested high-dose alkylating chemotherapy as salvage for germ-cell cancer patients relapsing after chemotherapy-induced complete remission.
