Patients received conventional-dose ifosfamide and etoposide with stem-cell harvest, then intermediate-dose carboplatin and etoposide, followed by two cycles of high-dose CTC with transplant. Of 35 patients, the two-year salvage rate in good-risk patients was 65%, with median PFS of 44 months. Toxicities included veno-occlusive disease, and the results confirm the Beyer prognostic model.

pmid-10645228.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎35例、正常胎盤、絨毛癌組織と細胞株でテロメラーゼ活性をTRAP法で測定した研究である。持続性絨毛性疾患へ進展した奇胎の75%で活性が検出され、自然寛解例の18.5%より高頻度であった。奇胎における活性化の頻度は早期胎盤と同程度で、奇胎は本質的に異常な妊娠産物との見解が示された。予後予測因子としての検討が必要とされる。
pmid-10645228.summary_en: Telomerase activity was measured by the TRAP assay in 35 hydatidiform moles, 35 normal placentas, choriocarcinoma tissue and cell lines. Telomerase was detected in 75% of moles that developed persistent trophoblastic disease, compared with 18.5% of those that regressed spontaneously, and its frequency in moles resembled that in early placentas. The authors conclude that the mole is essentially an abnormal conceptus and that telomerase activation is associated with persistent disease, warranting prognostic study.

pmid-10645528.summary_ja: 妊娠32週で出生した早産児の、胎児期に診断された仙尾部奇形腫の症例である。帝王切開時に腫瘍が破裂し、大量出血が生じた。輸液と手術を尽くしたが止血できず、55分後に蘇生が中止された。文献的考察と、仙尾部奇形腫を有する新生児の管理に関する提言が示されている。
pmid-10645528.summary_en: The authors report a premature infant born at 32 weeks' gestation by cesarean section, with a sacrococcygeal teratoma diagnosed in utero. Rupture of the tumor during delivery caused profound bleeding that did not respond to volume expansion or surgical control, and resuscitation was discontinued after 55 minutes. The authors review the relevant literature and offer suggestions for managing infants with sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-10645807.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の原因妊娠が、先行妊娠でも次の正常分娩でもなく、侵入奇胎へ進展した完全胞状奇胎であったことを示した症例である。新規STSプライマー5組を用いたPCRで遺伝子型を解析し、腫瘍と夫、奇胎のアレルを比較した。絨毛癌の原因妊娠を遺伝学的に特定する手法の有用性が示されている。
pmid-10645807.summary_en: This case report describes gestational choriocarcinoma whose responsible pregnancy was a complete hydatidiform mole that had progressed to invasive mole, rather than the antecedent or the subsequent term pregnancy. Using five new sequence-tagged site primer sets on four chromosomes, PCR analysis matched the tumor alleles to the husband and molar DNA. The study demonstrates the value of genetic tracing for identifying the causative pregnancy of choriocarcinoma.

pmid-10646030.summary_ja: 単独精巣の男性が残存精巣に胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告である。標準治療である2回目の精巣摘除は、不妊、ホルモン補充の必要性、心理的負担をもたらす。精巣温存の可能性を検討し、摘除前に組織学的診断を得ることで正常な精巣を失うリスクを避けるべきと述べている。
pmid-10646030.summary_en: This case report concerns a man with a solitary testis who developed a germ cell tumour in the remaining testis. The authors explore whether testis-sparing management is feasible, since standard second orchidectomy causes infertility, the need for hormone replacement and psychological morbidity. They also emphasize that histological diagnosis should be obtained before orchidectomy to avoid removing a potentially normal testis.

pmid-10646979.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の中で最も稀な胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の画像所見を報告している。高血管型では掻爬による大量出血のリスクがあり避けるべきとされ、比較的低血管型では子宮温存手術の可能性がある。画像診断の主な役割は腫瘍の血管分布を明らかにすることである。
pmid-10646979.summary_en: This imaging review addresses placental site trophoblastic tumor, the least common form of gestational trophoblastic disease. The authors describe two types: a hypervascular type, in which dilatation and curettage risks massive bleeding and should be avoided, and a relatively hypovascular type, in which uterine-conserving surgery may be possible. The main role of imaging is to clarify tumor vascularity.

pmid-10649813.summary_ja: 18歳女性の症例報告で、単角子宮と非交通性の遺残角、右卵巣の充実性腫瘤を認めた。手術で卵巣未分化胚細胞腫と診断された。ミュラー管奇形が卵巣悪性腫瘍の素因となることは考えにくいが、若年女性でも子宮頸部、子宮、卵巣の悪性腫瘍が生じうるため注意が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-10649813.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with a unicornuate uterus, a non-communicating rudimentary horn, and a solid right ovarian mass. Surgery identified the mass as a dysgerminoma. The authors conclude that Müllerian anomalies do not appear to predispose women to ovarian malignancy, but such patients may still develop cervical, uterine, or ovarian cancers and need careful evaluation. The report highlights the rare coexistence of a malignant ovarian germ cell tumor with a Müllerian anomaly.

pmid-10655574.summary_ja: 小児の純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍3例を報告し、うち2例で細胞学的所見を提示した。組織像は多彩だが、細胞診では捉えにくい。PAS陽性でジアスターゼ抵抗性の硝子小体はαフェトプロテイン産生に対応し、泡沫状の細胞質が特徴である。鑑別は腺癌であり、確定には組織学的、免疫細胞化学的、臨床的な所見の統合が必要である。
pmid-10655574.summary_en: This report describes three pediatric patients with pure yolk sac tumors arising in gonadal and extragonadal sites. The authors present cytologic findings in two cases and note that the variable histologic patterns are not evident on cytology. Key cytologic features include PAS-positive, diastase-resistant hyaline globules corresponding to alpha-fetoprotein production and cells with bubbly cytoplasm. The main differential diagnosis is adenocarcinoma, and definitive diagnosis requires histologic, immunocytochemical, and clinical correlation.

pmid-10660107.summary_ja: 放射線感受性の異なるラット卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株NMT-1とNMT-1Rを用い、潜在致死損傷修復(PLDR)とカフェインによる抑制効果を比較した。5Gy照射後の回復比は耐性株で高く(5.2対2.8)、カフェインによる抑制も弱かった。PLDR能は放射線感受性を規定する因子の一つと考えられる。
pmid-10660107.summary_en: This study compared two rat yolk sac tumor cell lines with different radiosensitivity, NMT-1 (sensitive) and NMT-1R (resistant), to examine potentially lethal damage repair (PLDR) and the effect of caffeine on it. The resistant line showed greater PLDR after 5 Gy irradiation (recovery ratio 5.2 versus 2.8) and was less inhibited by caffeine. The inhibitory effect of caffeine correlated with a reduction in G2-arrested cells. The authors suggest that PLDR capacity is one determinant of radiosensitivity.

pmid-10663328.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍55例で、血清β-hCGをポリクローナルRIAとモノクローナルFIAの2法で測定し比較した。4例(7%)で結果が不一致となり、両法で相反する判定がみられた。AFPでは不一致はなかった。単一の測定法では全例を正確に評価できないため、キットの選択に注意が必要と結論づけた。
pmid-10663328.summary_en: This prospective study of 55 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis compared a polyclonal radioimmunoassay with a monoclonal fluoroimmunoassay for serum beta-hCG. Four patients (7%) showed discordant results, with the two assays giving opposite conclusions in each direction. Discordance persisted in half and resolved in one with treatment. No discordance occurred with AFP assays. The authors conclude that no single assay is reliable for all patients and that commercial kits should be chosen carefully.

pmid-10685231.summary_ja: 定期的な胎盤検査で偶然発見された無症候性の胎盤内絨毛癌の症例報告である。胎盤所見と臨床経過を示し、文献レビューを加えている。肉眼的に見逃すと播種性疾患に進展しうるため、残存・転移病変の迅速な評価と化学療法の必要性を強調している。病変の正確な認識が重要であると結論づけている。
pmid-10685231.summary_en: This report describes an asymptomatic intraplacental choriocarcinoma found incidentally on routine placental examination. The authors describe the placental findings and clinical course, and review the literature. They emphasize that such lesions must be recognized on gross inspection, because missed cases can lead to disseminated disease. Prompt evaluation for residual or metastatic disease and chemotherapy are recommended once the lesion is identified.

pmid-10685309.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を有する新生児で、自然発生的な腫瘍崩壊と進行性の腫瘍壊死から致死的な高カリウム血症を来した症例報告である。固形腫瘍での自然腫瘍崩壊は極めてまれである。心停止は手術死亡の主因の一つであるため、術中の血清カリウム値の頻回なモニタリングが必要であると述べている。
pmid-10685309.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn with a sacrococcygeal teratoma who developed spontaneous tumor lysis with progressive tumor necrosis and lethal hyperkalemia. Spontaneous tumor lysis is rare in solid tumors and has been described only once before in infancy. The authors conclude that because cardiac arrest is a major cause of operative mortality, serum potassium should be monitored frequently during surgery.

pmid-10687774.summary_ja: 1998年にオーストラリアの2施設で出生前診断され分娩に至った仙尾部奇形腫の7症例をまとめた報告である。多くは外性で一部骨盤内進展を伴い、急速増大や羊水過多を来した例もあった。周産期死亡率は14%であった。切除された6例はいずれも良性で、1例に再発を認め化学療法を要した。
pmid-10687774.summary_en: This series describes seven fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma, diagnosed prenatally in all cases and delivered at two Australian hospitals in 1998. Most tumors were external with some intrapelvic extension, and some grew rapidly with polyhydramnios. Perinatal mortality was 14%. All six resected tumors were benign, and one infant had a recurrence requiring chemotherapy. The authors describe the delivery and postnatal management.

pmid-10697617.summary_ja: 小児がんの治療後に二次がんとして骨肉腫を発症した2例の報告である。1例は悪性奇形腫に対する大量化学療法後で、薬剤が二次がんの発生に関与した可能性が示唆される。もう1例は副腎皮質癌で、p53生殖細胞系列変異という遺伝的要因が関与したと考えられる。治癒例の増加に伴い、思春期の骨肉腫が増える可能性を指摘している。
pmid-10697617.summary_en: This report describes two children in whom osteosarcoma developed as a second malignancy after childhood cancer. One patient had a malignant teratoma treated with high-dose anticancer drugs, which the authors suggest may have contributed to the second cancer. The other had adrenocortical carcinoma with a germline p53 mutation, implicating genetic factors. The authors highlight a possible rise in adolescent osteosarcoma as cured childhood cancer survivors increase.

pmid-10700830.summary_ja: 術後に切除不能となった、悪性甲状腺組織を含む卵巣奇形腫の49歳女性の症例報告である。131Iの反復投与により血清サイログロブリンと腫瘍への集積は低下したが、CA-125の上昇や超音波検査で確認された高灌流成分の進行は抑えられなかった。機能画像と腫瘍マーカーを組み合わせた評価の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-10700830.summary_en: This case report describes a 49-year-old woman with an ovarian teratoma containing malignant thyroid tissue, unresectable after surgery. Three courses of radioiodine (131I) reduced serum thyroglobulin and tumor uptake but did not stop the rise in CA-125 or the progression of a hyperperfused component seen on Doppler ultrasound. The authors emphasize combining functional imaging with tumor markers to manage this rare tumor.

pmid-10700831.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の肝転移患者で、化学療法後のCTにおいて肝病変のCT値が低下し、脂肪性・嚢胞性の濃度を示した症例報告である。著者らはこれを成熟奇形腫への「逆分化」を示すCT所見と解釈し、組織学的進行を非侵襲的にモニタリングできる可能性を示唆している。
pmid-10700831.summary_en: This report describes a patient with testicular germ cell tumor liver metastases in whom CT after chemotherapy showed lower attenuation of the liver lesions, consistent with fatty and cystic density. The authors interpret this as CT evidence of metastatic 'retroconversion' to mature teratoma, which could allow noninvasive monitoring of histologic progression. The paper focuses on imaging-based assessment after chemotherapy.

pmid-10703482.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の患者に眼転移が生じた症例報告である。眼転移は乳がんや肺がんが原発であることが多く、予後不良とされる。絨毛癌からの眼転移の報告は本例が初めてとされ、妊娠歴のある患者の眼病変では絨毛癌を鑑別に含めて検討する必要性が示唆される。報告の意義は、稀な転移部位の認識と早期診断にある。
pmid-10703482.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with gestational choriocarcinoma who developed metastasis to the eye, a site rarely involved by this tumour. Ocular metastases typically arise from breast or lung primaries and carry a poor prognosis, with mean survival of about 6.5 months after diagnosis. The authors note that ocular metastasis from choriocarcinoma had not previously been reported, making this the first documented example. The report suggests that gestational trophoblastic tumours should be considered in the differential diagnosis of ocular masses in patients with a relevant history.

pmid-10704238.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を用い、鉄キレート剤による分化誘導時の増殖、細胞死、細胞周期の変化を、レチノイン酸および酪酸ナトリウムと比較した基礎研究である。鉄キレート剤はアポトーシスとG1-S期またはS期での細胞周期停止を引き起こし、その変化はレチノイン酸や酪酸ナトリウムとは異なっていた。著者らは、アポトーシスは分化とは独立して細胞内の鉄欠乏により生じると結論づけている。
pmid-10704238.summary_en: This basic-science study examines how three iron chelators (hinokitiol, dithizone and deferoxamine) induce differentiation in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, compared with retinoic acid and sodium butyrate. The iron chelators strongly inhibited proliferation, caused internucleosomal DNA fragmentation and apoptotic cell death, and arrested cell cycle progression at the G1-S interface or in S phase. Retinoic acid induced apoptosis only weakly at low doses, and sodium butyrate did not induce apoptosis. The authors conclude that chelator-induced apoptosis arises from cellular iron deprivation and may be independent of differentiation.

pmid-10711839.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍における経口エトポシドの有用性を検討した論文である。一次化学療法後に再発または無病状態に至らない患者は予後不良である。経口エトポシドは難治例の約25%で奏効し、緩和治療の選択肢となる。救援化学療法後の維持療法としても有望とされ、いずれかの救援療法で完全奏効した患者には3か月の維持療法が推奨されている。
pmid-10711839.summary_en: This article examines oral etoposide in germ cell tumours. Patients who relapse, or who fail to achieve disease-free status after first-line chemotherapy, have a poor prognosis. Oral etoposide produces responses in about 25% of refractory patients and is a reasonable palliative option. It has also been studied as maintenance after salvage chemotherapy or surgery, with results favourable compared with historical data. The authors recommend three months of maintenance oral etoposide for patients achieving a complete response to any salvage therapy.

pmid-10726091.summary_ja: 本論文は、精巣胚細胞がんにおける後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPL）の役割を概説している。臨床病期Iでは、RPL、監視療法、化学療法は生存率が同程度の選択肢である。RPLは晩期の後腹膜再発をほぼ排除し、CTによるフォローアップの必要性を減らす。病期IIでは化学療法とRPLは同等に有効で、RPLは腫瘍量の小さい疾患に限定すべきとされる。化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対してはRPLが適応となり、腫瘍マーカーが正常化し残存腫瘤が2cm未満であればRPLを省略できる場合がある。
pmid-10726091.summary_en: This article reviews the role of retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPL) in testicular germ cell cancer. For clinical stage I disease, RPL, surveillance and chemotherapy are alternatives with similar survival. RPL almost eliminates late retroperitoneal recurrence and reduces the need for follow-up CT. In stage II disease, chemotherapy and RPL are comparably effective, and RPL is best reserved for small-volume disease. Post-chemotherapy RPL is indicated for residual masses, and may be omitted when tumour markers normalise and residual masses are under 2 cm.

pmid-10738188.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の生検組織と細胞株は、PLAPを含む細胞性アルカリホスファターゼ(ALP)を発現し、膀胱および頭頸部腫瘍とは明確に区別された。EGF曝露によりEGF受容体発現細胞のALP発現は最大54%低下した。著者らは、EGFr発現を増殖の、PLAP発現を分化のマーカーとして位置づけている。
pmid-10738188.summary_en: This study examined placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and other cellular alkaline phosphatase expression across human tumours using colorimetric, flow-cytometric and immunocytochemical assays. Testis tumour biopsies were uniformly ALP-positive, particularly PLAP-positive, unlike bladder and head and neck tumours, and testis tumour cell lines expressed distinct high- and low-molecular-weight ALP bands. Epidermal growth factor exposure reduced ALP expression by up to 54% in EGF receptor-expressing lines. The authors propose EGFr and PLAP expression as markers of proliferation and differentiation respectively.

pmid-10743701.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍細胞株と新鮮な生検組織から、抗PLAPモノクローナル抗体ATC2を用いてPLAPを単離する方法を検討した。ジエチルアミンが最も効率よく溶出し、酵素活性を保持した。HPLCにより95kDaと70kDaに相当する2つのALP活性ピークが検出され、95kDaの分子種は従来報告がなかった。超音波検査で判断が難しい症例での胚細胞腫瘍の早期発見への応用が示唆された。
pmid-10743701.summary_en: This study developed an affinity-based method using the newly generated anti-PLAP monoclonal antibody ATC2 coupled to CNBr-Sepharose beads to isolate placental alkaline phosphatase from testis tumour cell lines and fresh tumour biopsies. Diethylamine was the most effective elution agent, preserving enzyme activity. HPLC separated two ALP activity peaks corresponding to 95 kDa and 70 kDa molecules, including a novel 95 kDa species. The authors suggest these methods could aid early detection of germ cell tumours, particularly when ultrasound findings are equivocal.

pmid-10743710.summary_ja: 播種性転移を伴う悪性精巣奇形腫の患者に、腫瘍由来hCGの過剰産生による甲状腺中毒症が生じた症例報告である。hCGの甲状腺刺激ホルモン様作用が原因とされる。抗甲状腺薬による治療と、傍腫瘍刺激を減らすための速やかな化学療法が重要である。血清hCGが20,000 U/lを超える全例で甲状腺機能の評価が推奨される。
pmid-10743710.summary_en: A patient with diffusely metastatic malignant testicular teratoma developed thyrotoxicosis attributed to excessive tumour-derived hCG, which acts on the thyroid-stimulating hormone receptor. The authors describe this paraneoplastic syndrome as a recognised complication of nonseminomatous germ cell tumours with potential morbidity. Management comprised standard antithyroid medication and prompt cytoreductive chemotherapy to reduce the paraneoplastic stimulus. They recommend thyroid hormone evaluation in all patients with serum hCG above 20,000 U/l.

pmid-10748869.summary_ja: パラフィン切片からのPCRにより、胚細胞腫瘍と良性精巣組織でパルボウイルスB19を検討した。陽性例はセミノーマ、混合型、良性対照のいずれにも認められ、奇形腫では認められなかった。免疫染色はすべて陰性だった。ウイルスは胚細胞腫瘍の一部にも存在するが、病因的意義は乏しいと結論された。
pmid-10748869.summary_en: Using PCR on paraffin sections, the authors tested for parvovirus B19 in 10 seminomas, eight teratomas, two mixed seminoma/teratomas and 10 benign testes. Viral DNA was detected in two of 10 seminomas, one of two mixed tumours, and four of 10 benign controls, but in no teratoma. Microdissection showed viral sequences in both tumour and normal tissue components, while immunostaining was negative. The authors conclude that parvovirus B19 is present in some germ cell tumours and benign testes but is unlikely to be aetiologically important.

pmid-10754134.summary_ja: 生後1年以内の乳児で、単純精巣嚢胞と精巣奇形腫が時期をずらして両側に発生した症例である。小児の両側精巣腫瘍は稀であり、非同時性の組み合わせとしては初の報告とされる。思春期前の小児では両病変とも通常良性だが、治療方針は慎重に決定すべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-10754134.summary_en: The authors report an infant with asynchronous bilateral testicular lesions, a simple cyst and a testicular teratoma, presenting within the first year of life. Bilateral testicular tumours are rarely described in children, and this is presented as the first reported case of an asynchronous simple cyst and teratoma in an infant. Although both lesions are typically benign in prepubertal children, the authors stress that treatment decisions must be made carefully.

pmid-10754155.summary_ja: 病期I奇形腫として根治的精巣摘除術と両側後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた12年後、骨盤内に胎児性癌として再発した症例である。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法3サイクルと完全切除で治療した。精巣がんでは、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の丁寧な手術手技と5年以降のフォローアップの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-10754155.summary_en: The authors report a man with pathologic stage I teratoma that recurred in the pelvis as embryonal carcinoma 12 years after radical orchiectomy and bilateral retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. He received three cycles of cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin followed by complete surgical excision. The authors suggest causes such as incomplete iliac node resection or a second extragonadal primary, emphasise meticulous RPLND technique, and recommend follow-up beyond five years.

pmid-10755789.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年女性45例を対象に、補助化学療法の有無にかかわらず妊孕性温存手術を施行した経過を検討した。平均58.7か月のフォローアップで再発4例、死亡2例、病期I生存率97%だった。化学療法後の96%で月経が再開し、健常児7例が出生した。妊孕性温存手術が第一選択と結論された。
pmid-10755789.summary_en: This study reviewed 45 women with malignant ovarian germ cell tumours treated with fertility-sparing surgery, with or without adjuvant chemotherapy. Most had stage I disease, and 44 underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. With mean follow-up of 58.7 months there were four recurrences and two deaths, with 97% survival in stage I disease. Menstrual function returned in 96% after chemotherapy, and seven healthy babies were born. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery is the treatment of choice, and advanced disease is not necessarily a contraindication.

pmid-10789702.summary_ja: 生後12日の男児に発見された巨大な心膜内奇形腫の症例報告である。呼吸窮迫を呈し、新生児では致死的となりうる稀な腫瘍である。腫瘍径は診断時の年齢と関連するが、新生児で巨大な腫瘍が認められた点が希少である。外科的切除により救命に成功した。
pmid-10789702.summary_en: This case report describes a 12-day-old male newborn with a large intrapericardial teratoma causing respiratory distress. Intrapericardial teratomas are rare and can be lethal in neonates, and tumor size tends to correlate with age at diagnosis. The authors emphasize the rarity of a huge tumor presenting in a newborn. Clinical and pathological findings are described, and surgical resection was lifesaving.

pmid-10834109.summary_ja: 精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜転移巣由来の培養系から、単一細胞クローニングで精巣絨毛癌細胞株HKRT-IIを樹立した。細胞はhCGを産生し、ヌードマウスでは絨毛癌を形成した。N-myc遺伝子の増幅も認められた。細胞の特性解析を報告する。
pmid-10834109.summary_en: The authors established a human testicular choriocarcinoma cell line, HKRT-II, by single-cell cloning from a culture derived from a retroperitoneal metastatic germ cell tumor. The primary tumor was a mixed germ cell tumor with seminoma, yolk sac tumor, choriocarcinoma, and immature teratoma components. The cells showed aneuploidy, proliferated stably, and produced hCG in vitro and in vivo. Subcutaneous xenografts formed choriocarcinoma, and N-myc was amplified.

pmid-10841273.summary_ja: 正常およびセミノーマを含む精巣組織における葉酸受容体を放射性リガンド結合法で解析した。セミノーマでは受容体量は正常精巣より少ないが、ヒトミルク葉酸結合蛋白に対する抗体で高い免疫反応性を示し、相同なアイソフォームの発現が示唆された。結合特性や葉酸による阻害も検討された。
pmid-10841273.summary_en: This study characterizes a high-affinity folate receptor in normal and malignant human testicular tissue using radioligand binding. Seminoma tissue showed lower receptor concentration than normal testis, yet higher immunoreactivity with antibodies against human milk folate binding protein, suggesting a homologous isoform is expressed in seminomas. Receptor binding characteristics, including pH-dependent dissociation and inhibition by folates, are described.

pmid-10851296.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍34例を対象に、定量RT-PCRでWT1 mRNA発現を測定した。進行期腫瘍では高発現が多く(67%)、病期との有意な相関が認められた。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性腫瘍の間に有意差はなく、WT1が腫瘍進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-10851296.summary_en: This study measured WT1 mRNA expression by quantitative RT-PCR in 34 patients with testicular germ cell tumors, including 23 seminomas and 11 nonseminomas. WT1 was highly expressed in 67% of high-stage tumors compared with 20% of low-stage tumors, with a significant correlation between expression and stage. No significant difference was found between seminomas and nonseminomatous tumors. The authors suggest WT1 may contribute to tumor progression.

pmid-10901872.summary_ja: 1957年から1992年に単施設で治療した原発性悪性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍18例の報告と文献的考察である。セミノーマは減量手術と縦隔放射線療法で良好な局所制御が得られた。非セミノーマ性腫瘍は生存率が有意に低かった。前縦隔に発生する点が強調されている。
pmid-10901872.summary_en: This article reviews the literature on primary malignant mediastinal germ cell tumours and reports 18 cases treated at a single institution from 1957 to 1992. Seminomas responded well to debulking followed by mediastinal radiotherapy, with good local control. Non-seminomatous tumours had significantly poorer survival, with only two of 12 patients remaining in remission. The anterior mediastinal location is emphasized, with a literature review through 1997.

pmid-10921231.summary_ja: 転移を伴う卵巣原発絨毛癌の2例を報告する。妊娠性と非妊娠性の鑑別は困難であり、非妊娠性は予後不良とされる。2例とも多剤併用化学療法により治療に成功し、報告時点で無病生存中である。卵巣原発絨毛癌の診断と治療の要点を示す。
pmid-10921231.summary_en: The authors report two cases of primary choriocarcinoma of the ovary with metastatic disease, distinguishing gestational from nongestational origin, which is difficult to determine. Nongestational choriocarcinoma carries a worse prognosis than gestational form. Both patients were treated successfully with combination chemotherapy and remained alive and disease free at reporting.

pmid-11240753.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の部分胞状奇胎28例、全胞状奇胎57例、絨毛癌14例、正常胎盤31例を用い、p53、mdm2、Ki67を免疫組織化学的に評価した研究です。p53発現は絨毛癌で最も高く、増殖指数やmdm2発現と相関しました。エクソン5-8に変異はなく、p53とmdm2は予後予測因子としての意義を示しませんでした。
pmid-11240753.summary_en: This study examined p53 and its regulator mdm2 in gestational trophoblastic disease using immunohistochemistry on 28 partial moles, 57 complete moles, 14 choriocarcinomas and 31 normal placentas, plus DNA sequencing of 36 moles. p53 expression was highest in choriocarcinoma and correlated with proliferation index and mdm2 expression across GTD groups. No mutations were found in exons 5-8. Neither p53 nor mdm2 expression predicted clinical outcome, suggesting no prognostic value.

pmid-11593563.summary_ja: 1988〜1996年に胞状奇胎後hCG監視プログラムに登録された616例の多施設研究です。全胞状奇胎の11%、部分胞状奇胎の7%で化学療法を要する持続性絨毛性腫瘍が発生しました。メトトレキサートを中心とした化学療法でほぼ治癒し、hCGによる早期発見が絨毛癌への進展防止に重要と示されています。
pmid-11593563.summary_en: This multicentre study followed 616 patients enrolled in a post-molar pregnancy serum hCG surveillance programme from 1988 to 1996. Persistent trophoblastic tumour requiring chemotherapy developed in 11% of complete moles and 7% of partial moles. Most were treated with methotrexate alone or combined regimens, with near-complete cure. Early detection by hCG monitoring is emphasized as a means of preventing progression to choriocarcinoma.

pmid-12090598.summary_ja: 71歳女性の卵巣粘液性嚢胞腺癌に卵黄嚢腫瘍が混在した、初めての報告例です。術前の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は55.6 ng/mLと上昇していました。免疫染色ではAFPとCEAが陽性、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は陰性でした。術後6か月で再発により死亡し、併用化学療法への反応は得られませんでした。
pmid-12090598.summary_en: This case report describes a 71-year-old woman with an ovarian mucinous cystadenocarcinoma admixed with a yolk sac tumor, the first such combination reported. Preoperative serum alpha-fetoprotein was elevated at 55.6 ng/mL. Immunohistochemistry showed AFP and CEA positivity with hCG negativity. The patient died of recurrent tumor six months after surgery without response to combination chemotherapy.

pmid-12894897.summary_ja: 1980〜1997年に1施設で治療された、肺転移と肺結核を合併した悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍10例の後方視的研究です。X線像が類似するため誤診の危険があります。多剤化学療法で7例が完全寛解しました。過剰治療と結核の見逃しを避けるため、鑑別診断の重要性が強調されています。
pmid-12894897.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed ten patients with malignant gestational trophoblastic tumor and pulmonary metastasis who also had pulmonary tuberculosis, treated at one hospital from 1980 to 1997. Radiographic appearances overlapped, risking misdiagnosis. Seven patients achieved complete remission with multiagent chemotherapy, while two died from drug-resistance complications and one died of miliary tuberculosis. The authors stress careful differential diagnosis to avoid both overtreatment and missed tuberculosis therapy.

pmid-14692398.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍の切片を用い、形態学的なDNA凝縮とTdT法によるDNA断片化の2種類のアポトーシス検出法を比較した研究である。転移の有無にかかわらずセミノーマ周辺組織を解析し、手法によっては最大66%のアポトーシス細胞が検出されないことを示した。非転移性セミノーマ関連組織では改良TdT法で領域差が検出されたが、転移例では認められなかった。
pmid-14692398.summary_en: This study compared two approaches for detecting apoptosis, morphological DNA condensation and a TdT-based DNA fragmentation assay, on double-labelled testicular tumour sections. Tissues from metastasized and non-metastasized seminoma, including regions distant from and adjacent to the tumour, were analysed across 19 histologies. Up to 66% of apoptotic cells were missed depending on the method. Morphology-only indices showed no regional differences, whereas the modified TdT-based indices revealed significant changes in tissue associated with non-metastasized seminoma, but not in metastasized cases. The findings highlight methodological differences and suggest altered apoptotic processes in seminoma-associated tissue.

pmid-15512382.summary_ja: 1989年から1997年にナイジェリア北東部の教育病院で組織学的に確認された卵巣腫瘍116例の組織型分布を検討した研究である。良性が79.3%を占め、上皮性腫瘍に次いで胚細胞腫瘍が多かった。良性では嚢胞性奇形腫が最も多く、悪性では漿液性嚢胞腺癌が最多であった。アフリカ地域の卵巣腫瘍の組織学的特徴を示す疫学データとして有用である。
pmid-15512382.summary_en: This retrospective study of 116 histologically confirmed ovarian neoplasms at a teaching hospital in north-eastern Nigeria, from 1989 to 1997, describes the distribution of tumour types. Most cases were benign (79.3%). Epithelial tumours were the most common type, followed by germ cell tumours. Among benign lesions, cystic teratoma was the most frequent, while serous cystadenocarcinoma was the most common malignant tumour. The study provides regional epidemiological data on histological patterns of ovarian neoplasia in an African setting, with germ cell tumours and teratoma as a notable component.

pmid-9841706.summary_ja: 在胎29週で出生した早産児に見られた、重量4500gの巨大な胎児仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。腫瘍内に完全に形成された眼球を認めたほか、フローサイトメトリーで腫瘍内DNA倍数性の不均一性が示された。予後は腫瘍の大きさや組織型、早産、合併奇形などに左右されるため、速やかな完全切除の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-9841706.summary_en: This report describes a huge fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 29-week preterm infant, weighing 4500 g. The tumor contained a completely formed eye, a finding rarely documented in such tumors. Flow cytometry revealed intratumoral DNA ploidy heterogeneity. The authors discuss how tumor size, histology, prematurity, associated malformations and delivery route influence prognosis, and they emphasize prompt and complete surgical removal.

pmid-9889041.summary_ja: I期の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫が初回手術から20年後に腹腔内で再発した症例の報告。外科的切除とプラチナ製剤による化学療法を受けたが、病勢は急速に進行して死亡した。遠隔期であっても再発を考慮すべきであり、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の晩期再発は化学療法への反応が乏しい可能性があると論じている。
pmid-9889041.summary_en: This case report describes intra-abdominal relapse of stage Ia ovarian dysgerminoma 20 years after initial surgery. The patient underwent surgical resection followed by platinum-based chemotherapy but had rapidly progressive disease and died. The authors review the literature, noting that this is the latest reported relapse of ovarian dysgerminoma. They emphasize considering recurrence even after a remote history, and note that late recurrences of ovarian germ cell tumors may respond poorly to chemotherapy.

pmid-9891249.summary_ja: 46,XY核型を有する19歳の表現型女性の異形成性性腺に生じた性腺芽腫の症例報告。9cmの充実性腫瘍は、性腺芽腫、ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、およびセルトリ細胞腫瘍様の性索成分の増殖から構成されていた。性腺芽腫の巣からセルトリ様成分への移行が認められ、性索成分が独立した性索腫瘍へ進展しうることが示唆された。
pmid-9891249.summary_en: This report describes a gonadoblastoma in the dysgenetic gonad of a 19-year-old phenotypic woman with a 46,XY karyotype. The 9 cm solid tumor contained gonadoblastoma, dysgerminoma and a proliferative sex cord component resembling a Sertoli cell tumor. Transitions between gonadoblastoma nests and the sertoliform element were observed, suggesting that the sex cord element of gonadoblastoma may progress to an independent sex cord tumor.

pmid-9914357.summary_ja: 頭蓋底および右側頭部に浸潤した先天性鼻咽頭奇形腫の症例報告。性腺外に生じる奇形腫の稀な頭頸部発生例である。中枢神経原発ではない奇形腫であり、胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に含まれる。単一症例の簡潔な報告である。
pmid-9914357.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital nasopharyngeal teratoma that invaded the skull base and the right temporal region. It is an unusual extragonadal teratoma presentation in the head and neck. Because the tumor arose in the nasopharynx rather than primarily in the central nervous system, it falls within the scope of germ cell tumors. The report is brief, describing a single case.

pmid-9915430.summary_ja: IIB期の非セミノーマ精巣がんで、化学療法後に孤立性または片側性のリンパ節転移を有する24例に対し、腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。全例で開腹移行なく完遂され、合併症は少なかった。病理では壊死71%、成熟奇形腫25%、活性腫瘍4%であった。順行性射精は全例で温存された。
pmid-9915430.summary_en: This study evaluates laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy in 24 patients with stage IIB nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma and solitary or unilateral nodal metastases. All procedures were completed laparoscopically without conversion to open surgery, with low morbidity. Histology showed necrosis in 71%, mature teratoma in 25% and active tumor in 4%. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved, and all patients remained disease-free at a mean follow-up of 24.4 months.

pmid-9923923.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎、絨毛癌(妊娠性、精巣・縦隔由来)、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍を対象に、インヒビンαの免疫染色性を検討した研究である。インヒビンはβ-hCGより合体栄養膜細胞での染色は弱いものの、β-hCGで見られる強い背景染色がない。胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍ではhPLより優れる症例もあり、β-hCG・hPLとともに抗体パネルに加えるべき有用なマーカーであると結論づけている。
pmid-9923923.summary_en: This study evaluates inhibin alpha-subunit immunohistochemistry in trophoblastic neoplasms, including hydatidiform moles, gestational, testicular, and mediastinal choriocarcinomas, and placental site trophoblastic tumors. Compared with beta-hCG and hPL, inhibin stained syncytiotrophoblasts less intensely than beta-hCG but without the marked background staining seen with beta-hCG. In placental site trophoblastic tumors, inhibin outperformed hPL in some cases. The authors conclude that inhibin is a useful marker and should be included in the antibody panel alongside beta-hCG and hPL.

pmid-9925764.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来のJeg-3細胞にコネキシン26、40、43を導入し、細胞間連絡と増殖・分化の関係を検討した研究である。導入クローンはいずれも増殖が抑制され、細胞間の接合コンダクタンスが増加した。β-hCG分泌で評価される分化は細胞間連絡が良好なクローンで顕著であり、コネキシン26は増殖抑制とβ-hCG産生増加を同時に示した。細胞間連絡の回復が絨毛癌細胞の増殖抑制と分化に寄与すると考察している。
pmid-9925764.summary_en: This study transfected connexin26, connexin40, or connexin43 into Jeg-3 human choriocarcinoma cells, which normally show very low gap junctional communication. All transfected clones grew more slowly, with increased junctional conductance. Differentiation, measured by beta-hCG secretion, was greatest in clones with the most well-coupled cell pairs, and connexin26 produced both reduced growth and increased beta-hCG output. The authors propose that restoring intercellular communication contributes to growth suppression and differentiation of choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-9930796.summary_ja: 鼠径部および陰嚢の探索術で異常がなかった既往を持つ3例で、腹腔内停留精巣に生じたセミノーマの臨床・画像所見を報告している。腫瘍は大きく無症状のこともあれば、捻転により急性腹症として発症することもある。画像所見は非特異的で、停留精巣の既往が伝えられないこともある。鼠径部探索が陰性でも腹部精査を行うべきと強調している。
pmid-9930796.summary_en: This report describes three patients with seminoma arising from intraabdominal undescended testes, all of whom had prior negative surgical exploration of the inguinal canal and scrotum. The tumors could be large and asymptomatic, mimic other diseases, or present with torsion and acute abdomen. Imaging findings were nonspecific and the cryptorchidism history was often absent. The authors stress that negative inguinal exploration should be followed by careful abdominal evaluation to avoid missing these neoplasms.

pmid-9930800.summary_ja: 悪性転化を伴う卵巣類皮嚢腫6例(女性5名)のMR所見を初めて報告した研究である。病変は脂肪を含み充実成分を有し、多くが壁を貫いて進展し隣接骨盤臓器へ浸潤していた。悪性成分は扁平上皮癌が4例、黒色腫と移行上皮癌が各1例であった。一般的な卵巣腫瘍と異なる進展様式を示し、扁平上皮癌の性質を反映すると考察している。
pmid-9930800.summary_en: This report presents MR imaging findings in five women with six ovarian dermoid cysts that underwent malignant transformation, a combination not previously described on MR. Lesions were fat-containing tumors with solid components that often extended transmurally and invaded adjacent pelvic organs. Histology showed squamous cell carcinoma in four, melanoma in one, and transitional cell carcinoma in one. The authors note that transmural spread and local invasion differ from common ovarian tumors and reflect squamous differentiation.

pmid-9932895.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、仙骨部の腫瘤が脊柱管内へ進展した満期産の女児新生児例である。超音波検査、CT、MRIで脊柱管内進展を確認し、手術でT4レベルまで及ぶ硬膜内髄外腫瘤を全摘出した。病理学的には成熟奇形腫であった。3年後のフォローアップでは成長と下肢機能は正常だったが神経因性膀胱を認め、MRIで再発はなかった。
pmid-9932895.summary_en: This case report describes a full-term female neonate with a sacrococcygeal mass that extended intraspinally. Ultrasonography, CT and MRI demonstrated the intraspinal extension, and surgery confirmed an intradural, extramedullary mass extending to T4 with total resection. Pathology showed a mature teratoma. At 3-year follow-up the child had normal growth and lower-limb function, though with neurogenic bladder, and MRI showed no recurrence. The authors note this is the third reported intradural sacrococcygeal teratoma and the first with such an extensive extramedullary component.

pmid-9951441.summary_ja: オンタリオ州がん登録の集団ベースのデータを用い、1964～1996年の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生率推移をセミノーマと非セミノーマ別に解析した。全体の発生率は人口10万人当たり4.01から6.39へ59.4%上昇し、両組織型とも年約2%の増加を示した。若年層で増加が大きく、出生コホート効果が示唆された。
pmid-9951441.summary_en: This population-based study from the Ontario Cancer Registry analysed incidence trends of testicular germ cell cancer in men aged 15 to 59 from 1964 to 1996, separately for seminoma and nonseminoma. Overall incidence rose by 59.4%, from 4.01 to 6.39 per 100,000, with an average annual increase of about 2% in both histologic groups. The greatest relative increase occurred in men aged 15 to 29, and nonseminoma incidence in that group appeared to decline from the early 1990s. The authors attribute the rise to a birth cohort effect and suggest shared underlying risk factors.

pmid-9973926.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍85例の細胞遺伝学的解析を行い、54例で核型異常を認めた。繰り返し出現する切断点として1p36、11q23、19q13などを同定した。化学療法後の腫瘍では3p25-p26、6q16-q21、8p22-p23の再構成が多く、未治療の腫瘍では9p22-p24の再構成が多かった。i(12p)の頻度は組織型や病期、治療歴による差はみられなかった。
pmid-9973926.summary_en: This study performed cytogenetic analysis of 85 testicular germ cell tumors, 54 of which were karyotypically abnormal. Recurrent breakpoints were identified at chromosome bands 1p36, 1p13-1q, 11q23, 19q13 and pericentromeric regions of acrocentric chromosomes. Postchemotherapy tumors showed more rearrangements of 3p25-p26, 6q16-q21 and 8p22-p23, whereas untreated tumors had more changes at 9p22-p24, 15q15 and 9q. Tumors of differing histology, clinical stage and treatment status showed no significant difference in the frequency of i(12p)-positive tumors.

pmid-9973927.summary_ja: 成人の悪性仙尾部奇形腫の細胞遺伝学的解析を報告した症例研究です。細胞の77%が近半数体、19%が近二倍体、4%が多倍数体で、複数の構造異常を伴う核型が示されました。近二倍体・多倍数体細胞にも同じ構造異常があり、共通の起源が示唆されています。成人の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のサブグループで報告された6番染色体の切断点との関連も議論されています。
pmid-9973927.summary_en: This case report describes cytogenetic analysis of a malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma in an adult. Cells were near-haploid (77%), near-diploid (19%), or polyploid (4%), with a detailed karyotype showing multiple structural rearrangements and a chromosome 7 gain. Identical structural changes appeared in near-diploid and polyploid cells, suggesting a common origin. Some changes appear unique to this case, while the authors note a chromosome 6 breakpoint previously reported in a subgroup of adult extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-9987644.summary_ja: 実験的腫瘍由来のCE44奇形癌細胞株を用い、微小環境が腫瘍分化をどのように修飾するかを検討しました。皮下・脾内の原発腫瘍と、肝・肺への実験的転移巣を比較しています。増殖部位によって分化能が異なり、肝転移巣では壊死巣が疎な結合組織に置換される修復像が見られました。微小環境とエピジェネティックな要因が奇形癌細胞の挙動に重要であると結論づけられています。
pmid-9987644.summary_en: The authors studied CE44 teratocarcinoma, a cell line derived from an experimental tumor, to examine how the microenvironment modulates tumor differentiation. They compared primary tumors (subcutaneous and intrasplenic) with experimental hepatic and pulmonary metastases. Differentiation capacity varied with growth site, and hepatic metastases showed reparative change in which necrotic areas were replaced by loose connective tissue. The authors conclude that the microenvironment and epigenetic factors critically influence the biological behavior and differentiation of teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-9988795.summary_ja: 完全奇胎の組織におけるテロメラーゼ活性を調べ、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患への進行との関連を検討しました。後に化学療法を要した奇胎の86.7%でテロメラーゼが検出され、自然寛解例では12.5%でした。侵入奇胎と絨毛癌はすべて陽性でした。完全奇胎でのテロメラーゼ活性は、持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患への進展と関連すると結論されています。
pmid-9988795.summary_en: This study examined telomerase activity in tissue from 31 complete hydatidiform moles, 7 invasive moles, and 5 choriocarcinomas, with 4 normal placentas as controls. Telomerase was detected in 86.7% of moles that later required chemotherapy for persistent disease, versus 12.5% of those that regressed spontaneously. All invasive moles and choriocarcinomas were positive, and all patients with metastatic disease had activity in their initial molar sample. The authors conclude that telomerase activity in complete moles is associated with progression to persistent gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-9988869.summary_ja: 小児の胚細胞腫瘍は稀で、性腺および性腺外に発生し、しばしば巨大になります。新生児や乳児では性腺外発生が多く、年長児では性腺発生が多いとされます。局所病変には外科的切除、残存・転移病変には白金製剤を用いた化学療法が行われ、生存率は近年大きく改善しています。
pmid-9988869.summary_en: This review covers pediatric germ cell tumors, which are rare in childhood and often large, arising in gonadal or extragonadal sites. Extragonadal tumors predominate in neonates and infants, while gonadal sites are more common in older children. Management includes surgical resection for localized disease, chemotherapy for residual or metastatic disease, and neoadjuvant chemotherapy with delayed excision for unresectable tumors. Platinum-based chemotherapy has markedly improved survival, which now approaches 100% for low-stage gonadal tumors and about 90% for low-stage extragonadal tumors.

pmid-10047453.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化させたF9胎児性癌細胞の胚様体において、インテグリンサブユニットの発現変化を時空間的に調べた研究です。β1とα5は下方制御されて上皮に蓄積し、β4とα6Aは誘導されて臓側内胚葉に局在しました。α6Bはほぼ変化しませんでした。臓側内胚葉の単層形成には、インテグリンの質的・量的変化が関与することが示されました。F9細胞は分化モデルとして用いられており、腫瘍の病態や治療は主題ではありません。
pmid-10047453.summary_en: This study mapped spatiotemporal changes in integrin subunit expression (β1, β4, α5, α6A, α6B) during retinoic acid-induced differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into embryoid bodies with visceral endoderm. β1 and α5 were downregulated and accumulated in the forming epithelium, while β4 and α6A were induced and localized to visceral endoderm. α6B remained largely unchanged. The results indicate that visceral endoderm monolayer organization involves both qualitative and quantitative integrin changes. F9 cells serve as a differentiation model.

pmid-10100370.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に遷延した乳糜瘻の管理を扱う。保存的治療（低脂肪食、中鎖脂肪酸トリグリセリド、完全静脈栄養）が基本で、持続例には直接的な外科的閉鎖が有効な選択肢とされる。原疾患は抄録に明記されていないが、後腹膜リンパ節郭清は主に胚細胞腫瘍の治療で行われる。
pmid-10100370.summary_en: This short abstract describes management of persistent chylous fistula after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Conservative therapy with a low-fat diet, medium-chain triglycerides or total parenteral nutrition is the mainstay for chylous ascites. In persistent chylous fistula, direct surgical closure is a valid option. The abstract does not state the underlying disease, although retroperitoneal lymph node dissection is mainly performed in germ cell tumour staging and treatment.

pmid-10200903.summary_ja: 若年女性の早期卵巣悪性腫瘍に対する妊孕性温存的治療を扱う総説で、早期病変での保存的治療を支持するエビデンスを提示している。抄録には組織型の記載がなく、胚細胞腫瘍を対象とするかは判然としない。生殖年齢の女性では治療方針の判断が難しいとされる点も論じられている。
pmid-10200903.summary_en: This review addresses fertility-sparing management for young women with early ovarian malignancies, a setting where treatment decisions pose a dilemma for physicians and patients. The authors present evidence supporting conservative management in early-stage disease, allowing preservation of fertility. The abstract does not specify tumor histology, so it is unclear whether germ cell tumors are the focus. The relevance to germ cell tumors therefore cannot be confirmed from the abstract alone.

pmid-10202748.summary_ja: 妊娠中または産褥期に付属器手術を受けた174例を後方視的に検討し、緊急手術と予定手術を比較した研究である。緊急手術では胎児喪失や腫瘍径が大きい例が多かった。妊娠7週以降に、10cmを超える腫瘍や奇形腫成分を有する腫瘍を摘出することが推奨されている。
pmid-10202748.summary_en: This retrospective study of 174 pregnant or puerperal women undergoing adnexal surgery compared emergency surgery (n=32) with elective surgery (n=142). Emergency operations were associated with greater fetal loss, larger tumors, and more extirpative procedures. Tumors under 5 cm never caused symptoms requiring surgery. The authors recommend removing tumors over 10 cm or those with a teratoma component after seven weeks of gestation to reduce malignancy risk and emergency surgery. Fetal loss did not increase when surgery occurred after that point.

pmid-10219919.summary_ja: 出生前の超音波検査やMRIで診断された先天性奇形について、胎児手術の適応を概説した総説です。仙尾部奇形腫は先天性肺病変などと並ぶ対象疾患の一つとして扱われています。重症の脊髄髄膜瘤に対する胎児修復への関心も紹介されています。胚細胞腫瘍を主題としたものではなく、論文に占める割合は限られます。
pmid-10219919.summary_en: This Current Opinion in Obstetrics and Gynecology review summarizes fetal surgery indications for congenital malformations diagnosed by prenatal ultrasound and MRI. It covers congenital lung lesions, congenital diaphragmatic hernia, sacrococcygeal teratoma, obstructing airway lesions, and the emerging interest in fetal repair of severe myelomeningocele. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is discussed as one of several conditions amenable to prenatal intervention, so germ cell tumour content is limited.

pmid-10235344.summary_ja: 生後3か月の男児に発生した後腹膜上部の胎児内胎児の症例報告である。脊柱と四肢芽の存在により奇形腫と区別された。DNA指紋解析と病理組織学的検査で、本病変は一卵性双胎の一方であることが示された。完全切除が行われた。後腹膜の類似病変では奇形腫との鑑別が重要であることを示す症例である。
pmid-10235344.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-month-old boy with a fetus-in-fetu located in the upper retroperitoneum. The lesion was distinguished from teratoma by the presence of a vertebral axis with limb buds. DNA fingerprinting and histopathological studies showed the mass to be a monozygotic twin. Complete surgical excision was performed. The case highlights the need to differentiate this entity from teratoma in the retroperitoneum.

pmid-10332108.summary_ja: 原発巣の異なる8例の肺転移に対し胸腔鏡下手術(VATS)で切除した報告。そのうち4例は胚細胞腫瘍由来(セミノーマ3例、絨毛癌1例)である。病変は5-30mmの末梢性で、合併症なく切除され、経過中の肺再発はなかった。末梢の30mm未満かつ1-2個の転移を選択基準とし、長期成績は今後の課題としている。
pmid-10332108.summary_en: This study reports video-assisted thoracic surgery (VATS) for resection of pulmonary metastases in eight patients with various primary cancers. Four patients had germ cell-derived primaries: three seminomas and one choriocarcinoma. Lesions were 5 to 30 mm and peripheral, and all surgeries were completed without complications. The patients had no lung recurrence during follow-up. The authors propose selection criteria of peripheral lesions under 30 mm and one or two tumors on CT, and conclude VATS is a suitable option in selected cases, though long-term outcomes remain unknown.

pmid-10365974.summary_ja: 2歳半の女児に生じた耳管の類皮嚢腫の症例を、CTおよびMRIで評価して報告している。報告例としては12例目で、既報は左側の女性に多い。手術アプローチと画像診断の役割を論じている。性腺外に生じた病変であり、胚細胞腫瘍や奇形腫としての分類は不確かである。
pmid-10365974.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst of the Eustachian tube in a 2.5-year-old girl, evaluated with CT and MRI. The authors note that it is only the twelfth reported case of this entity, and most previous cases occurred in females on the left side. The article discusses the surgical approach and the contribution of CT and MRI to diagnosis. Because the lesion arises outside the gonads, whether it should be classified as a teratoma or germ cell tumor is unclear. The paper does not frame it as a germ cell tumor.

pmid-10381633.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌細胞株P19を用い、神経分化中のアポトーシスをbFGFが抑制する機構を解析した基礎研究です。Badのリン酸化を介してカスパーゼ3の活性化を抑えます。胚細胞腫瘍そのものではなく、神経分化とアポトーシス研究のモデルとして用いられている点で関連性は間接的です。
pmid-10381633.summary_en: This basic research study investigates how basic fibroblast growth factor protects P19 embryonal carcinoma cells from apoptosis during retinoic-acid-induced neuronal differentiation. bFGF suppresses caspase-3 activation and DNA fragmentation through PI3K-dependent phosphorylation of the pro-apoptotic protein Bad, which then binds Bcl-xL. The P19 murine cell line serves mainly as a model for neuronal differentiation and apoptosis signaling, so its relevance to germ cell tumor biology is indirect.

pmid-10395283.summary_ja: アクチビンAとOP-1は、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2において互いのシグナル応答を拮抗的に抑制しました。両者は同じII型受容体に結合しますが、異なるI型受容体を利用します。実験モデルとしての細胞株の利用であり、腫瘍生物学そのものを扱う論文ではないため、関連性は不確実です。
pmid-10395283.summary_en: This cell biology study examines antagonism between activin A and osteogenic protein-1 (OP-1) in the human Tera-2 embryonal carcinoma cell line. Both ligands bind the activin type II receptor but recruit different type I receptors and compete at both receptor levels, while sharing Smad4 without limitation. Overexpression of ActR-II altered the outcome. Because Tera-2 is used as a model for TGF-beta family signaling rather than as a study of tumor biology, relevance is uncertain.

pmid-10447909.summary_ja: 縦隔に大きな腫瘤を有する乳児の麻酔管理を報告しています。気管分岐部や主気管支の圧迫を避けるため片肺換気を選択し、局所神経ブロックと硬膜外鎮痛を併用しました。抄録には腫瘍の組織型の記載がなく、胚細胞腫瘍であるかは判断できません。主題は腫瘍学ではなく周術期の気道管理です。
pmid-10447909.summary_en: This report describes the anaesthetic management of a small infant with a large anterior mediastinal mass. Because compression of the carina and main bronchi posed a risk to the airway, the team chose one-lung ventilation and kept anaesthesia very light, using local nerve blocks to secure the airway and epidural analgesia for surgery until the tumour was mobilized. The abstract does not state the tumour's histological type, so whether it was a germ cell tumour cannot be determined from the text. The paper focuses on perioperative airway safety rather than tumour biology or treatment.

pmid-10452248.summary_ja: 11歳女児の急性の腹痛の原因となった脾臓類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。超音波検査、CT、MRIで漿液性液体を含む嚢胞性病変として描出されました。脾摘後の感染予防に肺炎球菌ワクチンを接種し、経過は良好でした。脾臓原発の類皮嚢腫が胚細胞腫瘍の範囲に入るかは明確ではありません。
pmid-10452248.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-year-old girl with acute abdominal pain due to a splenic dermoid cyst. Ultrasonography, CT and MRI showed a cystic lesion containing serous fluid. She underwent splenectomy and, to reduce post-splenectomy infection risk, received pneumococcal vaccination, then recovered uneventfully. Histopathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed a dermoid cyst, and cytokeratin staining and electron microscopy were used to determine its origin. Whether a splenic dermoid belongs to the germ cell tumour spectrum is unclear, since it is a rare extragonadal lesion of uncertain origin.

pmid-10457332.summary_ja: 本報告は、周囲乳頭部に転移した腫瘍4例に対して膵頭十二指腸切除術を行った経験をまとめたものです。原発腫瘍は、原発不明の黒色腫、絨毛癌、大腿の高悪性度脂肪肉腫、小細胞肺癌でした。全例が手術を生存し、大きな合併症はありませんでした。2例は再発で死亡し、2例は術後12か月と21か月の時点で生存しています。経験豊富な外科医による選択的症例への適応が妥当と結論づけられています。
pmid-10457332.summary_en: This report describes four patients with metastatic tumors to the periampullary region treated with pancreaticoduodenectomy. The primary tumors were melanoma of unknown origin, choriocarcinoma, high-grade liposarcoma of the leg, and small cell lung cancer. All patients survived the operation without major complications. Two died of recurrence at 6 and 63 months, while two remained alive at 12 and 21 months. The authors conclude that pancreaticoduodenectomy can be considered for selected patients when performed by experienced surgeons.

pmid-10461054.summary_ja: 本総説は卵巣の非上皮性腫瘍を扱い、卵巣腫瘍全体の約半数、悪性卵巣腫瘍の約4分の1を占めると述べています。上皮性腫瘍とは自然経過や治療方針が異なるため、専門家による正確な病理組織学的見直しが不可欠だとしています。ランダム化試験がないため、記述的データに基づく総括です。悪性リンパ腫と転移性腫瘍は詳述されていません。
pmid-10461054.summary_en: This descriptive review addresses non-epithelial ovarian tumours, which make up roughly half of all ovarian tumours and about a quarter of malignant ones. The authors stress that these tumours differ from epithelial types in natural history and management, so accurate histological review by an expert is essential. Because no randomised trials exist, the recommendations rely on descriptive data. Lymphomas and metastatic tumours are excluded from detailed discussion and handled as in other sites.

pmid-10484981.summary_ja: Li-Fraumeni症候群のトルコ人家系を解析し、発端者のセミノーマを含む腫瘍組織で遺伝子異常を調べた。セミノーマではTP53のヘテロ接合性の消失も認めた。P16INK4Aの新規コドン94変異を見いだし、家系内の腫瘍マーカーとなる可能性と共通の発がん機構を示唆している。
pmid-10484981.summary_en: The authors studied a Turkish Li-Fraumeni syndrome family in which the proband had a seminoma, his daughter a medulloblastoma, and a cousin carried a hereditary TP53 codon 292 mutation. Analysis of TP53, P57KIP2, P15INK4B and P16INK4A in blood and tumor tissue identified a novel somatic P16INK4A codon 94 mutation in the seminoma and medulloblastoma, and loss of heterozygosity of TP53 in the seminoma. The authors suggest these alterations may serve as tumor markers in this family and point to a shared tumorigenic mechanism.

pmid-10487837.summary_ja: ヒト大腸癌、胚細胞腫瘍、乳癌、卵巣癌、子宮癌などの組織でチモシンβ10(TB10)遺伝子の発現を解析した。すべての腫瘍組織と細胞株で正常組織に比べTB10の過剰発現が認められ、マウス皮膚発癌モデルでは乳頭腫の段階から誘導されていた。胚細胞腫瘍は多数の腫瘍種の一つとして扱われており、胚細胞腫瘍に特化した知見は限られる。
pmid-10487837.summary_en: The authors measured thymosin beta-10 (TB10) mRNA and protein across multiple human carcinomas, including germ cell tumors of different histologies, as well as cell lines and a mouse skin carcinogenesis model. TB10 was overexpressed in all neoplastic tissues compared with normal tissue, suggesting it is a general event in carcinogenesis. Germ cell tumors represent only one of several tumour types studied, so findings specific to them are limited.

pmid-10491536.summary_ja: 1988〜1994年のカリフォルニアがん登録データを用い、ヒスパニック系と非ヒスパニック系白人の小児がん罹患率を比較した。全体の罹患率はヒスパニック系で約7%低く、性腺の胚細胞腫瘍とリンパ性白血病は高かった。一方、星細胞腫と癌腫は低かった。胚細胞腫瘍は多数の小児がんの一分類として報告されており、胚細胞腫瘍に特化した研究ではない。
pmid-10491536.summary_en: Using California Cancer Registry data from 1988 to 1994, the authors compared childhood cancer incidence in Hispanic and non-Hispanic white children, grouped by the International Classification of Childhood Cancer. Overall incidence was about 7% lower among Hispanic children. Hispanic children had higher rates of lymphoid leukemia and gonadal germ cell tumors, and lower rates of astrocytomas and carcinomas. Germ cell tumors are one of several reported categories in this population-level epidemiology study.

pmid-10493945.summary_ja: MDM2を標的とするアンチセンスオリゴヌクレオチドの抗腫瘍効果を検討した研究。骨肉腫細胞株SJSAと絨毛癌細胞株JARの両方で、in vitroおよびヌードマウス異種移植モデルにおいて用量依存的な抗腫瘍効果を示し、アドリアマイシンなどとの併用で相乗効果を認めた。絨毛癌は2つの評価モデルの一つにすぎず、論文の主題は一般的ながん治療標的としてのMDM2である。
pmid-10493945.summary_en: This study investigates MDM2 as a cancer therapy target using antisense oligonucleotides. In vitro, anti-MDM2 antisense showed antitumor activity in human osteosarcoma SJSA cells and choriocarcinoma JAR cells. In nude mice bearing SJSA and JAR xenografts, intraperitoneal antisense administration produced dose-dependent tumor inhibition. Combining MDM2 inhibition with adriamycin or 10-hydroxycamptothecin showed synergistic effects in vivo. The choriocarcinoma model is one of two efficacy models rather than the paper's main focus.

pmid-10504554.summary_ja: 統合失調症の既往がある38歳女性の右乳房腫瘤で、絨毛癌様の特徴を伴う乳癌と診断された症例報告。腫瘍は胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼとhCGが陽性で、血清hCG値も高値であった。乳房切除術と腋窩郭清後、術後7か月で胸壁・肺・肝への多発転移により死亡した。まれな亜型の認識に役立つ細胞診所見を報告している。
pmid-10504554.summary_en: A 38-year-old woman with schizophrenia developed a rapidly growing right breast mass, diagnosed as breast cancer with choriocarcinomatous features. The tumor was positive for placental alkaline phosphatase and hCG, and serum hCG was elevated. After mastectomy and axillary dissection, she died 7 months later with multiple metastases to the chest wall, lung and liver. Cytopathologic details are reported to aid recognition of this rare variant of breast carcinoma.

pmid-10507085.summary_ja: 32歳女性に発生した成熟型胎盤奇形腫の稀な症例報告。胎盤内に本腫瘍が生じる機序について考察している。特に無心体（fetus acardius amorphus）との鑑別の難しさを検討し、正確な診断の臨床的重要性を強調している。
pmid-10507085.summary_en: A rare case of mature placental teratoma in a 32-year-old woman is reported. The authors discuss possible mechanisms for development of this tumor within the placenta. They highlight the differential diagnostic difficulties encountered, especially compared with fetus acardius amorphus, and emphasize that an exact diagnosis is clinically important for managing such unusual lesions.

pmid-10553256.summary_ja: 成人の固形腫瘍に対する自家幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法を総説しています。乳癌、卵巣癌、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を主な対象とし、第II相試験の結果は多くで良好と述べています。有用性は依然として論争的で、大規模ランダム化試験で検討中とされています。
pmid-10553256.summary_en: This review covers high-dose chemotherapy with autologous stem-cell transplantation for adult solid tumors, notably breast cancer, ovarian cancer, and nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. It notes that phase II results are encouraging in most settings and appear superior to historical conventional-dose outcomes in some. The authors state that the value of high-dose therapy for adult solid tumors remains controversial and is being tested in large randomized trials. Future directions are outlined for each disease.

pmid-10556385.summary_ja: 小児の二次性心臓腫瘍8例を検討した研究で、そのうち1例は縦隔の悪性奇形腫が左房へ転移したものです。手術は5例に行われ、術後成績は不良でした。血行動態の破綻がある症例に限り慎重に手術を行うべきと結論づけています。
pmid-10556385.summary_en: This clinical study describes eight children with secondary cardiac tumors from lymphoma, Wilms tumor, malignant teratoma, neuroblastoma, and pleuropulmonary blastoma. One case was a malignant teratoma with metastasis to the left atrium, arising from a mediastinal mass that extended into the heart. Surgery was performed in five patients to relieve flow obstruction, and one of these had malignant teratoma. Postoperative outcomes were poor, with many deaths from metastases. The authors advise cautious surgery, limited to patients with hemodynamic decompensation.

pmid-10578180.summary_ja: P19胎児性癌細胞を用い、レチノイン酸とBMP-4の併用がカスパーゼ-9の活性化を介してアポトーシスを誘導する機序を解析した。Bcl-xLで抑制され、シトクロムcを介さない経路の可能性が示された。患者の腫瘍を対象とした臨床研究ではなく、細胞株を用いた基礎研究である。
pmid-10578180.summary_en: In P19 embryonal carcinoma cells in monolayer culture, combined treatment with retinoic acid and BMP-4 induced apoptosis through caspase-9 activation and the caspase-3 cascade, which was blocked by Bcl-xL. Unlike staurosporine, cytochrome c was not detected in the cytosol, suggesting an Apaf-1/cytochrome c-independent pathway, possibly involving reduced XIAP. The study is a cell-line mechanistic study rather than a clinical germ cell tumor study.

pmid-10582682.summary_ja: プロアポトーシス遺伝子Bcl10（1p22）の変異と欠失を、多様な組織型の腫瘍439例で検討しています。男性胚細胞腫瘍では10%に欠失が認められ、78例中2例に変異がありました。変異頻度は低く、Bcl10は一部の発症に関与する可能性があるにとどまると結論しています。胚細胞腫瘍は多数の腫瘍型の一つです。
pmid-10582682.summary_en: This study screened 439 tumor specimens from diverse histologies for somatic mutations and deletions in the Bcl10 gene on chromosome 1p22, which encodes a proapoptotic protein. Deletions were detected in 10% of male germ cell tumors, and mutations in 2 of 78 GCTs. The authors conclude Bcl10 may occasionally be involved in lymphoma and GCT pathogenesis, but the low mutation frequency suggests other inactivation mechanisms or additional targets of 1p22 deletion. GCTs form one part of a broad pan-cancer analysis.

pmid-10585260.summary_ja: 本基礎研究は、悪性胚細胞腫瘍のモデルである胎児性癌細胞株F9におけるD型サイクリンの発現とCdk4キナーゼ活性を検討した。全トランス型レチノイン酸とジブチリルcAMPは壁側内胚葉への分化を誘導し、サイクリンD1とD3を低下させ、D2とp27を増加させた。RXR選択的アゴニストは明らかな終末分化を伴わずに増殖を抑制し、Cdk4活性を低下させた。レチノイドが分化とは独立に増殖を直接制御しうることが示唆された。
pmid-10585260.summary_en: This basic research study examined D-type cyclin expression and Cdk4 kinase activity in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells, a malignant germ cell tumor model. All-trans-retinoic acid and dibutyryl cAMP induced differentiation into parietal endoderm, lowering cyclin D1 and D3 and raising cyclin D2 and p27. RXR-selective agonists LG100153 and LG100268 inhibited growth without overt terminal differentiation, increasing G1-phase cells and cyclin D2 and D3 levels while reducing Cdk4 activity. The findings suggest that some retinoids regulate proliferation directly, independent of differentiation.

pmid-10591558.summary_ja: 新生児の胸腔内腫瘤による急性呼吸不全の7例を後方視的に検討した報告。原因は主に先天性嚢胞性腺腫様奇形(CCAM)で、縦隔奇形腫を1例含む。小さく急速に増大する腫瘤は早期切除、大きな腫瘤では一酸化窒素やECMOで全身状態を安定させてから手術するという管理方針が示されている。
pmid-10591558.summary_en: This retrospective review of seven neonates with intrathoracic masses describes acute respiratory failure caused mainly by congenital cystic adenomatoid malformations, with one mediastinal teratoma among the cases. Small rapidly enlarging masses warranted prompt resection, whereas large masses with persistent fetal circulation could be stabilized with nitric oxide and ECMO before delayed surgery. The mediastinal teratoma is discussed as one contributor to neonatal respiratory compromise rather than being the primary focus of the report.

pmid-10603031.summary_ja: 胎児超音波検査で出生前に診断された脳腫瘍89例の解析。最多は奇形腫（53.9%）であった。予後は概して不良で、生後1年時の生存は10.5%にとどまったが、近年の症例および妊娠後期での検出例では改善していた。奇形腫8例のみ染色体情報があった。
pmid-10603031.summary_en: This survey of 89 brain tumors diagnosed prenatally by fetal ultrasound found teratomas to be the most common type (53.9%), followed by glioblastomas, lipomas, plexus papillomas, and craniopharyngiomas. Prognosis was poor, with only 10.5% alive after the first year, though survival improved in later cohorts and with later detection. Cytogenetic data were limited to eight teratomas.

pmid-10631814.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞を用いて、レチノイン酸による分化誘導時のビメンチン遺伝子プロモーターの活性を解析した。未分化細胞で活性が高く、分化に伴い増強された。5'側欠失変異体の解析により、F9細胞での活性に必要な領域は既報の分化細胞株のものと異なることを示した。分化時に活性が増す遠位領域にはHox-A5の結合部位があり、近位領域には30塩基対の反復配列が存在した。
pmid-10631814.summary_en: This molecular study examines the vimentin gene promoter in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells during retinoic acid-induced differentiation. The promoter is highly active in undifferentiated F9 cells and its activity increases on differentiation. Using 5' deletion mutants, the authors show that the promoter regions required for activity in F9 cells differ from those previously identified in differentiated cell lines. Two regions are enhanced during differentiation: a distal region containing binding sites for the Hox-A5 homeoprotein and a proximal region with a 30-bp repeat. A sequence-specific single-stranded DNA-binding protein interacts with the 30-bp sequence.

pmid-10659565.summary_ja: 縦隔穿刺吸引細胞診で胸腺腫と初診された14例を再検討し、組織診と比較した。組織診では胸腺腫12例と縦隔の未熟奇形腫1例が確認された。未熟奇形腫は細胞学的に胸腺腫と類似し、鑑別が困難であった。研究の主眼は胸腺腫の細胞診であり、未熟奇形腫は診断上の注意点として取り上げられている。
pmid-10659565.summary_en: This study reviewed 14 fine needle aspiration cytology samples initially diagnosed as thymoma, out of 80 mediastinal aspirations over six years, and compared them with histopathology. Revised cytologic diagnoses were made, and all samples showed a mixture of epithelial cells and lymphocytes. Histopathology showed 12 thymomas and one mediastinal immature teratoma. The immature teratoma resembled thymoma cytologically and was difficult to distinguish, making it a notable diagnostic pitfall. The main focus remains thymoma cytology.

pmid-10668979.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞と胚性幹細胞の単離・特性解析の歴史を概説し、これらを用いて哺乳類初期発生の分化制御因子、特にトランスフォーミング増殖因子βやアクチビン受容体リガンドの機能が明らかにされてきた過程をレビューした総説である。胎児性癌は臨床腫瘍ではなく発生研究のモデルとして扱われている。
pmid-10668979.summary_en: This review traces how embryonal carcinoma cells and embryonic stem cells, first isolated and characterized decades ago, became key models for studying early mammalian differentiation. It summarizes their contribution to understanding transforming growth factor beta and activin receptor signaling in development, and includes some of the authors' own work. The embryonal carcinoma cells serve as a developmental model rather than as a clinical tumor study, so the link to germ cell tumor care is indirect.

pmid-10668980.summary_ja: マウス初期胚におけるPrE由来の壁側内胚葉形成を、F9胎児性癌細胞を用いたin vitroモデルで検討したレビューである。1型PTHrP受容体、p21Ras、細胞接着分子が関与するシグナル経路について、著者らおよび他の研究者の知見を整理している。胚細胞腫瘍の臨床そのものを扱う論文ではなく、発生メカニズムの研究が主題である。
pmid-10668980.summary_en: This review focuses on how F9 embryonal carcinoma cells serve as an in vitro model of parietal endoderm formation from primitive endoderm after mouse implantation, an early epithelio-mesenchymal transition. The authors summarize their own and others' findings on signaling involving the PTHrP type 1 receptor, p21Ras, and cell adhesion molecules. The work addresses developmental mechanisms rather than clinical germ cell tumor management, so it is only indirectly related to germ cell tumors.

pmid-10754136.summary_ja: 9歳男児の陰嚢内に精巣とは別に存在する充実性腫瘤で、骨盤内へ進展していた。超音波検査と排尿時膀胱尿道造影を行い、手術で摘出した結果、表皮嚢腫と診断された。単一胚葉性奇形腫または正中縫線の異常閉鎖に由来する可能性が指摘されている。
pmid-10754136.summary_en: A 9-year-old boy presented with a solid scrotal mass separate from the testes that extended into the pelvis. Scrotal ultrasound and voiding cystourethrography were performed before surgical removal, and pathology showed an epidermoid cyst. The authors note that this uncommon lesion may represent a monodermal teratoma or abnormal closure of the median raphe. It is only the second reported case of a scrotal epidermoid cyst extending into the true pelvis.

pmid-15847378.summary_ja: 性分化異常を含む半陰陽について、歴史的・病因的観点から概説した病理総説である。アンドロゲン不応症や性腺異形成などの疾患と発生学的背景を扱う。性腺異形成に生じる腫瘍として性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）にも簡潔に触れる。胚細胞腫瘍は論文の一部の内容にとどまる。
pmid-15847378.summary_en: This historical and pathogenetic review covers hermaphroditism, a broad discrepancy between phenotype and genotype in sex development. It discusses androgen insensitivity, 5-alpha-reductase 2 deficiency, testosterone synthesis defects, persistent Müllerian duct syndrome, Turner syndrome, XX males, gonadal dysgenesis and true hermaphroditism, with embryological background. Tumours arising in dysgenetic gonads are briefly covered, notably gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma as mixed tumours, along with sex cord tumours. The main focus is disorders of sex development, and germ cell tumours form only a small part of the content.

pmid-9880524.summary_ja: F9胎児性癌細胞がレチノイン酸とPTHによる段階的処理を経て、原始内胚葉、次いで壁側内胚葉へ分化する過程のシグナル伝達を解析した。レチノイン酸はRas活性を持続的に上昇させて原始内胚葉分化を誘導し、その後のPKA活性化によりRas活性が低下して壁側内胚葉分化が起こる。主に発生学的な知見を扱う細胞株を用いた研究である。
pmid-9880524.summary_en: This study investigates signaling in the two-step differentiation of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells into primitive and then parietal endoderm. Retinoic acid triggers a sustained rise in Ras activity that drives primitive endoderm formation. Subsequent PKA activation lowers Ras activity, allowing parietal endoderm differentiation. Oncogenic Ras blocks this second step through the Raf-MEK-Erk pathway. The findings are mainly developmental biology obtained with a cell line model.

pmid-9892176.summary_ja: フェンレチニド（4HPR）が、F9胎児性癌細胞においてレチノイド受容体を介して作用するかを検討した。受容体欠損株を用いた解析で、4HPRは受容体非依存的に速やかな細胞死を誘導し、原始内胚葉様への分化誘導は受容体（RARγやRXRα）に依存することが示された。抗腫瘍作用の機序として、二つの異なる経路が関与することを示唆している。
pmid-9892176.summary_en: This study tests whether fenretinide (4HPR) acts through retinoid receptors in F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. Using receptor-deficient mutant lines, the authors find that 4HPR rapidly kills cells in a receptor-independent manner. Its slower induction of primitive endoderm-like differentiation requires RARgamma and RXRalpha. The compound thus has two distinct mechanisms, receptor-independent cytotoxicity and receptor-dependent differentiation, which is relevant to its antitumor activity.

pmid-9926741.summary_ja: 過去20年に仙骨前嚢胞性病変14例を後方視的に検討した研究である。病理診断は類皮嚢腫、類表皮嚢腫、嚢胞性過誤腫、良性奇形腫からなり、1例に腺癌の病巣があった。平均39か月のフォローアップで再発はなく、選択例では経直腸的切除が低侵襲で有用と報告している。奇形腫を含む発生性仙骨前嚢腫の切除を推奨するが、主題は仙骨前嚢腫全般である。
pmid-9926741.summary_en: This retrospective review of 14 patients with presacral cystic lesions over 20 years describes clinical presentation, imaging, and pathology. Pathology included dermoid cysts, epidermoid cysts, cyst hamartomas, and benign teratomas, with one focus of adenocarcinoma. Computed tomography identified the cyst in all patients imaged. Transrectal excision was feasible in select patients with low morbidity and no recurrence over average 39-month follow-up. The authors conclude that developmental presacral cysts, including teratomas, should be excised, with transrectal approach suitable in selected cases.

pmid-9929837.summary_ja: 1980年から1996年に卵巣手術を受けた前思春期女児52例を後方視的に検討した研究である。最も多い術後診断は卵巣捻転であり、悪性腫瘍は9.6%であった。病理では奇形腫、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、性腺芽細胞腫が含まれるが、大半は良性病変やその他の病変である。悪性例が少ないため、適切な場合は卵巣全摘より嚢腫摘出術を考慮すべきと結論している。
pmid-9929837.summary_en: This retrospective chart review of 52 premenarchal girls who underwent ovarian surgery at a single institution from 1980 to 1996 examines indications and pathology. Torsion was the most common diagnosis, and malignancies accounted for 9.6 percent. Pathology included teratomas, a mixed germ cell neoplasm, and a gonadoblastoma among many benign and other lesions. The authors recommend considering cystectomy over oophorectomy when appropriate, given the low malignancy rate in this population.

pmid-9951488.summary_ja: 側頭窩に原発した類皮嚢腫の5例を後方視的に検討した症例集積である。CTでは蝶形骨大翼、前頭骨、頬骨の合流部より前方に起始する嚢胞性病変が確認され、2例では骨浸潤や頭蓋内・眼窩内への進展を認めた。全例で良好な術後経過をたどった。
pmid-9951488.summary_en: This retrospective case series describes five patients aged 2 to 38 years with dermoid cysts arising primarily in the temporal fossa. CT showed cystic lesions originating anterior to the confluence of the greater wing of the sphenoid, frontal and zygomatic bones, with displacement of the anterior temporalis muscle common. Two lesions extended into the cranial and orbital cavities with bony erosion. At excision, cysts were ruptured or liquefied in some cases, and histology showed variable inflammation. All patients recovered well. A coronal approach facilitated excision, and neurosurgical assistance may be needed when dural extension is present.

pmid-9951602.summary_ja: 17歳男性の口腔底に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告である。穿刺吸引細胞診で診断し、切除組織の病理組織学的所見で確認した。類皮嚢腫の細胞学的・組織学的特徴を示し、本部位での発生と細胞診による診断の有用性を提示した。
pmid-9951602.summary_en: This case report describes a dermoid cyst of the floor of the mouth in a 17-year-old male, diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration cytology and supported by histologic examination of the excised tissue. The authors note that dermoid cysts are benign lesions that can occur in this location and present the case to raise awareness of this entity. They also demonstrate the feasibility of diagnosis by fine-needle aspiration and describe the cytologic and histologic features of dermoid cysts.

pmid-10023310.summary_ja: 1989年から1995年に治療された再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍の患者150例を後方視的に解析し、救援化学療法に続く大量化学療法（カルボプラチン、エトポシド、イホスファミド）の成績を報告しています。中央値55か月の追跡で34%が無病生存していました。長期生存者の約3分の1に持続する毒性が認められ、早期治療としての前向き試験の実施が支持されています。
pmid-10023310.summary_en: This large single-centre retrospective analysis evaluated high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) in 150 consecutive patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumours treated between 1989 and 1995. Patients received conventional-dose salvage chemotherapy followed by one cycle of HDCT with carboplatin, etoposide and ifosfamide. At median follow-up of 55 months, 34% were alive and disease-free, with 39% overall survival and 29% event-free survival. Prognostic variables were confirmed, and about one third of long-term survivors had persisting toxicities. The authors support prospective trials of early HDCT.

pmid-10028439.summary_ja: 統合失調症と自殺未遂の既往をもつ39歳男性の病期IIb精巣腫瘍の症例である。精神科病棟で高位精巣摘除術を受け、精神症状が安定した後に泌尿器科病棟へ移った。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法3コースと後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を実施し、治療中の精神状態は良好に管理された。術後8か月間再発はない。精神疾患を有する患者の悪性腫瘍治療に関する一般的な問題を考察している。
pmid-10028439.summary_en: A 39-year-old man with schizophrenia and a prior suicide attempt was diagnosed with stage IIb testicular tumor. After high orchiectomy in the psychiatry ward and stabilization of psychosis, he received three cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection on a general urology ward. Psychiatric status remained well controlled, and he was free of recurrence eight months after surgery. The authors discuss general issues in treating malignancy in patients with psychosis.

pmid-10065036.summary_ja: 54歳の女性が、急性心膜炎、大量の滲出性心嚢液貯留、両心室不全を呈した。卵巣のカルチノイド奇形腫に由来するカルチノイド心疾患と診断された。オクトレオチドが投与され、その後腫瘍の根治的外科的切除が行われた。術後1年で軽度のカルチノイド性三尖弁逆流症が残った。著者らは、卵巣原発例の報告は16例に限られること、また急性の非転移性心膜炎および左心不全はカルチノイド心疾患では非典型的な症状であることを指摘している。
pmid-10065036.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman presented with acute pericarditis, large exudative effusion and biventricular failure. She was diagnosed with carcinoid heart disease arising from an ovarian carcinoid teratoma. Octreotide was given, followed by radical surgical resection of the tumor, and mild carcinoid tricuspid regurgitation remained at one year. The authors note that only 16 ovarian-primary cases have been reported and that acute nonmetastatic pericarditis and left heart failure are atypical presentations of carcinoid heart disease.

pmid-10085620.summary_ja: 本研究は、1992年から1994年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者40例を検討したものである。治療はシスプラチンとエトポシドを用い、ブレオマイシンの併用の有無があった。1996年に評価されたPE療法患者の85%で完全寛解が認められ、18か月無病生存率は85%であった。表Iはロイヤル・マースデン病期分類をまとめたものである。著者らは、ブレオマイシンが負担できない場合には2剤レジメンが実用的な代替策となり得ると主張しているが、治療群では治療遵守は限定的であった。
pmid-10085620.summary_en: This series reviews 40 patients with testicular germ cell tumours treated between 1992 and 1994 with cisplatin and etoposide, with or without bleomycin. Complete regression occurred in 85% of PE-treated patients evaluated in 1996, and 18-month disease-free survival was 85%. Table I summarizes the Royal Marsden staging system. The authors argue that a two-drug regimen can be a practical alternative when bleomycin is unaffordable, although compliance was limited in the treated groups.

pmid-10085621.summary_ja: 生後4か月の男児が大きな腹部腫瘤で受診し、胃奇形腫と診断された症例である。腫瘍は切除され、切除後1年半の時点で再発の証拠はない。胃奇形腫は極めてまれな腫瘍であり、本報告は世界で報告された少数例に加わるものである。
pmid-10085621.summary_en: A four-month-old male infant presented with a large abdominal mass and was found to have a gastric teratoma, an extremely rare tumour. The lesion was excised, and there was no evidence of recurrence at 1.5 years after excision. The authors present this case as an addition to the few gastric teratomas reported in the world literature.

pmid-10089059.summary_ja: 一施設における胚細胞腫瘍患者876例の後方視的解析で、停留精巣に腫瘍が生じた症例が25例(2.85%)見つかった。大半はセミノーマであった。セミノーマの3年および5年生存率は100%だった一方、非セミノーマおよび混合型腫瘍では80%と60%であった。著者らは、精巣固定術よりも精巣摘除術を推奨し、下降した停留精巣には生涯にわたり年1回の精巣超音波検査による経過観察を、両側精巣摘除後にはアンドロゲン補充を勧めている。
pmid-10089059.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 876 germ cell tumour patients at one institution identified 25 (2.85%) with tumours arising in an undescended testis. Most were seminomas. Seminoma survival was 100% at 3 and 5 years, while non-seminoma and mixed tumours had 80% and 60% survival. The authors recommend orchidectomy rather than late orchidopexy, lifelong annual testicular ultrasound surveillance for descended cryptorchid testes, and androgen replacement after bilateral orchidectomy.

pmid-10091470.summary_ja: 膿胸様の経過で、心臓圧迫症状と心膜液貯留を伴って受診した心膜内良性充実性奇形腫の症例である。良性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）は縦隔に発生しうるが、心膜内発生の報告は非常にまれである。その希少性と非典型的な臨床像から本症例を報告している。縦隔奇形腫の特異な発生部位を示す症例といえる。
pmid-10091470.summary_en: A rare benign solid teratoma located within the pericardium was described in a patient who presented unusually with empyema, cardiac compression features and pericardial effusion. Benign teratomas, also called dermoid cysts, occur in the mediastinum, but intrapericardial location is very rarely reported. The authors present this case because of its rarity and atypical clinical presentation.

pmid-10095838.summary_ja: 25歳男性が良性成熟奇形腫に対し根治的精巣摘除術を受けた。変化のない3cmの後腹膜腫瘤を5年間経過観察したが、精巣摘除から12年後に増大し症状が出現した。切除標本から非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と判明し、奇形腫成分の悪性転化が考えられている。精巣奇形腫は潜在的に悪性の非セミノーマ性腫瘍として扱うべきと結論している。
pmid-10095838.summary_en: A 25-year-old man underwent radical orchiectomy for a benign mature teratoma. A 3 cm retroperitoneal mass that remained unchanged was followed for five years, then enlarged and became symptomatic 12 years after orchiectomy. Excision revealed a non-seminomatous germ cell tumour, probably from malignant degeneration of teratomatous elements. The authors conclude that testicular teratomas should be treated as potentially malignant non-seminomatous tumours.

pmid-10197149.summary_ja: 32歳男性の精巣奇形腫に由来する絨毛癌が鼻腔に転移し、難治性の鼻出血で発症した症例です。絨毛癌は血行性にも広がる点が、他の胚細胞腫瘍と異なります。本例は最終的にこの疾患で死亡しました。精巣腫瘍の既往がある若年男性の難治性鼻出血では、まれな転移部位としてこの可能性を考慮すべきと示しています。
pmid-10197149.summary_en: A 32-year-old man with testicular teratoma developed metastatic choriocarcinoma of the nasal cavity, presenting with intractable epistaxis. The authors note that choriocarcinoma spreads both by lymphatic and hematogenous routes, unlike many other germ cell tumors. The patient ultimately died of the disease. This case report highlights an unusual metastatic site that should be considered in the differential diagnosis of severe refractory epistaxis in young men with a history of testicular neoplasia.

pmid-10211110.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌の患者10例の精液中の細胞を対象に、FISH法で第12染色体の数的異常を調べ、対照群と比較しました。患者では第12染色体のシグナルが3個以上の核が有意に多く、8例で5個以上の核が認められました。精液を用いたFISH法は、高リスク男性における精巣上皮内癌や精巣胚細胞腫瘍の早期発見に役立つ可能性があると述べています。
pmid-10211110.summary_en: Fluorescence in situ hybridization was used to examine chromosome 12 copy-number changes in semen cells from ten men with testicular carcinoma in situ, compared with ten infertile controls. Patients showed significantly more nuclei with three or more chromosome 12 signals, and eight of ten had nuclei with five or more signals. Morphologically similar patterns to i(12p) were also seen in some control ejaculates. The authors suggest FISH on semen could aid early detection of CIS and testicular germ cell tumors in high-risk men.

pmid-10227755.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者において、化学療法およびG-CSF投与後の末梢血幹細胞採取の前後で、NK細胞およびLAK活性を検討しました。NK細胞は採取後3〜5日目にピークに達し、前値より高値を示しました。採取4日後のリンパ球は化学療法前より高いNKおよびLAK活性を示し、生成されたLAK細胞のキラー単位は約9.6倍でした。回復期の末梢血リンパ球はNK細胞の採取源として有利と考えられています。
pmid-10227755.summary_en: This study examined natural killer and LAK activities in patients with seminoma receiving chemotherapy and G-CSF before peripheral blood stem cell collection. NK cell counts fell and then rebounded above baseline, peaking 3 to 5 days after stem cell collection. Lymphocytes collected 4 days after PBSC collection showed higher NK and LAK activity than pre-chemotherapy samples, and LAK cells generated from them had about 9.6-fold more killer units. The authors suggest this recovery phase may be a better source of NK cells.

pmid-10323087.summary_ja: 57歳女性の縦隔成熟奇形腫の症例で、成熟膵組織とカルチノイドを含んでいました。外科的切除により良好な治療結果が得られました。縦隔の成熟奇形腫には、神経内分泌成分を含む多様な組織が存在しうることを示す症例報告です。
pmid-10323087.summary_en: The authors report a 57-year-old woman with a mature mediastinal teratoma containing mature pancreatic tissue and a carcinoid tumor, successfully treated with surgical resection. The case shows that mediastinal mature teratomas can contain varied neuroendocrine components. The report is brief and focuses on pathology and surgical outcome.

pmid-10359511.summary_ja: セミノーマ型の精巣がん組織からアルカリフォスファターゼ(ALP)を精製し、胎盤型ALP(PLAP)と比較しました。比活性はタンパク質1mgあたり66単位、分子量は約500kDaでした。セミノーマ由来のALPは既報とは異なる新規の高分子型であり、胎盤型とも区別されると結論づけています。
pmid-10359511.summary_en: Alkaline phosphatase was purified from seminoma-type human testicular cancer tissue and compared with placental ALP. The purified enzyme had 66 units per mg of protein and an approximate molecular weight of 500 kDa. The authors conclude the seminoma enzyme is a novel high-molecular-weight ALP that differs from previously reported forms and from placental ALP, which may help clarify ALP in cancers.

pmid-10426670.summary_ja: 再発・難治性の悪性胚細胞腫瘍25例を対象に、メトトレキサート類似体エダトレキサートの第II相試験(SWOG 9124)を実施した。評価可能な23例で客観的奏効は認められず、全例が病勢進行となった。Grade 3-4の毒性は56%に生じたが、治療関連死はなかった。本薬は抗腫瘍活性を示さず、毒性は強いと結論された。
pmid-10426670.summary_en: This phase II Southwest Oncology Group trial (SWOG 9124) evaluated edatrexate, a methotrexate analogue, in 25 patients with relapsed or refractory malignant germ cell tumors. Among 23 evaluable patients, no objective responses occurred and all developed progressive disease. Grade 3-4 toxicities, mainly stomatitis and fatigue, affected 56% of patients, though no toxic deaths occurred. The authors concluded that edatrexate at this dose and schedule lacks antitumor activity in this population and carries substantial toxicity.

pmid-10463296.summary_ja: 出生6日目の女児に発生した先天性甲状腺奇形腫の症例報告である。全摘術と隣接リンパ節の切除を行った。組織学的に神経グリア成分を伴う充実性・嚢胞性奇形腫であり、術後に頸部リンパ節腫脹が再発した。9か月時の切除で神経グリア組織の沈着を認めたが、侵襲性転移ではなく変位した病変組織と解釈された。5歳時点で良好な経過である。
pmid-10463296.summary_en: A case report of congenital thyroid teratoma in a female infant treated with complete surgical excision at 6 days of life, with an adjacent 1.2 cm lymph node also removed. Histology showed solid and cystic teratoma with prominent neuroglial tissue resembling neuroblastoma. Recurrent cervical lymphadenopathy developed months later, and multiple nodes were excised at 9 months, revealing neuroglial deposits interpreted as displaced lesional tissue rather than aggressive metastases. The child remained well at 5 years of age.

pmid-10463297.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍のインターグループ・プロトコルを病理医向けに概説した総説である。病期I精巣胚細胞腫瘍と全部位の未熟奇形腫は、手術後の厳重観察で治療可能とされる。病期I卵巣胚細胞腫瘍もこの低リスク群に加わる可能性がある。卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の評価と正確な病期分類が今後の鍵である。
pmid-10463297.summary_en: A pathology-focused review of pediatric germ cell tumor protocols from Intergroup trials. It notes that stage I malignant testicular germ cell tumors and immature teratomas at all sites can be managed with surgery and observation, and that stage I ovarian tumors may join this low-risk group. Low-stage extragonadal tumors may form an intermediate-risk category. The authors highlight endodermal sinus foci within immature teratomas and the growing importance of accurate staging and biologic studies for future protocols.

pmid-10772003.summary_ja: 新生児の鼻咽頭に生じた有毛性ポリープ(皮様嚢腫)の稀な症例報告である。上気道閉塞で発症し、奇形腫の原始的な型として常に良性であることが示された。病因、頭頸部奇形腫の分類、臨床像、新生児期の管理についても論じられている。
pmid-10772003.summary_en: A case report of a hairy polyp (dermoid) of the nasopharynx in a neonate presenting with upper aerodigestive tract obstruction. The authors describe this rare, invariably benign form of teratoma, which arises from ectoderm and mesoderm during early embryogenesis, and present the case because of its rarity. The report discusses the etiology of teratomas, their classification in the head and neck, clinical features, and management in neonates.

pmid-11189204.summary_ja: 1966年から1996年の間に、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に対する化学療法終了後1年以内に妊娠した22例を後方視的に検討した。胎児喪失率は27.3%、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率は9.1%で、化学療法後早期の妊娠は再発および胎児喪失のリスクが高かった。著者らは、妊孕性温存を希望する患者に対し、化学療法後少なくとも1年間の避妊を推奨している。
pmid-11189204.summary_en: This retrospective study followed 22 women who conceived within one year after completing chemotherapy for gestational trophoblastic tumor between 1966 and 1996. Fetal wastage occurred in 27.3% of pregnancies, and gestational trophoblastic disease recurred in 9.1%, including a repeated hydatidiform mole. Pregnancies conceived earlier after chemotherapy were associated with higher fetal wastage. The authors recommend contraception for at least one year after chemotherapy for patients who wish to preserve fertility, to improve pregnancy outcomes.

pmid-11236311.summary_ja: 本総説は、臨床病期Iセミノーマの治療をめぐる議論を整理したもので、サーベイランス、補助放射線療法、単剤化学療法（カルボプラチン）を比較している。800例以上のサーベイランス研究では17.1%が再発したが、適切に選択された患者では生存への悪影響は示されていない。照射野や線量の縮小により毒性を軽減でき、単剤化学療法は放射線療法と同等の効果が期待される。不妊や二次性悪性腫瘍などの晩期毒性評価には長期フォローアップが必要である。
pmid-11236311.summary_en: This review discusses current debates in managing clinical stage I seminoma, focusing on surveillance, adjuvant radiotherapy, and single-agent carboplatin. Relapse occurred in 17.1% of over 800 patients under surveillance, without evident survival compromise in compliant patients. Reducing radiotherapy volume or dose lowers toxicity, and early single-agent chemotherapy appears comparable to radiotherapy.
