Long-term follow-up is needed to assess late effects such as infertility and second malignancies.

pmid-11245075.summary_ja: 1993年から1996年に、臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍13例に対して変法の片側腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。12例で手術を完遂し、平均手術時間は292分、平均出血量は250mLであった。開腹移行は1例のみで、多くの症例で順行性射精が温存された。著者らは、低い合併症率と早期退院が得られる正確な病期分類法であると結論づけたが、より長期のフォローアップが必要としている。
pmid-11245075.summary_en: This study evaluated modified unilateral laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 13 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated between 1993 and 1996. The procedure was completed in 12 patients, with a mean operative time of 292 minutes and mean blood loss of 250 mL. One patient required conversion to open surgery. Antegrade ejaculation was preserved in most patients. The authors conclude the approach offers accurate staging with low morbidity and rapid recovery, though longer follow-up is needed.

pmid-11717924.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の患者24例を対象に、経膣超音波検査と骨盤動脈造影を比較した。両検査とも子宮の異常所見を捉えた。経膣超音波検査では5例で傍子宮組織への転移所見が認められ、動脈造影でも確認された。一方、超音波所見や臨床所見がない2例では、動脈造影で早期の傍子宮血管への転移が示された。著者らは、経膣超音波検査は診断に有用としつつも、早期の傍子宮転移を確実に予測することは困難だと結論している。
pmid-11717924.summary_en: This comparative study evaluated transvaginal ultrasonography against pelvic arteriography in 24 women with gestational trophoblastic tumor. Both modalities showed uterine abnormalities in most patients. Transvaginal ultrasonography detected parametrial metastatic signs in five patients, confirmed by arteriography. However, arteriography revealed early parametrial vessel metastasis in two patients without ultrasonographic or clinical signs. The authors conclude that transvaginal ultrasonography is useful, though it cannot reliably predict early parametrial spread.

pmid-11957303.summary_ja: エチオピアで18歳の初産婦から生まれた早産の新生児に発生した頸部奇形腫の症例を報告する。頸部奇形腫はまれで、急性期の管理では気道閉塞が主な懸念となる。剖検所見を含む臨床病理学的特徴を文献と併せて検討し、巨大な頸部腫瘤に続発した周産期仮死が死因と考えられると述べている。
pmid-11957303.summary_en: This report describes a case of cervical teratoma in a premature neonate born to an 18-year-old primigravida in Ethiopia. Neck teratomas are rare, and airway obstruction is the main concern in acute management. The clinicopathological features, including autopsy findings, are reviewed. The authors consider perinatal asphyxia secondary to the large neck mass to be the likely cause of death.

pmid-17039021.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍に関する最新の研究と治療動向をまとめた総説である。多くの患者は治癒が期待できるため、治療の焦点は毒性を抑えつつ適切な治療を選択すること、そして予後を正確に予測することへと移っている。低腫瘍量の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍や純粋セミノーマでは最適な治療選択が課題である一方、高腫瘍量の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では治癒率が依然として低い。
pmid-17039021.summary_en: This review summarizes recent literature on the study and treatment of testicular germ cell tumors. Most patients are now cured, so the therapeutic focus has shifted to selecting appropriate therapy with minimal toxicity and accurately predicting outcome. Low-volume nonseminomatous tumors and pure seminomas present dilemmas about optimal therapy, whereas cure rates remain lower for high-volume nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-21227189.summary_ja: 膀胱尿路上皮癌に絨毛癌様分化を伴う2症例を報告し、既報25例と合わせて検討した。腫瘍細胞のβ-hCG免疫染色を行った。全27例中、治療後に無病生存していたのは3例のみで、多くは浸潤性腫瘍として診断され平均生存期間は約12か月であった。進行例では化学療法、放射線療法、根治的手術のいずれも生存率を改善しなかった。著者らは絨毛癌成分を脱分化と解釈し、早期でβ-hCG値が正常から中等度上昇の症例では根治的手術により長期生存が得られる可能性があるとしている。
pmid-21227189.summary_en: This report describes two cases of bladder urothelial carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous differentiation that had different outcomes, and reviews 25 previously reported cases. Beta-hCG immunoperoxidase staining was performed on tumor cells. Of 27 patients, only three were alive without disease after treatment, and most presented with invasive tumors with a mean survival of about 12 months. Chemotherapy, radiation, or radical surgery in advanced stages did not improve survival. The authors suggest that the choriocarcinomatous component reflects dedifferentiation, and that early-stage patients with normal beta-hCG may survive long term after radical surgery.

pmid-29645231.summary_ja: 絨毛性疾患および非絨毛性腫瘍患者の血清と尿中のhCG関連物質を測定し、完全型hCG、遊離β-hCG、β-コア断片（β-CF）を解析した。絨毛性疾患では、β-CFは尿中のみで検出され、初期妊娠および胞状奇胎では尿中免疫反応性の約30〜50%、絨毛癌では60%以上を占めた。子宮頸癌、子宮内膜癌、卵巣癌、肺癌、膀胱癌でも尿中β-CFが検出され、卵巣癌では84%と高率であった。著者らは、絨毛性疾患の腫瘍マーカーとしては血清中の完全型hCGを測定すべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-29645231.summary_en: The authors measured immunoreactive hCG/hCG-beta in serum and urine of patients with trophoblastic disease and non-trophoblastic tumors, using assays for intact hCG, free hCG-beta, and the beta-core fragment (beta-CF). In trophoblastic disease, intact hCG and free hCG-beta were found in serum and urine, whereas beta-CF was detected only in urine. Beta-CF accounted for 30-50% of urinary immunoreactivity in early pregnancy and molar pregnancy, and over 60% in choriocarcinoma. Urinary beta-CF was also detected in cervical, endometrial, ovarian, lung, and bladder carcinomas, most often in ovarian cancer (84%). The authors suggest that serum intact hCG is preferable as a tumor marker.

pmid-29645238.summary_ja: 日本の妊娠性絨毛性疾患の地域登録（1974年〜1993年）の結果を報告している。登録地域は全人口の34%から48.5%に拡大した。胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の発生頻度は著明な減少傾向を示した。絨毛癌の先行妊娠は、1974年には胞状奇胎が多かったが、1993年には正期妊娠が最多となった。また、臨床的な8項目から侵入奇胎や転移性奇胎と絨毛癌を鑑別する絨毛癌リスクスコア表を提示し、組織診断との比較で90%以上の確率で判別できるとしている。
pmid-29645238.summary_en: This report summarizes Japanese regional registration of gestational trophoblastic disease, which covered 34% of the population in 1974 and expanded to 48.5% by 1993 under the Japan Trophoblastic Disease Committee. Incidence of molar pregnancy and choriocarcinoma showed a marked decreasing trend. The antecedent pregnancy of choriocarcinoma shifted from molar pregnancy in 1974 to term pregnancy in 1993. The authors present the Choriocarcinoma Risk Score Table, which uses eight clinical items to distinguish choriocarcinoma from invasive or metastatic mole, with over 90% probability compared with histologic diagnosis.

pmid-29645240.summary_ja: 新潟大学での20年以上にわたる妊娠性絨毛性疾患の研究をまとめた総説。県内の登録データ、妊娠性絨毛癌の治療成績、hCG様物質の抑制を目的としたGnRHアナログ投与の試験、子宮外妊娠性絨毛癌の稀な2例を検討している。
pmid-29645240.summary_en: This review summarizes more than 20 years of trophoblastic disease work at Niigata University. It covers regional registration data for trophoblastic disease, treatment outcomes for gestational choriocarcinoma at Niigata University Hospital, a trial of a GnRH analogue to suppress hCG-like substance that cross-reacts with hCG immunoassays, and two rare cases of extrauterine gestational choriocarcinoma seen at the Ryukyu University Hospital.

pmid-29645254.summary_ja: 1971〜1995年の韓国の7,198例の妊娠性絨毛性疾患を解析し、発生率の推移を検討した。医療機関ベースの胞状奇胎発生率は分娩1,000件あたり40.2から2.3へ低下した。寛解率の改善と生存率の向上も認められ、社会経済的発展が寄与したと考察されている。
pmid-29645254.summary_en: This Korean multicenter analysis of 7,198 gestational trophoblastic disease cases from 1971 to 1995 examined incidence and time trends. Hospital-based hydatidiform mole incidence fell from 40.2 to 2.3 per 1,000 deliveries between 1971-1975 and 1991-1995, and population-based incidence in 1991-1995 averaged 2.05. Maternal age and gravidity decreased, and annual remission rates improved. The authors attribute these trends partly to socioeconomic improvement and better survival.

pmid-29645256.summary_ja: 1959〜1985年に1,500例を治療した長期経験の報告。絨毛癌の死亡率は90%超から20%未満に低下し、侵入奇胎では死亡例がなかった。10〜38年追跡された生存者に残存病変はなく、多くが正常に妊娠・出産した。5-FU化学療法は広範な転移例でも治癒をもたらしうると結論づけている。
pmid-29645256.summary_en: This institutional series of 1,500 patients treated between 1959 and 1985 reports chemotherapy for choriocarcinoma and invasive mole. Choriocarcinoma mortality fell from over 90% to under 20%, and no deaths occurred among invasive mole patients. Survivors followed for 10 to 38 years had no residual disease, and about 80% of young patients treated with chemotherapy alone later conceived with normal pregnancy outcomes. The authors conclude that 5-FU chemotherapy can cure even widely metastatic disease.

pmid-29645259.summary_ja: 完全胞状奇胎の多くは良性だが、10〜20%は侵入奇胎や絨毛癌に進展する。著者らは、ホモ接合性の形成と父親由来ゲノムの選択的遺伝により腫瘍抑制遺伝子が不活化される可能性を論じている。第11染色体上のIGF2とH19の逆方向インプリンティングが、絨毛癌の発生に関与する候補として挙げられている。
pmid-29645259.summary_en: This review discusses how genomic imprinting and parent-of-origin effects may contribute to choriocarcinoma development. Complete hydatidiform moles, which are androgenetic, are usually benign, but 10 to 20 percent progress to invasive mole or choriocarcinoma. The authors propose that homozygosity and selective paternal transmission may inactivate tumor suppressor genes. IGF2 and H19, reciprocally imprinted genes on chromosome 11, are highlighted as candidates.

pmid-9391212.summary_ja: 7か月の乳児に生じた両側精巣腫瘍の症例報告。左側は卵黄嚢腫瘍、右側は成熟奇形腫と診断され、いずれも高位精巣摘除術で切除された。術前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は10,000 ng/mlを超えていた。両側精巣奇形腫の報告は文献上1例のみで、本例は異なる組織型の両側精巣腫瘍として稀な症例である。
pmid-9391212.summary_en: This case report describes a 7-month-old infant with bilateral enlarged scrotal masses and serum alpha-fetoprotein above 10,000 ng/ml. The left testis was removed for suspected yolk sac tumor, and the right testis was diagnosed as mature teratoma after high inguinal orchiectomy. The authors note that only one previous case of bilateral testicular teratoma has been reported, and describe this as a rare second case of bilateral testicular tumors with differing histologies.

pmid-9391213.summary_ja: 新生児の仙骨前奇形腫が出口閉塞を来し、膀胱破裂と先天性尿性腹水を生じた症例報告。腹水を排液し膀胱を修復したうえで奇形腫を切除した。先天性奇形腫は仙尾部に多く、仙骨前に限局する例は稀である。文献検索で同様の症例は見つからなかった。
pmid-9391213.summary_en: This report describes a newborn with presacral teratoma that caused outflow obstruction, bladder rupture, and congenital urinary ascites. The ascites was drained, the bladder was repaired, and the teratoma was successfully excised. Congenital teratomas most often present in the sacrococcygeal region, so a tumor confined to the presacral space is rare. The authors found no similar case in their literature review.

pmid-9400455.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の男性46例を対象に、奇形腫の悪性転化の組織型、染色体異常、予後を検討した。肉腫が63%と最多で、腺癌や原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍も見られた。精巣・後腹膜に限局し完全切除された例は生存期間が長かった。多くの腫瘍でi(12p)が認められ胚細胞由来であることが示された。シスプラチン系化学療法への反応は乏しく、外科的切除が治療の中心となる。
pmid-9400455.summary_en: This study of 46 men with germ cell tumors showing teratoma with malignant transformation found sarcoma in 63%, most often rhabdomyosarcoma, and other solid histologies such as adenocarcinoma or PNET in 37%. Malignant transformation was detected at the primary site in 44% and at metastases in 43%. Patients with transformed components confined to the testis or retroperitoneum and completely resected had longer survival than those with distant metastases. Most tumors carried i(12p), confirming germ cell origin. These tumors responded poorly to cisplatin-based chemotherapy, so surgical resection was central.

pmid-9400488.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの純粋胎児性癌で精巣摘除術を受けた14例のアーカイブ標本を対象に、12p・12q領域のプローブを用いたFISH解析を行った。14例中5例で多発性12pパターンが認められ、そのうち4例は病理病期Bであった。症例数は少ないが、多発性12pパターンが転移能の予測に有用となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9400488.summary_en: This study used fluorescence in situ hybridization (FISH) with chromosome 12p and 12q probes on archival paraffin-embedded orchiectomy specimens from 14 patients with clinical stage A pure embryonal carcinoma of the testis. Multifocal 12p hybridization patterns were observed in 5 of 14 specimens, and 4 of these 5 showed pathologic stage B disease. Although the series is small, the authors suggest that multifocal 12p may help predict metastatic potential, pending validation in a larger cohort.

pmid-9406578.summary_ja: セミノーマのcDNAライブラリーから6種のKrüppel型ジンクフィンガー遺伝子をクローニングした。そのうちZFS-1はZNF91 KRABジンクフィンガー遺伝子ファミリーと高い相同性を示し、同じ染色体に位置していた。第19染色体上の複数のジンクフィンガー遺伝子がセミノーマで優位に発現しており、精巣とセミノーマに共通する2.3kbの転写産物も認められた。これらの遺伝子がセミノーマの発生・増殖に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9406578.summary_en: Six Krüppel-type zinc finger genes were cloned from a seminoma cDNA library. One, ZFS-1, was highly homologous to the ZNF91 KRAB zinc finger family and mapped to the same chromosome. Northern blot analysis showed that multiple zinc finger genes on chromosome 19 were predominantly expressed in seminomas, and testis and seminoma shared a specific 2.3 kb transcript. The authors suggest that chromosome 19 zinc finger genes may contribute to seminoma development or growth.

pmid-9440751.summary_ja: 臨床病期Aの非セミノーマ性精巣がん91例を対象に、転移リスクの低い患者を同定する方法を検討した研究です。胎児性癌の体積、後腹膜リンパ節の径、MIB-1染色を組み合わせると41例が低リスクと判定されました。そのうち40例は病理学的にも病期Aであり、監視療法の対象になりうることが示唆されました。
pmid-9440751.summary_en: This study evaluated whether combined quantitative immunohistochemistry, histopathology, and CT assessment can identify clinical stage A nonseminomatous testicular cancer patients at very low risk of metastasis. In 91 patients who underwent nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, 41 were classified as low risk using embryonal carcinoma volume, lymph node diameter, and MIB-1 staining. Of these, 40 had pathologic stage A disease, suggesting that they could be offered surveillance rather than immediate dissection.

pmid-9440752.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤の組織型を予測する既存のロジスティック回帰式を検証した研究です。172例の解析で、壊死が45%、成熟奇形腫が42%、がんが13%でした。壊死の予測は良好でしたが、がんと成熟奇形腫の鑑別は困難でした。
pmid-9440752.summary_en: This study validated published logistic regression models that predict the histology of residual retroperitoneal masses after chemotherapy for metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Among 172 patients with normal tumor markers, residual masses were necrosis in 45%, mature teratoma in 42%, and cancer in 13%. Predicted necrosis probabilities matched observed rates well, with an ROC area of 82%. Cancer could not be reliably distinguished from mature teratoma, which limits decisions about the extent of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-9440755.summary_ja: 1981〜1993年に当院で治療された病期IIセミノーマ99例の後ろ向き解析。放射線療法80例、化学療法19例で、5年全生存率は94%、5年無再発率は83%。放射線療法群の20%が再発し、多くは照射野外の遠隔再発であった。病期IIC/IIDでは放射線療法の再発率が56%と高く、化学療法が第一選択とされた。
pmid-9440755.summary_en: This single-institution cohort of 99 patients with stage II seminoma treated between 1981 and 1993 compared radiotherapy (80 patients) and chemotherapy (19 patients). Five-year overall survival was 94%, and the relapse-free rate was 83%. Relapse after radiotherapy occurred in 20%, mostly outside the irradiated field, with distant sites including bone and lung/mediastinum. Relapse risk was markedly higher in stage IIC-IID disease (56%) than in IIA-IIB (11%), and no patients treated with chemotherapy in IIC-IID relapsed. The authors conclude that chemotherapy should be the primary treatment for IIC/IID seminoma.

pmid-9442139.summary_ja: 41歳男性の無症候性後縦隔腫瘤の症例報告。CTで脂肪と石灰化を認め、成熟奇形腫が示唆された。胸部の胚細胞腫瘍の大部分は胸腺近傍に発生することが指摘されている。神経原性腫瘍、脂肪肉腫、髄外造血が鑑別に挙げられた。CTの脂肪・石灰化所見が、性腺外の縦隔奇形腫の診断に有用であることを示している。
pmid-9442139.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old asymptomatic man with a posterior mediastinal mass found incidentally. Computed tomography showed fat and calcification, which suggested mature teratoma. The authors note that most thoracic germ cell tumors arise at or near the thymus. The differential diagnosis included neurogenic tumors, liposarcoma and extramedullary hematopoiesis. The report illustrates how CT findings of fat and calcification can help establish the diagnosis of an extragonadal mediastinal teratoma.

pmid-9442592.summary_ja: 33歳女性が30日間で10回の脳内出血を来した症例。血管造影で遠位血管の遅延性造影剤洗い出しが多発し、剖検で血管内に広がる絨毛癌が確認された。絨毛癌では10〜20%に脳転移がみられる。出血性脳血管障害を呈する妊娠可能年齢の女性では、絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げるべきと述べている。
pmid-9442592.summary_en: This report describes a 33-year-old woman who developed ten intracerebral hemorrhages over 30 days. Angiography showed multiple areas of delayed contrast washout in distal vessels. Autopsy revealed intravascular choriocarcinoma without true aneurysm formation. The authors note that cerebral metastases occur in 10-20% of choriocarcinoma patients and that multiple pseudoaneurysms and hemorrhage are rare. They recommend considering choriocarcinoma in women of childbearing age presenting with cerebrovascular syndromes.

pmid-9442957.summary_ja: 非機能性卵巣甲状腺腫を術前にI-123骨盤シンチグラフィで診断した症例報告。超音波、CT、MRIでは嚢胞性・充実性成分を伴う多房性腫瘤として描出された。組織学的に甲状腺組織と濾胞腺腫が確認された。I-123シンチグラフィは術前の正確な診断に有用であったとしている。
pmid-9442957.summary_en: This case report describes a nonfunctional struma ovarii diagnosed preoperatively by iodine-123 pelvic scintigraphy. Ultrasound, CT and MRI showed a multilobulated mass with cystic and solid components. Scintigraphy demonstrated uptake in the pelvic mass, and histology showed thyroid tissue with follicular adenoma. The authors conclude that I-123 scintigraphy helped reach an accurate preoperative diagnosis. The report highlights the role of nuclear medicine imaging in identifying struma ovarii, a specialized ovarian teratoma.

pmid-9445130.summary_ja: Ki-67とMel-CAMの二重免疫染色を用い、過剰胎盤部、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌を鑑別する方法を検討した研究。中間型トロホブラストにおけるKi-67標識率は、過剰胎盤部でほぼゼロ、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で約14%、絨毛癌で約69%であった。胎盤部病変の鑑別診断に有用と結論づけている。
pmid-9445130.summary_en: This study used double immunohistochemistry for Ki-67 and Mel-CAM to distinguish exaggerated placental site, placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT), and choriocarcinoma. Ki-67 indices in intermediate trophoblast were near zero in exaggerated placental site, about 14% in PSTT and about 69% in choriocarcinoma, with significant differences among groups. Molar implantation sites showed about 5%. The authors conclude that Mel-CAM-defined Ki-67 labeling is a useful aid in the differential diagnosis of these placental site lesions.

pmid-9446552.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌2102細胞が、グロボシド（Gb4）をコートした面に糖鎖同士の相互作用で接着する機構を検討した研究。レチノイン酸による分化に伴いSSEA-3などの糖脂質が減少し、接着も低下した。接着により、AP1とCREBの転写因子活性が一過性に増強された。
pmid-9446552.summary_en: This study examined how human embryonal carcinoma 2102 cells adhere to globoside (Gb4)-coated surfaces through carbohydrate-carbohydrate interactions involving SSEA-3 and nLc4. Adhesion declined with retinoic acid-induced differentiation as these glycosphingolipids decreased. Adhesion triggered a rapid, transient enhancement of AP1 and CREB transcription factor activity, whereas adhesion to Gg3 did not. The authors propose that glycosphingolipid-mediated adhesion of embryonal carcinoma cells initiates signaling that may be relevant to differentiation.

pmid-9454657.summary_ja: 卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍49例と成熟良性嚢胞性奇形腫64例で血清M-CSFを測定した研究です。悪性例の90%で上昇し、良性奇形腫では11%のみでした。ディスジャーミノーマでは全16例が上昇し、CA125より高い感度を示しました。特にディスジャーミノーマに対して、感度と特異度が高い血清マーカーとして有用である可能性が示されています。
pmid-9454657.summary_en: This study measured serum macrophage colony-stimulating factor (M-CSF) in 49 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and 64 with mature benign cystic teratoma. M-CSF was elevated in 90% of malignant cases, including all 16 dysgerminomas, versus only 11% of benign teratomas. CA125 was elevated in 69% of malignant cases. The authors conclude M-CSF is highly sensitive and specific for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, particularly dysgerminoma, and may serve as a useful serum marker.

pmid-9454662.summary_ja: 肺と膣に転移した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の31歳女性が、EMA/CO化学療法と手術の後、6年以上再発なく生存している症例報告です。文献的に、EMA/COを受けた転移例7例の総奏効率は71%、完全奏効率は28%でした。転移性PSTTは根治を目指せる可能性があり、EMA/COは従来の多剤併用療法より優れると著者らは結論づけています。
pmid-9454662.summary_en: This report describes a 31-year-old woman with metastatic placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) to the lungs and vagina who remains free of recurrence more than six years after EMA/CO chemotherapy and surgery. A literature review of seven metastatic PSTT patients treated with EMA/CO found a 71% overall response rate and 28% complete response. The authors conclude metastatic PSTT is potentially curable and that EMA/CO appears superior to older multiagent regimens.

pmid-9454890.summary_ja: 正常絨毛27例、胞状奇胎9例、絨毛癌2例でテロメラーゼ活性を比較した研究です。正常絨毛の48%で活性が検出され、妊娠初期に最も高く、妊娠後期に低下しました。全ての胞状奇胎では正常絨毛より有意に活性が上昇していました。細胞増殖、テロメラーゼ活性、妊娠性絨毛性疾患への進展の間に関連がある可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-9454890.summary_en: Telomerase activity was assessed in chorionic villi from 27 normal pregnancies, 9 hydatidiform moles, and 2 choriocarcinomas. Telomerase was detected in 48% of normal villi, with activity highest in the first trimester and declining later in gestation. All mole samples showed significantly increased telomerase activity compared with normal villi. The authors suggest a relationship between cell proliferation, telomerase activity, and progression to gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9456970.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍3例のMRI所見を報告した研究です。子宮筋層内の腫瘤として描出され、T1強調像では筋層と等信号、T2強調像では等信号からわずかに高信号を示しました。所見は非特異的で、診断には生検が必要です。超音波検査で描出されなかった2例では、MRIにより子宮切開術で治療できた例がありました。
pmid-9456970.summary_en: This series of three pathologically proven placental site trophoblastic tumors describes their MRI appearance. Lesions appeared as myometrial masses isointense to myometrium on T1-weighted images and isointense to slightly hyperintense on T2-weighted images, without cystic spaces or prominent vessels. Because these findings are nonspecific, diagnosis requires biopsy. In two cases the tumor was not seen on ultrasound, and MRI-guided localization allowed hysterotomy instead of hysterectomy.

pmid-9457255.summary_ja: 1968年から1993年に病期I精巣セミノーマ81例を放射線療法で治療し、放射線誘発の二次がんを検討した研究です。3例(4%)が高線量照射野内にがんを発症しました。膵癌を発症した1例は、追加の縦隔照射と再発に対する化学療法を受けていました。著者らは、総線量と照射野を縮小することで、このリスクを低減できる可能性を提案しています。
pmid-9457255.summary_en: This study of 81 patients treated with radiation for stage I testicular seminoma at a single Israeli center between 1968 and 1993 evaluated radiation-induced second cancers. Three patients (4%) developed cancers within the high-dose field, where they had received higher than usual doses to para-aortic and pelvic regions. One patient developed pancreatic carcinoma after additional mediastinal irradiation and multiple cisplatin/VP-16 regimens for relapses. The authors recommend lower total doses and smaller fields to reduce this risk.

pmid-9457304.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、腹腔内に生じた精巣セミノーマを腹腔鏡下に切除した1例を報告したものである。腹腔内精巣腫瘍は診断が困難で、従来は開腹探索と切除が治療の中心であった。後腹膜リンパ節腫大のない患者では、腹腔鏡が診断と低侵襲切除の両方に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-9457304.summary_en: This case report describes an intra-abdominal seminoma of the testis that was resected laparoscopically. Intra-abdominal testicular neoplasms are difficult to diagnose and have traditionally required open exploration and excision. The authors suggest that in patients without retroperitoneal lymphadenopathy, laparoscopy can serve both for diagnosis and for minimally invasive resection of these tumors.

pmid-9457835.summary_ja: 病期Iのセミノーマ35例を対象に、精巣摘除後のアジュバント治療として傍大動脈リンパ節照射のみを行った前向き予備試験である。照射は25Gy/15分割で、同側骨盤照射は行わなかった。追跡期間中央値39.7か月で97.1%が無病生存しており、晩期有害事象は認められなかった。
pmid-9457835.summary_en: This prospective preliminary study evaluated para-aortic lymph node irradiation as the sole adjuvant therapy after orchiectomy for 35 patients with Stage I seminoma. Patients received 25 Gy in 15 fractions to the para-aortic field, without ipsilateral pelvic irradiation. At a median follow-up of 39.7 months, 97.1% of patients were alive without evidence of disease, and only grade I-II acute toxicities occurred, with no late side effects. The authors conclude this approach is adequate and minimally toxic.

pmid-9461002.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍24例を比較ゲノムハイブリダイゼーション法で解析し、一貫したコピー数変化領域を同定した。12pのコピー数増加は全例で認められ、6q21-q24の増加は化学療法抵抗性と関連した。セミノーマと非セミノーマで異なる領域も示され、両者の分化の違いに関わる候補遺伝子の存在が示唆された。
pmid-9461002.summary_en: This study used comparative genomic hybridization on 24 adult testicular germ cell tumours (8 seminomas, 14 non-seminomas including two cell lines, and 2 combined tumours) to map consistent copy number changes. Gain of 12p occurred in all cases, with frequent gains of chromosomes 7 and 8. Gain of 6q21-q24 was associated with chemotherapy resistance. Several regions differed significantly between seminoma and non-seminoma, suggesting candidate genes underlying their divergent development.

pmid-9461006.summary_ja: 1979年から1994年にノルウェー放射線病院で治療された、脳以外の性腺外悪性胚細胞腫瘍48例の検討である。シスプラチン併用化学療法により多くの患者が腫瘍消失に至り、5年全生存率は60%であった。40歳以上で治療関連死が多く、晩期再発や精巣腫瘍の続発を受けて長期フォローアップの重要性が強調された。
pmid-9461006.summary_en: This review describes 48 patients with noncerebral extragonadal malignant germ cell tumours treated at the Norwegian Radium Hospital from 1979 to 1994. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy, with or without surgery, produced tumour-free status in many patients, and the 5-year overall survival was 60%. Treatment-related deaths were frequent, particularly in patients over 40. Late relapses and subsequent testicular tumours led the authors to emphasise long-term follow-up.

pmid-9467948.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞から新規遺伝子hGDF3をクローニングし、その発現を解析した。胎児性癌細胞株では幹細胞特異的に発現し、分化により低下する。原発精巣胚細胞腫瘍では、セミノーマで発現が低く、非セミノーマでは胎児性癌成分や卵黄嚢成分と関連して検出された。胎児性癌幹細胞のマーカーとなる可能性がある。
pmid-9467948.summary_en: The authors cloned human growth differentiation factor 3 (hGDF3), a TGF-beta family member, from human embryonal carcinoma cells. hGDF3 expression is stem-cell specific in embryonal carcinoma lines, falls with retinoic acid-induced differentiation, and rises with activin A. In primary testicular germ cell tumours, expression is low in seminomas but detectable in non-seminomas, associated with embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac components. The gene maps to chromosome 12p, and hGDF3 is proposed as an embryonal carcinoma stem cell marker.

pmid-9469359.summary_ja: 予後不良の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍380例を対象に、BOP/VIP-B療法とBEP/EP療法をランダム化比較したMRC/EORTC共同試験である。完全奏効率や全生存期間に有意差はなく、BOP/VIP-B群で骨髄抑制と毒性死が多かった。毒性増加に見合う利点は認められなかった。
pmid-9469359.summary_en: This MRC/EORTC randomized trial compared intensive induction-sequential BOP/VIP-B chemotherapy with standard BEP/EP in 380 patients with poor-prognosis metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumours. Complete response rates were similar (57% vs 54%), and there were no significant differences in failure-free or overall survival. BOP/VIP-B caused more myelosuppression, febrile neutropenia, and toxic deaths (9% vs 5%). The authors conclude BOP/VIP-B offered no benefit despite greater toxicity.

pmid-9469360.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で予後良好な胚細胞腫瘍118例を対象に、BEP療法3サイクルと4サイクルを比較したランダム化試験の長期フォローアップ解析である。追跡期間中央値10.1年で両群の全生存期間に差はなかった。血清ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が1,000 mIU/mLを超える症例は予後不良であった。
pmid-9469360.summary_en: This follow-up analysis of a randomized trial compares three versus four cycles of BEP chemotherapy in 118 patients with favorable-prognosis germ-cell tumors treated at Indiana University. With a median follow-up of 10.1 years, overall and disease-free survival did not differ between arms. Serum hCG was the only factor associated with survival; patients with hCG above 1,000 mIU/mL had markedly worse outcomes. Long-term follow-up confirmed that three cycles are equivalent to four.

pmid-9469361.summary_ja: 進行性胚細胞腫瘍796例のシスプラチン併用化学療法を後方視的に解析し、反応予測因子を同定した。縦隔原発、非セミノーマ組織型、非肺臓器転移、LDHおよびhCG高値が不良因子であった。これらに基づく予後分類では完全奏効率が良好群92%、中間群76%、不良群39%となり、AJCCおよびUICCの病期分類に組み込まれた。
pmid-9469361.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 796 patients with advanced germ cell tumors treated with platinum-based chemotherapy at Memorial Hospital identified factors predicting response. Mediastinal primary site, nonseminomatous histology, non-pulmonary visceral metastases, and elevated LDH and hCG were associated with lower complete response rates. Using these factors, the authors built a model stratifying patients into good-, intermediate-, and poor-risk groups with complete response rates of 92%, 76%, and 39%. The findings inform trial allocation and were incorporated into AJCC and UICC staging systems.

pmid-9469362.summary_ja: 予後不良の転移性悪性胚細胞腫瘍患者を対象とした第III相試験で、フィルグラスチムの併用効果を検討した。6サイクル以上を完遂した割合は投与群85%、非投与群70%と有意に高かった。毒性死亡は投与群3例、非投与群12例であった。無増悪生存と全生存期間に差はなく、標準的なBEP療法への定期的使用は支持されないと結論された。
pmid-9469362.summary_en: This EORTC/MRC phase III trial randomized patients with poor-prognosis metastatic malignant germ cell tumors receiving BEP/EP or BOP/VIP-B chemotherapy to filgrastim or no filgrastim. Filgrastim significantly increased the proportion completing at least six cycles (85% vs 70%) and allowed higher dose-intensity. Toxic deaths were fewer with filgrastim (3 vs 12), mostly confined to the intensified schedule. Failure-free and overall survival did not differ. The authors concluded that routine filgrastim use does not improve survival and does not support its routine use with standard BEP chemotherapy.

pmid-9469363.summary_ja: 1976～1993年にシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍38例を報告した。初回治療例の完全奏効率は66%であった。予後因子は肺外転移のみであった。完全奏効例の21%に血液悪性腫瘍が発生し、約40%で長期生存が期待できると結論された。
pmid-9469363.summary_en: This study describes 38 patients with primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy between 1976 and 1993, most at the Institut Gustave-Roussy. Complete response was achieved in 66% of initially treated patients, and about 34% remained disease-free at median 89 months. Extrapulmonary metastasis was the only significant prognostic factor. Leukemia developed in five patients, with 12p isochromosome in two, and was seen in 21% of complete responders. The authors conclude that primary mediastinal NSGCT is biologically distinct and that around 40% can achieve long-term survival.

pmid-9469364.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に積極的監視を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性105例を10年以上追跡した。41例(39%)が父親となり、監視中は78例中36例(46%)であった。妊娠を試みた夫婦の65%が妊娠に成功した。再発治療後の父性率は低く、妊孕性のカウンセリングに役立つ結果と考えられる。
pmid-9469364.summary_en: This long-term study followed 105 men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors managed by surveillance after orchiectomy for over 10 years. Forty-one men (39%) fathered children, including 36 of 78 during active surveillance and 5 of 27 after relapse treatment. Among couples attempting pregnancy or presumed capable, 65% achieved pregnancy. The authors note lower paternity after relapse treatment, since more surveillance patients required treatment, which reduces fertility chances compared with nerve-sparing RPLND. The results inform fertility counseling for men on surveillance.

pmid-9473756.summary_ja: 小児の頭蓋外非性腺悪性胚細胞腫瘍について、新しいJEB療法(1989～95年)を従来の5レジメン(1979～88年)と比較した。5年生存率は63%から95%に、無イベント生存率は46%から87%に改善した。毒性も少なく、腎障害や難聴が減少した。仙尾部腫瘍の生存者には神経学的な晩期合併症が見られた。
pmid-9473756.summary_en: The UK Children's Cancer Study Group compared a newer carboplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin (JEB) regimen (GCII, 1989-95) with five earlier regimens (GCI, 1979-88) in children with malignant extracranial non-gonadal germ cell tumors. Five-year survival improved from 63% to 95%, and event-free survival from 46% to 87%. JEB was also less toxic, with fewer renal impairments and less deafness. Some survivors of sacrococcygeal tumors had neurological late effects, including neuropathic bladder or bowel and limb weakness. The authors concluded that JEB is more effective and less toxic.

pmid-9473760.summary_ja: 発熱、不整脈、胸骨後部の圧迫痛を呈した成人の心膜内奇形腫例を報告した。術前に心エコーと胸部CTで診断が示唆された。530gの腫瘍は組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、完全切除後10年間再発はなかった。画像診断は大血管との関係の把握に有用であり、発見された場合は切除すべきとされる。
pmid-9473760.summary_en: The authors report an adult patient with an intrapericardial teratoma presenting with fever, arrhythmias, and substernal chest pain. Echocardiography and chest CT suggested the diagnosis preoperatively. The 530 g tumor was histologically a mature cystic teratoma and was completely excised, with no residual disease at 10 years of follow-up. The paper emphasizes that intrapericardial teratomas are rare in adults, that imaging can delineate their relationship to great vessels, and that these tumors should be excised whenever detected.

pmid-9474130.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣がんの化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた848例を後方視的に検討した。162例(19%)で一括腎摘除が行われ、主な適応は腎周囲構造への隣接浸潤であった。腎門部の病理では奇形腫が49%を占めた。周術期合併症に差はなく、大容量の腎門周囲病変を有する選択患者で支持された。
pmid-9474130.summary_en: This retrospective review of 848 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous testis cancer found en bloc nephrectomy was performed in 162 (19%). The main indication was contiguous perirenal involvement (73%). Hilar pathology showed cancer in 20%, teratoma in 49%, and fibrosis in 31%. Patients requiring nephrectomy had more advanced disease at presentation and after chemotherapy, but perioperative morbidity and mortality did not differ, and only three needed perioperative dialysis. The authors support en bloc nephrectomy in selected patients with large perihilar disease.

pmid-9474168.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術のみを受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性105例を前向きに監視し、中央値11.3年追跡した。74%が無病で、27例が再発した。胎児性癌が優勢な組織型と脈管侵襲が再発の予測因子であった。これらがない場合、再発率は12%で原病による死亡はなかった。
pmid-9474168.summary_en: This prospective surveillance trial followed 105 men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors after orchiectomy alone, with median follow-up of 11.3 years. Of these, 74% remained disease-free, 27 relapsed (all within 24 months), and three died of disease. Predominant embryonal carcinoma histology and vascular invasion predicted relapse. Without those features, relapse rate was 12% and no patients died of disease. The authors conclude that surveillance alone is appropriate for a highly selected cohort with normal postoperative markers and neither predominant embryonal carcinoma nor vascular invasion.

pmid-9474169.summary_ja: 一施設で治療された悪性転化を伴う奇形腫21例の解析です。精巣原発18例中17例が転移性疾患として発症し、81%が再発（中央値6か月）しました。縦隔原発や神経・横紋筋肉腫様分化を伴う例は進行・再発率が高く、予後不良でした。残存・再発病変の完全な外科的切除が長期生存の最善の機会と結論づけています。
pmid-9474169.summary_en: This clinicopathological study analyzed 21 men with teratoma showing malignant transformation, treated at one institution over seven years. Most testicular primaries (17 of 18) presented with metastatic disease, and 81% of patients recurred, typically within about six months. Mediastinal primaries and tumors with neural or rhabdomyosarcomatous differentiation had markedly higher progression and recurrence rates. Five patients died of disease. The authors conclude these tumors are more aggressive than teratomas without malignant transformation, and that complete surgical resection of residual or recurrent disease offers the best chance of prolonged survival.

pmid-9474935.summary_ja: 無症状の29歳男性で、健診の胸部X線で発見された前縦隔腫瘍の症例です。CTで8×6cmの境界明瞭な腫瘍を認め、β-hCGが上昇（20.4 mIU/ml）していました。経皮生検で縦隔セミノーマと診断されました。シスプラチン併用化学療法（エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）4サイクル後の残存腫瘤は、切除標本で生存腫瘍細胞を認めませんでした。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍の初回治療として外科的切除は選択すべきでないと強調しています。
pmid-9474935.summary_en: This case report describes a 29-year-old man with an asymptomatic anterior mediastinal mass found incidentally on chest radiography. CT showed a well-marginated 8 x 6 cm tumor, and beta-hCG was elevated at 20.4 mIU/ml. Transcutaneous biopsy diagnosed mediastinal seminoma. After four cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin chemotherapy, the residual mass was resected and showed no viable tumor cells. The authors emphasize that surgical resection should not be the initial treatment for mediastinal germ cell tumors, and that the timing and modality of treatment must be carefully selected.

pmid-9475149.summary_ja: 高リスク転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の多剤併用による集学的治療の総説です。EMA-CO療法と補助的な放射線療法・外科的切除により、治癒率80〜90%が得られています。一方、25〜30%の患者は不完全奏効または再発を示し、多くは絨毛癌や非典型的な転移部位、転移個数の多い例です。耐性例に対する救援化学療法や大量化学療法の役割も議論されています。
pmid-9475149.summary_en: This review describes multimodality management of high-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic tumors. EMA-CO chemotherapy with adjuvant radiotherapy and surgery achieves cure rates of 80-90%. However, 25-30% of high-risk patients have an incomplete response or relapse, most often those with choriocarcinoma, unusual metastatic sites, more than eight metastases, or prior inappropriate chemotherapy. The authors discuss salvage cisplatin/etoposide-based regimens, surgical resection of resistant disease, and high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support as strategies for drug-resistant patients.

pmid-9475150.summary_ja: 一施設で1975〜1995年に治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の分子遺伝学的解析と治療成績の報告です。解析可能であった7例のうち4例は両親由来の妊娠、3例は単精子性完全胞状奇胎に続発したアンドロジェネティックな腫瘍でした。子宮限局例は子宮摘出が選択され、転移例では化学療法の効果にばらつきがあります。前回妊娠から2年以上経過すると予後不良でした。
pmid-9475150.summary_en: This report analyzes the molecular genetics and outcomes of placental site trophoblastic tumors treated at one center over two decades. Among seven tumors with successful molecular analysis, four arose from biparental pregnancies and three were androgenetic following monospermic complete moles. Uterine-confined disease is treated by hysterectomy, while metastatic disease requires chemotherapy with variable response. The authors suggest cisplatin be included from the outset of treatment. A long interval (over two years) from the antecedent pregnancy predicted poor outcome.

pmid-9475153.summary_ja: 1964〜1996年に同センターで治療された正期産後絨毛癌44例の後方視的検討です。出産から診断までが4か月を超えること、治療前hCG値が100,000mIU/mLを超えること、肝・脳転移、WHOスコア8超が不良因子でした。WHOスコア8以下の31例は全例生存し、8超の13例中6例（46%）が死亡しました。
pmid-9475153.summary_en: This retrospective review of 44 women treated for postterm choriocarcinoma at the New England Trophoblastic Disease Center over 32 years evaluated prognostic factors. Five infants had significant complications from maternal disease. A delivery-to-diagnosis interval over four months, pretreatment hCG above 100,000 mIU/mL, liver or brain metastases, and a WHO score above 8 predicted poor outcome. All 31 patients with a WHO score of 8 or less survived, while 46% of those scoring above 8 died.

pmid-9475811.summary_ja: 生後9か月の女児に生じた膣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告である。膣出血を契機に小児科へ紹介され、内胚葉性の膣卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。手術と化学療法が施行された。3.5歳の現在、全身状態は良好で、定期的なフォローアップを受けている。本症例は、乳児のまれな腫瘍に対する手術と化学療法後の良好な経過を示している。
pmid-9475811.summary_en: This case report describes a yolk sac tumor arising in the vagina of a nine-month-old girl who presented with vaginal hemorrhage during a check-up. After referral to a pediatric department, an endodermal yolk sac tumor of the vagina was diagnosed. The patient underwent surgery followed by chemotherapy. At 3.5 years of age she is in good general health and under regular follow-up. The case illustrates a favorable outcome after surgery and chemotherapy in an infant with this rare tumor.

pmid-9477114.summary_ja: シスプラチンを含む一次治療に不成功だった小児・思春期の再発・難治性頭蓋外非精巣性胚細胞腫瘍10例を対象とした第I/II相試験です。白金製剤併用化学療法と局所的な温熱療法（RHT）の併用を検討しました。10例中7例（70%）で客観的奏効が得られ、完全奏効5例、部分奏効2例でした。小児・思春期患者への併用療法の実施可能性が示されています。
pmid-9477114.summary_en: This phase I/II study tested regional hyperthermia combined with platinum-based chemotherapy in ten children and adolescents with recurrent or refractory extracranial nontesticular germ cell tumors that had failed intensive cisplatin-based first-line treatment. Seven of ten patients (70%) achieved an objective response, including five complete and two partial responses. The authors conclude the combined regimen can be used in young patients and encourage extending the study to those with a poor response to first-line treatment.

pmid-9483640.summary_ja: 超音波検査で出生前に診断された新生児頸部奇形腫の2例の報告である。1例は妊娠中絶、もう1例は妊娠36週で出生し、気道確保後に亜全摘出術が施行された。5歳時点で発達・神経学的欠損はなかった。著者らは、出生前診断に基づく計画と速やかな気道確保の重要性を強調し、悪性転化や転移の可能性も文献的に検討している。
pmid-9483640.summary_en: This report describes two neonatal cervical teratomas detected prenatally by ultrasound. One pregnancy was terminated. In the other, delivery at 36 weeks was followed by airway securing and subtotal tumor resection, with no developmental or neurological deficit at 5 years. The authors review outcomes and the potential for malignant transformation and metastasis in neonatal cervical teratomas. They emphasize that prenatal diagnosis allows early planning of delivery and resuscitation, which improves prognosis when the airway is stabilized and resection is not delayed.

pmid-9486589.summary_ja: 播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の14例で、ブレオマイシン投与前後の血漿中サイトカインを測定した。TNF-αは投与後3時間、4.5時間、24時間で有意に上昇したが、IL-1βとTGF-βに有意な変化はなかった。TNF-αの上昇は、発熱などの急性副作用や肺毒性の発生に関与する可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-9486589.summary_en: In 14 patients treated for disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, the authors measured plasma TNF-alpha, IL-1beta and TGF-beta before and after bleomycin infusion. TNF-alpha rose significantly at 3, 4.5 and 24 hours after infusion. IL-1beta and TGF-beta showed no significant change within 24 hours. The authors conclude that bleomycin-induced TNF-alpha release may contribute to acute side effects such as fever and chills, and probably to bleomycin-induced pulmonary toxicity. They suggest further study of IL-1beta and TGF-beta.

pmid-9488075.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の50例を後方視的に検討し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤に対する後腹膜リンパ節郭清の範囲を評価した。修正テンプレート郭清と残存腫瘤切除を受けた症例は再発を認めず、射精機能も温存されやすかった。腫瘍マーカーが正常化していれば、後腹膜に腫瘍を残すリスクは大きくないと結論している。
pmid-9488075.summary_en: This retrospective study of 50 patients with stage II or III testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor evaluated retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy for post-chemotherapy residual masses. Among patients with bilateral dissection, one had teratoma outside the modified template and residual masses. Patients treated with resection plus modified-template dissection had no relapse at a median 55 months. Ejaculation was retained more often after modified dissection (4 of 8) than after non-nerve-sparing bilateral dissection (7 of 25). The authors conclude that a modified template with residual mass resection carries no significant risk of leaving tumor in the retroperitoneum when tumor markers are normal.

pmid-9488076.summary_ja: 白金製剤併用化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する転移性胚細胞腫瘍の男性75例に対し、後腹膜外手術アプローチを行った。全例で肉眼的完全切除が得られ、2例が術後早期に死亡した。追跡期間中央値22か月で生存率91%、無病生存率83%であった。胸腹部アプローチは安全で、胸腔内病変の同時切除などの利点があると結論している。
pmid-9488076.summary_en: This study evaluates extraperitoneal surgical approaches for removing residual masses after platinum-based chemotherapy in 75 men with metastatic germ cell tumors, 63 testicular and 12 extragonadal. Eighty extraperitoneal operations were performed, mostly thoraco-abdominal. Complete macroscopic clearance was achieved in all cases, with a median blood loss of 0.8 L and a median stay of 7 days. Two early deaths occurred. Survival was 91% and disease-free survival 83% at a median follow-up of 22 months. The authors conclude the thoraco-abdominal approach is safe and offers advantages over anterior approaches for retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-9491143.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療12年後に後腹膜腫瘤を生じた35歳男性の症例。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、生検は腺癌と診断されたが、組織像の類似性や原発巣の欠如から奇形腫の再発と結論された。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法後に手術を行い、良好な経過を得た。治癒可能な本疾患と原発不明の転移との鑑別の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-9491143.summary_en: A 35-year-old man developed a retroperitoneal mass adjacent to the abdominal aorta 12 years after treatment of testicular germ cell tumor. Tumor markers were not elevated and the initial biopsy suggested adenocarcinoma, but the authors diagnosed teratoma recurrence based on histological similarity to the earlier resected specimen, absence of another primary, young age and the retroperitoneal pattern of late recurrence. He responded to cisplatin, etoposide and bleomycin followed by surgery. The authors stress differentiating this curable disease from metastasis of unknown primary.

pmid-9496832.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）の免疫組織学的マーカーとして、ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン（hPL）と妊娠関連主要塩基性タンパク質（pMBP）を比較検討した研究である。PSTT 24例と過剰胎盤部位病変3例を対象とした。pMBPは中間型トロホブラスト腫瘍のマーカーとして有用で、他の絨毛性疾患との鑑別に役立つと結論づけられている。転移性病変では染色性が弱い傾向が示された。
pmid-9496832.summary_en: This study evaluated human placental lactogen (hPL) and pregnancy-associated major basic protein (pMBP) as immunohistochemical markers in placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT). Twenty-four PSTT specimens and three exaggerated placental site lesions were stained by immunofluorescence and immunohistochemistry. pMBP staining was present in most PSTT specimens and all exaggerated placental site specimens, while hPL stained a higher proportion of cases more intensely. Staining intensities correlated between the two markers, and pMBP stained metastatic PSTT only weakly. The authors conclude that pMBP is useful for identifying intermediate trophoblast tumors and distinguishing them from other trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9498265.summary_ja: 小児の充実性卵巣腫瘍の評価と治療をまとめた総説である。腹痛と腫瘤で発症することが多く、超音波検査や腫瘍マーカーで評価する。小児の悪性卵巣腫瘍の約3分の2は胚細胞腫瘍で、ディスジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍が主である。病期I（stage I）では生殖臓器温存手術で根治が期待でき、進行例には腫瘍減量手術と白金製剤による化学療法が必要である。
pmid-9498265.summary_en: This review addresses the diagnosis and management of solid ovarian tumors in children. These tumors usually present with abdominal pain and a mass, and evaluation includes history, examination, ultrasound, tumor marker assays, and imaging. Two thirds of malignant pediatric ovarian tumors are germ cell tumors, mostly dysgerminomas and endodermal sinus tumors. Organ-sparing surgery may be curative for stage I disease, while advanced tumors require cytoreductive surgery and platinum-based chemotherapy. Postinduction surgery is indicated for progressive or recurrent disease. Stromal and epithelial tumors are also discussed.

pmid-9498381.summary_ja: 小児がん研究グループの多施設後方視的検討で、仙尾部奇形腫の小児126例の長期成績を解析した。成熟奇形腫患者の約11%で再発がみられ、多くは卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例では補助化学療法や救援化学療法により良好な無病生存が得られた。良性奇形腫では3年以上の長期フォローアップが必要で、非転移性の悪性例は外科的切除のみで治療可能と結論づけられている。
pmid-9498381.summary_en: This retrospective Children's Cancer Group review of 126 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) examined how therapy affected long-term outcome. Presenting histologies were mature teratoma, immature teratoma, and endodermal sinus tumor. Recurrence occurred in 11% of mature teratoma patients, mostly as endodermal sinus tumor, and was rare among immature teratoma patients. Endodermal sinus tumor patients receiving adjuvant or salvage chemotherapy had high disease-free survival. The authors recommend close long-term follow-up for benign teratomas and conclude that resection alone is adequate for nonmetastatic malignant tumors.

pmid-9498382.summary_ja: 早産で出生した仙尾部奇形腫5例を後方視的に検討し、初回の減量術と後の根治的切除または剖検の組織所見を比較した。初回の組織は未熟奇形腫が中心で、悪性の卵黄嚢成分を伴う例もあった。悪性成分のない未熟奇形腫の3例では、減量術で残存腫瘍があったにもかかわらず、後の標本では線維化のみがみられた。減量術が腫瘍の成熟を誘導する可能性や、妊娠中に自然な成熟が起こる可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-9498382.summary_en: The authors reviewed five preterm fetuses or neonates with sacrococcygeal teratoma who underwent initial tumor debulking followed by definitive resection or autopsy. Initial histology showed grade 3 immature teratoma, with or without malignant yolk sac elements. In three cases with immature teratoma lacking malignant elements, later specimens showed only fibrosis despite residual tumor at debulking. In the two cases with malignant elements, one later specimen showed benign immature teratoma and the other showed mature benign tissue. The authors suggest that debulking may induce tumor maturation, or that maturation may occur naturally during gestation.

pmid-9498832.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍におけるメタロチオネイン（MT）の発現と化学療法への反応性の関係を、77例の根治的精巣摘除術検体で免疫組織化学的に検討した。MTはセミノーマと非セミノーマを含む全ての腫瘍で発現していた。MT発現が高い例ほど治療感受性が高く、予後良好と考えられた。MT過剰発現が精巣腫瘍のシスプラチン耐性に寄与するという仮説は支持されなかった。
pmid-9498832.summary_en: This study examined whether metallothionein (MT) expression in germ cell testicular tumors predicts response to chemotherapy. Formalin-fixed tissue from 77 patients treated with radical orchiectomy was stained immunohistochemically for MT. MT was expressed in all tumor types, including seminomas and nonseminomas. MT immunoreactivity correlated significantly with clinical sensitivity to antitumor therapy, with higher expression predicting better response. The results do not support a role for MT overexpression in cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-9503212.summary_ja: 6か月間の急速な陰茎増大で受診した10歳の女児に、モザイク核型（46,XY/45,X）による男性性腺異形成の仮性半陰陽を認めた症例報告である。両側の性腺には性腺芽腫が、左側には限局性のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）がみられた。両側性腺摘除術と女性化陰茎形成術が施行された。異形成性腺における胚細胞腫瘍の悪性化リスクを示す症例である。
pmid-9503212.summary_en: This case report describes a 10-year-old girl who presented with rapid phallic growth over six months and was found to have male dysgenetic pseudohermaphroditism with a mosaic 46,XY/45,X karyotype. Imaging showed a vagina, uterus, and fallopian tube-like structures. Both gonads were dysgenetic testicular tissue with gonadoblastoma, and a focal dysgerminoma was present on the left. Bilateral gonadectomy and feminizing phalloplasty were performed. The report highlights the risk of malignant germ cell tumor development in dysgenetic gonads.

pmid-9504690.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘍99例(上皮性癌85例、胚細胞腫瘍14例)を対象に、トポイソメラーゼIIα(topo II alpha)の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。胚細胞腫瘍ではtopo IIα/Ki-67比が上皮性癌より有意に高かった。漿液性腺癌は粘液性腺癌より高値であった。また、G1期に陽性細胞を有する腫瘍では比が上昇しており、化学療法の標的としての意義が示唆された。
pmid-9504690.summary_en: This study examined topoisomerase II alpha expression by immunohistochemistry in 99 ovarian tumors (85 epithelial carcinomas and 14 germ cell tumors) and by flow cytometry in 29 cases. The topo II alpha-to-Ki-67 ratio was significantly higher in germ cell tumors than in epithelial carcinomas, and serous tumors exceeded mucinous ones. Topo II alpha was mainly expressed in S to G2/M phases, though some G1-positive tumors also showed higher ratios, suggesting changes relevant to chemotherapy targeting.

pmid-9506359.summary_ja: 病期I・IIのセミノーマ58例を対象に、根治的精巣摘除術と放射線療法後のフォローアップの費用対効果を検討した。中央値55か月の追跡で再発は2例のみであり、8年無病生存率は93%、全生存率は100%であった。フォローアップ検査の費用は1人あたり平均1万ドル超と高額であった。再発2例はいずれもスクリーニング以外で診断され、費用の観点から正当化されないと結論された。
pmid-9506359.summary_en: This study evaluated the cost-effectiveness of posttreatment surveillance in 58 patients with early-stage seminoma treated with orchiectomy and radiation therapy. Median follow-up was 55 months, with two recurrences and 100% overall survival. Surveillance tests were costly, averaging over $10,000 per patient in private charges. Both recurrences were detected outside the screening program. The authors concluded that the surveillance program studied does not appear justifiable on cost grounds.

pmid-9507839.summary_ja: イリノイ大学病院で治療された精巣がん患者215例を14年間にわたって後方視的に検討した。白人、黒人、ヒスパニック系男性の間で、腫瘍型と診断時の病期に差は認められなかった。一方、5年疾患特異的生存率は白人88%、ヒスパニック系79%、黒人71%であり、黒人男性の差は統計学的に有意であった。黒人男性で生存転帰がより不良であることが示唆された。
pmid-9507839.summary_en: This 14-year review of 215 testicular cancer patients at University of Illinois hospitals compared stage, histology, and 5-year survival among white, black, and Hispanic men. Tumor types and stage at presentation were similar across groups, with 42% seminoma and 58% nonseminoma. However, 5-year disease-specific survival was 88% in white, 79% in Hispanic, and 71% in black patients. The difference for black men was statistically significant.

pmid-9513871.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるc-myc、c-erbB-2、c-fms、bcl-2の発現を免疫組織化学的に比較した。完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌ではc-erbB-2とbcl-2の発現が有意に強かった。c-mycも完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌で高発現していた。K-ras遺伝子変異はいずれの症例にも認めなかった。これらの癌蛋白が完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の発症に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-9513871.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compared c-myc, c-erbB-2, c-fms, and bcl-2 expression in normal placentas, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. c-erbB-2 and bcl-2 were significantly stronger in complete moles and choriocarcinomas than in normal placenta or partial moles. c-myc was overexpressed in complete mole and choriocarcinoma. No K-ras mutations were found. The authors propose these oncoproteins contribute to the pathogenesis of complete mole and choriocarcinoma.

pmid-9513873.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、部分および完全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌において、p53、p21、Rb、mdm2蛋白の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。完全胞状奇胎と絨毛癌ではp53、p21、Rbが有意に過剰発現していた。過剰発現したp53は野生型と考えられた。これらの変化は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の侵襲的な振る舞いと関連する可能性がある。
pmid-9513873.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined p53, p21, Rb, and mdm2 expression in normal placentas, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. p53, p21, and Rb were significantly overexpressed in complete mole and choriocarcinoma, and mdm2 was elevated in both mole types. Only one nonsense p53 mutation was found, suggesting that the overexpressed p53 is wild type. The authors suggest these alterations may relate to aggressive behavior in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-9515178.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の肺転移に対する内科的・外科的管理をまとめた総説である。第一選択はシスプラチン併用化学療法で、残存病変に対する肺転移切除術は補助的な役割を果たす。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では腫瘍マーカーが正常化した後に残存腫瘤の切除が推奨され、直径3cm以上の残存セミノーマでは切除または生検が代替手段となる。
pmid-9515178.summary_en: This review addresses management of pulmonary metastases from germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy is the first-line treatment. Pulmonary metastasectomy plays an adjuvant role in patients with residual radiographic abnormalities or progression despite chemotherapy. Surgical resection of residual pulmonary and mediastinal disease confirms response and removes viable tumor. For nonseminomatous tumors with normalized tumor markers after chemotherapy, resection of all residual masses is indicated. For seminoma residuals of 3 cm or more, resection or biopsy is a reasonable alternative.

pmid-9516062.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者12例の血清ヒト胎盤性ラクトゲン(hPL)を追跡し、ホロhCGと比較した研究である。hPLは上昇例があったものの値はホロhCGより桁違いに低く、腫瘍マーカーとしての追加的な情報は乏しいと結論づけられた。絨毛癌細胞株による in vitro 解析も併せて行われている。
pmid-9516062.summary_en: The authors measured human placental lactogen (hPL) in healthy individuals and in testicular cancer patients. Serum hPL was below 20 pg/ml in all healthy subjects. In 12 testicular cancer patients with markedly elevated holo-hCG, hPL rose in 10 but at levels 2-3 orders of magnitude lower, and it normalized sooner. Choriocarcinoma cell lines showed hPL secretion only in JAR cells. The authors conclude that hPL offers no additional information over holo-hCG as a tumor marker in testicular cancer.

pmid-9516957.summary_ja: 自家末梢血幹細胞移植を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者28例のアフェレーシス産物を、β-hCGのPCRで検査した後方視的研究である。β-hCG分泌腫瘍の7例で陽性となり、陽性例では再発や内臓転移が多い傾向にあったが統計学的有意差はなかった。腫瘍細胞の除去効果の監視や再発リスクの評価に有用である可能性が示唆された。
pmid-9516957.summary_en: The authors used PCR for beta-hCG to detect tumor cell contamination in apheresis products from 28 germ cell tumor patients undergoing autologous stem cell transplantation. Products were PCR positive in 7 of 20 beta-hCG-secreting tumor patients and in none of the non-secreting cases. PCR positivity correlated with higher serum beta-hCG at apheresis and at diagnosis. PCR-positive patients showed a non-significant trend toward higher relapse and visceral metastasis rates. The authors suggest the assay may help monitor tumor cell depletion and refine relapse risk models.

pmid-9519363.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後の臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者6例に対し、単側の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行った報告である。合併症なく施行され、2例に微小な胎児性癌の転移が見つかり補助化学療法が行われた。平均21.3か月の観察期間で再発はなかった。実現可能で有効と結論されたが、より大規模な研究が必要とされている。
pmid-9519363.summary_en: The authors report unilateral laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (LRPLND) in six patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors after radical orchiectomy. Procedures were completed without complications, with minimal blood loss and no transfusions. Histology showed microscopic embryonal carcinoma metastases in two patients, who received adjuvant chemotherapy. With mean follow-up of 21.3 months, no relapses occurred. The authors conclude LRPLND is feasible and effective, but larger series with longer follow-up are needed.

pmid-9519836.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍39例と対照12例の組織を対象に、サイトメガロウイルス、EBV、パルボウイルスB19のDNAをPCRで検査した研究である。CMVとEBVは検出されず、B19 DNAは腫瘍の85%で検出され正常組織では検出されなかった。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生への関与が示唆されている。
pmid-9519836.summary_en: The authors tested testicular tissue from 39 germ cell tumor patients and 12 controls for cytomegalovirus, Epstein-Barr virus, and parvovirus B19 DNA by PCR. Neither CMV nor EBV was detected. Parvovirus B19 DNA was found in 33 of 39 tumors (85%) and in none of the normal testicular samples. Most patients had B19-specific IgG, while acute infection was excluded in nearly all. The authors suggest parvovirus B19 may contribute to testicular germ cell tumor development or have tropism for tumor cells.

pmid-9519871.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍を含む300例以上の腫瘍について、テロメラーゼRNA遺伝子の発現をin situハイブリダイゼーションで解析した研究である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍の73%でhTRが検出された一方、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍や精巣奇形腫の分化成分では発現がみられなかった。腫瘍の種類によって発現パターンが異なり、がん治療標的としての示唆が得られている。
pmid-9519871.summary_en: The authors used RNA in situ hybridization to examine telomerase RNA (hTR) expression in more than 300 tumors, including germ cell and epithelial tumors. hTR was detected in 73% of testicular germ cell tumors (seminomas and teratomas), consistent with normal testicular germ cells. Differentiated components of ovarian germ cell tumors and testicular teratomas lacked hTR expression. Epithelial tumors showed distinct, tumor-type-specific patterns. The results suggest different tumor types regulate telomerase differently, with implications for targeting hTR in cancer therapy.

pmid-9520940.summary_ja: 本研究は、母性刷り込み遺伝子であるp57KIP2の発現を、正常初期胎盤と妊娠性絨毛性疾患で免疫組織化学的に検討した。完全奇胎および妊娠性絨毛癌ではp57KIP2の発現が低下または消失していた一方、部分奇胎や自然流産では正常胎盤と同程度であった。雄性発生由来の異常な栄養膜増殖に細胞周期抑制因子の喪失が関与すること、また診断の補助マーカーとなりうることが示唆された。
pmid-9520940.summary_en: This study examined p57KIP2, a maternally imprinted cyclin-dependent kinase inhibitor, by immunohistochemistry in first-trimester normal placentas and in gestational trophoblastic disease. p57KIP2 was present in normal extravillous and cytotrophoblast but absent in syncytiotrophoblast. Its expression was absent or low in all diploid and tetraploid complete moles and in three gestational choriocarcinomas, whereas spontaneous abortions and triploid partial moles retained normal levels. The findings suggest that loss of imprinted cell-cycle inhibitors contributes to androgenetic trophoblastic proliferation and that p57KIP2 staining may aid diagnosis in difficult cases.

pmid-9521397.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣類皮嚢腫（良性嚢胞性奇形腫）に対する腹腔鏡下類皮嚢腫摘出術18例を報告している。内容物の漏出や化学性腹膜炎のリスクから安全性が懸念されてきたが、検体の腹腔外への回収に関する推奨事項を示し、文献検討と合わせて腹腔鏡手術の安全性を確認した。良性卵巣奇形腫に対して、開腹術に代わる選択肢として腹腔鏡手術を支持する内容である。
pmid-9521397.summary_en: This study reports 18 cases of laparoscopic cystectomy for ovarian dermoid cysts, which are benign cystic teratomas, a procedure whose safety has been questioned because of the risk of cyst content spillage and chemical peritonitis. The authors describe recommendations for removing the specimen from the peritoneal cavity. Combined with a review of the literature, they conclude that laparoscopic treatment of ovarian dermoid cysts is safe. The paper supports laparoscopy as an acceptable alternative to laparotomy for benign ovarian teratomas.

pmid-9524557.summary_ja: 本総説は、思春期以降の若年成人でピークを示す精巣胚細胞腫瘍、停留精巣や性腺異形成との関連、先進国での発生率上昇について疫学的・生物学的な疑問を検討しています。上皮内がん細胞は幹細胞能を持つ原始生殖細胞に由来し、それが非セミノーマの発生を説明すると提案しています。セミノーマは幹細胞能の乏しい胚細胞腫とみなされます。セルトリ細胞とライディッヒ細胞の活動が進行に影響する可能性があります。著者らは、男性生殖機能の同時期の低下に環境内分泌撹乱物質が寄与しているかを論じています。
pmid-9524557.summary_en: This review examines epidemiological and biological questions about testicular germ cell cancer, including its peak in young adults after puberty, its association with undescended testis and gonadal dysgenesis, and its rising incidence in developed countries. It proposes that carcinoma in situ cells derive from gonocytes with stem cell potential, explaining the development of non-seminoma, and that seminoma represents a gonocytoma with little stem cell potential. Sertoli and Leydig cell activity may influence progression. The authors discuss whether environmental endocrine disruptors contribute to the concurrent decline in male reproductive health.

pmid-9524558.summary_ja: 1998年に発表された本研究は、片側の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する1,954例に対し対側精巣生検を実施しました。精巣上皮内腫瘍(TIN)は4.9%で認められ、萎縮精巣では4.3倍のリスクでした。症例の約60%は見た目に正常な精巣で発生しました。局所放射線療法(18~20Gy)はTINを根絶しましたが、約4分の1の患者に持続的なテストステロン欠乏を引き起こしました。化学療法はTINに対して安全ではないとされました。著者らは、TINのスクリーニングが早期発見と保存的管理への道であると結論づけています。
pmid-9524558.summary_en: This 1998 study screened 1,954 men with unilateral testicular germ cell tumours by contralateral testicular biopsy. Testicular intraepithelial neoplasia (TIN) was found in 4.9%, with a 4.3-fold higher risk in atrophic testes, and about 60% of cases occurred in normal-looking testes. Local radiotherapy (18-20 Gy) eradicated TIN but caused lasting testosterone deficiency in about a quarter of patients, while chemotherapy was unsafe for TIN. The authors conclude that TIN screening offers a route to early detection and conservative management.

pmid-9524564.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な6番と11番染色体の転座について、切断点を11q13バンド内に局在化した。ファージライブラリーを構築し、6つの候補遺伝子を同定した。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の原因遺伝子の単離に向けた初期段階の研究である。
pmid-9524564.summary_en: The authors previously described a subgroup of malignant extragonadal germ cell tumours carrying complex translocations between chromosomes 6 and 11. Here they used fluorescence in situ hybridization, pulsed-field gel electrophoresis and direct visual hybridization to localize the tumour-associated breakpoint to band 11q13. They also built a phage library enriched for this region to support genomic walking toward the breakpoint. Breakpoint-flanking contigs were generated, and six candidate genes were identified within them. The study is an early step toward isolating a gene implicated in extragonadal germ cell tumour biology.

pmid-9524565.summary_ja: 本総説は、成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的基盤を検討しています。これらの腫瘍は、増殖が限られた運命の胚細胞に由来するにもかかわらず、無制限の増殖と胚発生様の分化を獲得する必要があります。著者らは、上皮内がん/精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の段階から見られる12p増幅が、サイクリンD2を脱制御し、減数分裂の太糸期に細胞周期を再開させると提案しています。また、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍は、誤って配置された原始生殖細胞ではなく、形質転換した性腺の胚細胞の移動によって生じると提案しています。これらの仮説は検証可能なモデルとして提示されています。
pmid-9524565.summary_en: This review examines the cytogenetic basis of adult male germ cell tumours, which must acquire unlimited proliferation and embryonal differentiation despite arising from germ cells destined for limited proliferation. The authors propose that 12p amplification, present as early as carcinoma in situ/intratubular germ cell neoplasia, deregulates cyclin D2 and reinitiates the cell cycle during meiotic pachytene. They also propose that primary mediastinal germ cell tumours arise from migration of transformed gonadal germ cells rather than from misplaced primordial germ cells. These hypotheses are offered as testable models.

pmid-9524566.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍ではp53遺伝子変異は3%未満とまれであるが、p53タンパクは高発現している。p53標的遺伝子の発現は上昇しておらず、転写因子としての機能が乏しいと考えられる。野生型p53の高発現が化学感受性に寄与する可能性を示した。
pmid-9524566.summary_en: Unlike common solid tumours, germ cell tumours rarely carry p53 mutations (under 3%), even though p53 protein is abundantly expressed. P53-regulated genes are not correspondingly overexpressed, suggesting that p53 functions poorly as a transcription factor in these tumours. The authors propose that high levels of wild-type p53 may contribute to the chemosensitivity of germ cell tumours. This short review summarizes the paradox of abundant but apparently inactive p53 in germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-9524567.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍151例を解析し、p53は94%で過剰発現したが変異は認めなかった。bcl-2は9.3%でのみ発現し、主に奇形腫成分の腺・間質に限られた。成熟奇形腫の放射線・化学療法抵抗性の一因として、bcl-2とp53の発現パターンが示唆された。
pmid-9524567.summary_en: The authors examined p53 and bcl-2 in 151 clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours, 52 carcinoma in situ lesions, and 10 normal testes. p53 overexpression was found in 94% of tumours but no p53 missense mutations or deletions were detected by PCR-SSCP. Bcl-2 was expressed in only 9.3% of tumours, mainly in glandular and stromal elements of teratomatous components. Mature teratomas showed lower p53 expression, and the authors suggest bcl-2 overexpression and p53 underexpression may explain their radiation and chemotherapy resistance.

pmid-9524571.summary_ja: 本総説は、マウス胚において原始生殖細胞(PGC)が出現し、正常な生殖能力のために数を増やして性腺に到達する過程を説明しています。マウスの不妊変異により、PGC発生を調節する遺伝子が同定され、一部はクローニングされています。特定の系統のマウスでは、PGC由来の奇形腫と奇形癌の発生と分化に影響する変異が見つかっています。著者らは、これらの研究が増殖因子のPGC発生および胚細胞由来腫瘍(精巣がんを含む)における役割を明らかにすると示唆しています。
pmid-9524571.summary_en: This review describes how primordial germ cells (PGCs) arise in the mouse embryo and must increase in number and reach the gonad for normal fertility. Mouse sterility mutations have identified genes that regulate PGC development, and some have been cloned. Mutations affecting the development and differentiation of PGC-derived teratomas and teratocarcinomas have also been identified in certain mouse strains, pointing to genes involved in normal PGC growth. The authors suggest these studies will clarify growth factor roles in PGC development and in germ-cell-derived tumours, including testicular cancer.

pmid-9524574.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の組織発生と、胎児性癌（EC）細胞の分化機構を総説した。多能性EC細胞株NTERA2の神経分化で働くwnt遺伝子とFrizzled遺伝子群の関与を示した。
pmid-9524574.summary_en: This review examines the histogenesis of germ cell tumours and the differentiation of embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells into embryonic and extraembryonic lineages. The authors focus on the pluripotent human EC line NTERA2, which differentiates into neurones in response to retinoic acid, HMBA and bone morphogenetic proteins. They describe a novel human wnt gene activated during retinoic acid-induced differentiation and later downregulated, along with Frizzled family genes. The authors propose that these pathways modulate how pluripotent EC cells differentiate.

pmid-9524575.summary_ja: CD30は胎児性癌細胞やセミノーマの一部に発現し、そのリガンドCD30Lは卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株で高発現していた。CD30は分化に伴い低下した。自己分泌的な制御を介して胚細胞腫瘍の幹細胞を調節する可能性を示した。
pmid-9524575.summary_en: CD30 is a TNF receptor family member expressed in human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells, in foci of some seminomas, and in immune cells. Its ligand, CD30L, is highest in yolk sac carcinoma cell lines and also present in EC. CD30 expression falls as EC stem cells differentiate in vitro. Exogenous CD30L did not affect multipotent stem cell growth, but the authors suggest the receptor-ligand pair may act in autocrine regulation of EC stem cells. They propose CD30 and CD30L as candidate stem cell identity factors.

pmid-9524576.summary_ja: ヒトとマウスの自然発生的精巣胚細胞腫瘍は、全能性原始生殖細胞に由来するため多様な細胞型で構成されます。著者らは、Ter変異を用いて129/Svマウスの感受性の遺伝解析を単純化しています。Terは腫瘍発生率を、野生型雄の約1%から、Ter/+雄の約17%、Ter/Ter雄の約94%へと高める修飾因子として作用します。Terは129/Sv由来の感受性遺伝子の一部を必要とします。本総説は、片側性腫瘍と両側性腫瘍が異なる遺伝経路で生じるという証拠も示しています。
pmid-9524576.summary_en: Spontaneous testicular germ cell tumours in humans and mice are composed of diverse cell and tissue types, reflecting origin from totipotent primordial germ cells. The authors use the Ter mutation in 129/Sv mice to simplify genetic analysis of susceptibility. Ter raises tumour incidence from about 1% in wild-type males to about 17% in Ter/+ males and about 94% in Ter/Ter males, acting as a modifier that requires some 129/Sv susceptibility genes. The review also provides evidence that different genetic pathways produce unilateral and bilateral tumours.

pmid-9524578.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍におけるゲノムインプリンティングを論じた総説的な論文である。接合子の両親由来のインプリンティングパターンが消去され、精子形成の過程で父性パターンが確立される機構を、精巣がんをモデルとして検討する意義を提唱している。あわせてX染色体不活性化に関するデータも示している。
pmid-9524578.summary_en: This review discusses genomic imprinting in testicular germ cell tumours. Imprinting, the parent-of-origin-specific expression of genes, is established during gametogenesis. The authors propose testicular cancers, particularly those of germ cell origin, as a model for studying how the biparental imprinting pattern of the zygote is erased and the paternal pattern is established during spermatogenesis. They also present data on X-inactivation in these tumours. The work is a conceptual discussion with supporting data rather than a clinical study.

pmid-9524579.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の発生は、胎児期や乳児期早期における原始胚細胞や胚細胞の発生停止に起因するという仮説を提唱している。性腺発生異常や不妊症などでリスクが高く、環境因子が遺伝的素因のある個人に作用すると考えられる。上皮内癌細胞の表現型の多様性が、その発生段階に応じて異なる腫瘍型をもたらす可能性についても論じている。
pmid-9524579.summary_en: This review proposes that germ cell neoplasia originates from developmental arrest of primordial germ cells or gonocytes during fetal or early postnatal life. Risk is elevated in disorders of gonadal development, trisomy 21, infertility and low birth weight, and environmental factors may act on genetically predisposed individuals. The authors suggest that phenotypically heterogeneous carcinoma in situ cells may give rise to different tumour types depending on their developmental stage. Comparisons with primordial germ cells and embryonal carcinoma cells are discussed.

pmid-9524580.summary_ja: 思春期および成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を検出するため、血小板由来増殖因子α受容体の1.5kb転写産物を標的としたRT-PCR法を報告する。精巣摘出標本31例のスルーカット生検で評価し、成熟奇形腫を除く上皮内癌と浸潤性腫瘍を検出した。感度0.87、特異度1.00であり、不要な精巣摘出の回避に役立つ分子マーカーとして有用性を結論づけている。
pmid-9524580.summary_en: This study describes a highly sensitive RT-PCR assay targeting the 1.5 kb transcript of the platelet-derived growth factor alpha receptor for detecting adolescent and adult testicular germ cell tumours. Tested on through-cut biopsies from 31 orchidectomy specimens, the assay detected carcinoma in situ and invasive tumours, except mature teratoma. It showed a sensitivity of 0.87 and a specificity of 1.00. The authors conclude it is a useful molecular marker that may help avoid unnecessary orchidectomies.

pmid-9524581.summary_ja: 卵巣・精巣の胚細胞腫瘍、その前駆病変、性腺異形成、絨毛性病変において、HERV-K配列の発現をin situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した。奇形腫と精母細胞性セミノーマを除く多くの胚細胞腫瘍と精巣の上皮内癌でHERV-K転写産物が検出された。絨毛癌では発現がみられたが、胞状奇胎では認められなかった。HERV-K産物は診断とモニタリングのマーカーとして有用と考えられる。
pmid-9524581.summary_en: This study examines expression of human endogenous retrovirus HERV-K sequences by in situ hybridization in ovarian and testicular germ cell tumours, their precursors, dysgenetic gonads, and gestational trophoblastic lesions. HERV-K transcripts were found in most germ cell tumours, except teratomas and spermatocytic seminomas, and in testicular carcinoma in situ. Among trophoblastic lesions, expression was seen in choriocarcinomas but not molar lesions. The authors suggest a shared molecular pathogenesis and propose HERV-K products as potential diagnostic and monitoring markers.

pmid-9524582.summary_ja: 第4回コペンハーゲン・ワークショップにおける上皮内癌と精巣がんに関する総合討論をまとめたものである。原始胚細胞と、ヒト精巣胚細胞腫瘍の上皮内癌（CIS）幹細胞の類似点と相違点が議論された。単離されたCIS細胞はアポトーシスで死滅し、子宮内因子によって形成される可能性が示された。CIS細胞の本質は依然として不明である。
pmid-9524582.summary_en: This report summarizes a general discussion from the 4th Copenhagen Workshop on carcinoma in situ and testicular cancer. Participants compared primordial germ cells with the carcinoma in situ stem cells of human testicular germ cell tumours. Key points include that isolated CIS cells die by apoptosis, survive only within seminiferous tubules, and likely arise from in utero factors. A mouse model using grafted genital ridges may help clarify CIS biology. The true nature of CIS cells remains unresolved.

pmid-9524583.summary_ja: バルト海周辺の9か国のがん登録データを用いた集団ベースの研究である。精巣がんの症例は計34,309例であった。年齢調整発生率は国によって約10倍の差があった。診断年よりも出生コホートがリスクをより強く規定することが示され、病因となる環境曝露は子宮内を含む早期の人生で作用すると結論づけている。
pmid-9524583.summary_en: This population-based study uses data from nine Baltic Sea-area cancer registries, including 34,309 testicular cancer cases, to analyse incidence trends. Age-standardised incidence varied about tenfold among countries, from 0.8 to 7.6 per 100,000 person-years. Analyses of six countries with long registration periods show that birth cohort is a stronger determinant of risk than year of diagnosis. The authors conclude that the causal environmental exposures act early in life, possibly in utero.

pmid-9525018.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫に腹膜神経膠腫症を伴った2症例を報告する。腹膜神経膠腫症は成熟グリア組織の結節からなる稀な病態である。1例では初回手術後14週間で奇形腫性播種が急速に進行した。多くは良性とされるが、未熟成分の有無を確認するため広範な組織採取が不可欠であり、未熟成分は予後不良を示し積極的治療が必要となりうると述べている。
pmid-9525018.summary_en: This report describes two patients with immature ovarian teratoma associated with gliomatosis peritonei, a rare peritoneal condition composed mainly of mature glial nodules. In one patient, teratomatous peritoneal implants progressed rapidly within 14 weeks of initial surgery. Although gliomatosis peritonei is usually considered benign, the authors emphasise that peritoneal implants of suspected teratomatous origin require thorough sampling to exclude immature elements, which indicate a poorer prognosis and may need aggressive treatment.

pmid-9525723.summary_ja: 副鼻腔奇形癌肉腫は、癌肉腫と奇形腫の特徴を併せ持つ稀な悪性腫瘍である。本症例は鼻腔に発生し、頭蓋内へ大きく進展して意識混濁を初発症状とした。根治的手術と放射線療法の併用治療後、31か月間無病で経過した。外科的アプローチ、組織学的所見、臨床経過を詳述している。
pmid-9525723.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma, a rare malignancy combining carcinosarcoma and teratoma features. The tumour arose in the nasal cavity but extended massively into the cranial cavity, causing confusion as the initial symptom. The patient underwent combined radical surgery and radiation therapy and remained disease-free for 31 months. The paper details the surgical approach, histological features and clinical course.

pmid-9525725.summary_ja: 43歳男性の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。小脳転移と精巣腫瘍を認め、両者に奇形癌、胎児性癌、絨毛癌の成分があった。小脳腫瘍を先に手術で切除し、その後ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を行った結果、肺病変は消失し無病生存を得た。大きな脳転移では手術先行が有用と著者らは考察している。
pmid-9525725.summary_en: This case report describes a 43-year-old man with disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who presented with a large cerebellar metastasis alongside a testicular tumor and lung lesions. Both the brain and testicular tumors contained teratocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma elements. Surgical resection of the cerebellar tumor was performed before chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Afterward the lung lesions resolved and the patient remained cancer-free. The authors argue that surgery before radiotherapy and chemotherapy may improve outcomes for large brain metastases from NSGCT.

pmid-9525839.summary_ja: 未熟卵巣奇形腫(病理病期Ia期)と診断された女性の症例報告。診断直後から神経精神症状が出現し、辺縁系の機能障害を示した。未熟卵巣奇形腫に伴う傍腫瘍性辺縁系脳炎の初報告である。極めて小さな悪性の卵巣腫瘍の初発症状として神経精神症状が現れうるため、原疾患の積極的な検索が重要と著者らは述べている。
pmid-9525839.summary_en: This case report describes a patient whose paraneoplastic limbic encephalitis preceded diagnosis of a small, stage Ia immature ovarian teratoma. Neuropsychiatric symptoms developed within a month of the tumor diagnosis and reflected a purely limbic disorder affecting nearly all limbic functions. The authors describe this as the first reported case of limbic encephalitis associated with an immature ovarian teratoma. They emphasize that neuropsychiatric symptoms may be the first sign of a very small malignant ovarian tumor and should prompt an active search for an underlying cancer.

pmid-9526709.summary_ja: 卵巣の嚢胞性奇形腫由来の甲状腺乳頭癌(悪性卵巣甲状腺腫)の症例報告。甲状腺症状はなかったが、抗甲状腺抗体陽性から橋本病と診断された。嚢胞性奇形腫由来の腺癌は稀で、甲状腺由来のものは報告が少ない。甲状腺の自己免疫疾患が卵巣甲状腺腫由来の悪性腫瘍と併存し、その診断を複雑にしうることを示す。
pmid-9526709.summary_en: This report describes a patient with papillary thyroid carcinoma arising in a cystic ovarian teratoma, known as malignant struma ovarii. The patient had no thyroid symptoms, but antimicrosomal and antithyroglobulin antibodies led to a diagnosis of Hashimoto's disease. The authors note that adenocarcinomas arising in cystic teratomas are rare, and that thyroid-origin carcinomas have been reported in only a few cases. The case shows how thyroid autoimmunity may coexist with a struma ovarii-derived malignancy and complicate its recognition.

pmid-9528345.summary_ja: 39歳男性の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)の症例報告。左精巣上極近傍に、精巣網へパジェット様に進展した腫瘤様病変を認めた。周囲にはセミノーマの結節も存在した。病変細胞は明るい細胞質にグリコーゲンを含み、胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼが陽性であった。この腫瘤様形成を伴うパジェット様進展は、報告された初めての症例とされる。
pmid-9528345.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN) that spread in a pagetoid pattern into the rete testis, forming a tumor-like mass near the upper pole of the left testis. Nearby seminoma nodules were also present. The lesion consisted of large polygonal cells with clear, glycogen-rich cytoplasm that were positive for placental alkaline phosphatase, and nuclei with less coarse chromatin than seminoma. The authors consider this the first documented case of a tumor-like mass formed by pagetoid rete testis spread.

pmid-9529027.summary_ja: 1979～1995年に化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤の切除を受けた113例を後方視的に検討。成熟奇形腫は手術検体の45.1%(51例)に認められた。このうち9例が再発し、成熟奇形腫の増大、非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍の二次発症、胚細胞悪性腫瘍の再発が見られた。著者らは長期フォローアップの必要性と、再発に対する完全外科的切除の重要性を結論づけている。
pmid-9529027.summary_en: This retrospective review examined 113 patients who underwent laparotomy for resection of retroperitoneal residual tumor masses after chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor between 1979 and 1995. Mature teratoma was found in 45.1% of resections. Nine of the 51 patients with mature teratoma relapsed, from growing mature teratoma, secondary non-germ cell malignancy, or recurrent germ cell malignancy, and all were treated primarily with surgical excision. The authors call for long-term follow-up and complete surgical excision of recurrences.

pmid-9530347.summary_ja: 9歳女児の未熟卵巣奇形腫を短期培養して細胞遺伝学的解析を行った症例報告である。唯一のクローン性異常として3番染色体のトリソミーが確認された。過去に卵巣胚細胞腫瘍2例でも同じ変化が唯一の核型異常として報告されていることから、3番染色体の獲得が女性胚細胞腫瘍の一部における初期の病態発生上重要な変化である可能性を提案している。
pmid-9530347.summary_en: This case report describes cytogenetic analysis of short-term cultured cells from an immature ovarian teratoma in a 9-year-old girl. The only clonal abnormality identified was an extra copy of chromosome 3, i.e., trisomy 3. The authors note that trisomy 3 has previously been reported as the sole karyotypic change in two other ovarian germ cell tumors, one teratoma NOS and one immature teratoma. They propose that gain of chromosome 3 may be an early and pathogenetically important event in a subset of female germ cell tumors.

pmid-9533752.summary_ja: 小児の胚細胞腫瘍について、病理診断の観点から概説した総説である。腫瘍の発生部位や年齢に応じた肉眼的検索と検体処理の違いを解説している。免疫組織化学や細胞遺伝学などの特殊検査、小さな生検や穿刺吸引検体の扱いにも触れる。さらに、部位別の病期分類と未熟奇形腫の最新の悪性度分類を紹介している。小児と成人では腫瘍の性質が異なる点も強調されている。
pmid-9533752.summary_en: This review from the American Journal of Clinical Pathology summarizes pathologic evaluation of germ cell tumors in children. It explains how gross examination and specimen processing should differ by tumor site and patient age. It outlines useful special studies, including immunohistochemistry and cytogenetics, along with methods for small biopsies and fine-needle aspirates. The article also reviews site-based staging under Pediatric Oncology Group and Children's Cancer Study Group protocols and the latest grading system for immature teratomas.

pmid-9534214.summary_ja: 15歳女児の純粋未熟卵巣奇形腫の症例である。5コースの化学療法を受けたにもかかわらず、初診から15か月で再発した。血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は再発時に上昇しなかったが、免疫組織化学では内胚葉成分にAFPが残存していた。未熟神経組織は再発時に消失しており、化学療法の影響が示唆される。血清AFP値は臨床経過やAFP免疫染色所見と一致しなかったと結論している。
pmid-9534214.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old girl with a pure immature ovarian teratoma who developed recurrence 15 months after diagnosis despite five chemotherapy courses. Serum AFP was elevated at diagnosis and normalized after surgery, but did not rise at recurrence. Immunohistochemistry showed AFP persisted only in immature endodermal elements, and immature neural tissue had disappeared at recurrence, possibly due to chemotherapy. The authors conclude that serum AFP did not correlate with either clinical behavior or immunohistochemical AFP expression in the recurrent tumor.

pmid-9535605.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者19例(セミノーマ8例、非セミノーマ11例)を対象とした後方視的研究で、化学療法に対する不良な組織学的奏効の予測因子を検討した。残存腫瘍の切除を受けた16例では、少なくとも80%縮小した病変の多くで完全壊死が認められた一方、縮小が小さい病変では奇形腫や癌の残存が多く見られた。正常上限の100倍を超える初期hCG-βレベルと腫瘍マーカーの緩徐な低下は、いずれも不良な奏効を予測した。著者らは、これらの因子が、より早期でより積極的な治療の判断に役立つ可能性があると示唆している。
pmid-9535605.summary_en: This retrospective study of 19 patients with metastatic testicular germ cell tumors (8 seminomas, 11 nonseminomas) examined factors predicting poor histologic response to chemotherapy. Among 16 patients who underwent residual tumor resection, complete necrosis was seen in most lesions that shrank by at least 80%, whereas persistent teratoma or cancer was common in lesions with smaller reductions. An initial hCG-beta level over 100 times the upper limit of normal and slow tumor marker decline both predicted poor response. The authors suggest these factors could guide earlier, more aggressive treatment.

pmid-9537212.summary_ja: インドの単施設で10年間に治療された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍37例の解析である。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍は性腺由来の腫瘍と生物学的に異なると述べている。原発は縦隔が18例と最も多く、中枢神経系、仙尾部、後腹膜などがこれに続く。縦隔例の13例は無病生存していたが、他部位の成績は不良であった。全体の5年生存率は40%で、組織型と腫瘍マーカー高値が予後因子であった。
pmid-9537212.summary_en: This 10-year single-center study from India reviewed 37 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with combined modality therapy. Mediastinal tumors were most common (18 patients), followed by central nervous system, sacrococcygeal, retroperitoneal, and other sites. Thirteen of the 18 mediastinal patients remained alive without evidence of disease at a median follow-up of 16 months, whereas outcomes at other sites were poorer. The overall five-year survival rate was 40%. Histologic subtype and elevated tumor markers were significant prognostic factors on univariate analysis.

pmid-9537215.summary_ja: 32歳女性の原発性悪性甲状腺奇形腫の症例報告である。成人では予後不良とされる稀な疾患である。甲状腺葉切除後に他部位の腫瘍は認められなかった。シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる6コースの化学療法で完全奏効が得られ、6.5年間無病で経過した。甲状腺腫瘍の鑑別診断に本腫瘍を含め、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に準じた化学療法を考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-9537215.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old woman with a primary malignant teratoma of the thyroid, a rare adult tumor with poor prognosis. After thyroid lobectomy, no tumor was found elsewhere on examination or imaging. She received six courses of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin chemotherapy, achieving complete response and remaining disease-free for 6.5 years. The authors recommend including this tumor in the differential diagnosis of thyroid neoplasms and considering treatment similar to testicular germ cell tumors, with chemotherapy recommended.

pmid-9537572.summary_ja: 極めてまれな奇形腫であるエピグナトスの巨大例を報告する。本疾患は口蓋または咽頭から発生し、新生児期には重篤な気道閉塞をきたすため死亡率が高い。そのため出生前からの周到な計画と、出生直後の迅速な外科的治療が必要とされる。本症例では巨大病変の切除に成功し、術後の経過は順調で良好に回復した。
