pmid-8618293.summary_ja: 化学療法を受けていない低病期の非セミノーマ精巣がん患者を後方視的に解析し、精巣摘除術標本中の奇形腫成分が後腹膜奇形腫を予測することを示した。低病期非セミノーマの治療方針の決定では、過剰な治療（二重治療）を減らすため、この病理所見を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-8618293.summary_en: This retrospective study examined patients with clinical stage A, B, or B2 nonseminomatous testicular cancer who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection without prior chemotherapy. The authors asked whether teratomatous elements in the orchiectomy specimen predict teratoma in the retroperitoneum. They found that teratomatous elements in the orchiectomy specimen do predict retroperitoneal teratoma. They conclude that orchiectomy pathology should be considered when choosing treatment for low-stage nonseminoma, so that unnecessary double therapy can be minimized.

pmid-8618397.summary_ja: 米国海軍医療センターで、シスプラチン併用療法により治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を15年間にわたりレビューし、治療成績と治療失敗例を検討した。若年男性に多い精巣がんについて、治療の成功率と失敗の要因を評価した研究である。
pmid-8618397.summary_en: This 15-year review from the National Naval Medical Center examined patients treated for germ cell testis cancer, the most common solid tumor in men aged 20 to 35. The center has used cisplatin-based protocols since their introduction. The study reviews treatment success in these patients and examines cases of treatment failure. The article highlights the clinical importance of this disease for physicians who care for young adults, including military personnel in the high-risk age group.

pmid-8618400.summary_ja: 化学療法後のセカンドルック手術の意義を、卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍40例の後方視的解析で検討した。腫瘍マーカー高値例や、画像異常および奇形腫成分のない例では手術は不要であり、奇形腫成分があり画像異常が残存し、腫瘍マーカーが正常な例に限って実施を推奨すると結論づけている。
pmid-8618400.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 40 patients with ovarian malignant germ cell tumors who received various chemotherapy regimens after primary surgery, with a median follow-up of 8 years. Twenty-two underwent second-look laparotomy. Second-look surgery was not needed in patients with elevated tumor markers or without radiologic abnormalities and teratoma components in the primary tumor. The authors recommend second-look surgery only for patients with a teratoma component in the primary tumor, persistent imaging abnormalities, and normal tumor markers after chemotherapy.

pmid-8620450.summary_ja: 自然発生の精巣奇形腫を生じる129/Sv-Sl/+マウスを用いて、奇形腫幹細胞が胚細胞核抗原GCNA1を保持するかを免疫組織化学により検討した。受精後16.5日の初期奇形腫巣はGCNA1を強く発現していたが、19.5日までに発現が低下した。出生後の奇形腫細胞では発現が認められなかった。これらの所見は、精巣奇形腫が胚細胞に由来するという説を支持する。著者らは、GCNA1が初期の胚性腫瘍巣の同定に有用である可能性も示唆している。
pmid-8620450.summary_en: This immunohistochemistry study used 129/Sv-Sl/+ mice, which develop spontaneous testicular teratomas, to examine whether teratoma stem cells retain the germ cell nuclear antigen GCNA1. Early teratoma foci at 16.5 days post coitum strongly expressed GCNA1, but expression declined by 19.5 days. Postnatal teratoma cells did not express it. The findings support a germ cell origin for testicular teratomas. The authors also suggest that GCNA1 could help identify early embryonic tumor foci.

pmid-8621221.summary_ja: シスプラチン感受性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍細胞株と耐性の膀胱がん細胞株を細胞融合させ、シスプラチン感受性の遺伝的基盤を検討した。融合細胞では耐性が不完全優性に伝わることが示され、化学療法感受性を制御する遺伝子の同定には発現クローニングが有用と結論づけている。
pmid-8621221.summary_en: This study tested whether cisplatin sensitivity in testicular germ cell tumor cells has a genetic basis, using somatic cell fusion. Cisplatin-sensitive testis tumor lines and cisplatin-resistant bladder cancer lines were fused with a sensitive reference line. Hybrids between sensitive lines were more resistant than their parents, and hybrids with resistant cells were intermediate. Resistance was therefore incompletely dominant. The authors conclude that cisplatin sensitivity is genetically determined and suggest that expression cloning could identify the genes involved.

pmid-8622082.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に残存腫瘤を有する30例を対象に、外科的切除前の陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の有用性を検討した。生存腫瘍はSUVが有意に高く（中央値8.81）、壊死・線維化や奇形腫との鑑別に有用だった。化学療法後切除の判断を補助しうると結論づけている。
pmid-8622082.summary_en: This study assessed whether FDG-PET can distinguish viable germ cell tumor from necrosis/fibrosis or teratoma in 30 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who had residual masses after chemotherapy and underwent PET before surgical resection. Viable tumor showed markedly higher standardized uptake values (median 8.81) than necrosis/fibrosis (2.86) or teratoma (3.07), while PET could not separate necrosis from teratoma. The authors conclude that PET can help identify residual viable carcinoma and guide decisions about postchemotherapy resection.

pmid-8623080.summary_ja: 1978～1992年に単施設で治療した精巣セミノーマ230例の後方視的解析である。術後放射線療法の10年全生存率は96.5%、病期Iの無病生存率は96.8%だった。病期IIBでは76.9%と低かった。副作用は軽微で、病期I、IIA、IIBでは放射線療法単独で良好な制御が得られると結論づけている。
pmid-8623080.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated postoperative radiotherapy in 230 men with pure testicular seminoma, mostly stage I, treated at one institution from 1978 to 1992. Ten-year overall survival was 96.5 percent, and disease-free survival for stage I was 96.8 percent, with lower control in stage IIB (76.9 percent). Recurrences and contralateral testicular tumors occurred in a small number of patients, and side effects were mild. The authors conclude that radiotherapy alone gives excellent control for stage I, IIA and IIB.

pmid-8623764.summary_ja: 非触知性の卵巣類皮嚢腫に伴う自己免疫性溶血性貧血の症例報告である。腫瘍摘出後に貧血は改善した。嚢胞内容液にも組織にも抗体や免疫グロブリンは確認されず、交差反応や嚢胞内での抗体産生という仮説は支持されなかった。自己免疫性溶血性貧血の女性では、画像診断による卵巣類皮嚢腫の検索を広く行うべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-8623764.summary_en: This case report describes a woman with autoimmune hemolytic anemia caused by a nonpalpable ovarian dermoid cyst, which resolved after tumor excision. The red cell autoantibody was an IgG directed against the Rh complex. Cyst fluid contained no detectable red cell autoantibodies or immunoglobulins, and histology showed few lymphocytes and plasma cells, with no immunoglobulin deposits. These findings argue against cross-reactivity and intracystic antibody production as mechanisms, so the authors stress wider use of imaging to find dermoid cysts in women with autoimmune hemolytic anemia.

pmid-8624259.summary_ja: ヒトセミノーマ組織を単一細胞浮遊液に分散させると、アポトーシスが急速に誘導されることを示した研究である。無傷の組織では大部分の症例でアポトーシス細胞は少なかったが、細胞浮遊液ではDNAラダーと最大85%のDNA断裂が認められた。p53とbcl-2は発現していなかった。ヒトセミノーマ細胞の体外培養にはアポトーシスの抑制が鍵になると考察している。
pmid-8624259.summary_en: The authors investigated whether mechanical dissociation of human seminoma tissue into single-cell suspensions triggers apoptosis, a major barrier to in vitro culture. Intact tumors showed few apoptotic cells in most cases, and DNA ladders were absent in 11 of 14 tumors. In contrast, all pure cell suspensions showed DNA ladders, and flow cytometry revealed DNA breaks in up to 85 percent of cells. p53 and bcl-2 were not expressed. Loss of the microenvironment appears to trigger rapid apoptosis, suggesting that blocking this pathway may be needed to culture seminoma cells.

pmid-8624900.summary_ja: 京都大学病院で治療した卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ12例の後方視的解析である。腹水細胞診は検査した10例中6例で陽性だった。腹腔内転移結節は12例中5例に認められ、多くは小さかった。腹腔内への漏出は従来の報告より多い可能性があり、早期病期でも術後化学療法の根拠になると述べている。
pmid-8624900.summary_en: This retrospective study of 12 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated at Kyoto University Hospital examined the pattern of intraperitoneal spread. Ascitic cytology was positive in 6 of 10 tested cases, and 5 of 12 patients had intraperitoneal metastatic nodules, most of them small. Extraovarian spread did not correlate with symptom duration, serum LDH, tumor size, or ascitic volume. The authors suggest that intraperitoneal spillage may be more common than reported, supporting ascitic cytology, careful surgical inspection, and postsurgical chemotherapy even for apparently early-stage disease.

pmid-8624983.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、既知の精巣がんを有する20歳男性が心房細動で受診した症例を記述している。検査で左房に浸潤する肺転移が判明した。報告では精巣腫瘍の転移による心臓病変に関する現在の文献をレビューしている。精巣がんの若年患者において心腔内腫瘤が不整脈として現れうること、そして転移性疾患の評価を行うべきであることを強調している。
pmid-8624983.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with known testicular carcinoma who presented with atrial fibrillation. Investigation revealed a pulmonary metastasis invading the left atrium. The report reviews the current literature on cardiac involvement by testicular tumor metastases. It highlights that intracardiac masses in young patients with testicular cancer can present as arrhythmia and should prompt evaluation for metastatic disease.

pmid-8625243.summary_ja: 腹腔内精巣腫瘍の捻転はまれではあるが、停留精巣の既往を有する急性腹症の患者では考慮すべき病態である。本論文は新たな症例を報告するとともに、既報36例を文献的に検討したものである。組織型はセミノーマが最も多く、補助放射線療法が多く施行されていた。術前のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)は手術計画に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-8625243.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes torsion of intraabdominal testicular tumors, a rare presentation. Thirty-six previously reported cases were analyzed for histologic type, presenting symptoms, imaging, and adjuvant therapy. Seminoma was the most common type, followed by sarcoma, teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and choriocarcinoma. Most seminoma patients received adjuvant radiation, while one choriocarcinoma patient received chemotherapy. The authors recommend considering torsion in patients with an acute abdomen and a history of cryptorchidism, and suggest preoperative CT to aid surgical planning.

pmid-8626100.summary_ja: 抵抗性妊娠性絨毛癌の2症例にタキソールを投与した報告である。前治療はEMACO療法および白金製剤を含む救援化学療法であった。両例で有意な反応がみられ、1例は脳と肝臓に再発して死亡した。もう1例はカルボプラチンとの併用で、開頭による脳病変の切除後に持続的な寛解を得た。化学療法抵抗性の妊娠性絨毛癌に対するタキソールの有用性が示唆される。
pmid-8626100.summary_en: Two women with resistant gestational choriocarcinoma, previously treated with EMACO and platinum-based salvage chemotherapy, received paclitaxel (Taxol). Both showed significant responses. One patient relapsed in the brain and liver and died. The other received paclitaxel combined with carboplatin and achieved sustained clinical and hormonal remission after craniotomy and resection of brain lesions. The report suggests paclitaxel may be an active agent for chemotherapy-resistant gestational choriocarcinoma, including cases with brain involvement.

pmid-8626104.summary_ja: 妊娠31週の32歳初産婦が、妊娠性絨毛癌の脳転移による大発作で発症した。化学療法により治療に成功し、母体と児はともに生存した。妊娠中に脳転移で発症し母子ともに救命された初めての報告とされる。治癒可能な疾患であるため、妊婦に非典型的な神経症状を認めた場合は転移性絨毛癌を念頭に置くべきである。
pmid-8626104.summary_en: A 32-year-old primigravida at 31 weeks of gestation presented with a grand mal seizure caused by cerebral metastases from gestational choriocarcinoma. She was successfully treated with chemotherapy, and both mother and child survived. The authors describe this as the first reported case of cerebral metastatic choriocarcinoma presenting during a viable pregnancy with survival of both. They emphasize that metastatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in pregnant women with unusual neurological symptoms, since the disease is potentially curable.

pmid-8627820.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学および分子遺伝学的所見をまとめた総説である。大多数の症例にみられるi(12p)等染色体が中心的な特徴とされる。i(12p)を欠く腫瘍では、マスキングや余分な12p配列が報告されている。異数性化に続くi(12p)形成という発生モデルを提示し、関与遺伝子の同定は今後の課題とされる。
pmid-8627820.summary_en: This review summarizes cytogenetic and molecular findings in testicular germ cell tumors, including the i(12p) isochromosome that characterizes most cases. Tumors lacking i(12p) may show masking of this abnormality or extra 12p sequences on FISH and molecular analyses. The authors present a hypothetical model in which aneuploidization precedes i(12p) formation, and discuss how these findings might inform clinical, pathological, and basic research. The underlying genes remain largely undefined.

pmid-8629416.summary_ja: 36歳女性の左卵巣に生じた80mmの嚢胞性病変の症例である。穿刺吸引細胞診では脈絡叢細胞様の良性細胞集塊がみられた。切除により、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)に隣接する上衣嚢胞と診断された。脳脊髄液の細胞診に不慣れな細胞検査士への注意喚起を目的としており、卵巣嚢胞性病変の診断上の落とし穴を示している。
pmid-8629416.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old woman with an 80-mm left ovarian cystic lesion. Fine needle aspiration yielded clusters and rosettes of benign cells resembling choroid plexus cells. Surgical resection revealed an ependymal cyst adjacent to a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst). The authors report this rare entity of ovarian ependymal cysts to alert cytologists unfamiliar with cerebrospinal fluid cytopathology. The case highlights diagnostic pitfalls when evaluating cystic ovarian lesions.

pmid-8630281.summary_ja: 妊娠性栄養膜腫瘍におけるp53遺伝子変異の有無を検討しました。胞状奇胎14例、侵入奇胎6例、絨毛癌8例、正常初期胎盤10例の計38検体で、エクソン5～8を直接シーケンスしましたが、変異は1例も認められませんでした。p53変異は稀か存在しないと考えられ、他の癌抑制遺伝子や異なる経路が関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-8630281.summary_en: This study examined whether mutations in the p53 tumour-suppressor gene occur in gestational trophoblastic tumours. Using amplification-based direct DNA sequencing, exons 5-8 were analysed in 14 hydatidiform moles, six invasive moles, eight choriocarcinomas, and ten normal early placentas. No mutations were detected in any of the 38 specimens. The authors conclude that p53 mutation is either absent or very rare in these tumours, suggesting that other tumour-suppressor genes or distinct pathways drive their malignant transformation.

pmid-8630961.summary_ja: 1981年から1994年に単施設でシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた性腺外胚細胞腫瘍51例を後方視的に検討しました。セミノーマ患者の無病生存率は94%と良好でした。非セミノーマでは、縦隔原発が後腹膜原発より予後不良でした。後腹膜腫瘍が精巣原発由来かどうかについても議論しています。
pmid-8630961.summary_en: This single-institution review analysed 51 adults with primary extragonadal germ cell tumors treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy between 1981 and 1994. Thirty-five had nonseminomas and 16 pure seminomas, arising in the mediastinum and retroperitoneum. Seminoma patients had excellent survival, with 94% disease-free. Mediastinal nonseminomas fared worse than retroperitoneal ones. The authors question whether retroperitoneal tumors arise from occult testicular primaries, given metachronous testicular seminomas in three patients.

pmid-8631581.summary_ja: 1935年から1992年のコネチカット州のがん登録データを用いた記述疫学研究です。精巣がんの年齢調整発生率は3.5倍に増加し、セミノーマと非セミノーマともに若年成人で上昇しました。コホート効果が強く示唆され、今後も増加が続く可能性があります。既存の仮説だけでは十分に説明できず、リスク因子の大規模研究が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-8631581.summary_en: This descriptive epidemiological study of Connecticut cancer registry data from 1935 to 1992 shows that the age-adjusted incidence of testicular cancer rose 3.5-fold. Seminoma and nonseminoma rates have risen since the mid-1950s, most markedly in men aged 20-44 for seminoma and 15-34 for nonseminoma. Age-period-cohort modelling suggested a period effect for early seminoma increases but a strong birth-cohort effect for later cohorts. The authors argue the rise will likely continue and that proposed hypotheses cannot fully explain it, urging large analytical studies.

pmid-8632558.summary_ja: 精巣摘除後に腫瘍マーカー上昇のみが認められた非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍20例に対し、初回化学療法の有効性を検討しています。16例はシスプラチン、4例はカルボプラチンによる治療を受けました。全例で腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、19例は無病生存を維持しました。後腹膜リンパ節郭清より化学療法が適切な選択肢と結論づけています。
pmid-8632558.summary_en: This study evaluated primary chemotherapy in 20 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors whose only evidence of disease after orchiectomy was elevated serum tumor markers. Most received cisplatin-based regimens, and tumor markers normalized in all patients. Nineteen of 20 remained disease-free for 18 to 116 months. The authors conclude that primary chemotherapy is a reasonable strategy in this biological-disease-only setting, rather than primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection.

pmid-8635143.summary_ja: 難治性または再発性の転移性胚細胞腫瘍54例に対し、シスプラチンとイホスファミドを基本とした救援VIP/VeIP療法を施行した報告です。完全寛解は44%で得られました。大量化学療法と造血幹細胞支持を併用した症例では無再発生存率が高い傾向を示しました。治癒率は約30%と推定され、無作為化試験による検証が必要とされています。
pmid-8635143.summary_en: This Institut Gustave Roussy series treated 54 patients with refractory or relapsing metastatic germ cell tumors using salvage VIP/VeIP chemotherapy, combining cisplatin and ifosfamide with etoposide or vinblastine. Complete remission was achieved in 44 percent. Among patients with response, eleven received high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support, and relapse-free survival was higher in them (63 versus 35 percent). The authors estimate a cure rate of about 30 percent and call for randomized confirmation.

pmid-8635871.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍のモデルであるヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2D1を用い、EGFファミリー遺伝子CRIPTOの機能を検討しています。CRIPTOを抑制すると増殖とコロニー形成が低下し、未分化マーカーSSEA-3の発現も減少しました。CRIPTOが胎児性癌細胞の形質転換と分化に関与すると結論づけています。
pmid-8635871.summary_en: This study examined CRIPTO, an EGF-family gene first isolated from the embryonal carcinoma line NT2D1. Antisense oligonucleotides and an antisense expression vector reduced endogenous CRIPTO in NT2D1 cells. This lowered monolayer growth, soft agar colony formation and expression of the SSEA-3 antigen, while retinoic acid still induced the A2B5 neuroectodermal antigen. The authors conclude that CRIPTO regulates transformation and differentiation in human embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-8635936.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣セミノーマ86例を対象に、精巣摘除後に傍大動脈リンパ節のみへ放射線療法を施行した成績を報告しています。同側骨盤リンパ節への照射は省略されました。10年無病生存率は95.3%、全生存率は100%でした。照射野外の再発は4例（4.7%）で認められました。照射線量は30Gy以下が推奨されています。
pmid-8635936.summary_en: This Würzburg study reviewed 86 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with orchiectomy followed by paraaortic-only radiotherapy, omitting ipsilateral pelvic irradiation. The 10-year disease-free survival was 95.3 percent and overall survival 100 percent. Relapses outside the treated field occurred in four patients, most often in the ipsilateral hemipelvis. The authors recommend reduced paraaortic target volumes, complete omission of pelvic irradiation and a dose not exceeding 30 Gy.

pmid-8636755.summary_ja: 血管侵襲を伴う臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の高リスク症例に、補助化学療法として2コースのPEB療法を行った前向き試験の長期成績です。解析対象は29例で、追跡期間中央値は79か月でした。再発は2例のみで、27例が無病生存しています。晩期合併症は監視療法群と有意差はなく、補助化学療法は有効かつ妥当な選択肢と結論づけられています。
pmid-8636755.summary_en: This prospective study gave two cycles of adjuvant PEB chemotherapy to 29 analyzable patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and blood-vessel invasion, a high relapse risk. Median follow-up was 79 months. Only two patients relapsed, and 27 of 29 were alive without disease. Late sequelae, including cardiovascular, pulmonary, fertility and psychosocial outcomes, did not differ from surveillance controls. The authors conclude that adjuvant PEB is effective and reasonable.

pmid-8636757.summary_ja: メモリアル・スローン・ケタリング癌センターの本研究は、シスプラチン併用化学療法に反応した進行性セミノーマ患者104例を対象に、残存腫瘍の予測因子を検討した。10例(10%)で再発が認められ、残存腫瘤の大きさのみが有意な関連因子であった。残存腫瘤が3cm未満の患者では再発率3%、3cm以上の患者では27%であった。著者らは、小さな残存腫瘤には経過観察を、大きな残存腫瘤には外科的切除を提案している。
pmid-8636757.summary_en: This Memorial Sloan-Kettering analysis of 104 patients with advanced seminoma who responded to cisplatin-based chemotherapy examined factors predicting residual tumor. Site failure occurred in 10 patients (10%). The size of the residual mass was the only significant correlate. Failure rates were 3% for masses under 3 cm and 27% for masses of 3 cm or larger. The authors suggest observation for small residual masses and surgical resection for larger ones.

pmid-8637206.summary_ja: 精巣の病理学的病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍44例に対し、補助化学療法としてシスプラチン併用化学療法（mVAB-6またはEP、各4サイクル）を施行した後方視的研究です。中央値6年の追跡で全例が無増悪で経過しました。逆行性射精や重度の耳毒性がみられたものの、治癒率は100%と報告されています。
pmid-8637206.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 44 patients with pathological stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis who received adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy at Institut Gustave Roussy over seven years. Two regimens were used sequentially: mVAB-6 and EP, each given for four cycles. After a median follow-up of six years, all patients remained free from progression. Toxicities included retrograde ejaculation in eight patients and severe ototoxicity in two. The authors concluded that four cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy achieved a 100% cure rate with minimal toxicity.

pmid-8639142.summary_ja: 34歳男性の悪性仙骨前部胚細胞腫瘍の症例です。仙骨下部と直腸を含む一塊切除に加え、シスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる補助化学療法を受けましたが、術後7か月で肺および縦隔転移により死亡しました。成人例は予後不良で、外科的切除のみが治癒の機会であると文献的に考察しています。
pmid-8639142.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old man with a malignant presacral germ cell tumor treated with en bloc excision including the lower sacrum and rectum, followed by adjuvant cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide chemotherapy. He died of lung and mediastinal metastases seven months after surgery. The authors reviewed the literature, noting that only 17 adult cases had been reported since 1907. Adults with these tumors have a poor prognosis, and surgical excision is the only chance of cure.

pmid-8639316.summary_ja: 病期I・IIの精巣セミノーマ56例に対する術後放射線療法の毒性を、照射野と線量別に後方視的に検討しました。悪心・嘔吐は66%、排便回数増加は59%にみられ、皮膚反応は照射体積と線量に伴い増加しました。重篤な晩期合併症はまれで、放射線療法のみによるものとは断定できませんでした。
pmid-8639316.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 56 patients with stage I and II testicular seminoma treated with postoperative radiotherapy. Acute and late toxicities were analyzed by treatment field and radiation dose. Nausea and vomiting occurred in 66% of patients, independent of volume or dose. Increased bowel frequency occurred in 59%, more often with larger fields. Skin reactions increased with treatment volume and dose. Severe late complications were rare and could not be attributed solely to radiation, so the authors concluded that major posttreatment morbidity is minimal.

pmid-8639319.summary_ja: 中国人の縦隔原発悪性胚細胞腫瘍10例を単施設で検討しました。AFPの半減期が短い症例は寛解に至った一方、半減期の長い症例の多くは初回化学療法に反応せず死亡しました。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍特異的AFPバンドは総AFPと並行して変化し、治療反応の監視に優位性は認められませんでした。
pmid-8639319.summary_en: This single-institution review covers ten Chinese patients with primary mediastinal malignant germ cell tumors, including three pure seminomas and seven nonseminomatous tumors treated with chemotherapy with or without surgery. Patients with rapid AFP decline achieved remission, whereas most with prolonged AFP decay failed initial chemotherapy and died. Isoelectric focusing quantified NSGCT-specific AFP bands, which closely tracked total AFP. The authors concluded that NSGCT-specific AFP estimation offers no apparent advantage for monitoring response.

pmid-8640293.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性63例で、治療前と治療後3年時点の性腺機能を、精巣摘除術のみ、放射線療法、化学療法の群間で比較しました。放射線療法や大量化学療法を受けた群では精子所見が最も低下し、Leydig細胞機能の持続的な低下がみられました。多くの患者で精子形成とLeydig細胞機能は持続的に障害されていました。
pmid-8640293.summary_en: This study assessed gonadal function in 63 men with testicular germ cell cancer before treatment and three years after treatment. Patients were grouped by orchiectomy alone, infradiaphragmatic radiotherapy, or four or six cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Semen quality was impaired in all groups before treatment. Radiotherapy and high-dose chemotherapy produced the lowest sperm parameters and persistent subclinical Leydig cell dysfunction. The authors concluded that spermatogenesis and Leydig cell function remain impaired in most patients receiving radiotherapy or intensive chemotherapy.

pmid-8640678.summary_ja: HIV陽性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者を単施設で検討し、診断時にHIVが確認された6例と、化学療法後にHIV陽性が判明した1例を報告しました。治療は化学療法、放射線療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清などで、予後は様々でした。著者らは都市部の患者ではHIV感染を考慮し、個々の状況に応じた治療を推奨しています。
pmid-8640678.summary_en: This single-institution review examined testicular germ cell tumors in HIV-seropositive men, including six patients with HIV documented at diagnosis and one who tested positive after chemotherapy for stage IIB seminoma. Treatments ranged from platinum-based chemotherapy to adjuvant radiotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Outcomes varied, and several patients had progressive HIV disease. The authors concluded that HIV infection should be considered in patients with testicular cancer from urban populations and that therapy should be individualized.

pmid-8640741.summary_ja: 臨床的には原発性に近い経過をたどった卵巣の妊娠性絨毛癌の症例です。多型性アレルのPCR解析により、妊娠由来であることが確認されました。Y染色体配列の欠如と配偶者アレルのヘテロ接合性から、X染色体を持つ精子による空の卵子の二精子受精が示唆されました。分子解析が治療方針の決定に役立つことを示しています。
pmid-8640741.summary_en: This case report describes an ovarian choriocarcinoma whose origin was difficult to determine clinically, as it behaved more like a primary than a gestational tumor. PCR amplification of polymorphic alleles demonstrated that the tumor was gestational. The absence of chromosome Y sequences and heterozygosity of the spouse's alleles indicated dispermic fertilization of an empty ovum by an X-bearing sperm. The case illustrates that molecular analysis can distinguish gestational from primary ovarian choriocarcinoma, which has important implications for therapy.

pmid-8641628.summary_ja: 閉経後の58歳女性に発生した子宮原発の転移性絨毛癌の症例報告。妊娠に関連しない絨毛癌はきわめてまれである。腫瘍は単剤化学療法に初めから抵抗性を示し、3種類の多剤併用療法にも耐性を獲得した。診断から11か月後に進行した転移性疾患により死亡した。
pmid-8641628.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old postmenopausal woman who developed metastatic choriocarcinoma of the uterus six years after menopause and 29 years after her last pregnancy, a rare occurrence since trophoblastic disease usually follows pregnancy. The tumor was primarily resistant to single-agent chemotherapy and later became resistant to three polychemotherapy regimens. The patient died eleven months after diagnosis from advanced metastatic disease. The report highlights that trophoblastic tumors can arise independently of gestation, though very rarely, and that such cases can be refractory to standard treatment.

pmid-8646605.summary_ja: 父親と息子の両方に精巣がんが発生した家族内発症例の報告。父親は純粋セミノーマ、息子は混合性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍であった。両者の末梢血リンパ球についてHLA 52種類の特異性を検査したところ6つを共有し、息子はHLA-A24がホモ接合体であった。HLA抗原や他の遺伝因子と精巣がんとの関連について、今後の研究が必要とされる。
pmid-8646605.summary_en: This report describes testicular cancer in a father and his son. The father had pure seminoma, while the son developed a mixed nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. HLA typing of peripheral blood lymphocytes from both patients for 52 specificities showed six shared antigens, and the son was homozygous for HLA-A24. The authors suggest that associations between HLA antigens and other genetic factors with testicular cancer warrant further study to improve care and counseling for patients and their families. The rarity of testicular tumors among closely related relatives is emphasized.

pmid-8647654.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍由来の細胞株を用い、22種類の抗体で細胞表面抗原の発現を免疫蛍光法により比較した研究。TRA-1-60などの抗体は主に胎児性癌細胞を染色し、GD2・GD3を認識する抗体は神経外胚葉様の細胞を優先的に染色した。結果は成人精巣の原発性胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学所見と概ね一致した。
pmid-8647654.summary_en: This study compared cell surface antigen expression in a panel of human germ cell tumor-derived cell lines, representing different differentiation phenotypes found in these tumors, using immunofluorescence with 22 antibodies. Antibodies such as TRA-1-60, TRA-1-81, and SSEA-3/4 mainly stained embryonal carcinoma cells, while GD2/GD3-recognizing antibodies preferentially stained neuroectodermal-type cells. Staining patterns were broadly consistent with prior immunohistochemistry of primary adult testicular germ cell tumors, including carcinoma in situ. The findings support using these antigens to characterize differentiation states of germ cell tumor cells.

pmid-8648363.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性の胚細胞腫瘍患者58例に対し、大量化学療法（カルボプラチン・エトポシド・シクロホスファミド）と自家骨髄移植を施行した前向き試験。完全奏効は40%、中央値28か月のフォローアップで21%が無病生存していた。治療前のhCG値と後腹膜転移の有無が生存の独立した予後因子であった。
pmid-8648363.summary_en: This prospective trial evaluated high-dose carboplatin, etoposide, and cyclophosphamide with autologous bone marrow transplantation in 58 patients with cisplatin-refractory germ cell tumors. Forty percent achieved complete response, and 21% remained alive and disease-free at a median follow-up of 28 months. Treatment-related deaths occurred in 12%. Pretreatment hCG levels above 100 times the upper limit of normal and the presence of retroperitoneal metastases were independent predictors of survival. The regimen offers meaningful benefit in patients with otherwise poor prognosis.

pmid-8648364.summary_ja: 英国MRCの前向き研究で、再発リスクが約50%の高リスク病期I精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍114例にBEP補助化学療法2コースを施行した。中央値4年のフォローアップで再発は2例のみで、治療関連死は1例であった。長期的な毒性は臨床的に有意ではなく、監視療法や後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代替となりうる。
pmid-8648364.summary_en: This UK Medical Research Council study prospectively evaluated two courses of adjuvant BEP chemotherapy in 114 patients with high-risk stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis, who had roughly a 50% risk of relapse. Only two relapses occurred during a median follow-up of 4 years. One treatment-related death occurred, and fertility, lung function, and audiometry showed no clinically significant changes, apart from a mean 15% decrease in transfer factor. The authors conclude that short-course adjuvant chemotherapy is effective with minimal long-term toxicity and may be an alternative to surveillance or RPLND.

pmid-8648365.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者71例を対象に、大量化学療法後の自家移植用に末梢血前駆細胞を採取した研究。白血球除去術前の末梢血CD34+細胞数は採取量と強く相関し、4×10⁴/mL超で1回の採取により2.5×10⁶/kg超が得られると予測された。2.5×10⁶/kg超を移植された患者では造血の生着が有意に速かった。
pmid-8648365.summary_en: Seventy-one patients with germ cell cancer underwent peripheral blood progenitor cell harvest after chemotherapy and G-CSF for autologous transplantation following high-dose therapy. Circulating CD34+ cells before leukapheresis strongly correlated with the number of collected CD34+ cells; a pre-apheresis count above 4 x 10^4/mL predicted a yield exceeding 2.5 x 10^6 CD34+ cells/kg from a single apheresis. Patients reinfused with more than 2.5 x 10^6 CD34+ cells/kg achieved faster hematopoietic engraftment. These findings guide efficient progenitor cell collection and transplant planning.

pmid-8648817.summary_ja: 本研究は、EBVと精巣腫瘍との関連を検討した。セミノーマ16例、胎児性癌11例、非腫瘍性対照精巣25例を解析した。腫瘍27例全例でEBV RNAの発現を認め、対照では発現がなかった。EBNA2とLMP1の発現も免疫染色で確認された。EBVは精巣腫瘍に関連すると結論づけられている。
pmid-8648817.summary_en: This study examined whether Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) is associated with testicular tumors. Sixteen seminomas, 11 embryonal carcinomas and 25 nonmalignant control testes were analyzed using mRNA in situ hybridization, immunostaining and nested PCR. All 27 tumors expressed EBV RNA, and EBNA2 and LMP1 were detected by immunostaining, whereas controls showed no expression. Nested PCR detected the EBV genome in both normal and tumorous testes. The authors conclude that EBV is related to testicular tumors.

pmid-8648846.summary_ja: 後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が疑われ精巣を触知しない男性6例を検討した。全例で陰嚢超音波検査に高エコー性病変を認め、6例中5例(83%)で退縮した原発性精巣がんの病理学的証拠が得られた。低エコー性腫瘤を伴わない高エコー性病変は、燃え尽き型の原発腫瘍を示すと考えられる。画像所見の解釈に重要な知見である。
pmid-8648846.summary_en: Six men with presumed retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumors and palpably normal testes underwent chemotherapy, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection and orchiectomy. Scrotal sonography showed echogenic foci in all, and histology revealed remnants of regressed primary testicular cancer in five of six (83%). Hematoxyphilic bodies, psammoma bodies and hemosiderin-laden fibrosis were identified. The authors conclude that a sonographic echogenic lesion without a hypoechoic mass in such patients probably represents a burned-out primary testicular neoplasm.

pmid-8649681.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫44例を後方視的に検討し、腹腔鏡下の摘出法を比較した。腹腔鏡補助下経膣的卵巣嚢腫摘出術は、従来の腹腔鏡下嚢腫摘出術に比べ、より大きな嚢腫の摘出が可能で、嚢腫破綻が少なく手術時間も短かった。推定出血量に有意差はなかった。大きな類皮嚢腫に対して有用な術式と結論づけられている。
pmid-8649681.summary_en: This retrospective study compared three laparoscopic approaches for removing ovarian dermoid cysts in 44 patients. Laparoscope-assisted transvaginal cystectomy allowed removal of larger cysts, with less cyst spillage (43%), shorter operative time (mean 81 minutes) and fewer disposable instruments than conventional laparoscopic cystectomy. Blood loss did not differ significantly between groups. Four major complications related to bleeding or infection occurred. The authors conclude this technique is advantageous for larger dermoid cysts.

pmid-8651859.summary_ja: 35例の四倍体水疱状絨毛組織を検討した臨床病理学的研究で、完全奇胎25例と水疱状流産10例が確認され、部分奇胎はなかった。四倍体完全奇胎14例のフォローアップでは、浸潤性病変2例と絨毛癌1例が認められた。著者らは、四倍体は持続性疾患の独立した予測因子ではないため、四倍体完全奇胎の患者にも二倍体完全奇胎の患者と同様に密接なフォローアップが必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-8651859.summary_en: This clinicopathological study of 35 tetraploid hydropic villous specimens found 25 complete moles and 10 hydropic abortions, with no partial moles. Follow-up data on 14 tetraploid complete moles showed two invasive lesions and one choriocarcinoma. The authors conclude that patients with tetraploid complete mole require the same close follow-up as those with diploid complete mole, since tetraploidy is not an independent predictor of persistent disease.

pmid-8653285.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍116例(セミノーマ78例、非セミノーマ38例)の血清673検体で、腫瘍マーカーとしての胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)を検討した。セミノーマ患者の約50%で上昇し、3マーカー併用で82%を同定した。PLAPの推移は病勢と予後の情報を与えるため、モニタリングに有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-8653285.summary_en: This study assessed placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) as a tumor marker in 116 testicular germ cell tumor patients, comprising 78 seminomas and 38 non-seminomas, with 673 serum samples analyzed. PLAP was elevated in about 50% of seminoma patients, averaging five times normal. Combining PLAP, LDH and HCG-B identified 82% of seminoma patients. False-positive PLAP occurred in 1.6% of samples. The authors suggest serial PLAP monitoring provides information on disease status and prognosis.

pmid-8654472.summary_ja: 卵巣の類皮嚢腫(成熟嚢胞性奇形腫)から発生した扁平上皮癌の3症例を報告。高齢女性に多い稀な悪性転化である。術中迅速病理診断による早期検出と病期分類の重要性を指摘し、シスプラチンを用いた化学療法や二次的細胞減量術を含む積極的治療で長期寛解が得られた例を示している。
pmid-8654472.summary_en: This report reviews three patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising in a dermoid cyst (mature cystic teratoma) of the ovary, a rare form of malignant transformation mostly seen in older women. One patient was lost to follow-up. A patient with stage III disease achieved 42 months of remission after extensive surgery and multiagent chemotherapy. A third patient with pelvic node metastases received adjuvant radiation and chemotherapy and was disease-free at 6 months. The authors recommend frozen section to improve detection and staging.

pmid-8654650.summary_ja: 卵巣の類皮嚢腫(奇形腫)の内容物を腹腔内に漏出させた場合の炎症と癒着を、ウサギモデルで検討した研究。類皮嚢腫物質の注入は顕著な腹膜炎と癒着を引き起こした。生理食塩水による洗浄は肉眼的な炎症を対照群に近いレベルまで低下させたが、組織学的な改善は限定的であった。手術中の内容物漏出への対策に示唆を与える。
pmid-8654650.summary_en: In a prospective, randomized, blinded rabbit study, the authors examined whether peritoneal exposure to human dermoid cyst material causes inflammation and adhesions beyond control levels, and whether saline lavage reduces this reaction. Thirty rabbits in five groups were compared. Dermoid material produced marked peritonitis and adhesions. Lavage brought clinical inflammation close to control levels, although the histologic benefit appeared less pronounced. The findings relate to intraoperative spillage of ovarian teratoma contents.

pmid-8656244.summary_ja: 精巣の転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で化学療法後に残存した腫瘤を、後腹膜・胸部・頸部で同時に切除した24例の報告。手術死亡はなく合併症も少なかった。病理では壊死のみや奇形腫のみの所見が多く、5年生存率は79%であった。選択された患者では段階的切除ではなく一度の手術で切除する方法が実行可能かつ安全な選択肢と示された。
pmid-8656244.summary_en: This study reports 24 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis who underwent simultaneous resection of postchemotherapy residual masses in the retroperitoneum, chest, and neck. Many had been heavily pretreated, and several had prior retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. The combined procedure had no mortality and low morbidity, with a median operative time of 5 hours 45 minutes. Pathology often showed necrosis or teratoma only, and six patients had discordant findings. The 5-year survival rate was 79%.

pmid-8656440.summary_ja: スウェーデンの症例対照研究で、精巣がん患者232例と対照904例の周産期因子を解析した。新生児黄疸と低体重・高体重は精巣がん全体のリスクと関連した。非セミノーマは新生児黄疸や低出生体重と、セミノーマは胎盤重量の増加と関連する傾向が見られた。組織型ごとに病因が異なる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8656440.summary_en: This Swedish case-control study compared 232 men with invasive testicular cancer against 904 matched controls, analyzing perinatal characteristics as risk factors and examining seminomas and nonseminomas separately. Neonatal jaundice and both low and high birth weight were associated with testicular cancer overall. Nonseminomas were linked to high maternal socioeconomic status, neonatal jaundice, and low birth weight, while high placental weight suggested increased seminoma risk. The authors conclude that the two histologic types may have different etiologic profiles.

pmid-8662037.summary_ja: 腹部卵黄嚢腫瘍が心臓に広範に浸潤した小児例の症例報告。心エコー検査で腫瘍の心内所見を捉え、治療方針の決定に有用であったことを示している。小児で報告された初の例とされる。胚細胞腫瘍の心臓浸潤の評価に心エコーが果たす役割を示す。
pmid-8662037.summary_en: This case report describes a pediatric patient with an abdominal yolk sac tumor that extensively involved the heart, reported as the first such pediatric case. Echocardiography documented the intracardiac tumor findings and helped guide management decisions. The paper highlights the diagnostic value of echocardiography in identifying and characterizing cardiac extension of a germ cell tumor.

pmid-8664395.summary_ja: 1941〜1957年生まれのデンマーク人男性を対象に、精巣がん183例と対照366例を比較した症例対照研究。停留精巣の既往は約5.2倍のリスク上昇と関連し、早期の矯正後もリスクは低下しなかった。精巣がんと停留精巣には共通の原因因子が存在する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-8664395.summary_en: This Danish cohort study of men born 1941-1957 compared 183 men diagnosed with testicular cancer before 1985 with 366 matched controls, using genital anomaly data from school health records. A history of cryptorchidism was associated with a markedly raised risk (RR 5.2), while inguinal hernia, hypospadias and hydrocele showed elevated but less certain estimates. Risk remained elevated after early correction, and was also increased in the contralateral normally descended testis. The authors support a shared causal factor for testicular cancer and cryptorchidism.

pmid-8669440.summary_ja: インプリンティング遺伝子ZNF127のDNAメチル化を、片親性由来組織である完全胞状奇胎と卵巣奇形腫で比較した研究。完全胞状奇胎は精子に類似した父性型のメチル化パターンを示した。部分胞状奇胎や正常絨毛との差異も検討され、奇胎の確認にも臨床的に有用と考えられる。
pmid-8669440.summary_en: This study examined DNA methylation of the imprinted ZNF127 gene in tissues of uniparental origin: complete hydatidiform moles, which are androgenetic, and ovarian teratomas as the maternal counterpart. Androgenetic moles showed a paternal-type methylation pattern nearly identical to that of sperm, suggesting a germline imprint. Partial moles, triploid conceptions, normal chorionic villi and somatic tissue showed modified patterns with limited imprint features. The authors propose androgenetic conceptions as a model for epigenetic analysis and as a clinical tool to confirm molar pregnancies.

pmid-8669530.summary_ja: 卵巣原発扁平上皮癌37例を検討した研究で、類皮嚢腫に伴うもの19例、子宮内膜症に伴うもの7例、純粋型11例に分類された。子宮内膜症関連例の予後は不良で、病期と異型度が全生存期間(全生存率)と最もよく相関した。類皮嚢腫由来の癌は、嚢腫の円柱上皮の内張りに由来する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-8669530.summary_en: This series of 37 primary ovarian squamous cell carcinomas includes 19 arising with dermoid cysts, 7 with endometriosis and 11 pure tumors. Patients with carcinoma associated with endometriosis had poorer survival, with five of six evaluable patients dying of disease after a mean of 5 months. Tumor stage and grade correlated best with overall survival across all three groups. Dermoid-associated tumors often showed a columnar epithelial cyst lining, suggesting an origin there. Eighteen cases fit the new WHO category of squamous cell carcinoma in the surface epithelial-stromal group.

pmid-8673928.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍のモデルであるマウス奇形癌細胞株を用いた研究。p53タンパク質は多量に存在するものの転写活性が低い。レチノイン酸による分化でp53転写活性は上昇し、DNA損傷ではp53依存性アポトーシスが誘導される。これが精巣奇形癌でp53変異が見られず、併用化学療法で治癒しやすい理由と考察されている。
pmid-8673928.summary_en: This study examines murine teratocarcinoma cell lines, a model of testicular germ cell tumors. Although p53 protein is abundantly expressed in these cells, it is transcriptionally inactive. Retinoic acid differentiation reduces p53 levels yet increases p53-mediated transcription, while DNA damage activates p53-dependent apoptosis. The authors propose this explains why p53 mutations are absent in testicular teratocarcinomas and why these tumors respond well to combination chemotherapy.

pmid-8675733.summary_ja: 若年男性の頸部リンパ節腫脹として発症した2例で、穿刺吸引細胞診では未分化癌の転移と診断された。組織学的・免疫組織化学的検討により、臨床的に潜在していた精巣原発の胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。腫瘍細胞はPLAP陽性、EMA陰性であった。若年男性の転移性低分化癌では胚細胞腫瘍を念頭に置き、PLAPとEMAの染色が診断の助けになると述べている。
pmid-8675733.summary_en: Two young adult males presented with cervical lymphadenopathy, initially diagnosed on fine needle aspiration as metastatic undifferentiated carcinoma. Histology and immunohistochemistry revealed germ cell tumors of occult testicular origin. Tumor cells were positive for placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP) and negative for EMA. The authors emphasize that pathologists and clinicians should consider germ cell tumor when evaluating young men with metastatic poorly differentiated carcinoma, and that PLAP and EMA staining aid diagnosis.

pmid-8677112.summary_ja: 妊娠19週の胎児に前頸部腫瘤が見つかり、急速に増大した。後に舌根部から生じた巨大な咽頭内および口腔内奇形腫と判明した。羊水過多と頭部屈曲も生じた。妊娠29週に帝王切開で娩出されたが、気道に到達できなかったため気管切開が必要であった。組織学的には未熟な神経外胚葉組織と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が認められた。著者らは、咽頭奇形腫の出生前診断は慎重な分娩計画を促すべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-8677112.summary_en: A 19-week fetus had a rapidly enlarging anterior neck mass, later identified as a huge intrapharyngeal and intra-oral teratoma arising from the tongue base. Polyhydramnios and head deflexion developed. Delivery at 29 weeks by cesarean section required tracheostomy because the airway could not be accessed. Histology showed immature neuroectodermal tissue and endodermal sinus tumor components. The authors conclude prenatal diagnosis of pharyngeal teratoma should prompt a careful delivery plan.

pmid-8677122.summary_ja: 子宮内膜癌の子宮全摘術中に偶然発見された5cmの卵巣腫瘍は、ほぼ良性脂肪細胞から構成されていた。周辺には良性の汗腺が散在していた。著者らはこれを脂肪に富む充実性奇形腫、すなわち奇形腫由来の卵巣脂肪腫と分類している。このような卵巣の脂肪性病変は奇形腫の変異型として認識すべきだと報告している。
pmid-8677122.summary_en: A 5-cm circumscribed yellow ovarian tumor found incidentally during hysterectomy for endometrial cancer was composed almost entirely of benign adipocytes, with small benign sweat glands at the periphery. The authors classify this predominantly lipomatous tumor as a fat-rich solid teratoma, that is, an ovarian lipoma of teratomatous origin rather than a true lipoma. The report highlights that such ovarian lipomatous lesions should be recognized as teratomatous variants.

pmid-8677452.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の治療におけるイホスファミドの位置づけを検討した総説。シスプラチン、エトポシドに次ぐ活性を持つ。シスプラチン感受性の精巣がん救援療法では約半数が無病となるが、その半数は再発する。予後不良例の初回治療では標準治療と同等だが、骨髄抑制など毒性が強い。
pmid-8677452.summary_en: This review examines ifosfamide in germ cell tumor treatment. Ifosfamide ranks third in activity behind cisplatin and etoposide. In salvage settings for cisplatin-sensitive testicular cancer, ifosfamide-based combinations achieve disease-free status in about half of patients, though half of those relapse. As first-line therapy for poor-risk patients, it is therapeutically equivalent to standard treatment but more toxic, especially myelosuppression. Its role in high-dose carboplatin/etoposide regimens for recurrence remains undefined.

pmid-8678865.summary_ja: 父と娘に発生した遺伝性仙骨前奇形腫の報告です。精巣外に生じる胚細胞腫瘍の希少な家族性発生例であり、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)による診断の有用性が示されています。既報例の文献レビューも行われ、家族例を既報の文脈の中に位置づけています。
pmid-8678865.summary_en: This report describes a hereditary presacral teratoma in a father and daughter, a rare familial occurrence of an extragonadal germ cell tumor. The authors show how magnetic resonance imaging was used in the diagnosis of this condition. They also present a review of the published literature on this unusual entity, placing the family's cases in the context of previously reported cases.

pmid-8678866.summary_ja: 2歳半の中国人女児に生じた未熟性縦隔奇形腫の症例報告です。小児悪性腫瘍の約3%を占める奇形腫は希少であることが述べられています。縦隔に生じた小児の胚細胞腫瘍の一例として提示されています。抄録は簡潔で、単一症例の提示が中心です。
pmid-8678866.summary_en: This report describes a 2.5-year-old Chinese girl with an immature mediastinal teratoma. The authors note that teratoma is rare in children, accounting for about 3% of childhood malignancies. The abstract is brief, focusing on the rarity of the tumor and the presentation of this single case.

pmid-8679447.summary_ja: ヒト原発精巣胚細胞腫瘍の糖脂質発現を、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、混合型胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマで比較した研究です。Le(x)や乳糖セラミドは非セミノーマとセミノーマの鑑別に有用でした。分化した非セミノーマではグロボ系糖脂質が減少しました。
pmid-8679447.summary_en: This study analyzes glycolipid profiles in primary human testicular germ cell tumors, including 5 embryonal carcinomas, 5 yolk sac tumors, 9 mixed non-seminomas, and 19 seminomas. Lactosylceramide and Lewis x expression distinguished non-seminomas from seminomas. Globo-series glycolipids decreased in differentiated non-seminomas. The authors conclude that cell line glycolipid patterns reflect primary tumors, and that Lewis x expression allows discrimination of non-seminomas from seminomas.

pmid-8679458.summary_ja: 1983年から1994年に治療された病期I精巣腫瘍973例を解析し、精巣摘除後に監視療法を受けた530例を中心に検討しています。混合型胚細胞腫瘍は非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と再発パターンが一致し、セミノーマとは異なりました。NSGCT中のセミノーマ成分は臨床経過に影響しないと結論づけています。
pmid-8679458.summary_en: This study analyzed 973 patients with stage I testicular tumors treated between 1983 and 1994, including 530 managed with surveillance after orchidectomy. Median age differed among non-seminomatous, seminoma, and combined tumors, suggesting distinct natural histories. Five-year relapse-free survival and relapse patterns were identical for non-seminomatous germ cell tumor and combined tumor, both distinct from seminoma. Seminoma components within NSGCT did not affect clinical outcome.

pmid-8683237.summary_ja: 1978年から1994年にオークランドとクライストチャーチで診断された精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性741例を解析しています。2%以上が二次性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症し、15年累積リスクは5.2%でした。シスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた後も二次腫瘍は予防されず、長期監視が推奨されています。
pmid-8683237.summary_en: This study reviews 741 men with germ cell testicular cancer in Auckland and Christchurch between 1978 and 1994. More than 2% developed a second germ cell testicular cancer, with a 5.2% cumulative 15-year risk. Relative contralateral risk was 27.5 times that of age-matched peers. Five of 16 bilateral tumors were synchronous, and prior cisplatin chemotherapy did not prevent a second tumor. Long-term surveillance is recommended.

pmid-8683382.summary_ja: 精巣上皮内癌(CIS)18例のうち15例(83%)が神経特異的エノラーゼ(NSE)陽性を示しました。顕在性のセミノーマ、非セミノーマ、混合型胚細胞腫瘍でもNSE発現が認められました。N-mycとの関連は乏しく、12p染色体のアイソクロモソームによる遺伝子量効果が示唆されています。
pmid-8683382.summary_en: This study shows that neuron-specific enolase (NSE) is expressed in testicular carcinoma-in-situ (CIS), the preinvasive stage of testicular germ cell tumors. Fifteen of 18 CIS samples stained positive, and overt seminomas, non-seminomas, and a mixed germ cell tumor also expressed NSE. N-myc protein was rarely detected, so NSE expression does not appear linked to N-myc. The authors suggest that isochromosome 12p gene dosage may explain high NSE levels.

pmid-8685577.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性において、病期分類の精度向上を目的に行う腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の総説。技術的難度と合併症リスクは開腹手術より高いものの、入院期間の短縮と早期の社会復帰が利点とされる。リンパ節転移の可能性が低い患者で、術後の経過観察検査を減らせる可能性がある。役割を確立するには前向き研究が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-8685577.summary_en: This review describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) used to enhance staging in men with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. The authors note that the procedure is technically demanding and carries a higher complication risk than open surgery, although it offers shorter hospitalization and faster return to normal activity. They suggest it may reduce post-operative surveillance studies and is best suited to men with a low likelihood of nodal metastases. Prospective studies in larger groups are needed to define its role.

pmid-8686410.summary_ja: 26歳女性が急性の強い腹痛で受診した症例報告。CTで卵巣成熟奇形腫の捻転が強く疑われ、腹腔鏡手術で診断を確定した。奇形腫と左側の卵管卵巣複合体を腹腔鏡下に摘出し、良好に治療された。卵巣腫瘍の10~15%を占める成熟奇形腫では、捻転が最も多い合併症(約3.5%)であることを文献的に考察している。
pmid-8686410.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with severe acute abdominal pain caused by torsion of a benign mature ovarian teratoma (dermoid cyst). Computed tomography strongly suggested the diagnosis, which was confirmed at laparoscopy. The teratoma and the left tubo-ovarian complex were removed laparoscopically with success. The authors also review the literature, noting that benign mature teratomas account for 10-15% of ovarian neoplasms and that torsion is the most frequent complication, occurring in about 3.5% of cases.

pmid-8688365.summary_ja: 37歳男性の膀胱原発絨毛癌の症例報告。5か月の集中的化学療法で良好な反応を示したが、治療完遂前に肺塞栓症で死亡した。剖検では肺と脳に壊死性結節を認め、膀胱内に残存腫瘍はなかった。移行上皮癌の脱分化により生じ、構造変化を伴わずにβ-hCGを分泌しうると考察している。
pmid-8688365.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with primary choriocarcinoma arising in the urinary bladder. He responded well to five months of intensive chemotherapy but died of pulmonary embolism before completing treatment. Postmortem examination showed necrotic nodules in the lungs and brain, with only one small focus of viable brain tumor and no residual bladder tumor. The authors suggest that bladder choriocarcinoma may arise from dedifferentiation of transitional cell carcinoma and that beta-hCG can be secreted without structural trophoblastic change.

pmid-8688967.summary_ja: 成人の胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変である精巣上皮内癌(CIS)で、腫瘍マーカーの発現を二重免疫染色により検討した研究。混合性腫瘍に隣接するCISでは、形態が類似していても抗原発現に大きなばらつきがみられた。CISは表現型的に不均一であり、セミノーマ性・非セミノーマ性の両腫瘍へ直接進展しうるという仮説を支持すると結論している。
pmid-8688967.summary_en: This study examines immunohistochemical expression of tumor markers in testicular carcinoma in situ (CIS), the precursor of adult germ cell tumors, using double staining for TRA-1-60 with Kit or PLAP. CIS cells adjacent to pure seminoma, pure nonseminoma, and mixed tumors showed marked heterogeneity in antigen expression despite similar morphology. The authors conclude that CIS is phenotypically heterogeneous, with cells possibly at different stages of progression, which supports the hypothesis that CIS can progress directly to both seminomatous and nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-8690645.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマに対し傍大動脈領域へ術後放射線療法を行った45例で、照射野位置合わせの精度を測定した研究。初回確認時のずれと治療中のずれは、側方など一部でのみ相関を示した。初回確認で後の誤差を確実には予測できず、最大1cmのランダムなずれを考慮して安全域を設定すべきと結論している。
pmid-8690645.summary_en: This study measured field alignment accuracy in 45 patients receiving adjuvant paraaortic abdominal radiation for stage I testicular seminoma. Linear and rotational discrepancies were recorded at simulation, the first check, and 10 subsequent verification films. Deviations were broadly similar between simulator-to-treatment transfer and later delivery, with 95% of absolute deviations under 10 mm and 4 degrees. The first verification correlated only partly with later errors, so it cannot reliably predict inaccuracies. Random displacements up to 1 cm should be considered when setting planning target volume margins.

pmid-8691713.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、病期IVの未分化セミノーマに対し長期の初回および救援化学療法を受けた46歳男性の経過を述べる。エトポシド投与開始から約32か月後に重度の汎血球減少が出現し、t(8;21)異常を伴う急性骨髄性白血病と診断された。著者らは、高用量エトポシドの白血病原性を示唆し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍治療後のエピポドフィロトキシン関連続発性白血病の国内初報告例として位置づけている。
pmid-8691713.summary_en: This case report describes a 46-year-old man with stage IV anaplastic seminoma who received prolonged induction and salvage chemotherapy, including several cycles of etoposide-containing regimens. About 32 months after starting etoposide-based therapy, he developed severe pancytopenia and was diagnosed with acute myelogenous leukemia carrying a t(8;21) abnormality. The authors suggest that high cumulative doses of etoposide may be leukemogenic, representing a rare epipodophyllotoxin-related secondary leukemia after testicular germ cell tumor treatment in Japan.

pmid-8692374.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、出産後3か月の16歳女性が言語障害と右上肢のしびれで受診した例を述べる。画像で左中大脳動脈領域の脳梗塞が確認された。再開通後に腫瘍性動脈瘤が形成され、その後破裂してくも膜下出血と脳内出血を起こした。病理組織では動脈瘤壁への絨毛癌浸潤が認められた。肝転移の急速な進行により、初診から7か月後に死亡した。著者らは、腫瘍が動脈壁へ転移して血栓を形成したと考察している。
pmid-8692374.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old woman, three months after a normal delivery, who presented with speech disturbance and right arm paresthesia due to cerebral infarction from choriocarcinoma involving the left middle cerebral artery. A neoplastic aneurysm formed after recanalization and later ruptured, causing subarachnoid and intracerebral hemorrhage. Histology showed choriocarcinoma invading the aneurysm wall. She developed liver metastases and died seven months after admission. The authors propose that tumor cells metastasized to arterial walls, forming thrombus and subsequent aneurysm.

pmid-8692663.summary_ja: 本研究は、手術で確定した卵巣奇形腫52個（45例）の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)所見を検討した。脂肪成分の量により3型に分類された。82.7%は嚢胞内腔が脂肪組織で満たされ、9.6%は嚢胞壁内または辺縁に脂肪を認め、7.7%では脂肪を認めなかった。脂肪を欠く腫瘍は皮脂腺が少ない傾向があった。脂肪組織の証明は本腫瘍に特異的である一方、脂肪が少ない例は他の嚢胞性卵巣腫瘍と区別しにくいとされる。
pmid-8692663.summary_en: This imaging study reviewed magnetic resonance images from 45 patients with 52 surgically confirmed ovarian teratomas. Tumors were classified into three types by the amount of fatty tissue. Most (82.7%) had fat filling the cystic cavity, 9.6% showed fat within the cyst wall or at its edge, and 7.7% had no visible fat. Tumors lacking fat tended to have fewer sebaceous glands. The authors conclude that demonstrating fatty tissue is pathognomonic, though tumors with little fat may resemble other cystic ovarian tumors on MRI.

pmid-8693640.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、腎移植後に終生免疫抑制療法を受けていた患者の停留精巣に発生した精巣セミノーマを述べる。腎移植後の純粋な精巣セミノーマは英文献で6例のみ報告されており、停留精巣発生例は本例が初である。著者らは、終生の免疫抑制が見込まれる場合には萎縮した停留精巣の摘除を考慮すべきと提案している。免疫抑制下では腫瘍の増殖が促進されうるためである。
pmid-8693640.summary_en: This case report describes a testicular seminoma arising in an undescended testis in a renal allograft recipient on lifelong immunosuppression. The authors note that only six prior cases of pure testicular seminoma after renal transplantation have been reported, and this is the first describing a seminoma in an undescended testis post-transplant. They propose that removal of atrophic undescended testes should be considered when lifelong immunosuppression is anticipated, because accelerated tumor growth can occur in immunosuppressed patients.

pmid-8693931.summary_ja: 本研究は、一施設で経験した悪性妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍50例のうち、中枢神経系に病変を認めた7例を後方視的に検討した。5例は頭蓋内症状で発症し、2例は治療中に脳転移を生じた。2例は原発性脳疾患との鑑別が困難で、生検により診断された。6例で全脳照射を化学療法と併用した。1例は2か月以内に死亡し、1例は24か月の時点で無病生存していた。予後は依然不良と結論づけている。
pmid-8693931.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review analyzed seven of 50 patients with malignant gestational trophoblastic neoplasia who had central nervous system involvement. Five presented with cranial symptoms, and two developed cerebral metastases during therapy. Two cases mimicked primary brain pathology and were diagnosed by biopsy. Treatment combined chemotherapy with whole-brain irradiation in six patients. One patient died within two months, and one remained disease-free at 24 months. The authors conclude that prognosis remains poor, emphasizing early diagnosis and prophylaxis.

pmid-8695258.summary_ja: 本研究は、転移性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の新規診断59例にPOMB/ACEレジメンを施行した成績を報告する。追跡期間中央値は7.7年であった。3年生存率は87.8%で、3年以降の再発は認められなかった。一次性薬剤耐性は7%、再発は7%であった。再発例12例のうち6例が救援化学療法で救済された。成人女性では42%が先天異常なく妊娠に成功した。生命に関わる毒性が少なく、他のレジメンと同等に有効と結論づけている。
pmid-8695258.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of 59 patients with newly diagnosed metastatic ovarian germ cell tumors treated with the POMB/ACE regimen, with a median follow-up of 7.7 years. The three-year survival was 87.8%, and no relapses occurred beyond three years. Primary drug resistance occurred in 7% and relapse in 7%. Six of twelve patients referred at relapse were salvaged. Among women over 18, 42% achieved successful pregnancies without congenital abnormalities. The authors conclude POMB/ACE is as efficacious as other regimens with low life-threatening toxicity.

pmid-8697394.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の病期IIおよびIIIの104例を対象とした研究である。原発巣に奇形腫成分があると、後腹膜リンパ節の不完全な放射線学的奏効が多かった。多変量解析で独立した予後因子はリンパ節転移の大きさのみであった。化学療法前のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCG高値は、リンパ節の奇形腫または癌成分と関連した。著者らは、原発巣に奇形腫成分を有する低容量の病期II例に初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を推奨している。
pmid-8697394.summary_en: This study of 104 patients with stage II and III testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors receiving primary chemotherapy found that teratoma in the primary tumor was associated with a higher incomplete radiologic response in retroperitoneal nodes. Lymph node metastasis size was the only independent predictor on multivariable analysis. Elevated prechemotherapy AFP and beta-hCG correlated with teratoma or carcinoma in the nodes. The authors recommend primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for low-volume clinical stage II disease with teratomatous elements in the primary tumor.

pmid-8697422.summary_ja: 精巣原発胚細胞腫瘍15例と化学療法後の残存転移性腫瘍2例をCGHで解析し、核型分析と比較した。12pのゲインが最も一貫した異常であり、原発腫瘍2例で12p11.1-p12.1の特異的増幅を認めた。残存腫瘍での6q15-q21の欠失は化学療法抵抗性に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-8697422.summary_en: This study applied comparative genomic hybridization (CGH) to 15 primary testicular germ cell tumors from adolescents and adults, plus two residual metastatic tumors after chemotherapy. CGH results were compared with karyotyping. Gain of 12p was the most consistent abnormality, and a specific 12p11.1-p12.1 amplification was found in two primary tumors. Loss of 6q15-q21 in residual tumors may relate to chemotherapy resistance. The findings confirm and extend prior chromosomal observations and identify candidate 12p genes relevant to pathogenesis.

pmid-8698307.summary_ja: 本研究は、33～43歳の男性における未分化成分が主体の精母細胞性セミノーマ4例を報告している。腫瘍は無痛性の精巣腫瘤として発見された。血清hCGおよびAFPは陰性であった。未分化領域では核異型、巨細胞、胎児性癌に類似する細胞シートが認められ、広範な壊死と浸潤を伴っていた。免疫組織化学では2腫瘍でp53過剰発現が認められ、他のマーカーは陰性であった。転移を生じた患者はいないが、自然経過を明らかにするにはより長期の追跡が必要である。
pmid-8698307.summary_en: This study describes four cases of spermatocytic seminoma with a predominant anaplastic component in men aged 33 to 43. Tumors presented as painless testicular masses. Serum hCG and AFP were negative. Anaplastic areas showed nuclear atypia, giant cells, and sheets resembling embryonal carcinoma, with extensive necrosis and invasion. Immunohistochemistry showed p53 overexpression in two tumors and negativity for other markers. No patient developed metastasis, though longer follow-up is needed to define the natural history.

pmid-8700532.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍66例を対象に、第5染色体の多型マーカー24個でLOHをマッピングした。56%の腫瘍でLOHを認め、5p15.1-15.2、5q11、5q34-35に共通の欠失領域を同定した。奇形腫では単染色体性が優位であった。第5染色体の遺伝情報の喪失が腫瘍発生に関与し、新規の腫瘍抑制遺伝子候補領域が示唆される。
pmid-8700532.summary_en: This study mapped loss of heterozygosity on chromosome 5 in 66 male germ cell tumors using 24 polymorphic markers. LOH was found in 56% of tumors, with monosomy 5 in 40.5% of LOH cases. Regional deletions were identified at 5p15.1-15.2, 5q11, and 5q34-35 in the remaining cases. Deletion patterns were similar across histologic subtypes, with monosomy predominating in teratomas. The findings suggest candidate tumor suppressor genes at three novel sites and that chromosome 5 loss contributes to male GCT development.

pmid-8703147.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫の患者70例に対し、腹腔鏡手術のみで治療した成績を検討した。60例で卵巣温存摘出術、10例で卵巣卵管摘出術を行い、全例で良性組織像であり合併症はなかった。熟練した術者による腹腔鏡手術は開腹術に代わる安全な選択肢とされた。
pmid-8703147.summary_en: This study reviewed 70 patients with ovarian mature teratoma treated exclusively by laparoscopic surgery. Ovary-preserving enucleation was performed in 60 patients and salpingo-oophorectomy in 10. All tumors were histologically benign, with no surgical complications. Second-look laparoscopy in eight primary ovary-preserving cases showed virtually no pathological findings. The authors conclude laparoscopic removal is a safe alternative to laparotomy when performed by experienced surgeons.

pmid-8707951.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を対象に、血液単球の酸化活性を全血ルシゲニン増強化学発光法で測定した研究です。治癒後の患者14例と、治療開始後最長2年まで追跡した15例を比較しました。化学療法前には活性が上昇し、治療後も18か月頃まで正常化しませんでした。TNFαは治療開始後12か月で正常化しました。腫瘍マーカーのαフェトプロテイン(AFP)は腫瘍根絶後に速やかに正常化しました。
pmid-8707951.summary_en: In 14 patients cured of non-seminomatous germ cell tumour, defined as relapse-free for at least three years, and 15 patients followed from diagnosis, blood monocyte oxidative activity was measured by whole blood lucigenin chemiluminescence. Activity was raised before chemotherapy and normalised slowly, only by about 18 months after treatment. TNF alpha normalised by 12 months, while AFP normalised rapidly after tumour eradication, suggesting that immune activation persists for over a year after cure.

pmid-8709319.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍26例に対する腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の経験を報告した論文です。病期I 17例では多くの症例で手技を完遂でき、合併症は少なく、中央値27か月の追跡で局所再発はありませんでした。化学療法後の病期II 9例では郭清が困難で、開腹への移行が多く見られました。著者らは化学療法後の症例に腹腔鏡手術を推奨しないと結論づけています。
pmid-8709319.summary_en: This report describes laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in 26 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumours, 17 with stage I disease and 9 with residual tumour after chemotherapy. The procedure was feasible in stage I patients, with few complications and no regional relapse at a median follow-up of 27 months. Dissection was much harder after chemotherapy, and the authors do not recommend laparoscopic surgery in that setting.

pmid-8711497.summary_ja: 精巣がんと尿路上皮がんにおけるイホスファミドの役割をまとめた総説です。胚細胞腫瘍では、シスプラチン抵抗性や再発例への救援療法として用いられ、完全奏効は約40〜50%です。ただし長期無病生存者は25%ほどにとどまります。予後不良例の初回療法への追加では効果の改善が示されていません。尿路上皮癌では奏効率にばらつきがあり、併用療法が検討中です。
pmid-8711497.summary_en: This review summarizes ifosfamide use in testicular and urothelial malignancies. In germ cell tumours it has been used for salvage therapy after cisplatin resistance or recurrence, in poor-risk first-line regimens, and in high-dose therapy with stem cell support. About 40 to 50 percent of patients achieve complete response with salvage, but only 25 percent remain long-term survivors. In urothelial carcinoma, response rates vary and combination regimens are under study.

pmid-8712082.summary_ja: 3か月から8歳までに診断された小児精巣腫瘍23例（悪性10例、良性13例）の治療経験を報告した論文です。悪性例では精巣摘除術と後腹膜照射・リンパ節郭清が中心で、進行例には化学療法が行われました。術後に転移を生じ死亡した2例も含まれます。病期に応じた治療方針が提案され、少なくとも3年間のフォローアップが必要とされています。
pmid-8712082.summary_en: This Japanese series reports 23 pediatric testicular tumours, 10 malignant and 13 benign, diagnosed between 3 months and 8 years of age. Most malignant cases were treated with high orchiectomy and retroperitoneal radiation or lymph node dissection, and advanced cases received chemotherapy. Two patients with postoperative metastases died. The authors propose a stage-based treatment strategy and recommend at least three years of follow-up.

pmid-8712095.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍とHLA抗原の関連を検討した研究。血清学的型判定を23例、PCR-RFLP法によるDRB1・DQB1アレルの型判定を13例で行った。その結果、DQ4の増加傾向と、DRB1 0405およびDQB1 0401の有意な頻度増加が認められた。過去の報告は一貫していなかったが、本腫瘍の遺伝的素因の理解に寄与する知見である。
pmid-8712095.summary_en: This Japanese study examined whether HLA antigens are associated with testicular germ cell tumors. Serological typing was performed in 23 patients, and HLA DRB1 and DQB1 alleles were genotyped by PCR-RFLP in 13. The authors observed a trend toward increased HLA-DQ4 and significantly increased frequencies of DRB1 0405 and DQB1 0401. Earlier reports on HLA associations with testicular cancer had been inconsistent, so these findings add to the evidence on genetic susceptibility.

pmid-8721032.summary_ja: 進行期の後腹膜純粋絨毛癌を有する17歳男性の症例。シスプラチンを基本とする化学療法に初期は良好に反応したが、治療中に多発脳転移を生じた。全脳への放射線療法後、血液脳関門を通過するMCNUを含む大量化学療法と自家骨髄移植を施行し、24か月後も再発はみられなかった。再発性脳転移に対して有効な治療となりうることが示唆される。
pmid-8721032.summary_en: A 17-year-old male with advanced retroperitoneal pure choriocarcinoma responded well to cisplatin-based chemotherapy but developed multiple brain metastases during treatment. After whole-brain radiotherapy, he received high-dose chemotherapy with etoposide, carboplatin, and MCNU, which crosses the blood-brain barrier, followed by autologous bone marrow transplantation. Twenty-four months later, there was no recurrence. The authors suggest this regimen may be effective for relapsing brain metastases during cisplatin-based therapy.

pmid-8721054.summary_ja: 千葉県で1974~1993年に登録された胞状奇胎3,203例の登録研究。侵入奇胎は8.8%、絨毛癌は0.91%に認められた。肉眼所見で分類した症例では、侵入奇胎の続発率は完全胞状奇胎12.5%、部分胞状奇胎1.5%であった。部分奇胎排出後にも妊娠性絨毛性疾患が生じるため、部分奇胎の管理は完全奇胎と同様に行うべきと結論づけている。
pmid-8721054.summary_en: This registry study from Chiba Prefecture analyzed 3,203 hydatidiform mole cases registered from 1974 to 1993. Invasive mole occurred in 8.8% and choriocarcinoma in 0.91%. After 1981, invasive mole followed complete mole in 12.5% and partial mole in 1.5%, and choriocarcinoma developed in 19 complete and one partial mole patients. The authors conclude that gestational trophoblastic disease can follow partial mole evacuation, so partial mole should be managed like complete mole when macroscopic criteria are used.

pmid-8721373.summary_ja: 突然の胸痛と右胸水で受診した49歳女性の、胸腔内に発育した成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例。被膜を有する腫瘍は11cmで膵組織を含み、腫瘍内のアミラーゼ値が著明に高値であった。膵酵素による自己消化で破裂し胸痛を生じたと考えられた。日本ではまれな胸腔内の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。
pmid-8721373.summary_en: A 49-year-old woman presented with sudden chest pain and a right pleural effusion. CT and MRI revealed an encapsulated thoracic mass. During surgery, the tumor was adherent to the parietal pleura and separate from the anterior mediastinum. The 11 cm tumor was a mature cystic teratoma containing pancreatic tissue. Markedly elevated amylase in the tumor fluid suggested autodigestion by pancreatic enzymes, probably causing rupture and the chest pain. Intrathoracic benign cystic teratoma is rare in Japan.

pmid-8721978.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍19例に対して行った腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の報告。病期I 12例と化学療法後に腫瘍マーカー陰性の残存腫瘍を有する7例が対象である。病期Iおよび選択された化学療法後症例では実施可能であったが、化学療法後症例では開腹術への移行を要した例があった。転移陽性は1例のみで、遅発性合併症は3例に生じた。
pmid-8721978.summary_en: This report describes 19 patients with non-seminomatous germ cell tumors who underwent laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, including 12 with stage I disease and 7 with marker-negative residual tumor after chemotherapy. The procedure was feasible in stage I patients and in selected post-chemotherapy patients, with a mean operating time of about 5 hours. One node was positive, and three patients had delayed complications. Several post-chemotherapy cases required conversion to open surgery, and outcome depended on pre-chemotherapy tumor bulk.

pmid-8725333.summary_ja: 手術で確定した小児卵巣腫瘤25病変の超音波所見を、嚢胞型・壁在結節を伴う嚢胞型・混合型・充実型の4型に分類した。嚢胞型は嚢胞性奇形腫などの良性病変が多かった。一方、混合型と充実型は卵黄嚢癌やディスジャーミノーマなどの悪性を強く示唆し、良悪性の鑑別に有用であると提案している。
pmid-8725333.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed ultrasound findings in 25 surgically proven ovarian masses from 23 children under 15 years of age. Lesions were classified into cystic, cystic with mural nodule, mixed, and solid patterns. Cystic and cystic-with-mural-nodule patterns were predominantly benign, mostly cystic teratomas, whereas mixed and solid patterns were highly suggestive of malignancy, including yolk sac carcinoma, dysgerminoma, and embryonal carcinoma. The authors propose this pattern-based classification as an aid in distinguishing benign from malignant pediatric ovarian masses.

pmid-8726474.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞を用い、アポトーシスと分化のin vitroモデルを確立した。レチノイン酸はネクローシスではなくアポトーシスを誘導した。LeY抗原の増加は、アポトーシスではなく分化を反映することが示された。アポトーシス経路と分化経路は異なる細胞集団で生じると結論づけ、ヒト発生生物学の研究に有用なモデルであるとしている。
pmid-8726474.summary_en: This study established an in vitro model of apoptosis and differentiation using human embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. Retinoic acid induced cell death that was apoptotic rather than necrotic, and serum deprivation caused apoptosis in both undifferentiated and differentiated cells. Although the carbohydrate antigen LeY increased with retinoic acid treatment, flow cytometry and cell sorting showed that this reflected differentiation rather than apoptosis. The authors conclude that apoptotic and differentiation pathways involve distinct cell subpopulations, and that this system is useful for studying programmed cell death in human developmental biology.

pmid-8726837.summary_ja: 29歳女性の直腸に非妊娠性絨毛癌と腺癌が併存した症例を報告した。非妊娠性絨毛癌は稀で、大腸に生じることはまれである。組織発生は不明瞭だが、類似報告や消化管での発生から、消化器腫瘍の一つの臨床単位となりうると考察している。
pmid-8726837.summary_en: The authors describe a 29-year-old woman with a rectal tumor in which non-gestational choriocarcinoma coexisted with adenocarcinoma. Non-gestational choriocarcinoma is rare and typically arises in the lung, mediastinum, kidney, or stomach, but seldom in the large intestine. Although the histogenesis of this combination is unclear, the authors note similar reports and digestive-tract occurrences, suggesting that choriocarcinoma with adenocarcinoma may constitute a distinct clinical entity among digestive tumors.

pmid-8726881.summary_ja: 高エコー性付属器腫瘤118例を対象とした前向き研究で、卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の超音波エコーパターンを3つの基本型に分類する方法を提案した。正診率は97.45%（115例）で、誤診された3例はいずれも良性腫瘍であった。超音波検査による迅速かつ正確な診断に有用であると結論している。
pmid-8726881.summary_en: This prospective study of 118 echogenic adnexal masses proposed a simplified classification of sonographic echo patterns for ovarian cystic teratomas, based on three basic types. Histological confirmation was obtained after surgery. The classification correctly diagnosed 115 cases, an accuracy of 97.45%. The three misdiagnosed tumors were benign lesions: serous cystadenoma, serous cystadenofibroma, and Brenner tumor. The authors conclude that this approach can make ultrasonography a quick and accurate tool for recognizing ovarian cystic teratoma.

pmid-8729974.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の混合型3例について、セミノーマ成分と非セミノーマ成分を別々に細胞遺伝学的に解析した。1例では両成分が8種類の構造的染色体異常を共有し、共通の腫瘍化経路をもつことが示された。残り2例では共有異常は一部または無かった。両成分は単クローン性または多クローン性の起源をもつと結論している。
pmid-8729974.summary_en: This study performed separate cytogenetic analysis of the seminoma and nonseminomatous components in three cases of mixed testicular germ cell tumor. In one case, both components shared eight structural chromosomal abnormalities, suggesting a close pathogenetic relationship and a common neoplastic pathway. The other two cases showed partial or no shared abnormalities. The authors conclude that the two components of mixed testicular tumors may arise either monoclonally or polyclonally.

pmid-8735296.summary_ja: 1977〜1994年に治療された悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍50例の後方視的検討。初回治療は手術で、化学療法はVAC/BVPからBEP/EPへ移行し、救援にVIPを用いた。生存率は卵黄嚢腫瘍54%、未熟奇形腫85%、ディスジャーミノーマ90%。AFP上昇は再発の予測に有用であった。組織型の内訳も示されている。
pmid-8735296.summary_en: Retrospective review of 50 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors treated 1977-1994, comprising endodermal sinus tumor, immature teratoma, dysgerminoma, and mixed germ cell tumor. Surgery was the initial treatment; chemotherapy regimens evolved from VAC/BVP to BEP/EP, with VIP for salvage. Survival was 54% for endodermal sinus tumor, 85% for immature teratoma, and 90% for dysgerminoma. AFP elevation tracked with endodermal sinus elements and predicted recurrence.

pmid-8740018.summary_ja: 転移性非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍220例にPVB化学療法を行った解析。化学療法単独で49.1%が完全奏効し、38.6%で化学療法後手術が行われた。開腹残存腫瘤では成熟奇形腫61.3%、生存癌12.9%。全体で72.3%が無病生存。
pmid-8740018.summary_en: Analysis of 220 patients with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors treated with primary PVB chemotherapy. Complete response occurred in 49.1% with chemotherapy alone, and 38.6% underwent postchemotherapy surgery of residual masses. Residual laparotomy specimens showed mature teratoma in 61.3% and viable cancer in 12.9%, while lung masses contained viable cancer in 31.6%. Overall, 72.3% were alive and disease-free.

pmid-8741121.summary_ja: 新生児の右眼窩と頭蓋内前部に及ぶ急速増大腫瘍の症例。眼球は露出により破裂した。生後12日に切除したが、2か月後に大きな再発をきたし再切除された。腫瘍は上眼窩裂に付着しており眼窩由来と考えられ、二次性眼窩奇形腫に分類された。組織学的には三胚葉すべての組織を含む良性奇形腫であった。
pmid-8741121.summary_en: A neonate presented with a rapidly growing tumor involving the right orbit and anterior intracranial space, which ruptured the exposed eye. Extirpation at 12 days old was followed by a large recurrence removed two months later. The tumor was attached to the superior orbital fissure, suggesting an orbital origin, and was classified as a secondary orbital teratoma. Histology showed benign teratoma with all three germ layers.

pmid-8741301.summary_ja: 34歳女性が肉眼的血尿、発熱、腰痛で受診した。CTで混在濃度を示す右腎腫瘍と多発肺転移を認めた。難治性血尿に対し腎摘除術を施行し、転移性腎絨毛癌と診断された。若年女性で血尿、月経不順、多発肺転移を伴う非典型的腎腫瘍があれば本疾患を疑うべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-8741301.summary_en: A 34-year-old woman presented with gross hematuria, fever, and loin pain. CT showed a right renal mass with mixed density and multiple lung metastases. Because hematuria was refractory, nephrectomy was performed. Histology confirmed metastatic choriocarcinoma of the kidney. The authors advise suspecting this diagnosis in young women with hematuria, menstrual irregularity, and an atypical renal tumor with multiple lung metastases.

pmid-8741563.summary_ja: 24歳男性が喀血と胸痛で受診し、左前上縦隔腫瘤とAFP高値(550 ng/ml)を認めた。化学療法前に手術を行ったが切除は不完全であった。組織はセミノーマ、未熟奇形腫、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍の混在であった。シスプラチンを含む併用化学療法3コースと放射線照射を行い、1コース後にAFPは正常化した。術後3年間再発は認めていない。
pmid-8741563.summary_en: A 24-year-old man had hemoptysis and chest pain with a left anterosuperior mediastinal mass and AFP of 550 ng/ml. Surgery was performed before chemotherapy, but resection was incomplete. Histology showed a mix of seminoma, immature teratoma, embryonal carcinoma, and yolk sac tumor. He received three cycles of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy with irradiation, and AFP normalized after one cycle. No recurrence was seen over three years.

pmid-8750515.summary_ja: 左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した扁平上皮癌の3例を報告する。閉経後の54歳と71歳の2例は高分化型で卵巣外進展があり、術後4～8か月で死亡した。42歳の月経のある女性の1例は低分化型で卵巣内に限局し、術後2年時点で生存していた。腫瘍の進展様式が予後に重要であると著者らは強調している。
pmid-8750515.summary_en: Three cases of squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratomas of the left ovary are described. Two patients were postmenopausal, aged 54 and 71, with well-differentiated tumors that extended beyond the ovary; both died within eight months. The third, a 42-year-old menstruating woman, had a poorly differentiated tumor confined to the ovary and was alive at two years. The authors emphasize the prognostic importance of tumor spread.

pmid-8751543.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞と正常胎盤栄養膜細胞を比較し、オートクリン運動因子受容体(AMF-R)の発現と遊走能を検討した。絨毛癌細胞では細胞表面に集簇したAMF-Rの発現が正常胎盤より強かった。組織標本でも悪性細胞性栄養膜細胞で強く発現していた。AMF-R刺激により絨毛癌細胞の運動能は亢進したが、正常胎盤細胞は反応しなかった。本受容体は癌の運動性に関与する可能性がある。
pmid-8751543.summary_en: Human choriocarcinoma cells were compared with normal placental trophoblasts for autocrine motility factor receptor (AMF-R) expression and migration. AMF-R was expressed on choriocarcinoma cells with surface clustering and was more intense than in term placenta. In tissue sections, malignant cytotrophoblasts strongly expressed AMF-R, while normal villous trophoblasts were weakly stained. AMF-R stimulation increased choriocarcinoma cell motility, whereas normal placental cells did not respond. The receptor may contribute to cancer cell motility.

pmid-8751814.summary_ja: 縦隔腫瘤とAFP高値(893 ng/ml)を示す20歳男性に、シスプラチン併用化学療法を3コース施行後、腫瘍を全摘した。化学療法後にAFPは正常化したが腫瘍の大きさは不変であった。病理では線維成分が豊富な未熟奇形腫で、他の胚細胞腫瘍成分やAFP産生細胞は認めなかった。18か月間再発はない。腫瘍径が治療反応を必ずしも反映しないことに注意すべきと著者らは述べている。
pmid-8751814.summary_en: A 20-year-old man with a mediastinal mass and markedly elevated AFP (893 ng/ml) received three cycles of cisplatin-based combination chemotherapy before total tumor resection. AFP normalized after chemotherapy, but tumor size did not change. Pathology showed an immature teratoma with extensive fibrous stroma, without other germ cell tumor elements or AFP-producing cells. No recurrence was seen at 18 months. The authors note tumor volume may not reflect treatment response.

pmid-8756054.summary_ja: ナイジェリアのがん登録に基づき、1960〜1994年の精巣悪性腫瘍74例の標本を再検討した。セミノーマは24.3%で、停留精巣に生じた腫瘍は全例がセミノーマであった。セミノーマ患者は非セミノーマ性精巣がん患者より平均年齢が高かった。思春期以降の腹腔内精巣は摘出すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-8756054.summary_en: This Nigerian cancer registry review re-examined 74 testicular malignancy slides from 1960 to 1994. Seminomas comprised 24.3 percent, and all tumors arising in undescended testes were seminomas. Seminoma patients were significantly older than those with nonseminomatous cancers. The authors conclude that abdominal testes after puberty should be removed and that testicular cancer belongs in the differential diagnosis of older patients with abdominal masses.

pmid-8756059.summary_ja: 進行子宮頸癌と絨毛癌による難治性出血に対し、腹膜外で下腹動脈を結紮した7例を報告する。全例で出血が停止し、以後の輸血は不要であった。手術手技とその利点を詳述している。絨毛癌の出血管理に焦点を当てた報告であり、妊娠性栄養膜疾患の治療に関連する。
pmid-8756059.summary_en: This report describes seven cases of extraperitoneal ligation of the hypogastric (internal iliac) arteries used to control intractable bleeding from advanced cervical cancer and choriocarcinoma. In all cases the procedure arrested hemorrhage without requiring further transfusion. The surgical technique and its advantages are detailed. Because choriocarcinoma is one of the two subjects, the paper is relevant as a management-focused gestational trophoblastic disease report.

pmid-8756389.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、セミノーマに対して縦隔照射を受けた後に放射線誘発性心膜血管肉腫を発症した患者を記述している。著者らはMedlineで心膜腫瘍と照射後肉腫を検索し、心膜肉腫の詳細なレビューを示している。放射線誘発性心膜肉腫の初めての報告と考えており、縦隔照射を受けた患者には長期フォローアップの必要性を強調している。
pmid-8756389.summary_en: This case report describes a patient who developed a radiation-induced pericardial angiosarcoma after mediastinal irradiation given for seminoma. The authors searched Medline for pericardial tumors and post-irradiation sarcomas and provide a detailed review of pericardial sarcomas. They believe this is the first reported radiation-induced pericardial sarcoma and stress the need for long-term follow-up in patients who receive mediastinal irradiation.

pmid-8757478.summary_ja: 62歳日本人男性の剖検例で、肝細胞癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍が混在した肝腫瘍を報告する。両成分ともαフェトプロテイン(AFP)陽性であった。肝卵黄嚢腫瘍が肝細胞癌を伴った初めての報告であり、性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍の組織発生を考えるうえで示唆に富む。
pmid-8757478.summary_en: This report describes a 62-year-old Japanese man with a hepatic tumor combining hepatocellular carcinoma and yolk sac tumor, found at autopsy. Both components were alpha-fetoprotein positive, while only the yolk sac component expressed carcinoembryonic antigen, EMA, keratin, and other markers. The authors consider this the first reported case of hepatic yolk sac tumor associated with hepatocellular carcinoma. They propose it as a hepatocellular carcinoma variant with yolk sac differentiation, offering insight into extragonadal yolk sac tumor histogenesis.

pmid-8758261.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍細胞株5種を、膀胱癌株5種およびシスプラチン耐性株2種と比較した基礎研究である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍株はグルタチオン(GSH)が低く、シスプラチン感受性と整合する。耐性株ではGSHが77倍に増加していた。GSHが化学療法感受性と獲得耐性に寄与する可能性を示している。
pmid-8758261.summary_en: This laboratory study compares glutathione, glutathione-S-transferase, and metallothionein levels in five human testis tumour cell lines with five bladder cancer lines and two cisplatin-resistant lines. Testicular germ cell tumour lines had low glutathione, consistent with cisplatin sensitivity, and a 77-fold rise in glutathione marked a cisplatin-resistant derivative. Metallothionein was relatively high in testis lines. Glutathione may contribute to chemosensitivity of metastatic testicular germ cell tumors and to acquired cisplatin resistance.

pmid-8758342.summary_ja: 4例の症例集積により、妊娠性絨毛性疾患による生命を脅かす内出血に対する選択的動脈塞栓術を評価した。診断は動脈造影で行われ、塞栓術は全例で出血を制御した。平均手術時間は42分で、ショックは著明に改善した。一般的な合併症は発熱と疼痛であった。著者らは、選択的動脈塞栓術は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の出血管理における救命的な選択肢であると結論づけている。
pmid-8758342.summary_en: This four-patient case series evaluated selective arterial embolization for life-threatening internal bleeding caused by trophoblastic disease. Diagnosis was made by arteriography, and embolization controlled bleeding in all patients. Mean procedure time was 42 minutes, and shock improved markedly. Fever and pain were the common complications. The authors conclude that selective arterial embolization is a life-saving option for managing hemorrhage in gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-8760299.summary_ja: 精巣原発のヒト胚細胞腫瘍における血管新生因子を検討した研究。VEGFは81.8%の腫瘍で正常精巣より著明に増加し、微小血管密度と強く相関した。一方、PlGFの相関は弱かった。VEGF受容体も上昇していた。低酸素刺激によりVEGF発現が誘導された。VEGF評価は転移リスクの予測に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-8760299.summary_en: This study examined angiogenic factors in human germ cell tumors (GCTs) from testicular primaries. VEGF mRNA and protein were markedly elevated in 81.8% of tumors relative to normal testis and correlated strongly with microvessel density, whereas PlGF correlated only weakly. VEGF receptors were also upregulated. Hypoxia induced VEGF expression in NTERA-2 and JEG-3 cell lines. The authors suggest VEGF evaluation may help predict patients at risk for metastatic disease in stage A GCT.

pmid-8763274.summary_ja: 78歳の未経産婦に生じた、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内の癌肉腫の症例報告。主訴は右側腹痛だった。組織学的に、癌腫成分と肉腫成分の両方を含む典型的な成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、広範な壊死を伴っていた。類皮嚢腫の悪性転化は2%未満と稀である。癌腫と肉腫が合併した例は、これまで報告がないとされている。
pmid-8763274.summary_en: The authors report a 78-year-old nulliparous woman with carcinosarcoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, presenting with right-sided abdominal pain. Histology showed typical mature cystic teratoma containing both carcinomatous and sarcomatous components, with extensive necrosis. Malignant transformation of a dermoid cyst is rare, estimated at under 2%. Adenocarcinoma is the commonest malignancy in such cysts, and sarcomas are described. The authors note no prior case of sarcoma combined with adenocarcinoma has been reported.

pmid-8764742.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴う卵巣子宮内膜様腫瘍6例(子宮内膜様癌5例、癌肉腫1例)の解析。患者年齢は31~73歳だった。複数例で術後にαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が上昇した。シスプラチン併用化学療法を行ったにもかかわらず、6例中4例が3~14か月で死亡した。免疫組織化学では、子宮内膜様成分はAFP陰性、卵黄嚢成分はAFP陽性だった。予後不良な子宮内膜癌の亜型と考えるべきだとしている。
pmid-8764742.summary_en: The authors describe six ovarian endometrioid tumors (five carcinomas, one carcinosarcoma) containing yolk sac tumor components, a rare entity with aggressive behavior. Patients were aged 31 to 73. Postoperative AFP elevation occurred in several patients. Four of six died within 3 to 14 months despite cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Immunohistochemistry showed that endometrioid areas were AFP-negative while yolk sac areas were AFP-positive. The authors conclude these tumors should be considered a variant of endometrial carcinoma with poor prognosis.

pmid-8764955.summary_ja: ヒルブロウ病院で精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を受けた精巣セミノーマ患者65例を後方視的に検討した。病期Iが47例、病期IIが9例で、全例が横隔膜下照射を受け、病期IIの4例には予防的に横隔膜上照射も行われた。5年全生存率と無病生存率は文献報告と遜色なく、重篤な晩期毒性はまれであった。
