pmid-8764955.summary_en: This retrospective study from Hillbrow Hospital evaluated postorchidectomy irradiation in 65 patients with stage I or II testicular seminoma. Forty-seven had stage I and nine had stage II disease. All patients received infradiaphragmatic irradiation, and four stage II patients also received prophylactic supradiaphragmatic treatment. Five-year overall and disease-free survival compared favorably with published series, and severe long-term toxicity was rare. Seminoma was uncommon among black patients during the 12-year study period.

pmid-8765055.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1に変異原処理と選択を行い、レチノイン酸（RA）およびHMBA抵抗性のクローンを樹立した。RA抵抗性クローンは9-cisレチノイン酸にも交差耐性を示し、マウスでの抗腫瘍作用も克服した。いずれの耐性細胞でもRARγの発現異常が認められ、RA抵抗性はRARγ制御の変化によると考えられた。
pmid-8765055.summary_en: Investigators derived retinoic acid- and HMBA-resistant clones from the human embryonal carcinoma line NT2/D1 after mutagen treatment and selection. Nine RA-resistant clones and one HMBA-resistant clone were obtained, and the RA-resistant clones were cross-resistant to 9-cis retinoic acid. In athymic mice, the representative clone NT2/D1-R1 overcame the antitumorigenic effects of RA. All resistant cells showed deregulated RARgamma expression without detectable structural changes in the RARgamma gene. The findings suggest that RA resistance arises from altered RARgamma regulation.

pmid-8768388.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に悪性転化を認めた症例を報告した。病変は腺扁平上皮癌と、上気道のシュナイダー乳頭腫に似た病変が併存していた。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は稀で、腺扁平上皮癌はさらに稀である。単一の奇形腫内に多様な組織像が生じうることを示し、病理学的にこの変化を認識する必要性も示唆する。
pmid-8768388.summary_en: This case report describes a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary that underwent malignant transformation. The lesion combined adenosquamous carcinoma with a schneiderian papilloma-like component, a combination the authors describe as rare. Malignant transformation is uncommon in mature cystic teratoma, and adenosquamous carcinoma is rarer still. The report highlights the histological diversity possible within a single teratoma and the need to recognize such transformation pathologically.

pmid-8772614.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性36例で精子形成を評価した。精子濃度と組織スコアは両群で低下し、非セミノーマで特に顕著であった。非セミノーマでは血中および精索静脈のエストラジオールとhCGが上昇していた。非セミノーマでアロマターゼ活性が高く、腫瘍の増大と局所でのエストロゲン産生が精子形成障害の原因と考えられた。
pmid-8772614.summary_en: This study evaluated spermatogenesis in 36 men with testicular germ cell tumors, 11 with seminoma and 25 with nonseminoma, in both the tumor-bearing and contralateral testes. Sperm concentration and Johnsen's score were reduced, most markedly in nonseminoma. Serum and spermatic vein estradiol and hCG were elevated in nonseminoma but normal in seminoma. Aromatase activity was higher in nonseminoma tumors and in nontumorous testes. The authors propose that tumor size and in situ estrogen production impair spermatogenesis.

pmid-8774660.summary_ja: HIV感染女性の子宮頸部奇形腫内に生じた扁平上皮癌の症例を報告した。患者は広汎子宮全摘術と傍大動脈・骨盤リンパ節郭清を受け、治療後1年まで再発を認めていない。子宮頸部奇形腫に浸潤性扁平上皮癌を合併する例は稀であり、本報告は限られた文献に加わるものである。
pmid-8774660.summary_en: This case report describes an HIV-infected woman with squamous cell carcinoma arising within a teratoma of the uterine cervix. The authors note that cervical cancer has been an AIDS-defining illness since January 1993 and that HIV infection among women is increasing in the United States. The patient underwent radical hysterectomy with para-aortic and pelvic lymphadenectomy and showed no evidence of recurrence one year after treatment. Cervical teratoma with invasive squamous cell carcinoma is rare, and this case adds to the limited literature.

pmid-8775270.summary_ja: 17歳女性の未熟卵巣奇形腫に伴い、抗利尿ホルモン不適切分泌症候群(IADHS)による持続性低ナトリウム血症が生じた症例報告である。術前の水分制限には反応しなかったが、腫瘍摘出後に血清ナトリウム値は正常化した。未熟卵巣奇形腫や胚細胞腫瘍によるIADHSの初報告であり、傍腫瘍性内分泌症候群は切除により改善しうることを示している。
pmid-8775270.summary_en: A 17-year-old girl with an immature ovarian teratoma developed inappropriate antidiuretic hormone secretion syndrome, causing persistent hyponatraemia unresponsive to fluid restriction. Plasma sodium normalised after tumour removal. The authors describe this as the first reported case of IADHS attributable to an immature ovarian teratoma or germ cell tumour, highlighting that paraneoplastic endocrine syndromes can accompany gynaecological malignancy and resolve with resection.

pmid-8777501.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマおよび非セミノーマ)について、疫学、病因、病理、臨床像、病期分類を概説した総説である。手術、放射線療法、化学療法といった治療選択肢を、病期と予後不良因子の有無に応じて検討している。泌尿器科・腫瘍内科医にとっての実地的な入門資料となる。
pmid-8777501.summary_en: This review covers testicular germ cell tumours, including seminoma and non-seminoma, addressing incidence, aetiology, pathology, clinical presentation and staging. Management options, namely surgery, radiotherapy and chemotherapy, are discussed according to disease stage and the presence of adverse prognostic factors. It serves as a concise clinical overview for urologists and oncologists managing testicular malignancy.

pmid-8777620.summary_ja: 1988〜1993年の37例の精巣悪性奇形腫の後腹膜転移に対する開腹手術を後方視的に検討した研究である。大半は白金・ブレオマイシン併用化学療法後の待機的切除を受けた。化学療法抵抗性病変への介入的手術や再発例への手術も含め、大半が生存していた。腫瘍マーカーや再発時期に応じた手術の適応を論じている。
pmid-8777620.summary_en: This retrospective series of 37 patients treated between 1988 and 1993 examined laparotomy for excising retroperitoneal metastases from testicular malignant teratoma. Most underwent elective resection after platinum and bleomycin chemotherapy; others had interventional surgery for chemoresistant disease or surgery for relapse. Most patients were alive at follow-up. The authors conclude that surgery has a broader role than residual-disease resection, with timing guided by tumour markers and the timing of relapse.

pmid-8782202.summary_ja: 64歳女性の子宮悪性ミュラー管混合腫瘍で、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分が顕著であり、血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値を示した症例報告である。腫瘍は侵攻性の経過をたどり、術後2か月で死亡した。この型の初症例であり、AFP産生子宮内膜癌としては文献上9例目と報告している。
pmid-8782202.summary_en: A 64-year-old woman had a malignant müllerian mixed tumour of the uterus with a prominent yolk sac tumour component and markedly elevated serum alpha-fetoprotein. The tumour followed an aggressive course, and she died two months after surgery. The authors report this as the first case of this type and only the ninth alpha-fetoprotein-secreting endometrial carcinoma described in the literature.

pmid-8785650.summary_ja: 縦隔前部の良性嚢胞性奇形腫で、CT検査中に腫瘍内容物が前方へ移動する新たな所見を報告している。その見た目は照明器具に似ているという。約半数の症例で脂肪が認められ診断の手がかりとなるが、この動的な所見も縦隔嚢胞性奇形腫の認識に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-8785650.summary_en: This case report describes a new imaging feature in benign cystic teratoma of the anterior mediastinum. Components of the tumour were seen drifting anteriorly during a computed tomography examination, and the appearance resembled a light fitting. Fat is present in roughly half of such cases and suggests the diagnosis. The authors highlight that this dynamic finding may aid recognition of mediastinal cystic teratoma on CT, adding to the established diagnostic clues for this tumour.

pmid-8791060.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍44例で、セミノーマの腫瘍マーカー候補としてMnSODを胎盤型アルカリホスファターゼ(PLAP)と比較した。血清陽性率は病期Iで11%、病期IIIで80%だった。セミノーマと非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍との間に差はなかった。感度がPLAPより低く、マーカーとしての有用性は限定的と結論している。
pmid-8791060.summary_en: This study assessed manganese superoxide dismutase (MnSOD) as a potential tumour marker for seminoma in 44 patients with testicular germ cell tumours, comparing it with placental alkaline phosphatase (PLAP). Serum positivity rose with stage, from 11% in stage I to 80% in stage III. No difference was seen between seminoma and non-seminomatous tumours, or between tumour and normal tissue. Because sensitivity was lower than PLAP, the authors concluded that MnSOD has limited value as a seminoma marker.

pmid-8791062.summary_ja: 35歳男性で、精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が腫瘍血栓による致死的な肺動脈塞栓として発症した。心肺バイパスと深部低体温循環停止下に外科的血栓摘除を行い、精巣摘除術と補助化学療法を実施した。3年後も身体所見、画像、腫瘍マーカーで無病を維持している。若年成人の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍には積極的な多職種治療が重要と結論している。
pmid-8791062.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man whose nonseminomatous germ cell tumour of the testis presented as a life-threatening pulmonary embolism caused by a neoplastic thrombus. Surgical thrombectomy with cardiopulmonary bypass and deep hypothermic circulatory arrest was performed, followed by orchiectomy and adjuvant chemotherapy. Three years later the patient remained disease free by examination, imaging and serum markers. The authors argue for aggressive multidisciplinary management of nonseminomatous germ cell tumours in young adults.

pmid-8795414.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初発症状から組織診断までの遅延を、1978～1994年の453例で後方視的に検討した研究。診断遅延が長いほど初診時転移や監視療法中の再発が増加した。原発巣を残したまま化学療法を受けた32例では、精巣摘除時に多くが生存腫瘍を認めなかった。早期診断の啓発の継続と、単独精巣の腫瘍における精巣温存の検討が結論として示された。
pmid-8795414.summary_en: This retrospective study of 453 untreated patients with testicular germ cell cancer (1978-1994) examined how diagnostic delay affects metastasis at presentation and relapse under surveillance. Longer delays were associated with more metastases and more relapses, while the proportion of patients presenting early improved over time. Thirty-two patients received primary chemotherapy with the testis in situ, and most had no viable tumor at orchidectomy. The authors conclude that early diagnosis should continue to be encouraged and that testis conservation merits exploration, particularly in solitary testis tumors.

pmid-8796806.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患66例と健常妊娠初期女性23例で血清IL-2と可溶性IL-2受容体（SIL-2R）を測定した研究。IL-2は全群で低下し、SIL-2Rは高リスク絨毛癌で特に上昇した。SIL-2Rは血清β-hCGと正の相関を示し、腫瘍量の指標となりうる。正常値は高リスク絨毛癌の除外に役立つ可能性があり、疾患モニタリングや鑑別診断への応用が示唆された。
pmid-8796806.summary_en: This study measured serum interleukin-2 (IL-2) and soluble IL-2 receptor (SIL-2R) in 66 patients with gestational trophoblastic disease and 23 healthy pregnant controls. IL-2 was lower in all GTD subgroups, whereas SIL-2R rose several-fold, most markedly in high-risk choriocarcinoma. SIL-2R correlated positively with serum beta-hCG, suggesting it tracks tumor burden. The authors propose SIL-2R for disease monitoring and differential diagnosis, since a normal value may help exclude high-risk choriocarcinoma. The findings suggest an impaired immune response in GTD.

pmid-8796832.summary_ja: 正常細胞性栄養膜細胞と絨毛癌細胞の共培養in vitroモデルを用い、細胞動態と形態変化を解析した研究。絨毛癌細胞は正常細胞性栄養膜細胞を引き寄せて取り込み、ゆっくり増殖するコロニーを形成した。この過程で形態学的に区別できるハイブリッド細胞が生じた。妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の発生における細胞間相互作用の役割を支持する所見である。
pmid-8796832.summary_en: In an in vitro coculture of normal cytotrophoblasts and choriocarcinoma cells, the authors used time-lapse imaging, immunofluorescence and confocal microscopy to examine cellular kinetics and morphology. Choriocarcinoma cells attracted normal cytotrophoblasts, engulfed them via pseudopod-like extensions, and formed slow-growing colonies. This process produced hybrid cells distinguishable by morphology. The findings are presented as support for earlier biochemical and molecular data on cell-cell interaction in cytotrophoblast transformation and the development of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia.

pmid-8797887.summary_ja: 原発性精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例と転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍3例について、第1p、3p、11p、17p染色体のヘテロ接合性の消失(LOH)と親由来を検討した。LOH頻度は高かったが、臨床病理学的特徴との相関や優先的な親由来の欠失は認められなかった。11p上でLOHのない11例の腫瘍は、インプリントされたH19遺伝子の両対立遺伝子発現を示した。著者らは、この発現は腫瘍形成中のインプリンティングの喪失ではなく、元の胚細胞でインプリンティングが消去されていることを反映している可能性が高く、インプリンティングの再確立の失敗が初期事象である可能性を示唆すると結論づけている。
pmid-8797887.summary_en: The study examined 40 primary and 3 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors for loss of heterozygosity (LOH) on chromosomes 1p, 3p, 11p and 17p and their parental origin. LOH frequencies were high, but showed no correlation with clinicopathological features and no preferential parental loss. Eleven tumors without LOH at 11p showed biallelic expression of the imprinted H19 gene. The authors conclude that biallelic H19 expression likely reflects erased imprinting in the original germ cells rather than loss of imprinting during tumorigenesis, possibly indicating a failure to re-establish imprinting as an early event.

pmid-8798322.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）に悪性転化を認めた4例の報告。扁平上皮癌3例、腺癌1例であった。凍結切片による術中診断で2例が同定され、病期分類のための開腹術が行われた。転移や被膜浸潤は認められなかった。1例は切除中に腫瘍が破裂し、術後に化学療法を受けた。
pmid-8798322.summary_en: The authors report four patients with mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) harboring malignant transformation, three squamous cell carcinomas and one adenocarcinoma. Diagnoses were made intraoperatively by frozen section in two cases, prompting staging laparotomy. None showed metastases or capsule invasion. One tumor ruptured during excision and received chemotherapy after surgery. Three patients remained well and one was lost to follow-up. Malignant transformation is rare, and preoperative diagnosis is seldom achieved.

pmid-8799004.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍8例に対し集中的なシスプラチン併用化学療法を行った報告。1例を除き非セミノーマ成分を有していた。組織像は精巣腫瘍と類似するが、性腺外原発では生物学的特性が異なると考察された。予後不良の要因として、シスプラチン併用療法の成績不十分さと、非胚細胞性および血液系悪性腫瘍の発生が挙げられた。
pmid-8799004.summary_en: This paper reviews eight patients with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors treated with intensive cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Apart from one patient, all had non-seminomatous components. The authors argue that primary extragonadal germ cell tumors behave differently from testicular tumors despite similar histology. The poor prognosis of mediastinal germ cell tumors is attributed to suboptimal cisplatin-based treatment results and the development of non-germ cell and hematological malignancies.

pmid-8804361.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、着床部位および妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるMel-CAMの発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。Mel-CAMは中間型トロホブラスト細胞に特異的に発現し、胞状奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌でも同様に認められた。細胞栄養膜細胞と合胞体栄養膜細胞には発現しなかった。中間型トロホブラストの有用な免疫表現型マーカーとなる所見である。
pmid-8804361.summary_en: This study examined Mel-CAM (MUC18) expression by immunohistochemistry in normal placentas, implantation sites, and gestational trophoblastic lesions. Mel-CAM marked intermediate trophoblast in normal and exaggerated placental sites, hydatidiform moles, placental site trophoblastic tumors, and choriocarcinomas, but was absent from cytotrophoblast and syncytiotrophoblast. The authors propose defining intermediate trophoblast by both morphology and Mel-CAM immunophenotype, supporting a dual pathway of trophoblastic differentiation.

pmid-8804810.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の最近の進歩を概説した総説である。若年層での罹患率上昇と、ゴナドトロピン依存性分裂を含む発症要因を論じている。化学感受性の基盤として、p53とアポトーシスの役割も取り上げられている。良好リスク症例では、BEP療法でブレオマイシンを維持することが治療期間短縮の条件とされた。孤立精巣では臓器温存手術と術後放射線療法が、精子形成の温存には術前化学療法が検討されている。
pmid-8804810.summary_en: This review summarizes recent advances in testicular germ cell cancer, including its rising incidence in younger men and proposed etiologic factors such as gonadotropin-driven mitosis. It discusses genetic linkage studies, p53 status and apoptosis as bases of chemosensitivity, and emerging agents such as paclitaxel and temozolomide. Key clinical points include retaining bleomycin in BEP for good-risk patients to shorten treatment to 9 weeks, organ-conserving surgery with postoperative radiation for a solitary testis, and preoperative chemotherapy to preserve spermatogenesis.

pmid-8805936.summary_ja: 転移性絨毛癌の女性2例に対する全身PET検査の所見を報告した。1例では、腫瘍塞栓と血栓を鑑別できる非侵襲的検査はPETのみであった。もう1例では化学療法後もβ-hCGが高値を示し、PETにより残存腫瘍の部位を同定できた。全身PETは絨毛癌における腫瘍組織の局在診断に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-8805936.summary_en: This brief report describes whole-body PET imaging in two women with metastatic choriocarcinoma. In one patient, PET was the only noninvasive modality able to distinguish tumor emboli from blood clots. In the other, PET localized residual tumor tissue in a patient with persistently elevated beta-hCG after chemotherapy. The authors conclude that whole-body PET can help localize tumor tissue in choriocarcinoma.

pmid-8806199.summary_ja: 転移性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の臨床的生物学を、臨床医の視点から概観した総説である。化学療法の成績と再発の危険因子を検討し、精巣由来と縦隔・後腹膜原発の腫瘍の生物学的相違を論じている。化学療法後には外科的管理ではなく経過観察を選択できる「良好リスク」基準を提唱した。転移巣の組織学的多様性や晩期再発にも言及し、個別化された管理戦略の必要性を示している。
pmid-8806199.summary_en: This review examines the clinical biology of metastatic testicular germ cell tumors from a clinician's perspective. It discusses chemotherapy outcomes, relapse risk factors, and biological differences between testicular and primary mediastinal or retroperitoneal tumors. The authors propose good-risk criteria for expectant management after chemotherapy instead of routine surgery. It also addresses histologic diversity of metastases, including non-germ-cell malignant components, and late relapse with chemotherapy refractoriness.

pmid-8808867.summary_ja: 腹部停留精巣に生じた胚細胞腫瘍で、後腹膜に大きな転移を伴う39例を対象とした。術前にシスプラチン併用化学療法を行い、その後に精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清または放射線療法を施行した。推定生存率はセミノーマで86%、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で39%であった。多変量解析で有意な予後因子は組織型のみであった。
pmid-8808867.summary_en: This study reviews 39 patients with germ cell tumors of an abdominal undescended testis and bulky confluent retroperitoneal metastases treated with neoadjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy, followed by orchiectomy with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or radiotherapy. Actuarial survival was 86% for seminoma and 39% for nonseminomatous tumors. Viable tumor was found in 61.5% of orchiectomy specimens, and ilioinguinal metastases required additional therapy in 41% of patients. Histology was the only significant prognostic factor on multivariate analysis.

pmid-8808868.summary_ja: 後方視的な大学の症例集積で、縦隔に転移した非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者80例が同定され、そのうち65例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清も受けた。化学療法後の組織型は奇形腫が主体で、縦隔検体の65%に認められ、癌は26%に認められた。転帰は良好で、75%が無病であり、18%が癌で死亡した。切除後の縦隔再発は80例中4例とまれであった。著者らは、縦隔転移は後腹膜病変と類似した挙動を示し、原発性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍とは明確に異なると結論づけている。
pmid-8808868.summary_en: This retrospective university series identified 80 patients with nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors metastatic to the mediastinum, 65 of whom also underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Teratoma was the predominant histology after chemotherapy, found in 65% of mediastinal specimens, while cancer was present in 26%. Outcomes were favorable, with 75% disease-free and 18% dying of cancer. Mediastinal relapses after resection were rare, four of 80. The authors conclude that mediastinal metastases behave similarly to retroperitoneal disease and differ clearly from primary mediastinal germ cell tumors.

pmid-8811467.summary_ja: 経口避妊薬を服用中の24歳未経産女性に偶然発見された、良性の成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫の症例報告である。組織学的に前立腺様組織を含んでいた。hK2とhK3に対するモノクローナル抗体を用いて、上皮島が前立腺由来であることを確認した。ただし、これらの細胞の一部のみがカリクレインを産生していた。
pmid-8811467.summary_en: This case report describes a benign mature cystic ovarian teratoma incidentally found in a 24-year-old nulliparous woman taking oral contraceptives. Histology showed prostate-like tissue alongside various other tissues. Using monoclonal antibodies against human prostate-specific kallikreins hK2 and hK3, the authors confirmed that the epithelial islets were prostatic in nature. Only part of these cells retained the ability to produce kallikreins. The study illustrates prostatic differentiation within an ovarian teratoma.

pmid-8812492.summary_ja: 男性胚細胞腫瘍で高頻度にヘテロ接合性の消失とホモ接合欠失がみられる12q22の候補腫瘍抑制遺伝子領域を、物理的にマッピングした研究である。67組の腫瘍・正常DNAを用いて最小欠失領域を絞り込み、約2 Mbの領域をYACおよびRH地図で示した。候補から除外された遺伝子も示され、腫瘍抑制遺伝子の単離に役立つと述べている。
pmid-8812492.summary_en: This genomic study maps a commonly deleted region at chromosome 12q22, previously linked to a candidate tumor suppressor gene in male germ cell tumors. Deletion mapping of 67 tumor-normal DNA pairs with 20 markers narrowed the minimal deleted region between D12S377 and D12S296. The authors built a YAC contig and a radiation hybrid map covering about 3 cM, with a minimal deletion of roughly 2 Mb. Four previously mapped genes were excluded as candidates. The maps should aid isolation of the tumor suppressor gene.

pmid-8813125.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍患者の85%が、ヒト内在性レトロウイルスEnvタンパクに対する抗体を産生していた。抗腫瘍治療後には抗体価が経時的に低下した。非胚細胞腫瘍の対象では陽性例が0.8%に限られ、膜貫通領域（TM）に対する抗体は胚細胞腫瘍患者のみに高力価で認められた。抗TM抗体は特異性の高いマーカーとなり得ること、Envが腫瘍形成に関与する可能性も示唆している。
pmid-8813125.summary_en: This study examines antibodies against the Env protein of human endogenous retroviruses in germ cell tumor patients. Eighty-five percent of GCT patients had Env antibodies, and their titers fell over time after antitumor treatment. Among non-GCT individuals, only 0.8% had Env antibodies, and none of those reacted with the transmembrane domain. In contrast, all tested Env-positive GCT patients produced high-titer anti-TM antibodies. The authors propose anti-TM antibodies as highly specific GCT markers and suggest a possible role for Env in tumorigenesis.

pmid-8814409.summary_ja: 小児期の奇形腫を概説した総説である。奇形腫は少なくとも二胚葉の組織を含む胚性腫瘍で、正中部や傍脊椎部に多く発生する。約80%は良性、20%は悪性である。乳幼児では性腺外に、年長児では性腺に生じやすい。新生児では仙骨・仙骨前部が最も多い部位である。予後は年齢、切除可能性、転移能に依存する。
pmid-8814409.summary_en: This review summarizes teratomas in childhood, which are embryonal neoplasms containing tissues from at least two germ layers. They occur in almost any body region, most often in midline and paraxial sites. About 80% are benign and 20% malignant, and females account for 75-80% of non-testicular cases. Infants and young children usually present with extragonadal tumors, while older children more often have gonadal teratomas. Neonatal tumors arise most commonly in the sacrococcygeal and presacral region. Prognosis depends on age, resectability, and metastatic potential.

pmid-8815974.summary_ja: 本報告は、肺に発生したと考えられる非妊娠性・性腺外絨毛癌の女性3例を提示したものである。原発性肺絨毛癌は極めて稀で、報告例は約20例にすぎない。血清β-hCGの有用性と化学療法への反応性を示し、起源および鑑別診断について考察している。肺腫瘍でhCGが上昇する場合には絨毛癌を念頭に置く必要性を示唆する。
pmid-8815974.summary_en: This report describes three female patients with nongestational, extragonadal choriocarcinoma apparently arising in the lung. Primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma is extremely rare, with about 20 cases reported in the literature. The authors illustrate its clinical spectrum, the diagnostic utility of serum beta-hCG, and responsiveness to chemotherapy. Plausible origins and differential diagnosis are discussed. The cases highlight the importance of considering choriocarcinoma in pulmonary tumors with elevated hCG.

pmid-8816895.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマ13例と精巣セミノーマ13例を、K-ras-2遺伝子解析とp53免疫組織化学で比較した研究である。p53陽性率は縦隔例31%、精巣例77%で差があった。K-ras変異は両群とも稀であった。変異パターンは縦隔腫瘍の原発性と転移性の鑑別に役立つ可能性が示唆されている。
pmid-8816895.summary_en: This study compared 13 primary mediastinal seminomas with 13 testicular seminomas using K-ras-2 exon-1 sequencing and p53 immunohistochemistry. P53 staining was weaker and less frequent in mediastinal tumors (31%) than testicular tumors (77%). K-ras codon 12 and 13 mutations were rare in both groups, with one mediastinal and two testicular cases mutated. The authors suggest that codon mutation patterns may help distinguish primary from metastatic origin of mediastinal seminomas.

pmid-8821703.summary_ja: 若年患者に生じた同時性両側精巣胎児性癌の症例報告である。後腹膜リンパ節転移を伴うIIb期であった。両側根治的精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の代わりに精巣温存手術を行い、PEB化学療法を施行した。良好な生活の質が得られた。慎重に選択された症例では、両側精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対して温存手術が検討しうることを示す。
pmid-8821703.summary_en: A young patient with synchronous bilateral embryonal carcinoma of the testis and retroperitoneal lymph node involvement (stage IIb) is described. Instead of bilateral radical orchiectomy with retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, testis-sparing surgery was performed, followed by systemic PEB chemotherapy. The patient achieved good quality of life. The management decision and a literature review are presented. The case suggests that conservative surgery may be considered in carefully selected bilateral testicular germ cell tumors to preserve endocrine function and quality of life.

pmid-8822204.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株F9にFGF-4を恒常的に発現させ、増殖、分化、軟寒天コロニー形成能への影響を検討した。FGF-4の持続発現は形態学的分化や分化関連遺伝子の発現を変えず、増殖にも影響しなかった。分化に伴う腫瘍原性の喪失は、FGF-4遺伝子の抑制だけでは説明できないと結論づけている。
pmid-8822204.summary_en: This study examined whether constitutive expression of fibroblast growth factor-4 (FGF-4) alters the growth, differentiation, or tumorigenicity of F9 embryonal carcinoma cells. F9 cells were transfected with a plasmid driving FGF-4 expression from the human beta-actin promoter. Sustained FGF-4 expression did not block morphological differentiation, did not change expression of six differentiation-regulated genes, and did not alter growth before or after differentiation. It also did not restore colony formation in soft agar. The authors conclude that FGF-4 gene repression after differentiation is not, on its own, responsible for the loss of tumorigenicity.

pmid-8823477.summary_ja: 進行胚細胞腫瘍の未治療男性20例を対象に、5剤併用のVIP/VB療法を評価した第II相試験である。11例(55%)が化学療法単独で完全寛解に至り、さらに5例が外科的切除後に無病となった。再発は2例、ブレオマイシン肺毒性による治療関連死は1例であった。観察期間中央値20か月で65%が生存し無病であった。グレード3または4の白血球減少症は80%に認められた。著者らは、VIP/VBは非常に有効であるが血液毒性が強いと結論づけている。
pmid-8823477.summary_en: This phase II trial evaluated the five-drug VIP/VB regimen (etoposide, ifosfamide, cisplatin, vinblastine, bleomycin) in 20 treatment-naive men with advanced germ-cell tumor. Eleven patients (55%) achieved complete remission with chemotherapy alone, and five more became disease-free after surgical resection. Two patients relapsed. One treatment-related death from bleomycin lung toxicity occurred. At a median follow-up of 20 months, 65% were alive and disease-free. Grade 3 or 4 leukopenia was common, affecting 80% of patients. The authors conclude that VIP/VB is highly active but hematologically toxic.

pmid-8825026.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoを、マトリゲル上、poly-HEMAコート面、浮遊スフェロイドの3条件で培養し分化を比較した。絨毛性ゴナドトロピン産生は基質に接着した凝集体で増加したが、浮遊スフェロイドでは増加しなかった。細胞間通信より基質への接着と物理的性質が分化の決定因子であると結論づけている。
pmid-8825026.summary_en: This study examined how matrix contact and cell-cell interactions affect differentiation of BeWo choriocarcinoma cells. Cells were grown as aggregates on Matrigel gels, on poly-HEMA-coated plastic, or as suspended spheroids. Chorionic gonadotropin production was increased in aggregates attached to gels or poly-HEMA but not in suspended spheroids. E-cadherin expression was unchanged, and gap-junction communication was absent in all aggregates. Differentiation markers were distributed randomly regardless of contact with the gel. The authors conclude that substrate anchorage and physical properties, rather than cell-cell communication, drive differentiation in these cultures.

pmid-8826863.summary_ja: 進行期セミノーマ27例に対し、シクロホスファミド、ビンクリスチン、カルボプラチン（COC）を外来で施行した成績を報告している。完全奏効は6例、部分奏効は19例であった。中央値26カ月の観察で治療失敗は1例のみで、血液毒性が主な毒性であった。外来治療として実施可能で有効と結論づけている。
pmid-8826863.summary_en: This study reports the efficacy and toxicity of cyclophosphamide, vincristine, and carboplatin (COC) given on an outpatient basis for 27 patients with advanced seminoma. Six patients (22%) achieved complete response, and 19 (70%) had partial response. Two patients showed only marker response without mass reduction. Post-chemotherapy masses were not resected or irradiated. At a median follow-up of 26 months, only one of 27 patients had treatment failure. Hematological toxicity was common and required dose reduction in five patients. The authors conclude that COC is feasible and effective as an outpatient regimen, even after prior radiotherapy.

pmid-8828260.summary_ja: 帝王切開術の12日後に腹腔内出血を来した女性の症例である。開腹術で脾破裂が確認され脾摘出術が行われ、病理学的に転移性絨毛癌と診断された。多剤併用化学療法で良好な反応が得られた。妊娠可能年齢の女性で腹腔内出血を見た場合は、転移性絨毛癌を鑑別に入れるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-8828260.summary_en: This case report describes a woman who developed intraperitoneal hemorrhage twelve days after cesarean section. Laparotomy revealed a ruptured spleen with active bleeding, and splenectomy was performed. Histopathology showed metastatic choriocarcinoma. Multiagent chemotherapy produced a good response. The authors note that this is the fourth reported case of metastatic choriocarcinoma causing splenic rupture as the main sign of acute hemoperitoneum. They conclude that metastatic choriocarcinoma should be considered in women of childbearing age presenting with intraperitoneal bleeding.

pmid-8828426.summary_ja: 妊娠関連主要塩基性タンパク(PAMBP)の血清値を、良性と悪性の絨毛性疾患の鑑別マーカーとして検討した研究です。正常妊娠、部分・完全胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、絨毛癌の7群で比較しました。侵入奇胎は絨毛癌と区別できず、血清値の低下は悪性度の高い腫瘍を示唆する可能性があります。
pmid-8828426.summary_en: This study evaluated serum pregnancy-associated major basic protein (PAMBP) as a marker distinguishing benign from malignant trophoblastic disease. Levels were compared across seven groups, including normal pregnancy, partial and complete moles, persistent moles, placental-site trophoblastic tumors, and choriocarcinoma. Partial and complete moles had elevated levels similar to normal pregnancy, whereas persistent moles, placental-site trophoblastic tumors, and choriocarcinoma showed low levels comparable to nonpregnant controls. Persistent moles could not be distinguished from choriocarcinoma. Low levels may therefore suggest a more aggressive or malignant trophoblastic tumor.

pmid-8831215.summary_ja: 腹腔内の停留精巣に生じた、CA19-9産生性の混合型胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告です。43歳男性で、AFP、β-hCG、CA19-9が上昇していました。CEB化学療法3コース後に腫瘍を切除し、組織では化学療法による壊死と、神経・筋・消化管組織からなる奇形腫成分が認められました。
pmid-8831215.summary_en: This is a case report of a 43-year-old man with a CA19-9-producing mixed germ cell tumor arising in an undescended testis located in the abdomen. Serum AFP, β-hCG, and CA19-9 were elevated, and CT showed a large encapsulated solid and multilocular cystic mass. After three cycles of CEB chemotherapy (carboplatin, etoposide, bleomycin), the tumor was resected. Histology showed extensive necrosis from chemotherapy, with a teratoma component containing neural, muscular, and digestive tissue. The authors describe this as a rare presentation of a mixed germ cell tumor in an abdominal undescended testis.

pmid-8831562.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoをクローニングし、浸潤能の異なる2つのクローンを単離した研究です。浸潤性のMC-2クローンは、ゼラチナーゼAの分泌が多く、ヌードマウスで微小転移を伴う大きな腫瘍を形成しました。浸潤能はゼラチナーゼAの発現と活性化に相関することが示されました。
pmid-8831562.summary_en: This study cloned BeWo choriocarcinoma cells to isolate two clones with distinct behaviors resembling villous and extravillous cytotrophoblasts. The invasive clone MC-2 invaded collagen gels, secreted more gelatinase A, and formed larger tumors with micrometastases in nude mice, whereas clone MC-1 was noninvasive and formed localized tumors. Laminin and Matrigel increased gelatinase A production, and type I collagen activated progelatinase A in invasive cells. The findings show a correlation between invasion and gelatinase A expression and activation, providing a model for studying implantation and tumor invasion.

pmid-8832559.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍326例のレビューで、精索への腫瘍混入と真の浸潤を検討した研究です。精索内に腫瘍を認めた79例のうち、大半は混入でした。真の浸潤は胎児性癌で多く、切除断端への浸潤は再発リスクの高さを示します。厳密な検体取り扱いで混入を防ぐことが推奨されています。
pmid-8832559.summary_en: This review of 326 testicular germ cell tumors examined spermatic cord involvement and found tumor in the cord in 79 cases. Of these, 72.1% were contamination, 19% were true involvement, and 8.9% were both. Contamination was most frequent in seminomas, while true involvement was most common in embryonal carcinoma. Distinguishing the two can be difficult, but true involvement at the cord resection margin identifies patients at high risk of relapse. The authors recommend meticulous specimen handling to prevent contamination caused by inadequate precautions.

pmid-8833238.summary_ja: 1996年の『Mammalian Genome』誌掲載のこの論文は、免疫刻印を受けたトランスジーン構築物を保有するトランスジェニックマウス系統TG.KDについて報告している。この系統のヘミ接合体の雌の15～20%では、混合型胚細胞腫瘍の形態を示す悪性卵巣奇形腫が発生する。腫瘍はしばしば転移し、致死的となることがある。遺伝学的解析により、腫瘍の発生は第8染色体上のトランスジーン挿入部位と関連づけられ、ホモ接合体では周産期致死も引き起こされる。同一の構築物を持つ近交系FVB/Nマウスでは、この挿入がない場合に奇形腫は発生しなかった。ヘミ接合体の遺伝子型から、腫瘍は減数分裂I期完了前の初期の胚細胞に由来すると考えられる。
pmid-8833238.summary_en: This 1996 Mammalian Genome paper describes transgenic mouse line TG.KD, carrying an imprinted transgene construct, which develops malignant ovarian teratomas with mixed germ cell tumor morphology in 15 to 20% of hemizygous females. The tumors often metastasize and can be fatal. Genetic analysis links tumor development to the transgene integration site on chromosome 8, which also causes perinatal lethality in homozygotes. Inbred FVB/N mice carrying the same construct without this integration did not develop teratomas. The hemizygous genotype suggests that tumors arise from early germ cells before completion of meiosis I.

pmid-8833382.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の総説で、精巣腫瘍患者に対して反対側精巣の生検を行うべきかを論じている。両側性腫瘍は約5%にみられ、反対側生検では5〜6%で上皮内癌(CIS)が検出される。未治療のCISはほぼすべて浸潤性胚細胞腫瘍に進行する。生検の実施は国によって異なり、米国では初回精巣摘除時の生検は推奨されていないとされる。CISの診断は最適な治療選択のために重要であると結論づけている。
pmid-8833382.summary_en: This 1996 Seminars in Urologic Oncology review addresses whether the contralateral testis should be biopsied in patients with testicular tumors. Bilateral tumors occur in about 5% of cases, and contralateral biopsy reveals carcinoma in situ (CIS) in 5 to 6% of patients. Virtually all untreated CIS progresses to invasive germ cell tumor. The authors note that biopsy practice varies by country and that US policy discourages contralateral biopsy at initial orchiectomy. They argue that CIS diagnosis enables optimal treatment.

pmid-8833383.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の論文で、精巣がんに必要な病期分類のための検査を概説している。適切な腫瘍マーカー、後腹膜画像検査、胸部画像検査、原発腫瘍の病理組織学的解析を取り上げる。これらを組み合わせることで比較的正確な臨床病期を決定できるが、病期診断の誤差はゼロにはできないと述べている。正確な病期分類は治療選択に不可欠であると結論づけている。
pmid-8833383.summary_en: This 1996 Seminars in Urologic Oncology article reviews the staging investigations needed for testicular cancer. It discusses appropriate tumor markers, retroperitoneal imaging, chest imaging, and careful histopathological analysis of the primary tumor. The authors note that combining these modalities yields a reasonably accurate clinical stage, though some staging error persists and cannot be eliminated entirely. Accurate stage classification is essential for choosing therapeutic options.

pmid-8833385.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の論文で、低容量の病期II病変に対する伝統的治療法としての後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPL)を検討している。病期診断の正確性、手術と化学療法の合併症の比較、適応となるRPLの種類、神経温存手術の可否を論じる。さらに、病期II非セミノーマに対する施設の治療成績も報告している。
pmid-8833385.summary_en: This 1996 Seminars in Urologic Oncology article examines retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy (RPL) as the traditional treatment for clinical stage II low-volume disease. The authors discuss staging accuracy, the morbidity of surgery compared with chemotherapy, which RPL type is indicated, and whether nerve-sparing surgery is feasible. They also report institutional results for stage II nonseminomas.

pmid-8833386.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の総説で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後の病期II非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する二つの方針を比較している。シスプラチン併用の補助化学療法と、再発時に化学療法を行うサーベイランスである。結節病変が少ない症例ではサーベイランスが適するが、結節病変が多い症例では再発率が50〜90%に達するため補助化学療法が強く考慮される。エトポシド併用の補助化学療法は、ビンブラスチン系レジメンより忍容性が高く有効であると報告されている。
pmid-8833386.summary_en: This 1996 review compares two strategies for pathological stage II nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor after retroperitoneal lymph node dissection: adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy versus surveillance with salvage chemotherapy. The choice depends on nodal involvement and patient compliance. Surveillance suits patients with minimal nodal disease, whereas high-volume nodal disease carries a relapse rate of 50 to 90% on surveillance, making adjuvant chemotherapy a strong consideration. A prospective trial found etoposide plus cisplatin adjuvant therapy highly effective and better tolerated than vinblastine-based regimens.

pmid-8833387.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の論文で、少量転移性非セミノーマに対する初回化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)の治療成績を比較している。ロイヤル・マーズデン病院の122例では5年生存率が97%であった。化学療法後のリンパ節郭清を受けた35例のうち射精障害を生じたのは5例のみであった。著者らは、病期II精巣非セミノーマに対して初回化学療法はRPLNDの妥当な代替手段であると結論づけている。
pmid-8833387.summary_en: This 1996 review argues that for small-volume metastatic nonseminoma, primary chemotherapy after orchidectomy cures as high a proportion of patients as retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Royal Marsden Hospital data from 122 patients showed 97% five-year survival, and only 5 of 35 patients who underwent postchemotherapy lymphadenectomy lost ejaculation. The authors conclude that primary chemotherapy is a reasonable alternative to RPLND for stage II testicular nonseminoma.

pmid-8833388.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の総説で、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療後の妊孕性を検討している。治療前および治療関連の乏精子症が将来の妊孕性を損なう可能性がある。神経温存術の普及により低病期のRPLND後の射精障害はほぼ解消され、シスプラチン併用化学療法の多くの患者は無精子症となるが、4年以内に大半が精子形成を回復する。生存精子が存在する場合は精子凍結保存を提案すべきと勧告している。
pmid-8833388.summary_en: This 1996 review addresses fertility after testicular germ cell tumor treatment. Pretreatment and treatment-related subfertility may complicate future fertility. Nerve-sparing techniques have nearly eliminated ejaculatory dysfunction after low-stage RPLND, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy causes azoospermia in nearly all patients, most of whom recover spermatogenesis within four years. Assisted reproduction and semen cryopreservation offer hope for those without spontaneous recovery. The authors recommend offering semen cryopreservation whenever any viable sperm are present.

pmid-8833389.summary_ja: 1996年のSeminars in Urologic Oncology誌の論文で、低容量の非セミノーマ性精巣がん治療後にどの程度の頻度でフォローアップすべきかを検討している。文献と自施設のデータから、病期IおよびIIの再発パターンを解析した。最も厳格なプロトコルは、サーベイランス中の病期Iと、RPL後の病期IIに適用すべきとしている。再発は治療後1〜2年に最も多く、各受診時に診察と腫瘍マーカー測定を行うべきと述べている。
pmid-8833389.summary_en: This 1996 review considers how intensive follow-up should be after treatment for low-volume nonseminomatous testicular cancer. The authors examined literature and their own data on failure patterns in stages I and II after RPL and stage I on surveillance. They conclude that the most rigorous protocols suit stage I on surveillance and stage II after RPL, that relapse risk is highest in the first 1 to 2 years, and that physical examination and marker determination should accompany every visit. Abdominopelvic CT is generally unnecessary where RPL has sterilized the retroperitoneum.

pmid-8833994.summary_ja: 20歳男性の剖検で発見された原発性肺悪性奇形腫の症例報告である。卵黄嚢成分を含み、右中葉と上葉に病変があった。同時に細胞期の骨髄線維症を合併し、肝、脾、リンパ節、副腎などに骨髄外造血（骨髄化生）が認められた。性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と血液腫瘍の稀な合併例として重要である。
pmid-8833994.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old man with a primary pulmonary malignant teratoma containing yolk sac tumor elements, discovered at necropsy. The lesion arose in the right middle and upper lobes. The patient also had concurrent cellular-phase myelofibrosis with extramedullary myeloid metaplasia involving the liver, spleen, lymph nodes, adrenal gland and lung. The authors highlight this unusual extragonadal germ cell tumor coexisting with a hematologic neoplasm.

pmid-8836792.summary_ja: 思春期前の小児に生じた精巣の類皮嚢胞を、精巣を温存して切除した症例報告である。類皮嚢胞には奇形腫成分を伴うことがあるが、小児の精巣奇形腫は一般に良性である。したがって小児の精巣腫瘍に対しては精巣温存手術が適応となりうると結論している。
pmid-8836792.summary_en: This report describes a prepubertal child with an epidermoid cyst of the testis that was excised while preserving the testis. The authors note that although such cysts may contain a teratomatous component, testicular teratomas in prepubertal children are generally benign. They conclude that testis-sparing surgery may be appropriate for childhood epidermoid cysts, avoiding unnecessary orchidectomy in this rare, typically benign lesion.

pmid-8838863.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株PCC4.aza1Rにおけるレチノイン酸誘導性分化の調節機構を検討した基礎研究である。RAR選択的リガンドは形態学的分化と初期遺伝子発現を誘導したが、RXR選択的リガンドは誘導しなかった。分化不全の2つの変異株は、分化過程の異なる段階で障害を受けていた。
pmid-8838863.summary_en: This study investigates how retinoid signaling controls differentiation of embryonal carcinoma PCC4.aza1R cells into mesenchymal-like cells. Using retinoid receptor-selective ligands and an antagonist, the authors show that RAR-selective activation induces morphological differentiation and early gene expression, while RXR-selective activation does not. They also characterize two differentiation-defective mutant lines, which are impaired at different stages of the program.

pmid-8838883.summary_ja: T1強調像で高信号を示す卵巣病変31例を対象に、化学シフト勾配エコー法MRIで嚢胞性奇形腫と子宮内膜症性嚢胞を鑑別できるかを検討した。信号強度指数は子宮内膜症性嚢胞で2.1未満、嚢胞性奇形腫で18.1以上と明確に分かれた。簡便で有用な鑑別法であると結論している。
pmid-8838883.summary_en: This study evaluates chemical shift gradient echo MRI for distinguishing ovarian cystic teratomas from endometriomas in 22 patients with 31 high-signal lesions on T1-weighted images. Signal intensity indices were uniformly low for endometriomas (below 2.1) and high for cystic teratomas (18.1 or greater), giving clear separation. The authors conclude that this simple technique is a useful alternative for differentiating these two lesions.

pmid-8838978.summary_ja: 67歳女性の右卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じたムチン産生性腺癌の症例報告である。推定病期Icの卵巣癌として手術と補助化学療法（シスプラチン、アドリアマイシン、シクロホスファミド）が行われた。腫瘍は嚢胞壁を越えて進展していたが治療は成功した。卵巣奇形腫の稀な悪性転化例である。
pmid-8838978.summary_en: This case report describes a 67-year-old woman with mucin-producing adenocarcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma of the right ovary, diagnosed as probable stage Ic ovarian cancer. She underwent hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy and omentectomy, followed by adjuvant cisplatin, doxorubicin and cyclophosphamide. Treatment was successful even though the tumor had extended through the cyst wall, illustrating a rare malignant transformation of ovarian teratoma.

pmid-8840488.summary_ja: 単一施設で治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍299例を検討し、27例（9%）の死亡を解析した。死因は進行性疾患が59%、治療関連が22%であった。死亡例の78%は非セミノーマ性腫瘍であった。一部の死亡は依然として回避可能であり、再発や治療毒性への対策が必要と結論している。
pmid-8840488.summary_en: This single-centre study reviews 299 patients with germ cell testicular tumours, of whom 27 (9%) died. Most deaths resulted from progressive disease (59%), with treatment-related deaths accounting for 22%. Non-seminomatous tumours made up 78% of deaths. The authors conclude that some deaths remain potentially avoidable, highlighting the need for improved management of persistent or recurrent disease and of treatment toxicity.

pmid-8840489.summary_ja: 1979～1992年に当施設で治療したセミノーマ79例のうち、進行例19例をシスプラチン併用化学療法で治療した症例シリーズ。治療関連死を2例認めた。導入化学療法後に残存後腹膜腫瘤を有した10例で後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行い、大半は壊死または線維化であった。導入化学療法が最適であり、3cm超の残存腫瘤には郭清が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-8840489.summary_en: This 1979-1992 single-institution series of 79 seminoma patients focuses on 19 with advanced disease treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Two treatment-related deaths occurred, one from progressive disease and one from chemotherapy-associated sepsis leading to heart failure. Of 10 patients with residual retroperitoneal masses after induction chemotherapy who underwent RPLND, most had necrosis or fibrosis, while one had viable seminoma. The authors conclude that inductive chemotherapy is the preferred strategy and that residual masses larger than 3 cm warrant RPLND.

pmid-8841257.summary_ja: 25歳女性の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍症例。子宮底前壁の筋層に限局し、MRIで局在を確認した。子宮摘出術ではなく子宮切開による局所切除と子宮再建を行い、断端は陰性で再発はなかった。その後の妊娠は帝王切開で満期分娩に至った。妊孕性を望む限局例では保存的手術を考慮しうると述べている。
pmid-8841257.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old woman with placental site trophoblastic tumor confined to the anterior fundal myometrium, diagnosed by curettage and immunostaining for hCG and human placental lactogen. Endovaginal ultrasonography and MRI localized the lesion. Instead of hysterectomy, she underwent local excision by hysterotomy with uterine reconstruction, with tumor-free margins and no recurrence. A subsequent pregnancy ended at term by cesarean with an intact scar. The authors suggest conservative surgery may be considered in selected patients who desire fertility preservation.

pmid-8841507.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者49例を対象とした前向き研究で、治療は摘出した原発腫瘍の病理組織によって層別化された。胎児性癌が主体で脈管侵襲のある患者は、補助化学療法を受け、病勢進行は認められなかった。奇形腫が主体の患者は後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受け、40%が病理学的病期IIへ進展した。脈管侵襲のない患者はサーベイランスを受け、15%が再発し救済療法により治癒した。全生存率は97.9%であった。著者らは、脈管侵襲のない病期I患者に限りサーベイランスを推奨すると結論づけている。
pmid-8841507.summary_en: This prospective study of 49 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell testicular tumors stratified treatment by primary tumor histology after orchiectomy. Patients with vascular invasion and embryonal carcinoma predominance received two cycles of adjuvant BEP chemotherapy without progression. Those with vascular invasion and teratoma predominance underwent primary RPLND, with 40% upstaged to pathologic stage II. Patients without vascular invasion were kept under surveillance, with 15% relapsing and salvaged successfully. Overall survival was 97.9%, and the authors recommend surveillance only for stage I patients without vascular invasion.

pmid-8843960.summary_ja: 肺転移を伴う胚細胞性精巣がん28例にBEP初回化学療法を施行した症例シリーズ。75%が完全奏効に至り、残存病変に対して化学療法後手術を12例で施行した。全体治癒率は89.3%。残存病変は画像で組織型が判定できないため、検出された病変はすべて切除すべきと提案している。
pmid-8843960.summary_en: This Neoplasma series reports 28 men with germ cell testicular cancer and pulmonary metastases treated with primary BEP chemotherapy. Complete response was achieved in 75%, and 12 patients underwent postchemotherapy surgery for residual masses, mainly pulmonary and retroperitoneal. The overall cure rate was 89.3% at a mean follow-up of 19.7 months. Two patients died, one from progression during chemotherapy and one from postoperative respiratory failure. The authors recommend resecting all radiologically detected residual lesions, since imaging cannot reliably determine histology.

pmid-8843962.summary_ja: 17歳女性の症例報告。1993年12月の胞状奇胎妊娠の後、1994年1月に絨毛癌が発生し、同年6月に人工妊娠中絶が行われた。DNA解析により絨毛癌は先行する胞状奇胎妊娠に由来することが証明された。妊娠が近接して起こった際の絨毛性腫瘍の起源判定にDNA解析が有用であることを示している。
pmid-8843962.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old woman who had a molar pregnancy in December 1993, followed by choriocarcinoma in January 1994 and an induced abortion in June 1994. DNA analysis established that the choriocarcinoma originated from the preceding molar pregnancy rather than from a separate gestation. The report illustrates how genetic analysis can clarify the origin of gestational trophoblastic tumors when pregnancies occur in close succession.

pmid-8846312.summary_ja: 胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍患者のMRI所見を提示した症例報告。子宮の接合部帯を変形させ筋層に浸潤する小さな限局性腫瘤を認めた。本腫瘍は攻撃性が高く臨床的に発見しにくいため、評価にMRIが有用である可能性を示唆している。単一症例の画像所見の記述である。
pmid-8846312.summary_en: This short imaging report presents magnetic resonance findings in a patient with placental site trophoblastic tumor. MRI showed a small focal mass that distorted the junctional zone and invaded the myometrium. Because this neoplasm is aggressive and difficult to detect clinically, the authors suggest MRI may be a valuable tool for evaluating such tumors. The report describes a single patient rather than a larger series.

pmid-8852449.summary_ja: 25〜57歳の女性に発生した卵巣類表皮嚢腫8例を報告した。嚢胞内腔は毛髪やロキタンスキー結節を欠く平滑な重層扁平上皮で覆われていた。3年間の婦人科検体の0.07%を占め、従来考えられるほど稀ではなく、類皮嚢腫として誤診されている可能性がある。著者らは単一胚葉性の高分化型奇形腫として分類すべきと主張している。
pmid-8852449.summary_en: This report describes eight cases of ovarian epidermoid cysts in women aged 25 to 57. The cysts were lined by smooth stratified squamous epithelium without hair or Rokitansky tubercles. They accounted for 0.07% of gynecologic specimens over three years, suggesting they are not as rare as the literature implies and are sometimes misdiagnosed as dermoid cysts. The authors propose that ovarian epidermoid cysts represent monodermal, highly differentiated teratomas and should be classified accordingly.

pmid-8854195.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値を示し、組織学的に妊娠性絨毛性疾患と確認された女性13例について、治療前後の骨盤MRI所見を検討した。子宮のびまん性腫大、局所腫瘤、子宮の層構造の消失、拡張した腫瘍血管が特徴的であった。4例の追跡検査では治療後にほぼ正常化した。MRI所見はhCG値や組織型と相関せず、絨毛性腫瘍の浸潤を反映する信頼性の高い所見と結論された。
pmid-8854195.summary_en: This study describes MRI findings in 13 women with elevated hCG and histologically proven gestational trophoblastic disease, before and after therapy. Common findings included diffuse uterine enlargement, focal masses, loss of zonal anatomy, and dilated tumor vessels. Follow-up scans in four patients showed normalization of these findings at 4 and 8 weeks. MRI findings did not correlate with hCG levels or histologic subtype, and the authors conclude that MRI reliably reflects trophoblastic infiltration.

pmid-8854733.summary_ja: 70歳男性の精巣成熟奇形腫に原発性カルチノイド腫瘍の成分が含まれていた症例。精巣摘除術を施行した。組織学的にカルチノイド形態を示し、免疫組織化学的にクロモグラニンおよびNSEが陽性、グリメリウス染色で親銀性顆粒を認めた。カルチノイド症候群は認めず、術後無病経過である。精巣成熟奇形腫内の稀な神経内分泌成分の報告である。
pmid-8854733.summary_en: A 70-year-old man with a testicular mature teratoma containing a primary carcinoid tumor component underwent unilateral orchiectomy. Histology showed carcinoid morphology within the teratomatous tumor, with immunohistochemical positivity for chromogranin and neuron-specific enolase and argyrophil granules on Grimelius staining. He had no symptoms of carcinoid syndrome and remained disease-free after surgery. The report highlights a rare neuroendocrine component within a mature teratoma of the testis.

pmid-8855077.summary_ja: 妊娠36週で健康な生児を出産した女性で、完全胞状奇胎の併存が判明した症例。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の臨床経過、超音波検査所見、フォローアップの推奨を述べている。完全奇胎でも正常胎児を満期まで妊娠継続でき、良好な経過をたどり得ると結論している。一般には持続性妊娠性絨毛性疾患や絨毛癌のリスクから妊娠中断が勧められる。
pmid-8855077.summary_en: A woman delivered a healthy, live infant at 36 weeks' gestation who was found to have a coexisting complete hydatidiform mole. The report describes clinical presentation, ultrasound findings, and follow-up recommendations for gestational trophoblastic disease. The authors conclude that a complete mole can coexist with a normal fetus that can be carried to term with a good outcome. They note that such pregnancies are usually recommended for termination because of risks of persistent disease or choriocarcinoma.

pmid-8855577.summary_ja: インド・マンガロールの一病理部門で38年間に診断された性腺外胚細胞腫瘍32例を解析した。多くは乳幼児および小児で、女児に多かった。好発部位は仙尾部で、後腹膜、縦隔が続いた。稀な部位として腸間膜、卵管、鞍上部が報告された。32例中27例が奇形腫で、その75%は良性であった。文献レビューを併せて報告している。
pmid-8855577.summary_en: This study analyzed 32 extragonadal tumors diagnosed over 38 years at a single pathology department in Mangalore, India. Most occurred in infants and children, predominantly females. The sacrococcygeal region was the most common site, followed by the retroperitoneum and mediastinum. Rare sites included the mesentery, fallopian tube, and suprasellar region. Twenty-seven of 32 cases were teratomas, 75% of which were benign. The paper also includes a review of the literature.

pmid-8856302.summary_ja: 満期妊娠の4か月後に発症した33歳女性の転移性絨毛癌の症例です。耳後部の頭皮結節が初発症状でした。EMA-CO療法に反応せず、肝・肺転移により1年後に死亡しました。満期妊娠後の絨毛癌は予後不良であり、寛解が得られない症例には移植を伴う大量化学療法を考慮すべきと提言しています。
pmid-8856302.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman developed metastatic choriocarcinoma four months after delivering a healthy term infant. The tumor presented as a scalp nodule behind the ear. Unlike choriocarcinoma after molar pregnancy, choriocarcinoma after a term pregnancy carries a poor prognosis. The tumor did not respond to EMA-CO chemotherapy, and she died of liver and lung metastases a year later. The authors suggest considering high-dose chemotherapy with transplantation for patients who do not achieve remission after EMA-CO.

pmid-8859614.summary_ja: 初回治療に成功してから10年後、残存する成熟型充実性卵巣奇形腫が悪性転化して腺癌となった症例である。この症例は、残存する成熟奇形腫が治療後も長年を経て進行しうることを示している。著者らは、残存成熟病変の患者には長期フォローアップが必要であると結論づけている。残存病変は永久に良性と見なすのではなく、監視が必要であることも示している。
pmid-8859614.summary_en: A patient with a residual mature solid ovarian teratoma developed adenocarcinoma through malignant transformation ten years after successful initial treatment. The case shows that residual mature teratoma can progress even many years after treatment. The authors conclude that patients with residual mature disease require long-term follow-up. The report illustrates the need for surveillance of residual lesions rather than assuming they are permanently benign.

pmid-8861313.summary_ja: フォン・ヒッペル・リンドウ病の患者で、12年前に切除された小脳血管芽腫と同じ部位に精巣胎児性癌が転移しました。非中枢神経系の胚細胞腫瘍が小脳に転移した稀な症例です。過去の手術部位に転移が生じうることを示しており、精巣腫瘍の転移形式として重要な報告です。
pmid-8861313.summary_en: A patient with von Hippel-Lindau disease had a cerebellar haemangioblastoma excised. Twelve years later, a testicular embryonal carcinoma metastasized to exactly the same site. This case illustrates a metastatic germ cell tumor appearing at a previous surgical site in the cerebellum. It is a rare presentation of a non-CNS germ cell tumor and shows that metastases can occur at sites of earlier surgery.

pmid-8861488.summary_ja: 先天性直腸肛門奇形腫の初めての報告例です。一般的な仙尾部奇形腫と異なり、腫瘍は尾骨から完全に分離していました。再発と悪性転化を防ぐため、完全な外科的切除が重要であると述べています。小児の奇形腫の管理と鑑別に関連する症例です。
pmid-8861488.summary_en: This report describes the first case of congenital anorectal teratoma. Unlike the more common sacrococcygeal teratoma, the tumor was completely disconnected from the coccyx and covered by mucomembranous tissue. The authors emphasize that complete surgical excision is important to prevent recurrence and malignant transformation. The case is relevant to pediatric teratoma management and to the differentiation of anorectal teratomas from sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-8862685.summary_ja: 1980年から1990年にヘルシンキで治療された精巣非セミノーマ71例の後方視的研究です。5年生存率は病期Iで91%、病期IIで94%、病期IIIで70%でした。病期IIは化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清の併用で良好な成績でした。病期IIIで失われた患者は、肝転移や高い腫瘍マーカー値などの不良因子を有していました。
pmid-8862685.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 71 testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated at Helsinki University Central Hospital from 1980 to 1990. Five-year survival was 91% for stage I, 94% for stage II, and 70% for stage III. Most stage I relapses had adverse histopathological risk factors. Stage II patients achieved good results with routine chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Patients lost in stage III all had poor-prognosis features such as liver metastases or very high serum markers.

pmid-8862714.summary_ja: EMA-COに抵抗性の高リスク転移性妊娠性絨毛性疾患の女性に、高用量パクリタキセルを投与したところ、脳転移を伴う難治例で血清学的寛解が得られた。難治性GTDに対するパクリタキセルの前臨床活性を支持する初めての臨床報告である。G-CSF支持下で忍容性も良好であった。
pmid-8862714.summary_en: This is the first clinical report of serologic remission with high-dose paclitaxel in a patient with highly refractory high-risk metastatic gestational trophoblastic disease. The patient had developed brain metastasis after multiple combined chemotherapy regimens and had failed EMA-CO. Paclitaxel (250 mg/m2 every 3 weeks) was well tolerated with G-CSF support. The authors suggest the result supports the preclinical activity of paclitaxel against refractory GTD, a setting without a standard salvage regimen.

pmid-8863564.summary_ja: 1988～1995年に化学療法後後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた472例のうち、神経温存手術を受けた81例を解析した。76.5%が正常な射精を維持し、後腹膜再発は認められなかった。適切に選択された精巣がん患者では、神経温存手技が後腹膜再発率を上げることなく妊孕性を温存できると結論づけている。
pmid-8863564.summary_en: This study reviewed 81 patients with testicular cancer who underwent nerve-sparing post-chemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection among 472 patients treated from 1988 to 1995. About 76.5% reported normal ejaculation at a mean follow-up of 35.5 months. Six patients had testicular cancer recurrence, none retroperitoneal. Ten pregnancies, seven of them term deliveries, were reported. The authors conclude nerve-sparing techniques preserve fertility without increasing retroperitoneal relapse.

pmid-8863671.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍35例で、p53関連蛋白を免疫染色、変異解析、酵母機能アッセイにより検討した。多くの腫瘍で野生型p53が過剰発現していたが、p53変異は検出されなかった。mdm2の過剰発現は一般的な説明にならず、p21も誘導されていないことから、p53が標的遺伝子を活性化できない転写不活性化が示唆された。
pmid-8863671.summary_en: Testicular germ cell tumours have been reported to express high levels of wild-type p53. In 35 tumours (seminomatous and nonseminomatous), the authors assessed p53 and related proteins by immunostaining, mutation screening and a yeast functional assay. Many tumours overexpressed wild-type p53 without p53 mutations, and mdm2 was often absent, so mdm2 does not explain p53 accumulation. p21 was not induced, suggesting p53 fails to activate target genes, which may explain why wild-type p53 is tolerated in these tumours.

pmid-8863984.summary_ja: 頸部正中の翼状片と奇形腫を有する7歳の女児を症例報告として記述している。著者らは、先天性の皮膚翼状片は稀であり、奇形腫は多能性の原始胚細胞に由来すると要約している。頸部の翼状片と奇形腫の間の未解明な関連についてレビューしている。性腺外奇形腫の症例報告として、本論文は奇形腫および胚細胞腫瘍関連疾患の領域に該当する。
pmid-8863984.summary_en: A 7-year-old girl with a cervical midline pterygium and a teratoma is described as a case report. The authors summarise that congenital skin pterygium is rare and that teratomas arise from pluripotent primordial germ cells. They review the undefined association between cervical pterygium and teratoma. As a case report of an extragonadal teratoma, the paper falls within the site's scope of teratoma and germ cell tumour-related disease.

pmid-8869591.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3とBeWoにおいて、一酸化窒素（NO）がヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分泌を抑制することを示した基礎研究です。NO供与体はhCG分泌を抑制し、NOS阻害薬はこれを増加させました。cGMP非依存的な経路の関与も否定できないと結論しており、胎盤ホルモン分泌の調節因子としてのNOの役割を支持する結果です。
pmid-8869591.summary_en: This study examined whether nitric oxide (NO) regulates hCG secretion in two choriocarcinoma cell lines, JEG-3 and BeWo. Both lines expressed an endothelial-type nitric oxide synthase, and the NO donor sodium nitroprusside suppressed hCG release, an effect reversed by the NO scavenger hemoglobin. Inhibiting NOS with L-NMMA increased hCG secretion, while cyclic GMP analogs reduced it. Cyclic GMP accumulation was not detected in response to SNP, suggesting that a partly cGMP-independent pathway may be involved. The findings support NO as a regulator of placental hormone secretion.

pmid-8870426.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の患者が、転移巣による脾破裂で急性腹痛を呈した稀な症例の報告です。両側卵巣奇形腫を伴い、原発巣は確認されませんでした。肝血管腫が初期の臨床像を混乱させた点も特徴です。絨毛癌が転移による自然破裂で発症しうることを示しています。
pmid-8870426.summary_en: A case report describes a patient with choriocarcinoma who presented with acute abdominal pain caused by splenic rupture from secondary deposits. Unusual features included bilateral ovarian teratomas and no evident primary lesion. Multiple hepatic hemangiomas initially confused the clinical picture. The report highlights that choriocarcinoma can present with spontaneous visceral rupture from metastases and that the primary site may not be identified.

pmid-8871007.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌の脳転移患者の症例報告です。脳転移巣は出血しやすく、化学療法の前の外科的切除は危険と判断されました。定位放射線治療の後に化学療法を行い、良好な結果が得られました。手術のリスクが高い場合の代替治療として有用であることを示しています。
pmid-8871007.summary_en: This report describes a patient with gestational choriocarcinoma metastatic to the brain. Because the brain lesions were hemorrhagic, surgical excision before chemotherapy was considered potentially hazardous. The patient was treated successfully with stereotactic radiosurgery followed by chemotherapy. The authors note that central nervous system involvement is not uncommon in metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma and that radiosurgery is an option when surgery carries high risk.

pmid-8872226.summary_ja: 頬部に生じた先天性奇形腫の稀な症例報告です。乳房様の形態を呈する非典型的な奇形腫として記載されています。報告は簡潔で、この稀な部位における形態学的特徴に焦点を当てています。頭頸部に発生した性腺外奇形腫の一例として参考になります。
pmid-8872226.summary_en: This case report describes a congenital teratoma of the cheek. The lesion was an atypical teratoma resembling a breast-like malformation. The report is brief and focuses on the morphological presentation of this rare head-and-neck location. It documents an extragonadal teratoma arising in an unusual site, which may interest clinicians managing congenital teratomas.

pmid-8874321.summary_ja: 再発または持続する予後不良の胚細胞腫瘍患者20例に対し、高用量ICE療法2コースと自家幹細胞支持を施行したパイロット試験です。治療関連死はなく、中央値45か月のフォローアップで9例が無病生存していました。予後不良例に有効な治療法として、高リスク症例の無作為化試験での検討に値すると結論しています。
pmid-8874321.summary_en: This pilot study evaluated two cycles of high-dose ifosfamide, carboplatin and etoposide (ICE) with autologous stem-cell support in 20 patients with poor-prognosis, chemotherapy-sensitive germ cell tumors that had relapsed or persisted. Toxicity was manageable, and there were no treatment-related deaths. With a median follow-up of 45 months, nine patients were alive and disease-free. The authors consider the regimen active in poor-prognosis patients and worthy of evaluation in randomized trials for high-risk disease.

pmid-8874322.summary_ja: 再発または難治性の胚細胞腫瘍の男性310例を対象に、大量化学療法の治療成績と予後因子を後方視的に解析した研究です。治療前の進行、縦隔原発非セミノーマ、シスプラチン抵抗性、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)高値が不良因子でした。2年無失敗生存率は良好群51%、中間群27%、不良群5%で、予後分類の有用性が示されています。
pmid-8874322.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 310 men with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors treated with high-dose chemotherapy and progenitor cell support identified prognostic factors for failure-free survival. Progressive disease before treatment, a mediastinal nonseminomatous primary, refractory disease to conventional cisplatin, and HCG above 1,000 U/L were independent adverse factors. Patients were stratified into good, intermediate and poor risk groups with 2-year failure-free survival of 51%, 27% and 5%. The specific regimen and higher carboplatin or etoposide doses did not significantly affect outcome.

pmid-8876902.summary_ja: 本研究はシンガポールで1980年から1995年に精巣セミノーマと診断された49例を後方視的に検討したものである。病期Iが71.4%を占め、鼠径部精巣摘除術後に放射線療法を施行された例が多かった。10年の無再発生存率と全生存期間(全生存率)はいずれも88.9%であった。長期的な治療毒性は少なかった。
pmid-8876902.summary_en: This retrospective Singapore series reviewed 49 patients treated for testicular seminoma over 15 years. Most were stage I. Most underwent inguinal orchidectomy followed by postoperative radiotherapy to para-aortic and iliac nodes, and nine also received chemotherapy. At 10 years, relapse-free and overall survival were both 88.9%. Long-term treatment toxicities were uncommon.

pmid-8877364.summary_ja: 5歳男児で生後2年目からProteus症候群と診断されていた。脂肪腫様腫瘍の中に隠れていた仙尾部奇形腫を切除した。奇形腫は出生時から存在していたと考えられる。報告時点で約50例のProteus症候群症例のうち、仙尾部奇形腫を合併した初めての例であった。
pmid-8877364.summary_en: A 5-year-old boy with Proteus syndrome, known since age two, was found to have a sacrococcygeal teratoma hidden within a lipomatous tumor, which was excised. The teratoma was presumably present since birth. Among about 50 published Proteus syndrome cases, this was the first with a concurrent sacrococcygeal teratoma. The report highlights a rare combination of overgrowth syndrome and germ cell tumor.

pmid-8877837.summary_ja: オンタリオ州の症例対照研究で、精巣の胚細胞腫瘍495例と対照974例の職業歴を組織型別に解析した。セミノーマおよび全体のリスクには職業による明確な関連は乏しかった。一方、非セミノーマは鉱夫、食品・飲料加工業者、公益事業従事者で有意にリスクが上昇した。
pmid-8877837.summary_en: This Ontario case-control study of 495 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 974 controls examined occupational risk by histologic type. Occupation showed little association with seminoma or overall risk. Nonseminoma risk was significantly increased among miners, food and beverage processors, and utilities employees. Leather-industry workers showed elevated but nonsignificant risk. The authors suggest an additional event may be needed to convert seminoma into nonseminoma.

pmid-8879254.summary_ja: 本総説は臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣がんの治療選択肢を概説している。待機観察、後腹膜リンパ節郭清、精巣摘除後の補助化学療法がある。血管侵襲と胎児性癌成分は潜在的な後腹膜転移の予測因子である。リスクに応じた層別化治療やp53遺伝子異常などの分子マーカーが検討されている。
pmid-8879254.summary_en: This review covers treatment options for clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular cancer: wait-and-see surveillance with chemotherapy at progression, retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy, and primary adjuvant chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Vascular invasion and embryonal carcinoma predict occult retroperitoneal metastases. Risk-adapted strategies stratify patients into high- and low-risk groups. Molecular markers such as p53 alterations may further refine stratification.

pmid-8882926.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、精巣摘除術後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行うか、サーベイランスとするかの判断を論じたレビューです。原発巣の胎児性癌の割合と血管侵襲が有用な予後因子とされ、フローサイトメトリーや増殖マーカーなどによるリスク層別化で過剰治療の回避が期待されると述べています。
pmid-8882926.summary_en: This review addresses clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ-cell cancer, where management after orchiectomy, either retroperitoneal lymph node dissection or surveillance, remains debated. As of 1996, the most useful prognostic factors in the primary tumor are the percentage of embryonal carcinoma and vascular invasion. The authors note that flow cytometry, image analysis, proliferation markers, and oncogene and tumor-suppressor gene markers may further refine risk stratification, allowing risk-adapted treatment that avoids overtreating many men.

pmid-8883418.summary_ja: シスプラチン時代に単施設で治療された転移性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍266例の長期成績を報告しています。3年全生存率は77%、無増悪生存期間は71%でした。肝・骨・脳転移や高度のhCG・AFP上昇などが予後不良因子とされ、そのような症例ではエトポシド含有レジメンが生存を改善したと述べています。
pmid-8883418.summary_en: This single-institution study reviews long-term outcomes in 266 consecutive patients with metastatic non-seminomatous germ cell tumours treated during the cisplatin era. The three-year overall survival was 77% and progression-free survival 71%. Poor-risk features included liver, bone or brain metastasis, markedly elevated hCG or AFP, a mediastinal mass over 5 cm, and 20 or more lung metastases. Etoposide-containing regimens improved survival in patients with at least one poor-risk factor. Late relapses and deaths underscore the need for long-term reporting.

pmid-8883763.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍41例に対する化学療法中の血清β-hCGの減衰曲線を解析した研究です。第一選択の化学療法で33例が生化学的寛解に至り、有効率は80%でした。β-hCGの減衰曲線は腫瘍の化学感受性を反映し、治療期間の推定や化学療法抵抗性の早期判断に役立つと述べています。
pmid-8883763.summary_en: This study examines how serum beta-hCG declines during chemotherapy in 41 patients with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including molar pregnancy and choriocarcinoma. Patients received single-agent or multidrug regimens, and decay curves were fitted to the data. First-line chemotherapy achieved biochemical remission in 33 patients, an efficacy rate of 80%. The authors suggest that beta-hCG decay curves reflect tumor chemosensitivity and can help estimate treatment duration and identify chemoresistance early, so treatment can be changed promptly.

pmid-8883774.summary_ja: 62歳女性が急性の胸水・腹水とCA 125の著明な上昇で受診し、超音波検査で付属器腫瘤を認めました。手術で良性の純粋型卵巣甲状腺腫と診断され、腫瘍摘出後に症状は速やかに完全消失しました。卵巣甲状腺腫が偽Meigs症候群と著明なCA 125上昇の両方を来した初の報告とされています。
pmid-8883774.summary_en: A 62-year-old woman presented with acute hydrothoraces, ascites, and a markedly elevated CA 125 level. Pelvic ultrasound revealed an adnexal mass with solid and cystic components. Surgery identified a benign pure struma ovarii, and her symptoms resolved completely and immediately after tumor removal. The authors describe this as the first report of struma ovarii causing both pseudo-Meigs syndrome and a marked CA 125 elevation. The case shows that a teratoma subtype should be considered when an ovarian mass presents with effusions and high CA 125.

pmid-8886077.summary_ja: 性腺外セミノーマの治療から21年後に、精巣腫瘍に似たLeydig細胞過形成を認めた症例を報告しています。性腺外セミノーマ患者は診断・治療後も長年経過してから原発性精巣腫瘍を発症する高いリスクがあるため、長期フォローアップが重要であると強調しています。
pmid-8886077.summary_en: This report describes Leydig cell hyperplasia that mimicked a testicular neoplasm in a patient treated for extragonadal seminoma 21 years earlier. The authors emphasize that patients with extragonadal seminoma carry a high risk of developing a primary testicular tumor many years after diagnosis and therapy. Long-term follow-up is therefore essential for proper management. They present this as the first documented case of Leydig cell hyperplasia mimicking a testicular neoplasm in this setting, a finding that can complicate surveillance decisions.

pmid-8886884.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）に生じた悪性黒色腫の2症例を報告し、1903年から1995年までの文献17例を追加して検討しています。原発性卵巣黒色腫は極めて稀で、転移性黒色腫との鑑別が重要とされています。近年は積極的な化学療法により予後が改善したと述べています。
pmid-8886884.summary_en: This paper reports two cases of malignant melanoma arising from melanocytes within mature ovarian cystic teratomas, also called dermoid cysts, and reviews 17 additional cases from 1903 to 1995. Primary ovarian melanoma is extremely rare and should be distinguished from metastatic melanoma by unilaterality, junctional change, and clinical history. The survival comparison shows 50% of patients with stage I dermoid-associated melanoma alive at two years, versus 89% of those with squamous carcinoma at five years. Survival has improved in recent years with aggressive chemotherapy.

pmid-8887115.summary_ja: 縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の女児乳児が、術前のPVB化学療法、外科的切除、術後化学療法により治療に成功した症例を報告しています。腫瘍縮小のための術前化学療法と、完全切除後の術後化学療法が治療成功の鍵であると論じ、縦隔卵黄嚢腫瘍の治療の最近の進歩にも言及しています。
pmid-8887115.summary_en: This case report describes a female infant successfully treated for a mediastinal yolk sac tumor. Treatment comprised four cycles of preoperative PVB chemotherapy, complete surgical resection, and postoperative PVB and VAC chemotherapy. The authors argue that success depends on preoperative chemotherapy to reduce tumor size before complete excision, followed by postoperative chemotherapy. The report also reviews recent advances in managing mediastinal yolk sac tumors, which are rare in young girls.

pmid-8889574.summary_ja: 40歳男性の縦隔・後腹膜・肺の多発腫瘍を当初性腺外胚細胞腫瘍と診断したが、左精巣の超音波検査で消失性腫瘍が疑われ精巣摘除術を施行した。組織学的に精巣の上皮内癌が判明し、エトポシドとシスプラチンによる化学療法で7か月間部分奏効が維持された。精巣が触知可能な症例でも精巣の精査が必要であると述べている。
pmid-8889574.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with lumbago and lower abdominal pain had multiple mediastinal, retroperitoneal, and lung tumors. A cervical lymph node biopsy suggested germ cell tumor, so an extragonadal primary was initially diagnosed. Ultrasonography of the left testis revealed a small 5 mm echogenic lesion, interpreted as a burned-out tumor, and orchiectomy was performed. Histology showed scar tissue and carcinoma in situ of the testis. Etoposide and cisplatin chemotherapy produced a partial response that was maintained for seven months. The authors advise examining the testes of extragonadal germ cell tumor patients even when they are normally palpable.

pmid-8892599.summary_ja: 14歳男児が縦隔未熟奇形腫の切除11か月後、化学療法中に肝脾腫を呈し、剖検で真性悪性組織球症と診断された。両病変はp53変異の部位が異なり多クローン性であった。悪性組織球症は未熟奇形腫とは独立して化学療法中に発生したと考察されている。胚細胞腫瘍治療に伴う稀な合併症を示す症例報告である。
pmid-8892599.summary_en: This autopsy case describes true malignant histiocytosis in a 14-year-old boy who developed hepatosplenomegaly during chemotherapy for a mediastinal immature teratoma resected 11 months earlier. Spleen and liver biopsies showed multinucleated atypical cells with erythrophagia that expressed macrophage markers. Both lesions expressed p53, but different mutations at codon 175 and codon 285 indicated polyclonality. The authors conclude that the histiocytic malignancy arose independently from the immature teratoma during chemotherapy. The report highlights a rare complication in germ cell tumor treatment.

pmid-8895354.summary_ja: 卵巣でBcl-2を過剰発現させたトランスジェニックマウスでは顆粒膜細胞のアポトーシスが抑制され、卵胞形成と排卵が増加した。高齢個体の20匹中4匹に良性嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫が生じ、対照には認められなかった。体細胞の生存亢進が胚細胞腫瘍形成を促す可能性が示唆された。
pmid-8895354.summary_en: Transgenic mice overexpressing Bcl-2 in ovarian cells showed reduced granulosa cell apoptosis, enhanced folliculogenesis, and higher ovulation and litter sizes. Aging transgenic mice also developed benign cystic ovarian teratomas (4 of 20), with respiratory, intestinal, and central nervous system-like tissue, whereas none of the wild-type controls did. The authors conclude that enhanced survival of somatic cells can promote germ cell tumorigenesis, offering a model for studying follicular atresia and ovarian somatic factors.

pmid-8895514.summary_ja: インプリンティング遺伝子IPWの対立遺伝子発現を正常組織と腫瘍で解析した研究。精巣胚細胞腫瘍と膀胱癌で両アレル発現が見られ、インプリンティングの消失が示唆された。単為発生由来の成熟奇形腫ではIPWが高発現した。胎児性癌細胞株Tera-2では分化誘導後もIPW発現は変わらず、H19やIGF2とは異なった。
pmid-8895514.summary_en: The authors examined allelic expression of the imprinted gene IPW in normal fetal and adult tissues and in tumors by RT-PCR. Biallelic IPW expression appeared in testicular germ cell tumor and bladder cancer, suggesting loss of imprinting, and H19 and IGF2 were also biallelically expressed in the same tumors. A parthenogenetic mature teratoma expressed high IPW. In the pluripotent embryonal carcinoma line Tera-2, IPW levels stayed constant during retinoic acid-induced differentiation, unlike H19 and IGF2, suggesting a housekeeping role.

pmid-8895763.summary_ja: LT/Sv系マウスは単為発生活性化した卵母細胞から自然発生的に卵巣奇形腫を生じる。BALB/cとC58由来の組換え近交系を用い、第一減数分裂中期停止は単為活性化に必要だが十分ではないことが示された。両形質があっても奇形腫を生じない系統があり、追加の許容アレルが必要と考えられた。
pmid-8895763.summary_en: Strain LT/Sv mice spontaneously develop ovarian teratomas from parthenogenetically activated oocytes, and their oocytes arrest at metaphase I. Using recombinant inbred strains derived from BALB/c and C58, the authors found that metaphase I arrest is necessary but not sufficient for parthenogenetic activation. Some strains with both traits still lacked teratomas, indicating extra permissive alleles are required. Segregation analysis suggested a single autosomal gene from C57BL/6J is responsible for high incidence in strain LTXBO.

pmid-8896386.summary_ja: 1990年にホーチミン市で行われた症例対照研究。妊娠性絨毛性疾患(胞状奇胎、絨毛癌)の87例と年齢・居住地を合わせた対照87例を比較した。既往出産数の増加と豚の飼育が危険因子として関連し、肉の摂取量は少なかった。枯葉剤の累積曝露指標と農薬使用では有意差は認められなかった。
pmid-8896386.summary_en: A 1990 case-control study in Ho Chi Minh City examined risk factors for gestational trophoblastic disease, including hydatidiform mole and choriocarcinoma, in 87 cases and 87 matched controls. Cases had more previous live births and raised more pigs, while eating less meat. Cumulative Agent Orange exposure, based on residence history, showed no significant association with risk, nor did agricultural pesticide use.

pmid-8898173.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3におけるインターロイキン6(IL-6)の役割を検討した。細胞はIL-6とその受容体、シグナル伝達分子gp130を発現していた。外から加えたIL-6や抗体による中和では増殖は変化しなかったが、IL-6 mRNAに対するアンチセンスオリゴヌクレオチドは増殖とIL-6産生を抑制した。細胞内オートクライン機構が示唆された。
pmid-8898173.summary_en: The authors studied the role of interleukin-6 in JEG-3, a human choriocarcinoma cell line. JEG-3 cells produced IL-6 and expressed its receptor and signal transducer gp130. Adding recombinant IL-6 did not stimulate growth, and neutralizing antibodies against IL-6, its receptor, or gp130 had no effect. Antisense oligonucleotides against IL-6 mRNA, however, suppressed both proliferation and IL-6 production, suggesting an intracellular autocrine mechanism. The authors propose antisense therapy may be more useful than antibody-based approaches.

pmid-8898183.summary_ja: 閉経前後の53歳女性が月経不順、骨盤痛、大きな骨盤内腫瘤と妊娠反応陽性で受診した。β-hCGとαフェトプロテイン(AFP)が高値で、開腹術により卵巣の胎児性癌と卵黄嚢腫瘍の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断された。多剤併用化学療法により無病生存を得た。高齢女性の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別診断と治療について考察している。
pmid-8898183.summary_en: A 53-year-old perimenopausal woman presented with irregular menses, pelvic pain, a large pelvic mass, and a positive pregnancy test. Elevated beta-hCG and AFP led to surgery, which revealed a mixed embryonal carcinoma and endodermal sinus germ cell tumor of the ovary. She received multiagent chemotherapy and remained disease-free. The authors review differential diagnosis and management of ovarian germ cell tumors in older women, noting that treatment and prognosis are similar regardless of age.

pmid-8899344.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の31歳男性に対し、手術およびガンマ線放射線療法の後にUkrainを投与した症例報告である。Ukrainは3コースにわたり週2回静脈内投与され、各コースの総量は200 mgであった。24か月の観察期間中、再発や転移は認められなかった。著者らは、複合治療の一部としてのUkrainが免疫状態を最適化し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の予後と治療成績を改善しうると示唆している。
pmid-8899344.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man with non-seminomatous germ cell tumour of the testis who received Ukrain after surgery and gamma-radiotherapy. Ukrain was given intravenously twice weekly over three courses, totalling 200 mg per course. No recurrence or metastases were observed over 24 months of follow-up. The authors suggest that Ukrain as part of complex treatment may optimise immune status and improve prognosis and treatment outcomes in non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-8899873.summary_ja: 本研究は、活性化型v-H-rasまたはv-K-rasがん遺伝子を絨毛癌細胞株CCIに導入し、その生物学的性質を解析したものである。v-H-rasを発現するクローンのみが胞胚様のドームを形成し、Na+-K+-ATPase活性も高かった。オアバインによりドームは減少したことから、同酵素活性がドームの維持に必要と示された。H-rasの活性上昇が絨毛細胞層を介する液体輸送を促すと考察している。
pmid-8899873.summary_en: This study transfected activated v-H-ras or v-K-ras oncogenes into the human choriocarcinoma cell line CCI. Only v-H-ras-expressing clones formed hemispherical domes resembling blastocysts, reflecting vectorial fluid transport. Na+-K+-ATPase activity was higher in H-ras clones, and ouabain treatment flattened the domes, showing that this activity is required for their maintenance. The authors suggest that up-regulated H-ras activity promotes fluid transport across the chorionic cell layer, which may be essential for embryogenesis and nutrient supply.

pmid-8900602.summary_ja: 本研究は、卵巣の類皮嚢腫（成熟嚢胞性奇形腫）を他の付属器腫瘤から鑑別する超音波検査の有用性を前向きに検討したものである。943名の女性の1,035個の付属器腫瘤を対象とし、典型的な所見の有無を評価した。感度94%、特異度99%、正確度98%と高い診断能を示し、超音波検査が卵巣腫瘤の鑑別に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-8900602.summary_en: This prospective study assessed the diagnostic performance of ultrasonography for distinguishing ovarian dermoid cysts (mature cystic teratomas) from other adnexal masses. Among 1,035 adnexal masses in 943 women who underwent surgery, sonographic features such as echogenic masses, dermoid plugs and intraovarian echogenic lesions were evaluated. Sensitivity was 94% and specificity 99%, with an overall accuracy of 98%. The authors conclude that ultrasonography is highly accurate for differentiating dermoid cysts from other ovarian masses.

pmid-8906012.summary_ja: 本研究は、完全・部分胞状奇胎および絨毛癌を含む妊娠性絨毛性疾患の診断における免疫組織化学の有用性を検討したものである。hCG、hPL、PLAP、サイトケラチン、ビメンチンに対する染色パターンを比較した。完全奇胎は強いhCG陽性と弱いPLAP陽性、部分奇胎は弱いhCGと強いPLAP、絨毛癌は強いhCGと弱いhPL・PLAPを示した。境界例の鑑別診断に有用な手段であると結論づけている。
pmid-8906012.summary_en: This study evaluates immunohistochemistry for diagnosing gestational trophoblastic disease, including complete and partial hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinoma. Nine complete moles, 20 partial moles and seven choriocarcinomas were stained for hCG, hPL, PLAP, cytokeratin and vimentin. Complete moles showed strong hCG and weak PLAP, partial moles weak hCG and strong PLAP, and choriocarcinoma strong hCG with weak hPL and PLAP. The authors conclude that immunohistochemistry is a useful tool for differential diagnosis in borderline cases.

pmid-8906667.summary_ja: 本研究は、思春期患者の良性嚢胞性奇形腫に対し、卵巣を温存しつつ外来で行える小開腹手技を報告したものである。特別な訓練や高価な器具を要さず、4例に合併症はなかった。平均手術時間は85分で開腹術と同程度であり、費用と侵襲の低減が示唆された。ただし結論にはより多数例のランダム化試験が必要とされる。
pmid-8906667.summary_en: This 1996 pediatric surgery report describes an ovary-conserving outpatient technique for removing benign cystic teratomas in teenagers via minilaparotomy. It requires no specialized training, laser devices, or costly disposable instruments. The first patient was observed as an inpatient for three days as a precaution, and the next three were treated as outpatients. None had complications, and mean operating time was 85 minutes, comparable to conventional laparotomy. The authors suggest cost savings and reduced morbidity, while acknowledging that a randomized trial with more patients is needed.

pmid-8908168.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫において、胚細胞腫瘍で典型的に見られるi(12p)様の小型メタセントリック染色体を検出した症例報告である。解析の結果、本染色体は12番染色体由来であるが、i(12p)ではないと結論づけている。卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞遺伝学的データは少なく、貴重な知見である。
pmid-8908168.summary_en: This short report describes a cytogenetic finding in an ovarian germ cell tumor, specifically a dysgerminoma. A small metacentric chromosome resembling the isochromosome i(12p) typically seen in germ cell tumors was identified. The authors show that this marker is a derivative of chromosome 12 but is not i(12p). Because cytogenetic data on ovarian germ cell tumors are limited, the case adds to understanding of recurrent chromosome 12 anomalies in these tumors.

pmid-8909261.summary_ja: 精巣・卵巣の胚細胞腫瘍、その前駆病変、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織におけるHERV-K転写産物を、in situハイブリダイゼーションで検討した研究である。奇形腫などを除く多くのGCTでHERV-K発現が認められ、悪性GTDでも発現がみられた。胚細胞腫瘍と悪性GTDの共通の分子病因を示唆し、上皮内癌を共通の前駆病変とする考えを支持している。
pmid-8909261.summary_en: This study used in situ hybridization on archival tissue to examine HERV-K gag and env transcripts in testicular and ovarian germ cell tumors, their precursors, and gestational trophoblastic disease. HERV-K expression was found in all germ cell tumors and testicular precursor lesions except mature and immature teratomas and spermatocytic seminoma. Malignant GTD (choriocarcinoma) expressed HERV-K, while benign molar pregnancy did not. The authors propose a shared molecular pathogenesis for GCT and malignant GTD, with implications for classification and support for carcinoma in situ as a common precursor.

pmid-8909317.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍18例に隣接する正常精巣内の上皮内癌（CIS）細胞を解析し、p53遺伝子の変化を検討した研究である。18例中12例でSSCP解析により変異が示され、7例では塩基配列で確認された。1例ではCISと腫瘍に同一の変異が認められ、CISからの単クローン性発生が示唆された。CISの悪性potentialとp53の関与を支持する結果である。
pmid-8909317.summary_en: This study examined p53 gene alterations in carcinoma in situ (CIS) cells found in normal testicular tissue adjacent to 18 germ cell tumors. CIS cells were isolated by microdissection using placental-like alkaline phosphatase staining. Mutational band shifts were found in 12 of 18 cases (66%), and sequencing confirmed point mutations in seven cases. One case showed an identical mutation in both CIS and the associated tumor, suggesting monoclonal development from CIS. The findings support malignant potential in testicular CIS and a role for p53 in germ cell cancer precursors.

pmid-8910077.summary_ja: 若年女性の悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の診断と治療をまとめた総説である。ディスジャーミノーマが最多で、卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫が続く。腫瘍マーカーはAFPとhCGが主に用いられ、治療効果判定と再発の早期発見に有用とされる。BEP療法などの現行治療と妊孕性への影響を論じ、新たな治療法への期待を述べている。
pmid-8910077.summary_en: This review addresses malignant ovarian germ cell tumors in young women, which account for most malignant ovarian tumors in preadolescents. Dysgerminoma is most common, followed by endodermal sinus tumor and immature teratoma. Among tumor markers, only AFP and hCG are routinely monitored, mainly to assess treatment response and detect recurrence early. The authors outline current regimens such as BEP, including their effect on fertility, and suggest that new surgical and chemotherapeutic approaches may further improve prognosis.

pmid-8910084.summary_ja: 妊娠中に手術で切除された卵巣腫瘍106例を検討した研究である。大半は良性で、類皮嚢腫（奇形腫）が最多であった。悪性は5例で、胎児性癌とディスジャーミノーマを含んでいた。術後の自然流産率は10%にとどまった。持続・増大する腫瘤には妊娠初期の手術による組織診断と悪性の除外を推奨している。
pmid-8910084.summary_en: This study reviews 106 ovarian tumors surgically resected during pregnancy. Most were benign, with dermoid cysts the most common lesion, and five were malignant, including one embryonal carcinoma and one dysgerminoma.
