The single case suggests a possible role for interferon therapy in this setting, although one patient cannot establish efficacy.

pmid-7563341.summary_ja: 低病期の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍143例のCTを後方視的に再検討し、後腹膜リンパ節径と病理学的病期の関係を解析した研究である。リンパ節径は0〜25mmの範囲で病理学的病期Bの確率と連続的に相関した。3mmを非転移性の閾値とすると、CTによる病期分類の感度と陰性的中率は90%であった。従来法より病期分類精度が向上すると結論づけられた。
pmid-7563341.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 143 CT scans from patients with low-stage nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, comparing retroperitoneal lymph node diameters with pathological stage. Node size correlated continuously with the likelihood of pathological stage B disease across a 0 to 25 mm range. Using a 3 mm threshold to define nonmetastatic nodes, CT-based staging achieved 90% sensitivity and negative predictive value. The authors conclude that size-based criteria improve staging accuracy over conventional CT interpretation.

pmid-7564144.summary_ja: 本報告は、小児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を治療した3つのGPO共同研究(MAHO-82、-88、-92)を要約したものである。137例のうち卵黄嚢腫瘍が多くを占め、次いで分化型奇形腫と悪性奇形腫であった。大半は病期Iであり、半去勢術後に経過観察または化学療法で管理された。標準療法はビンブラスチン、ブレオマイシン、シスプラチンを用い、生存腫瘍が疑われる場合には遅延開腹術を、必要に応じて救済療法を行った。観察期間中央値60か月における全体の無病生存率は97%であった。
pmid-7564144.summary_en: This report summarizes three cooperative GPO pediatric studies (MAHO-82, -88, -92) treating childhood testicular germ cell tumors. Among 137 patients, yolk sac tumors predominated, followed by differentiated teratomas and malignant teratomas. Most patients had stage I disease managed by semicastration with surveillance or chemotherapy. Standard therapy used vinblastine, bleomycin and cisplatin, with delayed laparotomy for suspected viable tumor and salvage therapy when needed. Overall disease-free survival was 97% at a median follow-up of 60 months.

pmid-7565312.summary_ja: 出生時に胎児母体間出血による重度の貧血を呈した乳児が、生後3週で肝腫瘍と肺転移を伴い死亡した症例報告である。剖検で絨毛癌と診断され、これにより同時期に肺転移を有していた母親の診断に至った。母親は治療に成功した。母児同時発症の報告例の文献的考察も加えられている。
pmid-7565312.summary_en: This case report describes a male infant who was severely anaemic at birth from feto-maternal haemorrhage and died at three weeks with a liver tumour and lung metastases. Postmortem examination revealed choriocarcinoma, which prompted diagnosis in the mother, who also had pulmonary metastases. The mother was successfully treated. The authors present the case in detail and review reported cases of simultaneous choriocarcinoma in mother and infant, highlighting the rarity and clinical significance of this presentation.

pmid-7566760.summary_ja: 1980年代にウェリントンの消防士で精巣がんが4例集積した事例を調査した研究である。4例はいずれも精巣胚細胞腫瘍と確認されたが、共通のリスク因子は見出されなかった。相対リスクは8.2（95%信頼区間2.2〜21）と高値であったが、偶然の可能性は除外できないとされた。ニュージーランドの他地域では上昇は認められなかった。
pmid-7566760.summary_en: This New Zealand cluster investigation examined four testicular cancer cases among Wellington fire fighters in the 1980s. All four were verified as germ cell testicular tumours, but no common risk factors emerged from medical records or interviews. The standardised incidence ratio was 8.2 (95% CI 2.2 to 21), indicating an unusually high risk, though chance could not be excluded. The authors found no evidence that fire fighters elsewhere in New Zealand had elevated rates, and noted that a separate investigation would be needed for the 1990s.

pmid-7567273.summary_ja: 小児の腹部に触知される腫瘤として発見された、極めてまれな胃奇形腫の症例報告である。CTで奇形腫に特徴的な嚢胞性成分と脂肪成分が確認され、胃由来であることが示された。胃奇形腫は良性で男性に多く、奇形腫全体の2%未満とされる。小児の固形腫瘤では、より悪性度の高い病変を除外する必要がある。
pmid-7567273.summary_en: This case report describes an extremely rare gastric teratoma presenting as a palpable abdominal mass in a child. CT demonstrated cystic and fatty components characteristic of teratoma and revealed the rare gastric origin of the lesion. The authors note that gastric teratomas are benign, predominantly occur in males, and account for less than 2% of teratomas. Clinicians should exclude more aggressive solid childhood masses when evaluating such presentations.

pmid-7567663.summary_ja: 15歳男児が胸痛と心雑音で受診し、心エコーで肺動脈狭窄と診断された。超音波検査で前縦隔の被膜を有する大型の嚢胞性腫瘤が主肺動脈を圧迫していた。切除により良性奇形腫と確定した。術後の超音波検査で流出路閉塞は消失した。
pmid-7567663.summary_en: A 15-year-old boy presented with chest pain and a new heart murmur, which echocardiography attributed to pulmonary stenosis. Ultrasonography revealed a large, encapsulated, partly solid and cystic anterior mediastinal mass compressing the main pulmonary artery. Surgical resection confirmed a benign teratoma. Postoperative ultrasound showed no outflow obstruction. The authors conclude that ultrasonography can make catheterization unnecessary and that removing an extrinsic cause can be curative.

pmid-7571033.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺性女性の14歳患者で、性腺芽腫と混合性胚細胞-性索間質腫瘍が同一腫瘍内に共存した。対側にディスジャーミノーマを伴い、子宮体部に播種を認めた。治療後7年の時点で生存して健康である。
pmid-7571033.summary_en: The authors describe a 14-year-old 46,XY phenotypically female patient with a gonadal tumor showing gonadoblastoma and mixed germ cell-sex cord stroma tumor features together. A contralateral dysgerminoma was also present. A subserosal implant of the mixed pattern was found in the uterine body. After therapy, the patient remained alive and well at 7-year follow-up. The paper discusses how to distinguish gonadoblastoma from mixed germ cell-sex cord stroma tumor.

pmid-7571184.summary_ja: 双生児でない2人の兄弟に、精巣胚細胞腫瘍が家族内で発生した。両側性で、発症間隔は16年と4年である。双生児でない兄弟における異時性・両側性精巣腫瘍の初報告とされる。文献的考察を含む。
pmid-7571184.summary_en: The authors report familial bilateral testicular germ cell tumors in two non-twin brothers. The tumors developed metachronously, after intervals of 16 and 4 years. The paper states that this is the first report of metachronous, bilateral testicular tumors in non-twin brothers. It includes a literature review on familial testicular germ cell tumor occurrence.

pmid-7571185.summary_ja: 両側停留精巣の既往を持つ性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例を報告した。この併存がまれである点を考察する。転移性胚細胞腫瘍では停留精巣の徹底的な精査が不可欠と強調する。
pmid-7571185.summary_en: The authors report a patient with an extragonadal germ cell tumor and a history of bilateral cryptorchidism. The rarity of this combination in one patient is discussed. The paper stresses that cryptorchid testes must be thoroughly investigated in patients with metastatic germ cell cancer. This case-based report highlights the importance of examining the testes in such patients.

pmid-7571973.summary_ja: 卵黄嚢腫瘍7例の穿刺吸引細胞診標本を検討した。好酸性の硝子様細胞質小体と基底膜様物質が特徴として認められた。組織所見と良好に相関した。細胞学的な予備診断は、その後の検査と治療計画に有用である。
pmid-7571973.summary_en: Fine needle aspiration biopsies from seven patients with yolk sac tumors were reviewed. Eosinophilic hyaline cytoplasmic bodies and irregular basement membrane-like deposits were readily recognized in aspirate smears. Some tumor cells contained cytoplasmic vacuoles, and these features correlated with histology. The authors conclude that cytologic recognition of yolk sac tumor is valuable for guiding further diagnostic studies and therapy planning. Yolk sac tumor affects children and adolescents.

pmid-7572150.summary_ja: 1965～1993年に同病院で登録された小児がん1026例を対象に、腫瘍の種類ごとの生存率の推移を解析した後方視的研究である。呼吸器、生殖器、胚細胞腫瘍（悪性奇形腫を含む）では生存率が大きく改善し、骨腫瘍では中等度であった。一方、横紋筋肉腫を中心とする軟部・結合組織腫瘍では改善が乏しかった。
pmid-7572150.summary_en: This Japanese retrospective analysis of 1,026 childhood cancer cases from 1965 to 1993 evaluated survival trends by tumor type. Survival improved considerably for respiratory, genital and germ cell tumors, including malignant teratomas, and moderately for bone tumors. Soft tissue and connective tissue tumors, mostly rhabdomyosarcoma, showed poor improvement. The study highlights that some relatively infrequent childhood neoplasms achieved substantial survival gains over three decades, while soft tissue sarcomas remained difficult to treat.

pmid-7572162.summary_ja: 2歳男児の病期I精巣卵黄嚢腫瘍症例の報告である。腫瘍は精巣静脈に浸潤していた。通常は精巣摘除術のみで足りるが、再発リスクを示す組織学的因子を有する症例では術後化学療法の必要性が議論されている。本症例は再発したが、シスプラチンを含む化学療法と後腹膜リンパ節郭清術により治療に成功した。組織学的因子に基づく治療方針の決定を考察する。
pmid-7572162.summary_en: This report describes a 2-year-old boy with stage I testicular yolk sac tumor that invaded the testicular veins. Although orchiectomy alone is often sufficient, high-risk histological features raise the question of postoperative chemotherapy. The patient developed recurrence, which was successfully treated with cisplatin-containing chemotherapy and retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. The authors discuss how histological risk factors should guide the decision between observation and adjuvant treatment in stage I testicular yolk sac tumor.

pmid-7573077.summary_ja: ドイツ・ハノーバーの精巣がん患者165例と対照187例を比較した症例対照研究である。金属加工業従事者はセミノーマおよび混合セミノーマ性腫瘍のリスクが有意に高かった（オッズ比2.05）。非セミノーマ性腫瘍全体ではリスク上昇はみられなかった。明確な原因物質は特定されず、動物実験に基づきカドミウムと亜鉛が考察された。
pmid-7573077.summary_en: This German case-control study of 165 testicular cancer patients and 187 hospital controls examined occupational exposures. Metalworkers had significantly higher odds of developing seminomas and mixed seminomatous tumors (OR 2.05). No increased risk was seen for nonseminomatous tumors overall, and metalwork history may even lower embryonal carcinoma risk. No single causative substance was identified, and the authors discuss cadmium and zinc based on animal data.

pmid-7574805.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の治療を総説した論文である。進行例の70～80%はシスプラチン併用療法で持続的な完全奏効を得るが、残りは治療抵抗性である。そうした患者に対する自家造血幹細胞移植を伴う大量化学療法の成績、安全性の向上、今後の展望が述べられている。奏効率は約50%で、生存者の約半数が無病生存を得ている。
pmid-7574805.summary_en: This Japanese review summarizes the management of germ cell tumors. Cisplatin-based chemotherapy cures most advanced GCT patients, but 20 to 30 percent are refractory. For these patients, high-dose chemotherapy with autologous hematopoietic stem cell transplantation has been used, with response rates around 50 percent and disease-free survival in about half of survivors. Treatment-related toxicity is manageable at current doses, and improved stem cell collection and growth factors have made the approach safer. Future multicycle or novel combinations may further improve outcomes.

pmid-7574821.summary_ja: 病期III非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍の4例にPOMB/ACE療法を行った報告である。3～4コース後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化し、肺および鎖骨上窩の転移は消失した。後腹膜リンパ節病変は3例で切除され、奇形腫や壊死組織が確認された。4例とも精巣摘除後2年以上再発なく生存しており、進行精巣腫瘍に有用な治療法と結論づけられている。
pmid-7574821.summary_en: This report describes four patients with stage III nonseminomatous testicular tumors treated with POMB/ACE chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Tumor markers normalized and lung and supraclavicular metastases resolved after 3 to 4 courses, but retroperitoneal nodes required excision in three patients. Two showed necrosis and one had teratoma. All four remained free of recurrence for 2 to nearly 7 years after orchiectomy, and the authors conclude that POMB/ACE is useful for advanced testicular tumors.

pmid-7576571.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍38例を対象に、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(ITGCN)周囲の細胞におけるβ2ミクログロブリンの発現を免疫組織化学で検討した研究である。陽性細胞は腫瘍の55%、セミノーマの60%で認められた。これらは腫瘍性胚細胞ではなくセルトリ細胞と同定された。正常な隣接精細管は陰性であり、腫瘍周囲の変化を示唆する。
pmid-7576571.summary_en: This study examined 38 testicular germ cell tumors, including 20 pure seminomas, for beta-2-microglobulin expression in the intratubular germ cell neoplasia surrounding them. Beta2m-positive cells were found in 55 percent of tumors and 60 percent of seminomas. These cells were identified as Sertoli cells rather than neoplastic germ cells, and staining was strongest in tubules with high neoplastic germ cell density. Normal adjacent tubules were negative, suggesting that Sertoli cells near tumors may express HLA class I components.

pmid-7577077.summary_ja: 1960～1990年のスコットランドにおける精巣がんの罹患数と死亡率の推移を示した研究である。1975～1989年に西スコットランドで治療された非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）患者440例の解析で、年齢は生存に影響する予後因子ではなかった。40歳超の5年生存率は71%で、若年者の79%との差は主に1980年以前の治療によると考察されている。高齢者にも根治を目的とした治療が推奨される。
pmid-7577077.summary_en: This Scottish study describes testicular germ cell cancer incidence and mortality from 1960 to 1990, with registrations more than doubling while mortality fell sharply. Among 440 patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated in the West of Scotland from 1975 to 1989, age was not a prognostic factor for survival. Patients over 40 had 71 percent five-year survival versus 79 percent in younger patients, a difference attributed to older patients being treated before 1980. The authors recommend curative-intent treatment for older patients.

pmid-7577486.summary_ja: 1983～1990年にスコットランドで精巣がんとして登録された患者を、専門腫瘍センターの記録と照合した研究である。部位や組織型の誤登録などの不一致が認められた。NSGCT患者の92%、セミノーマ患者の93%が専門センターに紹介されていた。紹介率は保健局管轄地域によって有意差がなく、居住地による受診格差は示されなかった。
pmid-7577486.summary_en: This Scottish study compared cancer registrations for testicular cancer from 1983 to 1990 with records at five specialist oncology centres. It found some coding errors, including wrong site or histology, and patients treated at centres without a registration. About 92 percent of NSGCT patients and 93 percent of seminoma patients were referred to specialist centres. Referral rates did not differ significantly by health board area, and the authors suggest true referral rates may be somewhat higher than measured.

pmid-7577487.summary_ja: 本スコットランドの監査は、1989年に精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍として登録された65例全例のカルテを検討した。一部の患者では診断の遅れが認められ、サーベイランスの検査、化学療法レジメン、臨床試験への登録に大きなばらつきがあった。3%が対側精巣の生検を受け、27%が外来フォローアップから脱落していた。著者らは、管理ガイドラインにより一貫性が向上し、経済的・心理的支援により脱落を減らせる可能性があると結論づけている。
pmid-7577487.summary_en: This Scottish audit reviewed casenotes of all 65 patients registered with testicular NSGCT in 1989. It found diagnostic delays in a few patients and wide variation in surveillance investigations, chemotherapy regimens and trial enrollment. Three percent had a contralateral testis biopsy and 27 percent defaulted from clinic follow-up. The authors conclude that management guidelines should improve consistency, and that financial and psychological support may reduce loss to follow-up.

pmid-7577488.summary_ja: スコットランドの全国調査で、1983〜1988年に登録され1992年までに死亡した精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者55例のカルテを審査した。5施設間で5年生存率に有意差(70.4〜94.2%)があり、全施設で最適とは言えない治療を受けた例があった。症例数の多い施設ほど不適切な治療が少ない傾向が見られたが、統計的には有意ではなかった。
pmid-7577488.summary_en: This Scottish national mortality study reviewed casenotes of 55 patients with testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumours (NSGCT) diagnosed between 1983 and 1988 who had died by 1992. Management at each of the five oncology centres was assessed for optimality, and details of cause of death were extracted. Five-year survival differed significantly between centres (70.4-94.2%), with two centres performing less well. Some patients at every centre received suboptimal treatment. Centres treating more patients showed a trend toward fewer suboptimal cases, though this was not statistically significant.

pmid-7583387.summary_ja: 1988〜1993年にBEP化学療法を受けた16歳未満の小児胚細胞腫瘍56例を検討した。卵巣腫瘍が22例と最多で、精巣および性腺外はそれぞれ17例だった。完全奏効89.1%、5年生存率83%、無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)93%で、化学療法は忍容性も良好だった。保存的手術と有効な化学療法の併用により、多くの小児が治癒しうると結論した。
pmid-7583387.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 56 children under 16 with germ cell tumors treated with BEP chemotherapy between 1988 and 1993. Ovarian tumors were most common (22 patients), with 17 each having testicular or extragonadal tumors, and endodermal sinus tumor was the most frequent histology. Complete response was 89.1% and partial response 10.9%. Five-year survival was 83% and progression-free survival 93%. Chemotherapy was well tolerated, and conservative surgery combined with effective chemotherapy may cure most children.

pmid-7587744.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎197例をフローサイトメトリーで解析し、臨床病理像と比較した研究である。完全奇胎では大半が二倍体または四倍体、部分奇胎では大半が三倍体であった。完全奇胎の17.4%で持続性疾患が発生し、部分奇胎では発生しなかった。非二倍体性は完全奇胎の独立した予測因子ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-7587744.summary_en: This study applied flow cytometry to 197 formalin-fixed hydatidiform moles, including 150 complete and 47 partial moles. Most partial moles were triploid, while complete moles were mainly diploid or tetraploid. Persistent disease developed in 17.4% of complete moles and in none of the partial moles. Cytometric aneuploidy did not predict clinical outcome in complete moles, so the authors conclude it is not an independent predictor of persistent disease. A literature review is included.

pmid-7588869.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫25例について、CTとMRIの所見を後方視的に比較した研究である。脂肪やロキタンスキー結節の検出が診断の鍵となった。腫瘍の性状診断率はCTが96%、通常のMRが88%、脂肪抑制併用MRが92%で、CTの方が優れていた。脂肪が確認できない場合、ロキタンスキー結節はCTのほうが容易に診断できた。
pmid-7588869.summary_en: This retrospective study compared CT and MR imaging in 25 histologically proven ovarian mature cystic teratomas. Detection of fat and Rokitansky protuberance was the key diagnostic criterion. CT characterized 96% of tumors, compared with 88% for standard MR and 92% with fat-suppression sequences. Standard MR was less effective at identifying fat, and fat mixed with hair was difficult to characterize on either modality. When fat is undetectable, CT more readily identifies a Rokitansky protuberance.

pmid-7589612.summary_ja: 授乳中の32歳の健康な女性が、有痛性の乳房腫瘤を主訴に受診し、絨毛癌と診断された症例報告である。若年女性において、絨毛癌が乳房に病変として出現しうることを示している。乳房は絨毛癌の稀な発症部位であり、授乳期の女性の乳房腫瘤では本疾患も念頭に置く必要がある。抄録には治療や経過の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-7589612.summary_en: This case report describes a previously healthy 32-year-old woman who presented with a tender breast lump while breastfeeding. The mass was diagnosed as choriocarcinoma. The report highlights that choriocarcinoma can present as a breast lesion, a rare site of involvement, in a woman of reproductive age. It is a brief report of a single patient, and the abstract gives no detail on treatment or outcome.

pmid-7589613.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍に由来する上顎歯肉への稀な転移例で、26歳女性が軽度の疼痛と腫瘤で受診した。歯肉生検で診断され、MAC化学療法（メトトレキサート、アクチノマイシンD、シクロホスファミド）を6コース施行した。化学療法終了後2年の時点で再発の所見はない。
pmid-7589613.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman with a gestational trophoblastic neoplasm presented with mild pain and a mass in the maxillary gingiva, a rare metastatic site. Gingival biopsy established the diagnosis. She received six courses of MAC chemotherapy (methotrexate, actinomycin D, and cyclophosphamide). At two years after completion of therapy, she had no evidence of disease. The report documents a rare metastatic pattern of gestational choriocarcinoma and its successful treatment.

pmid-7589744.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の管理に関する現在の考え方を概説したレビューである。用語の標準化、リスク分類、病期分類、β-hCG測定の導入など、これまでの進歩をたどっている。化学療法を中心とした多職種連携と、難治例における手術の役割を強調し、胞状奇胎除去後のフォローアップの重要性を指摘している。
pmid-7589744.summary_en: This review summarizes current views on managing gestational trophoblastic disease. It traces historical advances including standardized terminology, risk assignment, staging systems, centralized care, and the beta-hCG radioimmunoassay. The authors emphasize a multidisciplinary approach, with chemotherapy at the forefront, supported by newer diagnostic tools and surgery for resistant cases. They also stress careful follow-up after hydatidiform mole evacuation and continued refinement of regimens to reduce toxicity.

pmid-7589903.summary_ja: 分化中のTera 2ヒト胎児性癌細胞の増殖に対し、線維芽細胞増殖因子(FGF)が及ぼす作用を検討した基礎研究です。塩基性FGF(bFGF)はDNA合成を促進し、増殖関連抗原Ki 67を誘導しました。分化に伴い増殖促進活性は低下しました。ヘパリン結合性増殖因子が、胚細胞腫瘍細胞の自己分泌・傍分泌による増殖制御に関与することが示唆されています。
pmid-7589903.summary_en: The authors examined how fibroblast growth factors regulate proliferation of differentiating Tera 2 human embryonal carcinoma cells. Exogenous basic FGF stimulated DNA synthesis and induced Ki 67 in differentiated cells. Heparin-binding growth factors from undifferentiated cells had similar effects, and bFGF was detected in these cells. Growth-promoting activity decreased during differentiation. The results suggest that heparin-binding growth factors contribute to autocrine or paracrine growth regulation of teratocarcinoma cells.

pmid-7590607.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛癌細胞株CC1にH-rasまたはK-rasがん遺伝子を導入し、絨毛癌細胞の性質への影響を検討した研究です。H-ras導入株ではNa+-K+-ATPase活性の亢進に伴うドーム形成が見られ、K-ras導入株ではヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の分泌が増加しました。ras遺伝子が異なる機能を担うことが示唆されています。
pmid-7590607.summary_en: The author transfected viral H-ras or K-ras oncogenes into the human choriocarcinoma cell line CC1 to examine effects on trophoblast-like traits. H-ras-expressing clones formed fluid-filled domes, consistent with augmented Na+-K+-ATPase-driven vectorial transport. K-ras-expressing clones secreted significantly more hCG, suggesting roles in endocrine function. The findings indicate that H-ras and K-ras contribute differently to choriocarcinoma cell biology, with implications for trophoblastic differentiation and fluid transport.

pmid-7591258.summary_ja: 増幅法を用いて、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の組織および絨毛癌におけるヒトパピローマウイルス(HPV)16型と18型のDNAを検討した研究です。HPV16型は全例で陰性でした。HPV18型は胞状奇胎の2/11例と絨毛癌の4/8例で検出され、一部の症例で発がんに関与する可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-7591258.summary_en: The authors used amplification-based DNA methods to examine human papillomavirus (HPV) types 16 and 18 in gestational trophoblastic tissues and choriocarcinomas. HPV16 was absent in all samples. HPV18 was not detected in normal placentas or invasive moles, but was found in 2 of 11 hydatidiform moles and 4 of 8 choriocarcinomas. The results suggest that HPV18 may be involved in the carcinogenesis of some gestational trophoblastic tumors.

pmid-7591575.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍が下大静脈へ浸潤し、血栓症として発症した稀な症例の報告です。化学療法を4コース施行後、下大静脈を閉塞していた腫瘍は瘢痕組織に置き換わりました。精巣腫瘍の患者では、下大静脈閉塞も念頭に置く必要があることを示しています。
pmid-7591575.summary_en: The authors report an unusual case of testicular tumour presenting as thrombosis of the inferior vena cava caused by direct tumour invasion. This is a rare presentation of testicular tumour. After four cycles of chemotherapy, the invasive tumour that obstructed the vena cava was replaced by scar tissue, indicating a favorable response. The case highlights that vena cava obstruction should be considered in patients with testicular neoplasms.

pmid-7591576.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍で治療された210例のうち、6例(2.9%)に対側精巣腫瘍が異時性に発生したと報告しています。発症までの間隔は1年から22年でした。疫学、組織像、診断、治療、予後を考察し、残存精巣の定期的な自己検査の重要性を強調しています。
pmid-7591576.summary_en: The authors describe bilateral germ cell tumours of the testis, a rare condition whose incidence may rise as prognosis improves. Of 210 patients treated for malignant germ cell tumours, six (2.9%) developed a contralateral testicular tumour, all metachronously, with intervals from 1 to 22 years. The paper reviews epidemiology, histology, diagnosis, therapy and prognosis. It emphasizes regular self-examination of the remaining testis in patients treated for testicular tumour.

pmid-7591577.summary_ja: 女性化乳房を主訴に受診した34歳男性の症例です。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)が高値でした。担当医の診療中に病変が自然退縮し、精巣の連続切片で0.8mmの絨毛癌および胎児性癌の病巣が見つかり、微小精巣腫瘍と診断されました。自然退縮について文献的考察を加えています。
pmid-7591577.summary_en: A 34-year-old man presented with gynaecomastia and markedly elevated alpha-fetoprotein, human chorionic gonadotropin, oestradiol and prolactin. He had a history of testicular pain and mass, and the lesion regressed spontaneously under a physician's care. Serial sections of the testis revealed a 0.8 mm lesion of chorionic and embryonal carcinoma, establishing a diagnosis of microscopic testicular tumour. The authors discuss spontaneous regression with a literature review.

pmid-7591598.summary_ja: 導入化学療法後も腫瘍マーカーが陰性化しなかった非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の21例に対し、サルベージ後腹膜リンパ節郭清術を施行した結果を報告しています。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が100ng/ml未満の症例では有用性が高く、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)陽性またはAFPが500ng/ml超の症例は全例腫瘍死しました。不完全切除例もすべて腫瘍死に至りました。
pmid-7591598.summary_en: The authors reviewed 21 of 100 patients with advanced testicular cancer who underwent salvage retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy after inductive chemotherapy failed to normalize tumour markers. Low AFP titres below 100 ng/ml predicted benefit, whereas elevated hCG or AFP above 500 ng/ml led to death from tumour. Viable residues were found in 81%, and every incomplete resection was followed by tumour death. Persistent marker positivity after multiple PVB cycles indicated therapy-resistant disease.

pmid-7591890.summary_ja: 1964年から1988年に精巣摘除術と術後放射線療法を受けた早期セミノーマ128例を、中央値11.7年追跡した研究です。精巣以外の二次悪性腫瘍は9例で発生しました。全体のリスクは一般人口と比較して有意な上昇は認めませんでしたが、照射後11〜15年の期間ではリスクが上昇していました。
pmid-7591890.summary_en: This study followed 128 patients with early-stage testicular seminoma treated by orchiectomy and postoperative irradiation between 1964 and 1988, with median follow-up of 11.7 years. Nine second nontesticular malignancies occurred. Overall risk did not reach significance compared with the general population (O/E 2.09), but risk was elevated 11 to 15 years after radiation (O/E 4.45). Median latency was 11 years for tumours outside the irradiated field and 14 years within or near it.

pmid-7593809.summary_ja: Muir-Torre症候群の男性で、再発性の眼部皮脂腺癌の後に精巣セミノーマを発症した症例を報告。既報の泌尿生殖器腫瘍を伴う男性例も併せて検討された。11例の検討では泌尿生殖器腫瘍が初発の悪性腫瘍であった。皮脂腺腫瘍の患者では、無症状の内臓悪性腫瘍を検索すべきと結論づけられている。
pmid-7593809.summary_en: This report describes a man with Muir-Torre syndrome who had recurrent ocular sebaceous carcinoma and later developed seminoma, a testicular germ cell tumor. The authors review previously published men with Muir-Torre syndrome and genitourinary tumors. In 11 men, a genitourinary neoplasm was the initial malignant internal tumor, and in five it preceded the sebaceous gland tumor diagnosis. The authors conclude that patients with Muir-Torre-associated sebaceous tumors should be evaluated for occult visceral malignancy.

pmid-7595727.summary_ja: 病理学的病期IIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清で高リスク所見を有し完全切除された50例に、EP療法2コースを補助化学療法として投与した。全例が中央値35か月のフォローアップで再発なく生存し、毒性は許容範囲であった。N2bおよびN3病変に対する有効な補助療法の選択肢と結論づけられている。
pmid-7595727.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of two cycles of etoposide plus cisplatin (EP) given as adjuvant therapy to 50 patients with completely resected pathologic stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumors and high-risk nodal features found at retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. All patients were alive and relapse-free at a median follow-up of 35 months. Treatment was well tolerated, with nadir fever in 10% and no grade II or greater neurologic, renal, or pulmonary toxicity. The authors conclude that EP is an effective adjuvant option for N2b and N3 disease, alongside standard PVB or VAB-6 chemotherapy and observation.

pmid-7595728.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1986年から1994年にイタリアのGICATで治療された、HIV感染を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍の男性26例を解析した。セミノーマが14例、非セミノーマが12例であった。多くは精巣摘除術の後に化学療法または放射線療法を受け、完全奏効率は95%であった。再発は32%に生じ、3年全生存率は65%であった。重度の血液毒性が頻繁に認められた。著者らは、HIV感染患者もHIVの状況にかかわらず標準的な治療を受けるべきであり、日和見感染の予防を併用すべきであると結論づけている。
pmid-7595728.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzes 26 HIV-infected men with testicular germ cell tumors treated within the Italian Cooperative Group on AIDS and Tumors between 1986 and 1994. Fourteen had seminoma and twelve had nonseminoma. Most underwent orchidectomy followed by chemotherapy or radiotherapy, with a 95% complete response rate. Relapse occurred in 32%, and the 3-year overall survival was 65%. Severe hematologic toxicity was common. The authors conclude that HIV-infected patients should receive standard oncologic therapy regardless of HIV status, with prophylaxis for opportunistic infections.

pmid-7595739.summary_ja: セミノーマの化学療法後に残存する腫瘤が、生存腫瘍か壊死性線維組織かをガリウムシンチグラフィで鑑別できるかを検討。27例中、治療前にガリウム陽性であった19例は全例で化学療法後に正常化したが、再発例も認められた。転移性セミノーマの評価における有用性は限定的と結論づけられている。
pmid-7595739.summary_en: This study evaluates whether gallium scans can distinguish viable tumor from necrotic fibrous tissue in residual masses after chemotherapy for seminoma. Of 27 assessable patients, all 19 with gallium-avid tumors before treatment normalized their scans after chemotherapy, yet several patients who normalized still recurred. Eight patients had false-negative scans at diagnosis despite obvious metastatic disease. The authors conclude that gallium scanning has minimal value in the pre- or postchemotherapy evaluation of metastatic seminoma, and that CT and clinical follow-up remain essential.

pmid-7596049.summary_ja: 18歳女性の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫で、高カルシウム血症とPTH-rPの上昇を認めた症例報告。初回手術後にブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法を6コース実施した。化学療法終了後約30か月の時点で再発はみられていない。PTH-rPによる高カルシウム血症が本腫瘍の傍腫瘍症候群となりうることを示す。
pmid-7596049.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with ovarian dysgerminoma who presented with hypercalcemia and elevated serum parathyroid hormone-related protein (PTH-rP) alongside other tumor markers. After primary surgery she received six cycles of bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Approximately 30 months after completing chemotherapy, she remained free of recurrence. The report highlights that PTH-rP-mediated hypercalcemia can be a paraneoplastic feature of ovarian germ cell tumors and may serve as a marker of disease activity during follow-up.

pmid-7596070.summary_ja: 後腹膜卵黄嚢腫瘍を切除した後、CTでは転移が確認されなかったがAFPの上昇が持続した症例。67Gaシンチグラフィーで腹腔・骨盤内に多発集積を認め、18F-FDG-PETでも広範な取り込みが確認された。画像所見は剖検所見と一致し、潜在性の腹膜転移の検出と分布把握に有用であった。
pmid-7596070.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with a resected primary retroperitoneal yolk sac tumor who developed peritoneal metastases while serum alpha-fetoprotein remained elevated and CT showed no metastatic lesions. A 67Ga scan revealed multiple abdominopelvic hot spots, and FDG-PET showed extensive intraabdominal and intrapelvic uptake. The imaging findings corresponded to postmortem findings, indicating that these modalities can detect occult peritoneal dissemination and clarify its distribution, complementing conventional CT in germ cell tumor follow-up.

pmid-7597428.summary_ja: 奇形癌細胞株833Kとシスプラチン耐性株を用いて、パクリタキセルの細胞傷害性を検討した。特にシスプラチン耐性細胞に対して強い効果を示し、シスプラチンやヒドロキシペルオキシシクロホスファミドとの相乗効果が示唆された。既治療の胚細胞腫瘍31例の第II相試験では26%に完全または部分奏効を認め、イホスファミドと白金製剤との併用によるサルベージ療法の検討につながった。
pmid-7597428.summary_en: This study evaluated paclitaxel in germ cell cancer using the teratocarcinoma cell line 833K and its cisplatin-resistant subline. Paclitaxel showed marked cytotoxicity, especially against cisplatin-resistant cells, and demonstrated synergy with cisplatin and 4-hydroperoxycyclophosphamide in vitro. In a phase II trial of 31 previously treated patients with germ cell tumors, paclitaxel given as a 24-hour infusion produced major responses in 26 percent. These results led to combination studies with ifosfamide and platinum as salvage therapy.

pmid-7597877.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫は縦隔腫瘍の8〜13%を占める稀な腫瘍で、若年成人の前縦隔に多い。無気肺、隣接構造の圧迫、悪性転化の可能性がある場合は手術が推奨される。外科的切除後の治療成績は良好である。本稿は症例報告ではなく、良性嚢胞性奇形腫の臨床的特徴と治療方針を概説している。
pmid-7597877.summary_en: This paper reviews benign cystic teratoma as an uncommon cause of anterior mediastinal mass. Mediastinal teratomas are rare, accounting for 8 to 13 percent of mediastinal tumors, and typically occur in the anterior mediastinum of young adults. The authors recommend surgery whenever complications such as lung atelectasis, compression of adjacent structures, or possible malignant transformation are present. Surgical resection yields excellent outcomes, and the paper is a discussion of clinical features and management rather than a detailed case series.

pmid-7599055.summary_ja: イングランド西ミッドランズ地域で1957〜1992年に診断された小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍102例を解析した。年齢調整発生率は1975〜1992年に有意に上昇し、10〜14歳と卵黄嚢腫瘍で増加が目立った。都市部で発生率が高く、産業・都市環境の関与が示唆された。
pmid-7599055.summary_en: This population-based study from the West Midlands region of England analyzed 102 malignant germ cell tumors diagnosed in children between 1957 and 1992. The age-standardized incidence rose significantly from 1.6 per million per year in 1957 to 1974 to 3.6 per million per year in 1975 to 1992, with particular increases among children aged 10 to 14 and in yolk sac tumors. Geographic analysis showed higher rates in urban conurbation areas, suggesting that industrial or urban factors may contribute, and the authors recommend further studies in these areas.

pmid-7599789.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前浸潤段階である精巣上皮内癌（CIS）におけるGb3の発現を検討した。CIS 17検体中12検体（70.6%）、浸潤性腫瘍12検体中8検体（66.7%）でGb3の蓄積を認めた。糖脂質組成は前浸潤段階で変化し、Gb3は腫瘍関連抗原であることが確認された。
pmid-7599789.summary_en: This study examined globotriaosylceramide (Gb3), a globo-series glycolipid, in testicular carcinoma in situ, the preinvasive stage of testicular germ cell tumors. Gb3 was detected in 70.6 percent of 17 CIS specimens and in 66.7 percent of 12 invasive tumors, including seminoma, nonseminoma, and combined germ cell tumors. The findings indicate that glycolipid composition shifts at the preinvasive stage and confirm Gb3 as a tumor-associated antigen in testicular germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-7603399.summary_ja: 播種性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に生じた、転移性胎児性癌による動脈塞栓で急性肢虚血を来した症例報告。腸骨大腿動脈系への腫瘍塞栓は胚細胞腫瘍では報告がなかった。外科的塞栓摘出術で治療された。胚細胞腫瘍患者の突然の肢虚血では腫瘍塞栓を考慮すべきと強調されている。
pmid-7603399.summary_en: This case report describes acute limb ischemia caused by arterial embolism of metastatic embryonal carcinoma in a patient with disseminated germ cell tumor. Tumor embolization to the iliac-femoral arterial system had not previously been reported in germ cell tumors. The patient was treated with surgical embolectomy. The authors highlight that sudden limb ischemia in a patient with germ cell tumor should prompt consideration of tumor embolism, as it is a rare but serious complication.

pmid-7605174.summary_ja: 69歳女性の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（卵巣）に生じた小細胞性類表皮癌の症例報告。上皮マーカー陽性、ビメンチンおよび神経内分泌マーカー陰性で、他の卵巣小細胞腫瘍と鑑別される。メラノサイトは隣接する奇形様青色母斑への浸潤により集簇し、色素は産生ではなく移行によるものであった。経過は非侵襲的であった。
pmid-7605174.summary_en: A 69-year-old woman had a rare small-cell epidermoid carcinoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The tumor consisted of uniform small cells with focal keratinization, was positive for epithelial markers, and was negative for vimentin and neuroendocrine markers, distinguishing it from other ovarian small-cell tumors. Melanocytes colonized the tumor by invading an adjacent teratoid blue nevus, with pigment transferred rather than produced by the neoplastic cells. The tumor behaved in a nonaggressive fashion.

pmid-7609148.summary_ja: p53タンパク質が過剰発現する精巣胚細胞腫瘍について、p53遺伝子変異の有無を検討した。顕微解剖したパラフィン切片と凍結組織を解析し、エクソン5〜8をPCRとcold SSCPで評価した。サイレント変異（コドン140）の1例を除き変異は検出されず、p53タンパク質の増加は野生型であることが示唆された。
pmid-7609148.summary_en: Testicular germ cell tumors overexpressing p53 protein were examined for p53 gene mutations in 30 specimens from 26 patients. Microdissected archival tissue (11 cases) and fresh-frozen tissue (19 cases) were analyzed for exons 5 to 8 by PCR and cold SSCP. No mutations were found except a silent codon 140 change in one seminoma. The authors conclude that testicular tumors show elevated levels of wild-type p53 protein, whose significance remains to be elucidated.

pmid-7609354.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者51例で化学療法前後の精子形成と内分泌機能を評価した。治療前から44.8%が精子濃度低下、16.3%が無精子症であった。化学療法3か月以内には大半が無精子症となり、コース数に応じ障害は悪化した。2年以上経過後に回復する例もあり、血清FSHは上昇した。
pmid-7609354.summary_en: Fifty-one patients with testicular cancer were evaluated for spermatogenesis and endocrine function before and after chemotherapy. Before treatment, 44.8% had sperm concentrations below 20 million/mL and 16.3% were azoospermic. Within three months after chemotherapy, most patients became azoospermic, and damage worsened with more courses. Some recovered sperm counts after two or more years, and serum FSH rose markedly, reflecting spermatogenic damage.

pmid-7609521.summary_ja: 1961〜1993年に診断された卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍20例を検討した。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）が35%と最多であった。病期は60%がIA期だった。90%が無病生存し、5年生存率は93.3%。妊孕性温存を希望する若年女性には、病期分類を伴う温存手術とシスプラチンによる化学療法が推奨された。
pmid-7609521.summary_en: This study of 20 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors (1961 to 1993) found dysgerminoma to be the most frequent histology, at 35%. Most patients had early-stage disease. At follow-up, 90% were alive and disease-free, with an actuarial five-year survival of 93.3%. For young women who wish to preserve fertility, the authors recommend fertility-sparing surgery with complete surgical staging, followed by cisplatin-based chemotherapy if necessary, and for others, hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy.

pmid-7610394.summary_ja: 本総説は胚細胞腫瘍と小細胞肺癌におけるイホスファミドの役割を検討したものである。胚細胞腫瘍では、BEPのブレオマイシンをイホスファミドに置換しても有効性は向上せず毒性が増加した。初回BEPに不応の患者に対するサルベージ療法としてVIPとカルボプラチン/エトポシドの大量化学療法が有望とされる。小細胞肺癌では単剤での奏効率が48〜76%と報告されている。
pmid-7610394.summary_en: This review examines ifosfamide's role in germ cell tumors and small cell lung cancer. In GCT, substituting ifosfamide for bleomycin in BEP did not improve efficacy and increased toxicity. VIP combined with high-dose carboplatin/etoposide shows promise as salvage therapy for patients refractory to first-line BEP. Whether adding ifosfamide to carboplatin/etoposide improves outcomes in multiply relapsed patients remains unclear, and high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell rescue may benefit poor-risk patients. In SCLC, single-agent ifosfamide yields response rates of 48 to 76 percent.

pmid-7611215.summary_ja: セミノーマに対する放射線療法とリンパ節郭清の約20年後に、73歳男性が原発性大動脈十二指腸瘻による大量吐血を来した。剖検では大動脈壁の虚血性壊死と十二指腸の放射線性変化が認められた。放射線療法の既往があれば、原因不明の消化管出血では遠位十二指腸の早期評価を検討すべきである。
pmid-7611215.summary_en: A 73-year-old man developed massive hematemesis from a primary aortoduodenal fistula about 20 years after radiotherapy and para-aortic lymph node dissection for seminoma. Surgery and postmortem examination showed aortic wall ischemic necrosis with dense fibrous encasement and chronic radiation changes of the duodenum. The authors propose radiation contributed to fistula formation and suggest that a radiotherapy history should prompt early visualization of the distal duodenum in unexplained gastrointestinal bleeding.

pmid-7612798.summary_ja: 小児悪性胚細胞腫瘍105例と対照639例を比較した探索的症例対照研究である。正期産児は早産児に比べてリスクが約70〜75%低かった。両親の化学物質・溶剤やプラスチック・樹脂のヒュームへの曝露がリスク上昇と関連した。妊娠中の母体尿路感染症も新たな危険因子として示唆された。
pmid-7612798.summary_en: This exploratory case-control study compared 105 children with malignant germ cell tumors with 639 community controls using Children's Cancer Group data. Risk was about 70 to 75 percent lower for term-born children than preterm children. Maternal and paternal chemical or solvent exposure and plastic or resin fumes were associated with elevated risk. New associations included higher birthweight, prolonged breastfeeding, and maternal urinary infection during pregnancy, while maternal smoking showed an inverse association. The authors suggest in utero hormonal, environmental, and maternal disease influences, pending confirmation.

pmid-7616028.summary_ja: 1960年代から1990年代にかけて治療された縦隔悪性腫瘍を3期間に分けて検討した研究。後期は開胸率と術後生存者数が有意に多く、化学放射線療法後に残存組織を完全切除した9例は良好であった。正確な術前診断と集学的治療が重要で、悪性胚細胞腫瘍も対象に含まれる。
pmid-7616028.summary_en: This series of 214 patients (223 in the title) treated over 34 years for malignant mediastinal tumors is divided into early, intermediate, and late periods. Thoracotomy rates, thoracotomy after preoperative diagnosis, and postoperative survival were significantly higher in the late period. Nine patients receiving chemoradiation who underwent complete resection of residual tissue had good outcomes. The authors conclude that surgery should rest on accurate preoperative diagnosis and multidisciplinary care, particularly for malignant thymoma, malignant lymphoma, and malignant germ cell tumor.

pmid-7617511.summary_ja: 転移性精巣絨毛癌の17歳男性で脈圧の拡大を認めた症例。超音波検査とドプラ解析で、多発肝転移への拡張期の血流流出が判明した。化学療法後に転移が縮小し、脈圧の狭小化と肝臓での流出血流の消失が確認された。
pmid-7617511.summary_en: A 17-year-old boy with widely metastatic testicular choriocarcinoma presented with a widened arterial pulse pressure. Ultrasonography and Doppler analysis showed diastolic runoff flow into multiple large hepatic metastases. After chemotherapy, the metastases diminished, the pulse pressure narrowed, and runoff flow was no longer seen in the liver. The authors note that these cardiovascular findings have not previously been described in association with metastatic vascular malignancies.

pmid-7621717.summary_ja: 縦隔、後腹膜、肝臓、仙骨尾骨部に生じた性腺外胚細胞腫瘍10例を、穿刺吸引生検(FNAB)で診断した研究です。内訳はセミノーマ3例、卵黄嚢腫瘍3例、絨毛癌1例、胎児性癌1例、混合型2例でした。各組織型の細胞学的特徴を示し、免疫細胞化学などで診断を裏付けています。正中部の腫瘤では性腺外胚細胞腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-7621717.summary_en: This study reports ten primary malignant extragonadal germ cell tumors diagnosed by fine-needle aspiration biopsy. Tumors arose in the mediastinum, retroperitoneum, liver, and sacrococcygeal region in patients aged 1 to 54, mostly male. The series comprised three seminomas, three yolk sac tumors, one choriocarcinoma, one embryonal carcinoma, and two mixed germ cell tumors. Characteristic cytologic features for each histology are described, and immunocytochemistry, electron microscopy, and flow cytometry supported the diagnoses. The authors conclude that extragonadal germ cell tumors should be considered in FNAB of midline masses.

pmid-7622118.summary_ja: 同一卵巣に類皮嚢腫と粘液性嚢腫腺腫を伴う卵巣ストルマカルチノイドの54歳女性の症例です。血清CEAは202 ng/ml、CA125は710 U/ml、CA19-9は11,500 U/mlと著明に高値でした。免疫染色では、これらの腫瘍マーカーは甲状腺組織やカルチノイド成分には発現していませんでした。手術後にはマーカー値がカットオフ値未満に低下しています。著者らは、術後のフォローアップにおいてマーカーの経時的測定が有用である可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-7622118.summary_en: This report describes a 54-year-old woman with ovarian strumal carcinoid coexisting with a dermoid cyst and mucinous cystadenoma in the same ovary. Serum CEA, CA125, and CA19-9 were markedly elevated, at 202 ng/ml, 710 U/ml, and 11,500 U/ml. Immunohistochemistry showed these markers were not expressed in the thyroid tissue or carcinoid component. Marker levels fell below cutoff after surgical resection. The authors suggest serial measurement of these tumor markers may be useful for postoperative follow-up.

pmid-7622197.summary_ja: ディスジャーミノーマおよびセミノーマ患者の腫瘍浸潤リンパ球中で、γ/δT細胞が17〜35%を占めることを示した研究です。これらの細胞は肉芽腫性炎症部位に集積し、主にVγ9/Vδ2陽性でした。抗Vδ2抗体で阻害される自己腫瘍傷害活性を示しました。樹立したクローンは自己および同種のディスジャーミノーマを傷害し、TNF-α、GM-CSF、IFN-γを産生しました。著者らは、これらの細胞が腫瘍傷害と肉芽腫形成の両方に関与すると提案しています。
pmid-7622197.summary_en: This study shows that gamma/delta T cells accumulate in tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes and peripheral blood of patients with dysgerminoma and seminoma, comprising 17 to 35% of TILs. These cells often gather in granulomatous inflammation and are mostly Vgamma9/Vdelta2 positive. They mediate autologous tumor killing that is blocked by anti-Vdelta2 antibody. Established clones lysed autologous and allogeneic dysgerminoma, and their supernatants activated monocytes and released TNF-alpha, GM-CSF, and IFN-gamma. The authors propose a role for these cells in both tumor killing and granuloma formation.

pmid-7622418.summary_ja: c-mos遺伝子を欠損したメスマウスは、4〜8か月齢で約30%の頻度で卵巣腫瘍を発生しました。大半は成熟した外胚葉、中胚葉、内胚葉成分を伴う良性の多嚢胞性奇形腫でした。1例は胚外組織のみからなり、2例では悪性成分が腹膜臓器に転移していました。著者らは、単為発生と卵巣奇形腫の発生を関連づけ、c-mos変異がヒト胚細胞腫瘍にも関与する可能性を示唆しています。
pmid-7622418.summary_en: Female mice lacking the c-mos protooncogene developed ovarian tumors at about 30% frequency between 4 and 8 months of age. Most tumors were benign multicystic teratomas with mature ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal components. One tumor consisted only of extraembryonic tissue, and two had malignant components with metastases to peritoneal organs. Because c-mos-deficient mice show parthenogenetic oocyte activation, the authors link parthenogenesis to ovarian teratoma development. They conclude that c-mos mutations may be involved in human germ cell tumors.

pmid-7627721.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の再発例および難治例18例に対し、高用量カルボプラチンを基盤とした救援化学療法を実施したパイロット研究である。完全寛解からの再発例では11例中8例（73%）が救援に成功したが、難治例では7例中1例しか生存しなかった。完全寛解後の再発例には更なる検討の価値があり、難治例にはより強力な治療戦略が必要と結論されている。
pmid-7627721.summary_en: This pilot study evaluated a high-dose carboplatin-based salvage regimen in 18 patients with germ cell cancer: 11 relapsing from complete remission and 7 refractory or with unresectable partial remission. Patients received carboplatin and etoposide, followed by high-dose carboplatin, cyclophosphamide and thiotepa with autologous bone marrow or stem cell support. Eight of 11 relapsing patients (73%) were salvaged, but only 1 of 7 refractory patients survived. The authors conclude that the regimen merits evaluation in relapse from complete remission, while refractory disease may need more intensive strategies.

pmid-7627937.summary_ja: 悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍3例（ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）1例、未熟奇形腫2例）を対象に、バンド染色体解析と第12染色体12p領域のin situハイブリダイゼーションを行った研究である。3例中2例で12p領域の異常が検出された。卵巣と精巣の胚細胞腫瘍の一部に共通の遺伝的起源がある可能性が論じられており、症例数は少ないが、染色体12pの異常が卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の生物学に関与することを示唆する。
pmid-7627937.summary_en: This study analyzed three malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, one dysgerminoma and two immature teratomas, using banded chromosome analysis and in situ hybridization with a chromosome 12p painting probe. Chromosome 12p abnormalities were detected in two of the three cases. The authors discuss a possible shared genetic origin for a subset of malignant ovarian germ cell tumors and testicular germ cell tumors. Although the sample is very small, the findings suggest that chromosome 12p alterations may be relevant to ovarian germ cell tumor biology.

pmid-7637050.summary_ja: フローサイトメトリーで測定した核DNA倍数性が、精巣セミノーマの予後を予測するかを検討した研究です。純粋セミノーマ65例の保存検体を解析し、35%がDNA異数性を示しました。進行例はすべて異数性で、病期Iは病期IIより二倍体の割合が高く、DNA倍数性は予後情報を与える可能性があります。
pmid-7637050.summary_en: This study assessed whether nuclear DNA ploidy measured by flow cytometry predicts prognosis in testicular seminoma. Archival specimens from 65 patients with pure seminoma who underwent radical orchiectomy between 1970 and 1992 were analyzed. Thirty-five percent were DNA aneuploid, and diploidy was more frequent in stage I than stage II tumors. All five patients with tumor progression had aneuploid tumors, three of whom died of disease. The authors conclude that DNA ploidy may provide important prognostic information for testicular seminoma.

pmid-7637051.summary_ja: 臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する経過観察研究の10年成績です。精巣摘除術のみを行った85例を追跡し、29.4%に再発を認めました。後腹膜再発は肺再発より遅れて出現し、胎児性癌の割合などが再発と弱い相関を示しました。欠測データが予後因子に基づく治療判断を損なう可能性も指摘されています。
pmid-7637051.summary_en: This study reports 10-year results of surveillance for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Eighty-five patients with normal post-orchiectomy evaluations were followed after orchiectomy alone. Relapses occurred in 29.4%, with a median disease-free interval of 7 months, and 3.5% died of cancer. Retroperitoneal relapses appeared later than lung relapses. Embryonal carcinoma content, T category, scrotal violation, and vascular invasion showed weak correlations with relapse. The authors note that missing data may compromise therapeutic decisions based on prognostic factors.

pmid-7637230.summary_ja: 両側肺転移を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍の39歳男性に対し、横断胸骨切開術で肺部分切除を行った症例報告です。この術式は良好な術野を提供し、壁側胸膜や横隔膜を含む両側の部分肺葉切除が可能でした。両側性の転移性肺病変に対する徹底的な外科治療として有用と結論されています。
pmid-7637230.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man with bilateral pulmonary metastases from yolk sac tumor who underwent transverse sternotomy. The approach gave excellent exposure for resecting bilateral partial lobes, including parietal pleura and diaphragm. The authors conclude that transverse sternotomy is a beneficial method for thorough surgical treatment of bilateral metastatic lung lesions from germ cell tumors. The report focuses on surgical technique for metastatic disease rather than systemic therapy.

pmid-7640044.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍で前治療に抵抗性となった患者に対し、救援化学療法として大量化学療法(カルボプラチン・エトポシド)を評価した。23例中8例が寛解を維持した。カルボプラチン高用量群では重度の毒性と致死例がみられ、化学療法感受性の患者にはAUC 30 mg·min/mLが推奨された。
pmid-7640044.summary_en: This study evaluated high-dose carboplatin and etoposide with autologous bone marrow stem cell support as salvage therapy for metastatic germ cell tumors that had failed prior chemotherapy. Of 23 patients receiving high-dose treatment, 8 remained in remission. Grade 3/4 toxicity occurred in several patients, including fatal cases at higher carboplatin doses. The authors recommended an AUC of 30 mg·min/mL for further evaluation in chemosensitive patients.

pmid-7640048.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍細胞株を、精巣胚細胞がんの治療に用いられる化学療法薬に曝露した。シスプラチンとエトポシドは、胎児性癌および卵黄嚢腫瘍の細胞株においてアポトーシスを誘導し、DNAのオリゴヌクレオソーム断片化と核の凝縮が認められた。GCT27でのアポトーシスは速やかで、シクロヘキシミドによって阻害されなかった。低用量のイオノマイシンもアポトーシスを誘導し、これらの腫瘍が作用機序の異なる薬剤に感受性であることが示唆された。
pmid-7640048.summary_en: Human germ cell tumor lines were exposed to chemotherapeutic drugs used in testicular germ cell cancer treatment. Cisplatin and etoposide induced apoptosis in embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumor lines, with DNA oligonucleosomal fragmentation and nuclear condensation. Apoptosis in GCT27 was rapid and not blocked by cycloheximide. Low-dose ionomycin also induced apoptosis, suggesting that these tumors are sensitive to agents acting through different mechanisms.

pmid-7640186.summary_ja: 7歳女児が骨盤から発生した性腺外のディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)を呈し、母親は組織学的に同一の下垂体腫瘍の既往があった。患児の血清LDHは診断時に著明に上昇し、治療に伴い低下した。女性血縁者における性腺外ディスジャーミノーマの初報告である。
pmid-7640186.summary_en: A 7-year-old girl presented with an extragonadal dysgerminoma arising from the pelvis, and her mother had previously been treated for a histologically identical pituitary tumor. The child's serum LDH was markedly elevated at presentation and decreased as the tumor responded to treatment, supporting LDH as a tumor marker. Raised LDH with primary extragonadal dysgerminoma had not previously been described, and this is the first report of extragonadal dysgerminoma in female relatives.

pmid-7641112.summary_ja: 閉経後の55歳女性が左側の腹痛で受診した。切除された左卵巣はこぶし大で、壁在結節を伴う類皮嚢腫がみられた。結節は組織学的に肉腫様顆粒膜細胞腫と診断された。同一卵巣内での顆粒膜細胞腫と類皮嚢腫の合併は極めてまれで、術後2年間無病経過である。
pmid-7641112.summary_en: A 55-year-old postmenopausal woman presented with left lower abdominal pain. The resected left ovary, about fist-sized, contained a dermoid cyst with a mural nodule. Histologically, the nodule was a sarcomatoid granulosa cell tumor. The combination of granulosa cell tumor and dermoid cyst within the same ovary is extremely rare. The patient has remained disease-free for two years after surgery.

pmid-7642436.summary_ja: 1964～1989年にフロリダ大学で治療された純粋精巣セミノーマ74例を後方視的に解析した。10年無再発生存率は病期I 91%、病期IIA 93%、病期IIB 83%、病期III 75%であった。再発7例はいずれも照射野内ではなく、救援できたのは2例のみであった。文献的考察では、横隔膜下病変の大きさと縦隔再発の相関が示された。
pmid-7642436.summary_en: A retrospective analysis of 74 patients with pure testicular seminoma treated at the University of Florida from 1964 to 1989. All received irradiation, with chemotherapy reserved for salvage. Ten-year relapse-free survival was 91% for Stage I, 93% for Stage IIA, 83% for Stage IIB, and 75% for Stage III. None of the seven recurrences occurred in irradiated fields, and only two were salvaged. A literature review linked mediastinal recurrence in Stage II to the size of subdiaphragmatic disease, supporting elective mediastinal irradiation in selected cases.

pmid-7649326.summary_ja: XY染色体を持つ27歳の表現型女性が、破裂した腹部腫瘤による血腹で腹痛を訴えた症例である。組織学的には性腺芽腫に卵黄嚢腫瘍とディスジャーミノーマが重なって増殖していた。スワイヤー症候群のこのような症例における腫瘍発生リスクが論じられている。
pmid-7649326.summary_en: This report describes a 27-year-old phenotypically female patient with an XY karyotype (Swyer syndrome) who presented with abdominal pain caused by hemoperitoneum from a ruptured abdominal mass. Histology showed a gonadoblastoma overgrown by both endodermal sinus tumor and dysgerminoma. The authors discuss the risk of neoplasia in such cases.

pmid-7650160.summary_ja: 第1三半期と正期の胎盤、ヒト絨毛癌組織、絨毛癌細胞株3種(Jeg-3、JAR、BeWo)でp53蛋白の発現を免疫組織化学と免疫ブロットで検討した。p53は正常胎盤の一部の栄養膜細胞と、絨毛癌の悪性細胞および細胞株の核で陽性であった。著者らは、p53は悪性腫瘍細胞だけでなく、胎盤の特定の栄養膜細胞集団でも過剰発現していると結論づけている。
pmid-7650160.summary_en: This study examined p53 protein expression using immunohistochemistry and Western blotting in first-trimester and term placentas, human choriocarcinoma tissue, and three choriocarcinoma cell lines (Jeg-3, JAR, BeWo). p53 was detected in some trophoblast populations of normal placenta, as well as in nuclei of malignant choriocarcinoma cells and all three cell lines. The authors conclude that p53 is overexpressed not only in malignant tumor cells but also in certain normal trophoblast populations.

pmid-7650666.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の除去から17年後に血尿で受診した54歳女性で、膀胱の絨毛癌と診断された。経尿道的切除、3剤化学療法、子宮全摘・両側付属器切除を受けた。6か月後にβ-hCGの上昇があり、同部位の再発が判明して部分膀胱切除を行い、12か月後も無病であった。原発性の膀胱絨毛癌か、奇胎からの遅発性転移かは判別できないとしている。
pmid-7650666.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman presented with hematuria 17 years after evacuation of a molar pregnancy and was diagnosed with bladder choriocarcinoma. She underwent transurethral resection, three courses of triple-agent chemotherapy, and total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. A rise in beta-hCG six months later revealed a recurrent tumor at the same site, treated by partial cystectomy; she remained disease-free at 12 months. The authors could not determine whether this was a primary bladder choriocarcinoma or late metastasis from the molar pregnancy.

pmid-7651644.summary_ja: 本単一施設の後方視的研究では、10年間に治療された卵巣胚細胞腫瘍129例の外科的管理を検討した。108例で妊孕性温存手術が行われ、再病期分類により16例で病期が上昇した。全生存期間(全生存率)は96%であった。著者らは、妊孕性温存手術はすべての卵巣胚細胞腫瘍で妥当であり、広範な腫瘍減量手術は未熟奇形腫に限られると結論している。また、有効な化学療法の方が重要で、セカンドルック手術の有用性は限定的だとしている。
pmid-7651644.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 129 women with ovarian germ cell tumors over ten years examined surgical management. Fertility-sparing surgery was performed in 108 patients, and restaging increased the stage in 16 of 85 evaluated patients. Overall survival was 96% with a mean follow-up of 55 months. The authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery is warranted in all ovarian germ cell tumors since it does not affect recurrence or survival. Extensive reductive surgery is advisable only for immature teratoma, and effective chemotherapy seems more important than restaging or second-look surgery.

pmid-7654023.summary_ja: 未治療の精巣胚細胞腫瘍18例と正常精巣5例で、グルタチオン関連酵素の活性を比較した。奇形腫を除く多くの腫瘍で活性は正常精巣より大きく低下し、胎児性癌や混合性腫瘍で特に著明であった。奇形腫では活性が比較的保たれていた。著者らは酵素活性の低下が化学療法感受性に関与する可能性を指摘し、奇形腫の予後不良は解毒酵素活性の相対的な高さで説明できるかもしれないとしている。
pmid-7654023.summary_en: This study compared activities of glutathione-related enzymes (GST, glutathione reductase, and selenium-dependent and independent glutathione peroxidase) in 18 untreated testicular germ cell tumors and five normal testes. Most tumor types had markedly lower activity than normal testis, with the largest reductions in embryonal carcinoma and mixed tumors. Teratomas were the exception, with GPX activity near normal and GST roughly half of normal. The authors suggest reduced detoxifying capacity may contribute to chemosensitivity, while the higher detoxifying enzyme activity of teratomas may explain their poorer prognosis.

pmid-7654829.summary_ja: 1994年の文献を中心に、小児泌尿生殖器腫瘍の治療と分子生物学の進歩をレビューしている。重点はウィルムス腫瘍、泌尿生殖器横紋筋肉腫、そして精巣の精細管内胚細胞腫瘍である。国際プロトコールと多職種連携による治療の進歩や、腫瘍発生の分子機構に関する知見が紹介されている。
pmid-7654829.summary_en: This review covers the 1994 literature on childhood genitourinary tumors, with emphasis on Wilms tumor, genitourinary rhabdomyosarcoma, and testicular intratubular germ cell neoplasia. It highlights treatment advances through international protocols and a multidisciplinary approach, along with molecular insights into tumorigenesis in Wilms tumor and rhabdomyosarcoma. Testicular intratubular germ cell neoplasia is one of its three focus areas.

pmid-7654831.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の最新知見をまとめたレビューである。794例の症例対照研究では、外傷や感染による萎縮が性腺刺激ホルモンの亢進を介してリスクを高める可能性が示された。停留精巣患者では上皮内癌が見られず生検の必要性は低いとされる。病期Iセミノーマでは放射線療法後の晩期非胚細胞性癌を受けて治療方針が再検討され、カルボプラチン補助療法の有効性も報告された。
pmid-7654831.summary_en: This review summarizes recent findings on testicular germ cell cancer. A case-control study of 794 patients suggests that atrophy from trauma or infection may increase gonadotropin drive, with exercise reducing risk and early puberty increasing it. The value of self-examination education was debated. The absence of carcinoma in situ at orchidectomy in cryptorchid patients argues against biopsy. Late non-germ-cell cancers after radiotherapy prompted reconsideration of management for stage I seminoma, and single-course adjuvant carboplatin in 104 patients showed no relapses at two centers.

pmid-7658184.summary_ja: 低リスク妊娠性絨毛性疾患に対し子宮内容除去術と化学療法を受けた32歳タイ人女性が、2年後に両側頸部リンパ節腫大で受診した。生検と抗酸菌染色により頸部結核性リンパ節炎と診断された。抗結核薬による治療後、絨毛癌の再発も結核の再燃もみられなかった。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の再発と紛らわしい病態として注意が必要である。
pmid-7658184.summary_en: A 32-year-old Thai woman with low-risk gestational trophoblastic disease, treated with evacuation and chemotherapy, presented two years later with bilateral cervical lymphadenopathy suspicious for recurrence. Biopsy and Ziehl-Neelsen staining confirmed cervical tuberculous lymphadenitis, without clinical symptoms of tuberculosis. Antituberculous therapy (2HRZ/4HR) was given, and neither choriocarcinoma relapse nor tuberculous lymphadenitis recurrence was observed. The authors highlight that tuberculous lymphadenitis can mimic GTD recurrence and warrants clinical suspicion.

pmid-7658540.summary_ja: 1985〜1994年の陰嚢超音波検査3,019件中、触知不能な精巣内腫瘤15例を検討した。病理学的にはセミノーマ5例、非セミノーマ6例、消退腫瘍（burned-out）2例などであった。触知不能な精巣内腫瘤は悪性の可能性が高く、後腹膜や内臓の腫瘤を伴う若年男性では超音波検査が推奨されるとしている。
pmid-7658540.summary_en: This study reviewed 15 nonpalpable intratesticular masses detected by scrotal ultrasonography among 3,019 studies performed from 1985 to 1994. Pathology showed 5 seminomas, 6 nonseminomas, 2 burned-out tumors, a lipoma and a granuloma. The authors conclude that impalpable intratesticular masses are likely malignant. Young men with retroperitoneal or visceral masses should undergo scrotal ultrasound, since a primary testicular tumor may have regressed. Persistent scrotal pain also warrants ultrasound evaluation.

pmid-7659308.summary_ja: 消化管出血で受診した80歳男性で、胃原発絨毛癌と肝転移が確認された。文献検索の結果、本症例はこれまでに報告された中で最も高いβ-hCG値を示した。性腺外絨毛癌は稀であるが、hCG高値を伴う胃腫瘤の鑑別に含める必要がある。
pmid-7659308.summary_en: An 80-year-old man presented with gastrointestinal hemorrhage and was found to have primary choriocarcinoma of the stomach with liver metastases. The authors reviewed the literature and noted that this patient had the highest reported level of beta-hCG among published cases. The report underscores that extragonadal choriocarcinoma, although rare, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of gastric masses with markedly elevated hCG. Clinicians should be aware of this entity when evaluating unexplained gastrointestinal bleeding in older patients.

pmid-7660514.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者34例と健常者30例を対象に、凍結保存前後の精液品質を比較した研究である。患者では運動率や精子数が健常者より低く、混合型胚細胞腫瘍で最も不良であった。病期が進むほど精液品質は低下する傾向があり、凍結後の減少率は両群で差がなかった。治療開始前の精子バンキングを推奨している。
pmid-7660514.summary_en: This study compared semen quality before and after cryopreservation in 34 men with testicular cancer and 30 healthy volunteers. Patients had poorer baseline motility and sperm counts than controls, and quality was worst in mixed germ cell tumors and at higher stages. However, the relative decline after freezing was similar in both groups, suggesting cryopreservation does not inherently damage patients' sperm. The authors recommend routine sperm banking for all patients with testicular cancer before treatment begins.

pmid-7660521.summary_ja: 精巣がんに対する根治的精巣摘除術後の出血を経験した3例を報告している。術後の病期分類CTで後腹膜・骨盤内の血腫が転移と誤認され、不適切な治療方針につながりうることを示した。早期の認識と画像解釈時の考慮が、不要な治療を避けるうえで重要であると強調している。
pmid-7660521.summary_en: The authors report three cases from separate institutions in which hemorrhage after radical orchiectomy for testicular cancer formed retroperitoneal and pelvic hematomas. On postoperative staging CT, these hematomas were mistaken for metastatic disease, leading to inaccurate assessment and potentially unnecessary treatment. The paper emphasizes that postoperative hemorrhage should be recognized early and considered when interpreting staging imaging. The authors suggest clinicians be aware of this pitfall to avoid overtreatment.

pmid-7661278.summary_ja: 嚢胞性変化が目立つ胸腺セミノーマ10例を報告している。肉眼的には多房性嚢胞で、炎症を伴う嚢胞壁内に微小な腫瘍巣が認められ、良性の胸腺嚢胞と誤認されやすい。9例で外科的切除が行われ、追跡した5例はいずれも生存していた。前縦隔の嚢胞性病変では十分な標本採取が推奨される。
pmid-7661278.summary_en: The authors describe ten cases of thymic seminoma with prominent cystic change, occurring in males aged 16 to 79. Grossly, the tumors were multilocular cysts up to 19 cm, and microscopic neoplastic foci within inflammatory cyst walls were easily mistaken for benign thymic cysts. Tumor cells were positive for placental alkaline phosphatase. Nine patients underwent complete surgical excision, two received postoperative radiation, and five with follow-up were alive 2 to 19 years later. The authors recommend extensive sampling of anterior mediastinal cystic lesions.

pmid-7661594.summary_ja: 本総説は卵巣の悪性胚細胞腫瘍の現在の管理をまとめたものである。若年女性に多い本腫瘍について、組織型、臨床症状、腫瘍マーカーであるαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)による診断を述べる。治療は手術を第一段階とし、組織型に応じた補助療法を行う。VACとVBPの併用化学療法はいずれも有効である。予後は組織型、病期、残存腫瘍の大きさと関連する。
pmid-7661594.summary_en: This review summarizes current management of malignant germ cell tumors of the ovary, which typically affect young women and grow rapidly. It covers histologic types, clinical presentation, and diagnosis using AFP and hCG. Surgery is the first step, followed by histology-dependent adjuvant chemotherapy, with VAC and VBP regimens highly effective. Dysgerminoma is radiosensitive, and conservative surgery is appropriate for fertility-sparing treatment. Prognosis depends on histology, stage, and residual tumor size.

pmid-7664770.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化胚細胞腫の3例で血清LDHとそのアイソザイムを測定した研究である。LDHは診断時に上昇し、治療後に正常化した。1例では進行時に再上昇がみられた。アイソザイム解析は1例のみで実施され、臨床的有用性は限定的と考えられた。
pmid-7664770.summary_en: The authors measured serum lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) and its isoenzymes in three patients with ovarian dysgerminoma, with isoenzymes analyzed in only one. LDH was elevated at diagnosis and normalized after therapy, remaining low in two patients in remission. In one patient, LDH rose again at progression. The authors conclude that isoenzyme analysis has limited clinical utility. The very small sample size limits the strength of these conclusions.

pmid-7666083.summary_ja: 病期I精巣セミノーマの患者364例を対象とした単施設研究である。194例に補助的放射線療法、172例にサーベイランスを行った。5年全生存率は97%で、セミノーマによる死亡は1例のみであった。放射線療法群の5年無再発率は94.5%、サーベイランス群では27例が進行した。34歳以下の年齢は進行のリスクと関連した。
pmid-7666083.summary_en: This Princess Margaret Hospital series included 364 patients with stage I testicular seminoma, of whom 194 received adjuvant radiation and 172 underwent surveillance. Overall five-year survival was 97%, with only one seminoma death. Relapse occurred in 11 of the irradiated patients (94.5% five-year relapse-free rate), while 27 surveillance patients progressed. Age of 34 years or younger predicted progression on surveillance. Both strategies achieved high cure rates.

pmid-7666328.summary_ja: 在胎29週で出生し、1,350gの仙尾部奇形腫を有した未熟児女児の症例である。組織学的には悪性成分のない未熟奇形腫と診断されたが、剖検で仙骨前方に微小な卵黄嚢腫瘍が見つかった。肉眼的完全切除後に術中死し、生存していれば再発の起点となった可能性があると論じている。
pmid-7666328.summary_en: The authors describe a premature female infant born at 29 weeks with a large 1,350 g sacrococcygeal teratoma. Histology showed a grade 1 immature teratoma with no malignant elements in 26 sections examined. The infant died intraoperatively of cardiovascular complications despite a grossly complete resection. Autopsy revealed a small microscopic yolk sac tumor adjacent to the sacrum, which the authors suggest could have caused recurrence had the infant survived.

pmid-7666332.summary_ja: 本報告は、女児に発生した胃奇形腫の6例目の症例である。胃奇形腫は稀で、男児の奇形腫の約1%を占めるとされる。奇形腫は三胚葉すべての組織に由来し、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の一型として位置づけられる。抄録には臨床経過や治療、転帰の詳細は記載されていない。
pmid-7666332.summary_en: This case report describes the sixth documented occurrence of gastric teratoma, in a female infant. Gastric teratomas are rare, accounting for about 1% of teratomas in boys, and this report extends the limited literature by describing a girl. Teratomas arise from tissues of all three germ layers, which underlies their classification as germ cell tumors arising outside the gonads. The brief abstract provides no further clinical details on presentation, management, or outcome.

pmid-7668946.summary_ja: 33歳女性が不正性器出血で受診した子宮頸部の成熟奇形腫の報告である。病変は気管支、細気管支、肺胞構造を含む成熟肺組織のみから成り、免疫組織化学で呼吸上皮分化が確認された。胎児組織の着床は除外され、異所性組織より腫瘍性病変と判断された。性腺外成熟奇形腫として報告されている。
pmid-7668946.summary_en: This report describes a uterine cervical mature teratoma with pulmonary differentiation in a 33-year-old woman who presented with heavy vaginal bleeding. The lesion consisted entirely of mature lung tissue, including bronchial, bronchiolar, and alveolar structures, and respiratory epithelial differentiation was confirmed by immunohistochemistry. Because there was no prior dilatation and curettage, fetal tissue implantation was excluded. The authors favored a neoplastic process over heterotopia and interpreted the lesion as unilateral lung development in an extragonadal mature teratoma.

pmid-7669575.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍29例について、9種のマイクロサテライト座位を解析した。6例（21%）で異常が認められ、変化は四塩基および三塩基反復で多く、二塩基反復では少なかった。この分布は大腸癌など他癌種とは異なり、精巣胚細胞腫瘍に特徴的な不安定性パターンを示唆する。
pmid-7669575.summary_en: This study screened DNA from 29 testicular germ cell tumours at nine microsatellite loci, comprising dinucleotide, trinucleotide, and tetranucleotide repeats. Abnormalities were found in six patients (21%), with alterations most frequent at tetranucleotide and trinucleotide loci and rare at dinucleotide loci. This pattern differs from the dinucleotide-predominant instability seen in colorectal and other cancers. The findings suggest a distinct mechanism of microsatellite instability in testicular germ cell tumours.

pmid-7669750.summary_ja: ヒト胚細胞腫瘍由来の3種の細胞株を、ヒト胚発生のモデルとして検討した研究である。卵巣奇形癌由来のPA1/NR株は浮遊培養で原始神経外胚葉性ロゼットへ分化した。卵巣未分化胚細胞腫由来のlMa株は絨毛癌に類似し、精巣胎児性癌/卵黄嚢腫瘍由来のNEC14株は多能性を示した。
pmid-7669750.summary_en: This study examines three human germ cell tumor-derived cell lines as potential models of human embryogenesis. Human embryonal carcinoma cells are considered stem cells of germ cell tumors and may share pluripotency with early embryos. The PA1/NR line from ovarian teratocarcinoma differentiates into primitive neuroectodermal rosettes in suspension, the lMa line from an ovarian dysgerminoma resembles choriocarcinoma, and the NEC14 line from testicular embryonal carcinoma/yolk sac tumor shows pluripotency. The authors propose these lines as experimental tools.

pmid-7672699.summary_ja: Institut Gustave Roussyにおける13年間の卵巣未分化胚細胞腫12例の治療経験をまとめた後方視的研究である。術後初回治療として化学療法を受けた6例は全例が無病生存した。再発に対するサルベージ療法を受けた6例では3例が治療不成功となり、治療関連死を含む。
pmid-7672699.summary_en: This retrospective series from the Institut Gustave Roussy reports 12 patients with ovarian dysgerminoma treated with various cisplatin-based chemotherapy regimens over 13 years. Six received primary postoperative chemotherapy and all remained disease-free for 18 to 180 months. Six received salvage chemotherapy for recurrence, with three failures including one toxic death, one primary failure, and one relapse, while three remained disease-free. The authors review the role of chemotherapy in early- and advanced-stage ovarian dysgerminoma.

pmid-7672702.summary_ja: 治療前の末梢血Tリンパ球サブセットを、健常者、上皮性卵巣腫瘍、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍などで比較した研究である。Ia/Ib期の上皮性卵巣癌では活性化CD4+およびCD8+T細胞が増加した。悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍でもCD4+サブセットに同様の増加がみられ、活性化Tリンパ球が発がんや進展に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7672702.summary_en: This study measured peripheral blood T-lymphocyte subsets before therapy in healthy controls, patients with endometriosis, epithelial ovarian tumours, ovarian germ cell tumours, and sex cord-stromal tumours. Activated CD4+ and CD8+ T cells were elevated in stage Ia/Ib epithelial ovarian cancer, and similar CD4+ subset increases appeared in malignant ovarian germ cell tumours. The authors suggest activated T lymphocytes may contribute to oncogenesis and progression of both epithelial ovarian cancer and malignant ovarian germ cell tumours.

pmid-7672706.summary_ja: 標準的多剤併用化学療法と子宮全摘術に抵抗性を示した妊娠性絨毛性疾患の1例である。大量化学療法（シクロホスファミド、エトポシド、メルファラン）と自家骨髄移植を施行された。高度の骨髄抑制の後に完全寛解が得られ、3年間無病で経過している。
pmid-7672706.summary_en: This report describes a patient with gestational trophoblastic disease who failed all standard multiagent chemotherapy and had progressive uterine disease despite total hysterectomy. The patient received high-dose cyclophosphamide, etoposide, and melphalan with autologous bone marrow support. Severe marrow suppression followed, but complete remission was achieved and the patient remained disease-free for three years. The authors suggest high-dose multiagent therapy may optimize the dose-effect relationship for drug-refractory gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-7674089.summary_ja: 小児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍に隣接する精細管を、免疫染色とDNA量測定で解析した研究です。乳児型卵黄嚢腫瘍と奇形腫では上皮内癌様細胞が通常認められず、思春期以降の腫瘍（成人型）とは異なる起源が示唆されました。ただし、乳児型腫瘍の発生機序については、さらなる検討が必要とされています。
pmid-7674089.summary_en: This study examined seminiferous tubules adjacent to childhood testicular germ cell tumours, including 13 infantile yolk sac tumours, five infantile teratomas, and six adolescent tumours. Using immunohistochemistry for carcinoma in situ markers and DNA densitometry, the authors found that adolescent tumours were associated with carcinoma in situ, as in adults, whereas infantile tumours generally were not. They conclude that infantile yolk sac tumours and teratomas likely arise through a fundamentally different mechanism from adolescent and adult germ cell tumours, although their origin remains unresolved.

pmid-7674442.summary_ja: 中耳に発生した側頭骨奇形腫の症例報告です。奇形腫は外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉由来の組織から成る真の腫瘍であり、出生時や小児期の側頭骨腫瘤では鑑別対象に挙げる必要があります。著者らは本症例でコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)の画像診断能を評価し、文献的考察も加えています。
pmid-7674442.summary_en: This report describes a case of a teratoma involving the middle ear, a very rare presentation of temporal bone teratoma. Teratomas, which are true tumours comprising ectodermal, mesodermal and endodermal tissues, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of temporal bone masses at birth or during childhood. The authors evaluated the diagnostic utility of computed tomography and reviewed the relevant literature. The paper highlights imaging features that help identify this rare entity.

pmid-7674997.summary_ja: 新規診断された進行性悪性胚細胞腫瘍の小児11例に、大量シスプラチンとエトポシドを投与した研究です。切除不能であった9例中6例が3コース後に完全寛解し、完全切除を受けました。中央値17か月の追跡期間中に全例が生存しており、大量療法が進行例の制御に有効な可能性が示唆されました。
pmid-7674997.summary_en: This trial assessed high-dose cisplatin and etoposide in children and adolescents with newly diagnosed advanced malignant germ cell tumours. Eleven patients (eight girls, three boys, aged 1 to 16 years) received cycles of cisplatin 30 mg/m2/day and etoposide 120 mg/m2/day every 21 days. Six of nine patients with unresectable tumours achieved complete remission after three cycles and underwent complete resection. With a median follow-up of 17 months, all patients were alive, suggesting that this high-dose regimen is effective in controlling advanced malignant germ cell tumours.

pmid-7675028.summary_ja: 22歳女性の両側副腎に発生した巨大な奇形腫の症例です。血清CA19-9の上昇を認め、両側の腫瘍を手術で切除しました。病理学的にはいずれも成熟奇形腫で、奇形腫内の腸上皮様組織がCA19-9を産生していました。両側性の副腎奇形腫の報告は本症例が初めてとされています。
pmid-7675028.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 22-year-old woman with huge bilateral adrenal teratomas and elevated serum CA19-9. Both tumours were removed surgically, weighing 3976 g on the right and 618 g on the left. Histology showed mature teratoma in both. Immunohistochemistry demonstrated that CA19-9 was produced by intestinal epithelium within the teratoma, explaining the elevated marker. The authors note that this is the first reported case of bilateral adrenal teratoma, as previous reports described only unilateral lesions.

pmid-7695528.summary_ja: 1960～1990年に早期非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍（病期Iおよび病期IIA）と診断され、精巣摘除後に放射線療法のみを受けた117例の後方視的解析です。再発率は病期Iで22.2%、病期IIAで44.4%でした。5年全生存率は84%、無再発生存率は75%でした。著者らは放射線療法単独を廃し、シスプラチン併用化学療法などへ移行すべきと結論しています。
pmid-7695528.summary_en: This study analysed 117 men treated after orchidectomy for stage I or IIA non-seminomatous germ cell tumours of the testis between 1960 and 1990. Most received radiotherapy to para-aortic nodes and ipsilateral hemipelvis, and relapse occurred in 22.2% of stage I and 44.4% of stage IIA patients. Five-year overall and recurrence-free survival were 84% and 75%. Adverse factors included stage IIA disease, undifferentiated elements, tumours under 5 cm, and treatment before 1979. The authors conclude that radiotherapy alone should be abandoned in favour of cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-7695529.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の初診例（セミノーマ183例、非セミノーマ73例）を後方視的に解析し、早期病期における両脚リンパ管造影の意義を検討しました。リンパ管造影は後腹膜リンパ節転移の検出感度が高い一方、現在のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)でも10 mm以上の病変は確実に検出できます。非セミノーマでは腫瘍マーカーや血管侵襲の評価の方が病期分類に重要であり、同施設ではリンパ管造影はほとんど行われていません。
pmid-7695529.summary_en: This retrospective study of 183 seminoma and 73 non-seminomatous germ cell tumour patients evaluated the contribution of bipedal lymphography to the management of early-stage testicular tumours. Lymphography was more sensitive than abdominopelvic CT for detecting small retroperitoneal nodal metastases, but modern CT reliably detects lesions 10 mm or greater. Tumour marker status, vascular invasion and clinical examination were more important than lymphography for staging non-seminomatous disease. Consequently, lymphography is rarely used at this institution, though survival will be monitored.

pmid-7697645.summary_ja: 女性の絨毛癌6例を、染色体分析と12p領域のペインティングプローブを用いたin situハイブリダイゼーション法で検討した細胞遺伝学的研究です。2例で染色体12の異常が認められました。染色体12の異常は女性の泌尿生殖器腫瘍で一般的にみられ、悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍との関連が考察されています。
pmid-7697645.summary_en: This cytogenetic study examined six cases of choriocarcinoma in women using conventional karyotyping and in situ hybridization with a chromosome 12p painting probe. Chromosome 12 abnormalities were found in two cases. Because chromosome 12 aberrations are common in female genitourinary tumours, the authors discuss their findings in relation to malignant ovarian germ cell tumours, although the functional significance of these changes remains unknown.

pmid-7698387.summary_ja: 小さな卵巣良性嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）は、臨床所見や開腹・腹腔鏡下の直視でも見逃されることがあります。著者らは3症例を示し、高分解能超音波検査で典型的な卵巣の所見から同定できることを報告しています。術前の超音波検査において、これらの所見に注意を払うことが診断と治療に重要であるとしています。
pmid-7698387.summary_en: This study highlights the difficulty of detecting small ovarian benign cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) by clinical examination, as they may be missed even on direct inspection at surgery. The authors report three cases illustrating this problem and show that high-resolution ultrasonography can identify these cysts using typical ovarian sonographic signs. They emphasise that preoperative ultrasonography, with attention to these signs, is important for diagnosis and treatment planning.

pmid-7702385.summary_ja: 生後5か月の男児が後腹膜奇形腫を呈し、核型47,XXYからクラインフェルター症候群と診断されました。奇形腫が本症候群の初発徴候となりました。この症候群では縦隔、脳、精巣以外にも胚細胞腫瘍が生じうることを示唆しています。
pmid-7702385.summary_en: The authors report a 5-month-old boy with a retroperitoneal teratoma who was found to have a 47,XXY karyotype, establishing a diagnosis of Klinefelter syndrome. The teratoma was the first clinical sign of the syndrome. Previous reports describe germ cell tumors in the mediastinum, brain, and testes in these patients. This case suggests that germ cell tumors may also arise at other sites, such as the retroperitoneum, in patients with Klinefelter syndrome. Clinicians should consider the syndrome when a germ cell tumor appears at an unusual location.

pmid-7705686.summary_ja: 4歳女児にMayer-Rokitansky-Küster-Hauser症候群と卵巣未熟奇形腫の併存を認めた症例です。画像で囊胞性、石灰化、充実性成分を持つ不均一な腫瘤が確認されました。FIGO病期分類Ia期として右側卵管卵巣摘出術が施行され、病理で未熟奇形腫（グレードII）と確定しました。小児でのこの併存は稀です。
pmid-7705686.summary_en: The authors describe a 4-year-old girl with Mayer-Rokitansky-Kuster-Hauser syndrome and an immature teratoma of the right ovary, classified as FIGO stage Ia. Imaging revealed a heterogeneous mass with cystic, calcified, and solid components. Right salpingo-oophorectomy was performed, and histology confirmed a grade II immature teratoma. Surgery also confirmed agenesis of the upper third of the vagina and the uterus. The report is rare because the combination of Mayer-Rokitansky-Kuster-Hauser syndrome and ovarian germ cell tumor is uncommon in children.

pmid-7710929.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍株3種と大腸癌株3種を用い、シスプラチン耐性の機序を比較した研究です。グルタチオン量はIC50と相関し、総スルフヒドリル量は逆相関するという予想外の結果でした。薬剤を除去して24時間培養後、DNA結合白金が感受性と相関したのは胚細胞腫瘍株のみでした。胚細胞癌の特異的な感受性の原因は未解明です。
pmid-7710929.summary_en: This study compares cisplatin resistance mechanisms in three germ cell tumor cell lines and three colon carcinoma cell lines, chosen to represent intrinsically sensitive and resistant tumors. Cisplatin sensitivity matched clinical behavior. Glutathione levels correlated with IC50, while total sulphydryl content was unexpectedly inversely correlated with IC50. Neither GST, GST pi, nor topoisomerase activity explained sensitivity. After a 24-hour drug-free culture, DNA-bound platinum correlated with IC50 only in germ cell tumor lines. The authors conclude that multiple parameters are needed, but the reason for the unique sensitivity of germ cell carcinoma remains unexplained.

pmid-7712432.summary_ja: インディアナ大学で純粋奇形腫の成人41例を後方視的に検討した研究。臨床病期A症例のRPLNDでは後腹膜転移が16.7%、再発が11.1%に認められた。組織型が純粋奇形腫であっても監視療法を必須とせず、他の非セミノーマ性腫瘍と同様に扱うべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-7712432.summary_en: This retrospective Indiana University series of 41 adults with pure testicular teratoma examines clinical stage A management. Retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis was found in 16.7% of stage A patients undergoing RPLND, with an 11.1% relapse rate. Nearly 37% of referred patients already had advanced disease. The authors conclude that pure teratoma should not automatically mandate surveillance and should be managed like other nonseminomatous tumors.

pmid-7713330.summary_ja: 著者らは、ヒト胎児性癌細胞株NCR-G3に対するモノクローナル抗体6E2を作製した。6E2は精原細胞、卵母細胞、胎児性癌、セミノーマ、ディスジャーミノーマと反応したが、絨毛癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍とは反応しなかった。6E2が認識する抗原は分子量約80kDaの細胞表面タンパク質で、6E2は用量依存的にEC細胞を死滅させた。この分子は腫瘍と正常な胚細胞を結びつけ、EC細胞の生存に関与しうると示唆された。
pmid-7713330.summary_en: The authors generated a monoclonal antibody, 6E2, against the human embryonal carcinoma line NCR-G3. It reacts with spermatogonia, oocytes, embryonal carcinomas, seminomas and dysgerminomas, but not choriocarcinomas or yolk sac tumors. The antigen is an approximately 80 kDa cell surface protein, and 6E2 kills EC cells in a dose-dependent manner. The findings suggest the molecule links germ cell tumors to normal germ cells and may support EC cell survival.

pmid-7714386.summary_ja: 37歳男性の上縦隔セミノーマ症例。腕頭静脈、上大静脈、心膜、左肺に浸潤していた。ePTFE人工血管と心膜パッチで血管再建を伴う完全切除を行い、予防的に45Gyを照射した。術後2年で人工血管の閉塞が見られたが、45か月時点で再発はない。
pmid-7714386.summary_en: A 37-year-old man had a superior mediastinal seminoma invading the brachiocephalic veins, superior vena cava, pericardium, and left lung. En bloc resection with vascular reconstruction using an ePTFE graft and pericardial patch was performed, followed by prophylactic irradiation of 45 Gy. Pathology confirmed pure seminoma. Venography at two years showed graft obstruction and stenosis, but at 45 months the patient remained free of recurrence and symptoms.

pmid-7714992.summary_ja: 病期III胚細胞腫瘍の男性が化学療法中に大動脈仮性動脈瘤破裂を起こした。緊急の経皮的ステントグラフト留置で大量出血を制御し、化学療法を完遂した。腫瘍マーカー正常化後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清と動脈瘤切除を行い、病理では線維化のみであった。1年後も病勢の証拠はない。
pmid-7714992.summary_en: A man with stage III germ cell tumor developed a ruptured aortic pseudoaneurysm mid-course of systemic chemotherapy. Emergency percutaneous placement of an aortic stent-graft controlled life-threatening hemorrhage, allowing him to complete chemotherapy. After tumor marker normalization, he underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with resection of the pseudoaneurysm. Final pathology showed only fibrosis, and follow-up angiography at one year showed a patent stent-graft with no evidence of disease.

pmid-7715008.summary_ja: 本研究では、臨床病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の患者93例について、原発腫瘍の定量的な組織学的特徴にニューラルネットワーク解析を適用した。特徴には、血管、リンパ管、被膜への浸潤、および胎児性癌、卵黄嚢癌、奇形腫、セミノーマの割合が含まれた。独自に作成したバックプロパゲーションネットワークは93例中86例(92%)を正しく病期分類した。市販ソフトウェアの成績は劣り、著者らは本手法の前向き検証の必要性を提起している。
pmid-7715008.summary_en: This study applied neural network analysis to quantitative histologic features of primary tumors from 93 clinical stage I nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumor patients. Features included vascular, lymphatic, and tunical invasion and the percentages of embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac carcinoma, teratoma, and seminoma. The custom backpropagation network correctly staged 86 of 93 patients (92%). Commercial software performed less well, and the authors call for prospective validation of the approach.

pmid-7715010.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍30例を対象に、11番染色体短腕(11p)の多型マーカーを用いて対立遺伝子欠失を解析した。11pのヘテロ接合性消失は適格試料の59%、WT1のヘミ接合性消失は27%に認められた。精巣がん細胞株ではWT1転写産物の発現が著しく低下していた。11p13および11p15領域に、精巣がんの発生に関わる腫瘍抑制遺伝子が存在する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-7715010.summary_en: This study examined allelic loss on chromosome 11p in 30 testicular malignancies from 19 patients, using six polymorphic probes and WT1 gene-dosage analysis. Loss of heterozygosity at 11p was seen in 59% of informative samples, and WT1 hemizygosity in 27%. Northern blot analysis of WT1 expression in normal testis and four testicular cancer cell lines showed reduced or absent transcripts in several lines. The authors conclude that 11p13 and 11p15 likely harbor tumor suppressor genes important in testicular cancer development.

pmid-7715906.summary_ja: 香港の2施設で治療された中国人の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍患者52例を後方視的に検討した。病期I・IMの29例の3年生存率は96%、病期II以上の23例では54%であった。患者背景を欧米人集団と比較し、予後因子と最適な治療体制について考察している。
pmid-7715906.summary_en: This retrospective review describes 52 Chinese patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumour of testis treated at two Hong Kong institutions. Patients with stage I or IM disease had a 3-year survival of 96% (median follow-up 49 months), while those with stage II or higher had 54% (median follow-up 21 months). The authors compare patient characteristics with a Western population, discuss factors influencing outcome, and outline recommendations for optimal multidisciplinary care, emphasizing that combination chemotherapy achieves excellent cure rates.
